articles.title: UN human rights chief urges better protection of civilians in conflicts

paras.en: UN human rights chief urges better protection of civilians in conflicts
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员敦促在冲突中更好地保​​护平民

paras.en: Youth-led protests against corruption and inequality in Serbia, Bangladesh, Nepal and Madagascar reflect a growing demand for reinforcing human rights around the world, UN human rights chief Volker Türk said at a press briefing on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克在周三的新闻发布会上表示，塞尔维亚、孟加拉国、尼泊尔和马达加斯加青年领导的反对腐败和不平等的抗议活动反映了世界各地加强人权的需求日益增长。

paras.en: “The vast majority of people care about human rights [and] reject cruelty,” he said, noting that many advocates nonetheless feel isolated and disconnected from each other.
paras.zh: 他说：“绝大多数人关心人权并拒绝残酷行为。”他指出，尽管如此，许多人权倡导者仍然感到孤立和彼此脱节。

paras.en: Taking questions from journalists, he addressed crises around the world and called for greater respect for international law, especially with regard to the rights of civilians trapped in conflict zones.
paras.zh: 在回答记者提问时，他谈到了世界各地的危机，并呼吁更加尊重国际法，特别是在冲突地区平民的权利方面。

paras.en: Mr. Türk reiterated deep concern over the situation in Gaza, where Palestinians are now confined to around 30 per cent of the territory, face severe shortages of food and essential services and continue to be killed by Israeli forces.
paras.zh: 图尔克先生重申对加沙局势深表关切，巴勒斯坦人目前被限制在约 30% 的领土内，面临粮食和基本服务严重短缺，并继续遭到以色列军队的杀害。

paras.en: He urged the next Israeli Government, following Tuesday’s election, to “change the course of warfare” and respect international humanitarian law.
paras.zh: 他敦促下届以色列政府在周二的选举后“改变战争进程”并尊重国际人道主义法。

paras.en: He also rejected accusations that the UN only condemns Israel, stressing that it has repeatedly denounced the 7 October attacks and closely monitors abuses by Hamas and Palestinian authorities. He expressed particular concern over reports of extrajudicial executions by Hamas militants.
paras.zh: 他还驳斥了有关联合国只谴责以色列的指控，强调联合国已多次谴责10月7日的袭击事件，并密切监视哈马斯和巴勒斯坦当局的侵权行为。他对哈马斯武装分子法外处决的报道表示特别关注。

paras.en: Asked what leverage the UN can have in the crucial relationship with a future Israeli Government that controls aid flows, Mr. Türk said monitoring activities in Gaza, the West Bank, Lebanon and Syria were “extremely important” since it kept decision making factual and make sure the world was properly informed.
paras.zh: 当被问及联合国在与控制援助流动的未来以色列政府的关键关系中可以发挥什么影响力时，图尔克表示，监测加沙、约旦河西岸、黎巴嫩和叙利亚的活动“极其重要”，因为它可以保证决策的真实性，并确保世界得到适当的信息。

paras.en: Mr. Türk also expressed deep concern over rising attacks on Ukrainian civilians, warning that casualties could reach their highest levels since 2022 amid intensified drone warfare.
paras.zh: 图尔克还对针对乌克兰平民的袭击事件不断增加深表担忧，并警告称，随着无人机战争的加剧，伤亡人数可能达到 2022 年以来的最高水平。

paras.en: Attacks on electricity grids – particularly devastating for older people and people with disabilities – have been compounded by strikes on railway infrastructure and supermarkets.
paras.zh: 对电网的攻击——对老年人和残疾人来说尤其具有破坏性——加上对铁路基础设施和超市的袭击，加剧了这种情况。

paras.en: “I often feel there is no empathy about the plight of the civilians in Ukraine,” he said, urging greater attention to human rights in ceasefire and peace negotiations.
paras.zh: 他说：“我经常感到人们对乌克兰平民的困境没有同情心。”他敦促在停火与和平谈判中更多地关注人权。

paras.en: Asked whether Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and other civilian infrastructure constitute war crimes, Mr. Türk said targeting civilian sites “raise[s] questions of war crimes” since they are not clearly military targets.
paras.zh: 当被问及胡塞武装对沙特机场和其他民用基础设施的袭击是否构成战争罪时，图尔克表示，针对民用场所的攻击“引发了战争罪问题”，因为它们显然不是军事目标。

paras.en: He also called for the immediate and unconditional release of 71 UN workers detained by the Houthis, expressing concern over reports of “very, very dire” conditions in detention centres under their control.
paras.zh: 他还呼吁立即无条件释放被胡塞武装拘留的 71 名联合国工作人员，并对胡塞武装控制下的拘留中心条件“非常非常恶劣”的报道表示担忧。

articles.title: Civilians in Sudan’s El Obeid trapped between drones and incarceration

paras.en: Civilians in Sudan’s El Obeid trapped between drones and incarceration
paras.zh: 苏丹埃尔奥贝德的平民被困在无人机和监禁之间

paras.en: Civilians in Sudan’s El Obeid live in constant fear of drone attacks by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and of a wave of arbitrary arrests by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), UN-appointed independent investigators said on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 联合国任命的独立调查人员周三表示，苏丹奥贝德的平民一直生活在对快速支援部队（RSF）的无人机袭击和苏丹武装部队（SAF）的一波任意逮捕的恐惧之中。

paras.en: They warned that the war is becoming more geographically extensive, technologically sophisticated and increasingly dangerous for civilians.
paras.zh: 他们警告说，战争的地理范围越来越广，技术越来越复杂，对平民来说也越来越危险。

paras.en: “Thousands have been arrested by SAF security cells, detained and tortured in unofficial locations and in El Obeid Central Prison, kept under appalling conditions,” said Mona Rishmawi, an expert member of the Independent International Fact-Finding Mission for the Sudan, during a press briefing.
paras.zh: 苏丹独立国际实况调查团专家成员莫娜·里什马维在新闻发布会上表示：“数千人被苏丹武装部队安全小组逮捕，在非官方地点和奥贝德中央监狱被拘留和遭受酷刑，关押条件极其恶劣。”

paras.en: “These practices must stop immediately.”
paras.zh: “这些做法必须立即停止。”

paras.en: The Mission released its new report, Sudan’s Unrelenting War: Civilian Devastation and Deepening Insecurity in El Obeid, after presenting its September findings on external support for the warring parties to the General Assembly’s Third Committee.
paras.zh: 调查团在向大会第三委员会提交了 9 月份关于交战各方外部支持的调查结果后，发布了新报告《苏丹无情的战争：奥贝德的平民破坏和日益加深的不安全局势》。

paras.en: The report found that RSF drone strikes continue to kill and injure civilians in El Obeid, damaging homes, schools, displacement sites and electricity and water systems, and may amount to war crimes.
paras.zh: 报告发现，无国界医生组织的无人机袭击继续造成奥贝德平民伤亡，破坏房屋、学校、流离失所地点以及电力和供水系统，并可能构成战争罪。

paras.en: Only around 30 per cent of hospitals in the city remained operational after attacks, one expert told the Mission.
paras.zh: 一位专家告诉调查团，该市只有约 30% 的医院在袭击后仍在运营。

paras.en: The brutal conflict between the former allies turned rival militaries, first erupted in April 2023.
paras.zh: 这两个前盟友变成了敌对军队之间的残酷冲突于 2023 年 4 月首次爆发。

paras.en: At the same time, SAF-affiliated security actors have intensified surveillance and targeted people engaged in humanitarian, human rights and peace work.
paras.zh: 与此同时，苏丹武装部队附属安全人员加强了监视，并针对从事人道主义、人权与和平工作的人员。

paras.en: El Obeid Central Prison reportedly holds some 2,000 people against a capacity of about 450, with one former detainee describing up to 40 people confined in a cell measuring roughly 2.5 by 2 metres.
paras.zh: 据报道，奥贝德中央监狱关押着约 2,000 人，容量约为 450 人，据一名前被拘留者描述，一间面积约为 2.5 x 2 米的牢房内关押着多达 40 人。

paras.en: The mission is also investigating a drone attack on a market in Abyei on 19 October, reportedly by forces of the military government, which killed at least 80 people, as well as reported Egyptian airstrikes on gold mining sites near the Sudan-Egypt border that killed at least 72 miners.
paras.zh: 该特派团还在调查 10 月 19 日对阿卜耶伊市场的无人机袭击，据报道是军政府部队发动的，造成至少 80 人死亡；据报道，埃及对苏丹-埃及边境附近的金矿进行空袭，造成至少 72 名矿工死亡。

paras.en: Asked who was supplying weapons, mission chair Mohamed Chande Othman said investigators had found evidence that individuals and entities in Chad, Puntland in Somalia, southeastern Libya and the United Arab Emirates were involved in a transnational network supporting the RSF, though the UN Human Rights Council-appointed investigators had not “linked any of the neighbouring States.”
paras.zh: 当被问及谁在提供武器时，任务团主席穆罕默德·钱德·奥斯曼表示，调查人员发现证据表明，乍得、索马里邦特兰、利比亚东南部和阿拉伯联合酋长国的个人和实体参与了支持无国界部队的跨国网络，但联合国人权理事会指定的调查人员并未“与任何邻国联系起来”。

paras.en: He said October had seen the highest number of drone attacks on civilians since the conflict began, adding that States supplying weapons “cannot say that they are unaware”.
paras.zh: 他说，自冲突开始以来，十月份无人机袭击平民的次数最多，并补充说，提供武器的国家“不能说他们不知道”。

paras.en: Fellow expert Joy Ngozi Ezeilo reiterated the Mission’s call to expand the UN arms embargo, currently limited to Darfur, to all of Sudan. “Sovereignty should not shield mass atrocity crimes, period,” she said.
paras.zh: 专家研究员乔伊·恩戈齐·埃塞洛（Joy Ngozi Ezeilo）重申了调查团的呼吁，将目前仅限于达尔富尔的联合国武器禁运扩大到整个苏丹。 “主权不应该包庇大规模暴行，就这样，”她说。

paras.en: Marking one year since the RSF takeover of El Fasher, Ms. Ezeilo said accountability remained absent.
paras.zh: 埃塞洛女士在纪念无国界医生组织接管法希尔一周年之际表示，问责制仍然不存在。

paras.en: “The passage of time should not diminish attention to what has happened in El Fasher. On the contrary, it should remind us of the cost of impunity.”
paras.zh: “时间的流逝不应减少人们对法希尔发生的事情的关注。相反，它应该提醒我们有罪不罚的代价。”

articles.title: Higher Ground: How New York is raising a park to hold back the sea

paras.en: Higher Ground: How New York is raising a park to hold back the sea
paras.zh: 高地：纽约如何建造一座公园来阻挡海水

paras.en: On 29 October 2012, Hurricane Sandy slammed into New York City, unleashing a devastating storm surge that flooded homes, subways and tunnels, knocked out power and sparked deadly fires.
paras.zh: 2012 年 10 月 29 日，飓风桑迪袭击了纽约市，引发了毁灭性的风暴潮，淹没了房屋、地铁和隧道，导致停电并引发致命火灾。

paras.en: In just 48 hours, 44 people were killed, nearly two million New Yorkers lost power, and 6,500 patients were evacuated from hospitals and nursing homes.
paras.zh: 短短 48 小时内，就有 44 人死亡，近 200 万纽约人断电，6500 名患者从医院和疗养院撤离。

paras.en: But as climate change threatened to bring in ever more extreme weather, and to dangerously raise sea levels around the coastal city, “never again” meant building ambitious resiliency infrastructure all along the city’s coastline.
paras.zh: 但随着气候变化可能带来更加极端的天气，并导致沿海城市周围的海平面危险地上升，“再也不会”意味着沿着该城市的海岸线建设雄心勃勃的弹性基础设施。

paras.en: Fourteen years after Sandy, UN News visited one section of the multibillion-dollar project: the East Side Coastal Resiliency (ESCR) Project.
paras.zh: 桑迪事件发生十四年后，《联合国新闻》访问了这个耗资数十亿美元的项目的一部分：东区沿海防灾 (ESCR) 项目。

paras.en: North of the Williamsburg Bridge, a white crane hoists buckets of fill off a barge and tips them into waiting earth movers. Load by load, the East River Park is being raised as much as 10 feet (three metres).
paras.zh: 在威廉斯堡大桥以北，一台白色起重机从驳船上吊起一桶桶填料，并将其倾倒到等待的推土机上。随着荷载的增加，东河公园将被抬高 10 英尺（三米）。

paras.en: The park is one link in a chain of flood defences rising along more than three miles (five kilometres) of Manhattan’s waterfront. Conceived after Hurricane Sandy swamped the area in 2012, the East Side Coastal Resiliency project and a smaller companion to the south – a roughly $2 billion investment – are designed to protect more than 110,000 residents.
paras.zh: 该公园是沿着曼哈顿海滨超过三英里（五公里）的防洪链中的一环。 2012 年飓风桑迪席卷该地区后，东区沿海防灾项目和南部的一个较小的配套项目（投资额约 20 亿美元）诞生，旨在保护超过 110,000 名居民。

paras.en: “This whole place was inundated,” said Bobby Issac, Assistant Commissioner of Coastal Resiliency Construction at the city’s Department of Design and Construction.
paras.zh: “整个地方都被淹没了，”该市设计和建设部沿海防灾建设助理专员鲍比·伊萨克 (Bobby Issac) 说。

paras.en: During Sandy, he recalled, at least a storey of the public housing blocks behind him was underwater, and residents could not get in or out.
paras.zh: 他回忆说，桑迪期间，他身后的公共住房至少有一层被淹没在水下，居民无法进出。

paras.en: Here, most of the protection is out of sight. A floodwall runs hidden through the heart of the rebuilt park. At the water’s edge, concrete-filled piles plunge about 100ft (30m) into reclaimed land that can hide anything from old piers to the remains of ships.
paras.zh: 在这里，大部分保护措施都是看不见的。一座防洪墙隐藏在重建公园的中心。在水边，混凝土填充桩插入填海土地中约 100 英尺（30 m），可以隐藏从旧码头到船舶残骸的任何东西。

paras.en: “What you see on the top is only a third of what is built,” Mr. Issac said.
paras.zh: “你在顶部看到的只是已建成的三分之一，”伊萨克先生说。

paras.en: When a storm approaches, nothing in the park needs to move. Elsewhere along the waterfront, crews will swing or slide 18 floodgates shut, and farther south nearly 100 flip-up barriers will be raised. The design also builds in about 30 inches (76 centimetres) for rising seas, he said.
paras.zh: 当暴风雨来临时，公园里的任何东西都不需要移动。在海滨的其他地方，工作人员将关闭或关闭 18 个水闸，更南边的近 100 个翻转屏障将被竖起。他说，该设计还针对海平面上升而设计了约 30 英寸（76 厘米）的高度。

paras.en: With about 90 per cent of the system in place, temporary barriers can plug any gaps at a few days’ notice until work ends in 2027, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，随着系统约 90% 的部分到位，临时障碍可以在提前几天通知的情况下填补任何缺口，直到 2027 年工作结束。

paras.en: In addition to the lives lost, Sandy caused $19 billion in damage, recalled Kathryn Prybylski, New York City’s Assistant Commissioner of the Bureau of Coastal Resilience, who will operate the new walls and gates.
paras.zh: 纽约市海岸防灾局助理局长凯瑟琳·普赖比尔斯基 (Kathryn Prybylski) 回忆道，桑迪除了造成人员伤亡外，还造成了 190 亿美元的损失。她将负责新墙和大门的运营。

paras.en: “These projects that are in construction now around the city are kind of a reaction to Sandy,” she said. “It’s really time for us now to look to the future.”
paras.zh: “现在城市周围正在建设的这些项目是对桑迪的反应，”她说。 “现在确实是我们展望未来的时候了。”

paras.en: The wider picture adds urgency. According to the World Meteorological Organization (WMO), the rate of global sea level rise has nearly doubled since satellite measurements began in 1993, while warming oceans are fuelling more intense tropical storms.
paras.zh: 更广阔的前景增加了紧迫性。根据世界气象组织 (WMO) 的数据，自 1993 年开始进行卫星测量以来，全球海平面上升速度几乎翻了一番，而海洋变暖则助长了更强烈的热带风暴。

paras.en: For a city with 520mi (840km) of coastline, the threat is not only the next superstorm but also the everyday tide. Without protective measures, Ms. Prybylski warned, many New Yorkers will face regular tidal flooding in the decades ahead.
paras.zh: 对于一个拥有 520 英里（840 公里）海岸线的城市来说，威胁不仅是下一次超级风暴，还有日常的潮汐。普赖比尔斯基女士警告说，如果没有采取保护措施，许多纽约人将在未来几十年内经常面临潮汐洪水。

paras.en: “By regular, that could mean in some locations once a month, twice a month, 10 times a month,” she said. Eventually, she added, some streets could flood with the tide every day – changing how people get to work and how they send their children to school.
paras.zh: “定期来说，这可能意味着在某些地方每月一次、每月两次、每月 10 次，”她说。她补充说，最终，一些街道可能每天都会被潮水淹没——改变人们上班以及送孩子上学的方式。

paras.en: New York is only one of the cities facing these threats.
paras.zh: 纽约只是面临这些威胁的城市之一。

paras.en: Nearly 10 per cent of the world’s population – some 770 million people – live in coastal areas less than five metres (16.4ft) above the high tide and are thus heavily exposed, a recent UN report found.
paras.zh: 联合国最近的一份报告发现，世界上近 10% 的人口（约 7.7 亿人）居住在距高潮高度不到 5 米（16.4 英尺）的沿海地区，因此暴露在外的风险很大。

paras.en: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has warned that “mega-cities on every continent will face serious impacts” from rising seas, naming New York among them.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯警告说，“各大洲的大城市都将面临海平面上升的严重影响”，纽约就是其中之一。

paras.en: “[New York’s flood defence project] is a commendable step forward. It's also a message to all big cities,” Navid Hanif, from the UN’s Department of Economic and Social Affairs (DESA), told UN News.
paras.zh: “[纽约的防洪项目]是向前迈出的值得称赞的一步。这也是向所有大城市传达的信息，”联合国经济和社会事务部 (DESA) 的纳维德·哈尼夫 (Navid Hanif) 告诉《联合国新闻》。

paras.en: “What New York is doing should be acknowledged, appreciated and emulated in other parts of the world,” he said.
paras.zh: “纽约所做的事情应该得到世界其他地方的认可、赞赏和效仿，”他说。

paras.en: Importantly, while rising seas primarily threaten infrastructure in high-income cities like New York, Miami and China’s Guangzhou, they pose an existential threat to communities in low-lying South Asian cities such as Kolkata, Mumbai and Dhaka.
paras.zh: 重要的是，虽然海平面上升主要威胁纽约、迈阿密和中国广州等高收入城市的基础设施，但它们对加尔各答、孟买和达卡等低洼南亚城市的社区构成了生存威胁。

paras.en: Over 14 million people in South Asia risk losing their homes to permanent inundation, while communities in Fiji, Vanuatu, the Solomon Islands and other low-lying Pacific islands have already been forced to relocate.
paras.zh: 南亚超过 1400 万人面临着因永久洪水而失去家园的风险，而斐济、瓦努阿图、所罗门群岛和其他地势低洼的太平洋岛屿的社区已经被迫搬迁。

paras.en: The UN, whose headquarters are only less than two miles north of the ESCR, is an active partner, supporting mitigation and adaptation efforts worldwide.
paras.zh: 联合国总部位于经济、社会和文化权利委员会以北不到两英里的地方，是一个积极的合作伙伴，支持全世界的缓解和适应努力。

paras.en: At a recent meeting on sea level rise, Member States adopted the UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise, the first time all Member States have agreed on a single, common text on the issue.
paras.zh: 在最近一次关于海平面上升的会议上，成员国通过了《联合国海平面上升宣言》，这是所有成员国首次就该问题达成单一的共同文本。

paras.en: The Declaration notably called for more predictable and accessible funding for adaptation and resilience, especially for small islands and least developed countries.
paras.zh: 该宣言特别呼吁为适应和复原力提供更可预测和更容易获得的资金，特别是对于小岛屿和最不发达国家。

paras.en: New York’s East Side Coastal Resiliency project offers a glimpse of what such investments can mean for local communities.
paras.zh: 纽约东区沿海防灾项目让我们一睹此类投资对当地社区的意义。

paras.en: In the now-elevated East River Park, strollers enjoy riverside walking paths looking onto the Brooklyn skyline, along with neatly trimmed green areas and community spaces including sports fields, playgrounds and barbecuing spots.
paras.zh: 在现已抬​​高的东河公园，漫步者可以在河边步道上漫步，欣赏布鲁克林的天际线，还有修剪整齐的绿地和社区空间，包括运动场、游乐场和烧烤场。

paras.en: “We're in this park twice a day, every day. We love it! It's a beautiful example of how climate resilience can help people enjoy their lives,” said Liz, a passer-by from the neighbourhood walking her dog.
paras.zh: “我们每天都会来这个公园两次。我们喜欢它！这是一个很好的例子，说明气候适应能力如何帮助人们享受生活，”附近遛狗的路人莉兹说道。

articles.title: How England’s underdog spirit can fuel RL World Cup semi-final hopes

paras.en: How England must harness their underdog spirit to reach the Rugby League World Cup semi-finals
paras.zh: 英格兰队必须如何利用他们的弱者精神进入橄榄球联盟世界杯半决赛

paras.en: England women face Samoa in their winner-takes-all final group game on Friday (6.45am kick-off); England men face Papua New Guinea in their final Rugby League World Cup pool fixture also on Friday (9.05am kick-off)
paras.zh: 周五，英格兰女足将在小组赛最后一场胜者为王的比赛中迎战萨摩亚队（上午 6.45 开球）；英格兰男子橄榄球联盟世界杯决赛也将在周五对阵巴布亚新几内亚（上午 9 点 05 分开球）

paras.en: England’s men find themselves in an unusual position: they are favourites to beat Papua New Guinea in their final group game, but underdogs to emerge from the combined Groups B and C and reach the semi-finals
paras.zh: 英格兰队发现自己处于一个不寻常的位置：他们是小组赛最后一场击败巴布亚新几内亚的热门球队，但在 B 组和 C 组合并后进入半决赛时却处于劣势

paras.en: They trail Samoa by 68 points on points difference and cannot finish above Tonga because of their head-to-head record, leaving their hopes of progressing dependent on a convincing win and results elsewhere going their way.
paras.zh: 他们在积分上落后萨摩亚 68 分，而且由于交锋记录，他们无法领先汤加，因此他们晋级的希望取决于一场令人信服的胜利和其他地方的比赛结果。

paras.en: That means they must beat Papua New Guinea by as big a margin as possible, then hope Tonga defeat Samoa by enough to give England a route into the semi-finals.
paras.zh: 这意味着他们必须以尽可能大的优势击败巴布亚新几内亚，然后希望汤加以足够的优势击败萨摩亚，让英格兰进入半决赛。

paras.en: If that all aligns, into the semi-finals they will go.
paras.zh: 如果一切顺利，他们将进入半决赛。

paras.en: England's women, meanwhile, face a more straightforward equation. A win against Samoa would secure their place in the semi-finals, but it would rank among the biggest victories of their campaign. They are capable of pulling it off, but the challenge is clear.
paras.zh: 与此同时，英格兰女性面临着一个更简单的方程式。战胜萨摩亚将确保他们进入半决赛，但这将成为他们赛季最大的胜利之一。他们有能力实现这一目标，但挑战也很明显。

paras.en: England were beaten 78-0 by the Jillaroos, while Samoa lost 40-0 to the same opposition. Those results offer a stark indication of the task ahead.
paras.zh: 英格兰队以 78-0 惨败于 Jillaroos，而萨摩亚则以 40-0 输给了同样的对手。这些结果清楚地表明了未来的任务。

paras.en: Both England sides need to show the fighting spirit that has become synonymous with the nation as they look to make their mark on the other side of the world.
paras.zh: 英格兰双方都需要展现出已经成为这个国家代名词的战斗精神，因为他们希望在世界的另一边留下自己的印记。

paras.en: England's men may sit third in the international rankings, but that is not how they are viewed Down Under. Australia, New Zealand, Tonga and Samoa are all considered ahead of them, despite England having whitewashed both Tonga and Samoa in recent series.
paras.zh: 英格兰队在国际排名中可能排名第三，但在澳大利亚却并非如此。澳大利亚、新西兰、汤加和萨摩亚都被认为领先，尽管英格兰在最近的系列赛中粉饰了汤加和萨摩亚。

paras.en: The complicated group structure has done Brian McDermott's side few favours. They effectively had one chance to put themselves in a strong position, and they needed to beat Tonga in their opening match to do so. Instead, they lost 30-12.
paras.zh: 复杂的小组结构并没有给布莱恩·麦克德莫特的球队带来什么好处。他们实际上有一次机会让自己处于有利地位，他们需要在首场比赛中击败汤加才能做到这一点。然而，他们却以30-12落败。

paras.en: Even two wins from their remaining games - and convincing ones at that - may not be enough to save their campaign.
paras.zh: 即使他们在剩下的比赛中取得两场胜利——而且是令人信服的胜利——也可能不足以挽救他们的竞选。

paras.en: They could be enough despite England's men not meeting up once before the tournament. They could be enough despite having just two training sessions to prepare for their opening group match. They could be enough with the odds stacked against them.
paras.zh: 尽管英格兰队在比赛前没有碰面，但他们已经足够了。尽管只进行了两次训练来准备小组首场比赛，但他们已经足够了。在困难重重的情况下，他们已经足够了。

paras.en: Both England teams face an uphill battle, albeit for different reasons. While the men must overcome a difficult qualification equation, the women face opponents with greater experience of playing together.
paras.zh: 尽管出于不同的原因，两支英格兰队都面临着一场艰苦的战斗。男子队必须克服困难的资格方程式，而女子队则面临着拥有更丰富比赛经验的对手。

paras.en: Samoa's women, in particular, boast a squad packed with young, emerging talent who play week in, week out in the National Rugby League Women's Premiership (NRLW), gaining regular experience in one of the world's most intense women's rugby league competitions.
paras.zh: 尤其是萨摩亚女子队，拥有一支由年轻的新兴人才组成的球队，她们每周都参加国家橄榄球联盟女子超级联赛 (NRLW)，在世界上最激烈的女子橄榄球联盟比赛之一中获得常规经验。

paras.en: They were viewed before the tournament as the team most capable of pushing the Jillaroos closest. But England should not be written off after their heavy opening defeat. The 2022 Rugby League World Cup offers a reminder of why: England's men demolished Samoa in their opening game, only to be beaten by them in the semi-finals.
paras.zh: 他们在比赛之前被视为最有能力将 Jillaroos 逼近的球队。但英格兰队不应该在首场惨败后就被淘汰。 2022 年橄榄球联盟世界杯提醒人们注意其中的原因：英格兰队在首场比赛中击败了萨摩亚队，但在半决赛中却被萨摩亚队击败。

paras.en: For England's women, the equation is simpler: beat Samoa and reach the semi-finals. With their place in the last four on the line, they must show that, despite the women's game in England still being a work in progress, they can compete with the best on the international stage.
paras.zh: 对于英格兰女子来说，这个方程式更简单：击败萨摩亚并进入半决赛。凭借他们在前四名中的位置，他们必须表明，尽管英格兰的女子比赛仍在进行中，但他们可以在国际舞台上与最好的比赛竞争。

paras.en: There has been plenty of discussion about what international rugby league needs to thrive: greater investment, more mid-season internationals and more opportunities for the global game to capture the public's attention. The need for that backing is clear.
paras.zh: 关于国际橄榄球联盟需要什么才能蓬勃发展已经有很多讨论：更多的投资、更多的赛季中期国际球员以及更多让全球比赛吸引公众注意力的机会。这种支持的必要性是显而易见的。

paras.en: The prospect of both England sides exiting at the group stage has been described as a potential wake-up call for the sport in this hemisphere - a chance to invest in players, give the international game greater prominence and find a way to close the gap on the other side of the world.
paras.zh: 英格兰两支球队在小组赛阶段出局的前景被认为是对这个半球这项运动的潜在警钟——这是一个投资球员的机会，让国际比赛更加突出，并找到缩小与世界另一端差距的方法。

paras.en: But this is not a new conversation. After England's men fell short at the 2008 World Cup, figures at the top of the sport reviewed what had gone wrong. Many remain influential today, underlining how long these questions have persisted.
paras.zh: 但这并不是一个新的话题。英格兰队在 2008 年世界杯上失利后，体育界高层人士回顾了问题所在。许多问题至今仍然具有影响力，凸显出这些问题已经存在了多久。

paras.en: Failure can force change. But perhaps the bigger shock - and the more powerful catalyst - would be for England to succeed when so few expect them to.
paras.zh: 失败可以迫使改变。但也许更大的冲击和更强大的催化剂是英格兰在很少有人期望的情况下取得成功。

paras.en: If the men and women both defy the odds and reach the semi-finals, it would be more than a sporting triumph. It would be a statement that English rugby league can compete, and an opportunity to build momentum for the international game rather than wait for another failure to force the issue.
paras.zh: 如果男女都能克服困难进入半决赛，那将不仅仅是一场体育胜利。这将是英国橄榄球联盟可以参加比赛的一个声明，也是一个为国际比赛积蓄动力的机会，而不是等待另一次失败来强行解决这个问题。

paras.en: McDermott said before the tournament that a visit to just one NRL club would show how remarkable it is that England can compete, given the infrastructure available Down Under. The playing field is so uneven that England's position among the international elite is an achievement in itself.
paras.zh: 麦克德莫特在比赛前表示，考虑到澳大利亚现有的基础设施，仅仅参观一个 NRL 俱乐部就足以表明英格兰队的竞争能力是多么出色。竞争环境如此不平等，英格兰跻身国际精英行列本身就是一项成就。

paras.en: Too often, we judge England's rugby league teams by how far they still have to go. But is it time to look instead at how much they have achieved in spite of the disadvantages they face?
paras.zh: 我们常常根据英格兰橄榄球联赛球队还需要走多远来判断他们。但现在是时候看看他们在面临不利条件的情况下所取得的成就了吗？

paras.en: Could that be the catalyst for people to recognise the potential of English rugby league and give it the backing it deserves?
paras.zh: 这是否会成为人们认识到英国橄榄球联赛潜力并给予其应有支持的催化剂？

paras.en: The sport has long searched for its lightbulb moment: the spark that sets change in motion, the first domino to fall. Perhaps, rather than another setback being needed to force that change, this could be the tournament in which success provides the catalyst.
paras.zh: 这项运动长期以来一直在寻找它的灵光时刻：引发变革的火花，第一张倒下的多米诺骨牌。或许，这可能是一场成功提供催化剂的锦标赛，而不是需要再次遭遇挫折来迫使这一改变。

paras.en: It remains a long shot. England know the task ahead is monumental, but they persist regardless.
paras.zh: 这仍然是一个漫长的过程。英格兰知道前方的任务艰巨，但他们仍然坚持不懈。

paras.en: They will take that fight into their clashes with Papua New Guinea and Samoa, and by Sunday we will know how far their persistence has taken them.
paras.zh: 他们将把这场战斗带入与巴布亚新几内亚和萨摩亚的冲突中，到周日我们就会知道他们的坚持让他们走了多远。

paras.en: For England, it is not about the resources they lack, but the fight they show and what they can achieve against the odds.
paras.zh: 对于英格兰队来说，重要的不是他们缺乏资源，而是他们表现出的战斗力以及他们能够克服困难取得的成就。

articles.title: Kayla Allen: From self-taught boxer to star prospect

paras.en: Kayla Allen: From self-taught boxer to star prospect - 'It started in a unique way and it'll finish in a unique way'
paras.zh: 凯拉·艾伦：从自学成才的拳击手到明星前景 - “它以独特的方式开始，也将以独特的方式结束”

paras.en: Kayla Allen's ascent from using YouTube to teach herself to box in her garden to reaching the GB squad and becoming a star professional prospect is extraordinary; watch Chris Billam-Smith fight Cheavon Clarke on Zuffa Boxing 12 live on Sky Sports on November 7
paras.zh: 凯拉·艾伦 (Kayla Allen) 从使用 YouTube 在自家花园里自学拳击，到进入英国队并成为一名明星职业选手，她的进步是非凡的； 11 月 7 日，在天空体育直播的 Zuffa Boxing 12 比赛中观看 Chris Billam-Smith 与 Cheavon Clarke 的比赛

paras.en: Kayla Allen only started boxing a few years ago, teaching herself with YouTube videos and throwing punches in her garden.
paras.zh: 凯拉·艾伦 (Kayla Allen) 几年前才开始拳击，通过 YouTube 视频自学，并在自家花园里挥拳。

paras.en: Her rapid ascent since then has been astonishing. She made it all the way to the GB squad and has now become the first woman to sign with Zuffa Boxing. She will have her second fight on Sky Sports on November 7.
paras.zh: 从那时起，她的迅速崛起令人震惊。她一路进入英国队，现在成为第一位与 Zuffa Boxing 签约的女性。她将于 11 月 7 日在天空体育上进行第二场比赛。

paras.en: "Any fight I go into, whether it's the first debut, the second fight or a world title fight, everyone's getting dealt with the same," she told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “我参加的任何一场比赛，无论是第一次亮相、第二次比赛还是世界冠军争夺战，每个人都会受到同样的对待，”她告诉天空体育。

paras.en: - Clarke warns Billam-Smith: 'The bull's always driven, but they get tamed'
paras.zh: - 克拉克警告比勒姆-史密斯：“公牛总是被驱使，但它们会被驯服”

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW📺
paras.zh: - 立即观看最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播📺

paras.en: - Listen to the Toe2Toe podcast every week
paras.zh: - 每周收听 Toe2Toe 播客

paras.en: "It's always been exciting, it's never been boring. So for me it's not about being someone else, it's about being myself, and the best Kayla beats anybody on the night."
paras.zh: “这总是令人兴奋，从来不会无聊。所以对我来说，这不是成为别人，而是成为我自己，最好的凯拉在当晚击败了任何人。”

paras.en: After originally pursuing ambitions in football, Allen started trying to box at home during the pandemic lockdown.
paras.zh: 在最初追求足球梦想后，艾伦开始在大流行封锁期间在家尝试拳击。

paras.en: "I learned how to box in my back garden as an 18-year-old girl. I watched videos on YouTube, how to throw a jab, watched Mayweather, Mike Tyson, AJ, I just studied the sport and then went down to the local boxing gym, did a couple of white-collar fights and now we're here," Allen said.
paras.zh: “作为一个 18 岁的女孩，我在我的后花园学会了如何拳击。我在 YouTube 上观看了视频，如何刺拳，观看了梅威瑟、迈克·泰森、AJ，我刚刚学习了这项运动，然后去了当地的拳击馆，进行了几次白领拳击比赛，现在我们就在这里，”艾伦说。

paras.en: "I've always believed in myself. Whenever I first started, no matter what I do I always go: 'I'm going to be the best at this'. So whatever that means I don't know, but that's just my mindset. No matter what I do I'm always the best at it and I'll be the best at boxing."
paras.zh: “我一直相信自己。每当我刚开始的时候，无论我做什么，我总是说：‘我将在这方面成为最好的’。所以无论这意味着什么，我不知道，但这只是我的心态。无论我做什么，我总是最擅长的，我将成为拳击方面最好的。”

paras.en: Her first amateur tournament was the Golden Girl, a large international competition in Sweden. She won it.
paras.zh: 她的第一个业余比赛是 Golden Girl，这是在瑞典举行的一项大型国际比赛。她赢了。

paras.en: Allen performed well in the national championships and was soon on the GB squad, an astonishing ascent.
paras.zh: 艾伦在全国锦标赛中表现出色，很快就进入了英国队，这是一个惊人的进步。

paras.en: "Within six months I was on England and then within eight months I was on GB. That's work, credit to my coaches and credit to myself, and the GB system and the England system to allow me to get to where I needed to be. It's a blessing. I'm glad to be here and it's a good opportunity," she said.
paras.zh: “六个月内我来到了英格兰，然后八个月内我来到了英国。这是工作，归功于我的教练和我自己，以及英国体系和英格兰体系让我到达了我需要去的地方。这是一种祝福。我很高兴来到这里，这是一个很好的机会，”她说。

paras.en: It led her now to her breakthrough move into professional boxing, becoming Zuffa's first female signing.
paras.zh: 这使她现在突破性地进入职业拳击界，成为祖法的第一位签约女性。

paras.en: "Where's the girls at? I'm here now, so let's go!" she said. "It helps other females coming through, that nothing's impossible."
paras.zh: “姑娘们在哪儿？我在这儿，我们走吧！”她说。 “它可以帮助其他女性渡过难关，让一切皆有可能。”

paras.en: She promises: "Explosive, knockouts, just explosive energy, I'm going to bring ferocity to the ring… When I step into that ring it's game on for me.
paras.zh: 她承诺：“爆炸性的、击倒性的、爆炸性的能量，我将为擂台带来凶猛……当我踏入擂台时，比赛对我来说就开始了。

paras.en: "It's creating my own legacy, one of one, and creating my own name for female boxing.
paras.zh: “它正在创造我自己的遗产，其中之一，并为女子拳击创造我自己的名字。

paras.en: "It started in a unique way and it'll finish in a unique way as well. I do everything my own way."
paras.zh: “它以独特的方式开始，也将以独特的方式结束。我以自己的方式做一切。”

paras.en: Watch Chris Billam-Smith fight Cheavon Clarke in the main event on Zuffa Boxing 12, live on Sky Sports on November 7.
paras.zh: 观看克里斯·比拉姆·史密斯 (Chris Billam-Smith) 在 11 月 7 日天空体育 (Sky Sports) 直播的《Zuffa Boxing 12》主赛事中对阵切文·克拉克 (Cheavon Clarke)。

articles.title: Wolff explains Antonelli turnaround after 'tears'

paras.en: Toto Wolff explains Kimi Antonelli turnaround after 'tears' in Belgium 2025 to likely world championship coronation at Mexico City GP
paras.zh: 托托·沃尔夫解释基米·安东内利在 2025 年比利时世界杯“泪流满面”后的转变，并可能在墨西哥城大奖赛上加冕世界冠军

paras.en: Toto Wolff says "I don't know what happened over the winter" to Kimi Antonelli as the 20-year-old looks set to become world champion this Sunday; watch every session of the Mexico City GP from this Friday, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 托托·沃尔夫 (Toto Wolff) 对基米·安东内利 (Kimi Antonelli) 说“我不知道冬天发生了什么”，这位 20 岁的球员看起来将在本周日成为世界冠军；从本周五开始，天空体育 F1 直播墨西哥城大奖赛的每一场比赛

paras.en: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff says it is "extremely satisfying" to see Kimi Antonelli's turnaround from last year as the Italian looks to secure the 2026 Formula 1 world title this weekend in Mexico.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫表示，看到基米·安东内利去年的转变“非常令人满意”，因为意大利人希望本周末在墨西哥获得 2026 年一级方程式世界冠军。

paras.en: A top nine in this Sunday's Mexico City Grand Prix for Antonelli will ensure he becomes the sport's youngest world champion at 20 years old - breaking Sebastian Vettel's record by three years.
paras.zh: 安东内利在本周日的墨西哥城大奖赛中进入前九名，将确保他以 20 岁的年纪成为这项运动最年轻的世界冠军，将塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔的纪录打破三年。

paras.en: Antonelli joined Mercedes last year and struggled for the majority of his rookie season after a huge amount of excitement prior to his Formula 1 debut.
paras.zh: 安东内利去年加入梅赛德斯，在首次参加一级方程式比赛之前经历了巨大的兴奋之后，他在新秀赛季的大部分时间里都在挣扎。

paras.en: - How Antonelli can win world title at Mexico City GP on Sunday
paras.zh: - 安东内利如何在周日的墨西哥城大奖赛上赢得世界冠军

paras.zh: - 墨西哥城大奖赛日程| F1 2026 积分榜 | F1 2026 日历

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: Wolff recalls the 2025 Belgian Grand Prix as a particular low moment when Antonelli was in tears after being eliminated in Q1.
paras.zh: 沃尔夫回忆道，2025 年比利时大奖赛是一个特别低落的时刻，当时安东内利在第一季度被淘汰后流下了眼泪。

paras.en: "The many people that said last year after nine races without points, he shouldn't be in a Mercedes," said Wolff.
paras.zh: “很多人去年在九场比赛没有得分后说，他不应该驾驶梅赛德斯，”沃尔夫说。

paras.en: "People in other teams that said, he shouldn't even be in Formula 1, the tears in Spa, in parc ferme. And all of that now is extremely satisfying to see what he's able to deliver, how he's working with the team, with Bono [Antonelli's engineer Peter Bonnington] and yielding the results. But it wasn't an easy road.
paras.zh: “其他车队的人说，他甚至不应该参加一级方程式赛车，在斯帕、在公园里流泪。现在看到他能够交付的东西，他如何与车队合作，与波诺（安东内利的工程师彼得·邦宁顿）合作并取得成果，所有这一切都令人非常满意。但这并不是一条容易的路。

paras.en: "So, I'm happy that, 99.9 per cent, he still needs to finish the race in Mexico. So, it's either going to be a big tequila party or if it's not a tequila party, then it's going to be Caipirinha the weekend afterwards."
paras.zh: “所以，我很高兴，99.9%，他仍然需要在墨西哥完成比赛。所以，这要么是一场大型龙舌兰酒派对，要么如果不是龙舌兰酒派对，那么之后的周末就会是凯皮林纳鸡尾酒。”

paras.en: Antonelli has won nine races this season and consistently had the upper hand on Mercedes team-mate George Russell throughout the year.
paras.zh: 安东内利本赛季赢得了九场比赛，并且全年一直领先于梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔。

paras.en: Wolff thinks the new 2026 cars, which provided a reset for the field, has benefitted Antonelli and is mystified how the Italian has hit back so strongly after last year.
paras.zh: 沃尔夫认为，新款 2026 赛车为赛场带来了重新定位，让安东内利受益匪浅，但令人困惑的是，意大利人在去年之后为何能如此强劲地反击。

paras.en: "I think maybe it was to his benefit that the regulations were all new. When last year he came in and those cars existed, those cars existed for four years. The other drivers were used to it," he said.
paras.zh: “我认为，也许全新的规定对他有利。去年他进来时，这些汽车就已经存在了，这些汽车已经存在了四年。其他司机已经习惯了，”他说。

paras.en: "And all new for everyone this year. And he just made it stick with his easiness, with his mindset, with his easiness of approaching things.
paras.zh: “今年对每个人来说都是全新的。他只是用他的轻松、他的心态、他处理事情的轻松来坚持这一点。

paras.en: "In Austin, he came to my office before getting ready, before getting dressed and just sat down on the sofa and said, 'I'm going to enjoy this one. And isn't it funny? I'm not thinking at all about the championship'.
paras.zh: “在奥斯汀，他在准备之前来到我的办公室，在穿好衣服之前，只是坐在沙发上说，‘我会喜欢这个。这不是很有趣吗？我根本没有考虑冠军。’”

paras.en: "I said, 'well, exactly stick to that attitude. You have the best job in the world. Don't forget that.' So he has also the right mindset.
paras.zh: “我说，‘好吧，坚持这种态度。你拥有世界上最好的工作。别忘了这一点。’所以他的心态也是正确的。

paras.en: "It's been 30 or more years that I've tried to understand racing drivers' brains and I still don't know what has happened over the winter.
paras.zh: “三十多年来，我一直在尝试了解赛车手的大脑，但我仍然不知道冬天发生了什么。

paras.en: "His ability to process and deliver something that's outstanding, which we didn't see coming. But credit to him, credit to his engineers, to his environment, his family that he's delivered in that way."
paras.zh: “他有能力处理和交付一些出色的东西，这是我们没有预见到的。但要归功于他，归功于他的工程师，归功于他的环境，归功于他以这种方式交付的东西。”

paras.en: Antonelli looking to win championship 'in style'
paras.zh: 安东内利希望“以时尚的方式”赢得冠军

paras.en: Antonelli's win last weekend in Austin was somewhat of a surprise after Red Bull's Max Verstappen won the previous two Formula 1 races.
paras.zh: 在红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘赢得前两场一级方程式比赛之后，安东内利上周末在奥斯汀的胜利有点令人惊讶。

paras.en: Several F1 championships have been won without the champion finishing on the podium in that race, but Antonelli is keen to "finish on a high".
paras.zh: 已经有好几个F1冠军都没有在那场比赛中登上领奖台，但安东内利渴望“取得更高的成绩”。

paras.en: "The perfect way would be to finish off in style and enjoy the rest of the season," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: 他告诉天空体育F1：“完美的方式就是以时尚的方式结束比赛并享受剩下的赛季。”

paras.en: "I'm very well aware it's very close but the mindset hasn't changed. I want to finish the season on a high in order to have high hopes in 2027.
paras.zh: “我很清楚，比赛已经非常接近了，但心态并没有改变。我希望以较高的成绩结束本赛季，以便对 2027 年抱有很高的希望。

paras.en: "First we focus and worry about finishing this [season] well and we will see."
paras.zh: “首先，我们专注并担心能否很好地完成这个[赛季]，我们拭目以待。”

paras.en: Antonelli admits his success has been a "good surprise" but Mercedes have played a pivotal role in his quick development over the last 18 months.
paras.zh: 安东内利承认他的成功是一个“惊喜”，但梅赛德斯在他过去 18 个月的快速发展中发挥了关键作用。

paras.en: "I'm very lucky because I have a very good group of people around me. In the team, I have my father, who always comes, then my performance coach," he said.
paras.zh: “我很幸运，因为我身边有一群非常好的人。在团队中，我有我的父亲，他总是来，然后是我的表现教练，”他说。

paras.en: "I just have a great group of people around me that help me to be more relaxed and not worry about these kinds of things. They help me to block out the noise, and that's also what's been allowing me to enjoy the weekend and perform."
paras.zh: “我身边有一群很棒的人，他们帮助我更加放松，不用担心这些事情。他们帮助我隔绝噪音，这也让我能够享受周末和表演。”

articles.title: 'Systemic' increase of children with complex needs in Canberra
articles.author: Madeleine Rojahn

paras.en: National early learning data shows a growing number of Canberra children are at risk of poor developmental outcomes, with children increasingly starting school with complex and often unmet needs.
paras.zh: 全国早期学习数据显示，越来越多的堪培拉儿童面临发育不良的风险，越来越多的儿童在入学时面临着复杂且往往未得到满足的需求。

paras.en: An analysis of the data notes mounting pressures on families and thinning carer-child relationships.
paras.zh: 对数据的分析表明，家庭的压力越来越大，看护者与孩子的关系也越来越薄弱。

paras.en: Experts say the data "challenges the narrative of an affluent territory".
paras.zh: 专家表示，这些数据“挑战了富裕地区的说法”。

paras.en: Children living in the nation's capital are increasingly facing poorer developmental outcomes, with experts pointing to mounting pressures on families.
paras.zh: 生活在首都的儿童越来越面临着较差的发展结果，专家指出家庭面临的压力越来越大。

paras.en: The latest data from the Australian Early Development Census (AEDC) found the proportion of ACT children developmentally on track across five areas was the second-lowest in the country.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚早期发展人口普查 (AEDC) 的最新数据发现，五个地区的 ACT 儿童发育正常的比例是全国第二低。

paras.en: According to the figures, one child in four begins school with at least one area of "significant" concern — amounting to about six children in a kindergarten class of 22.
paras.zh: 根据这些数字，四分之一的孩子开始上学时至少有一个“重大”关注领域—相当于22个幼儿园班级中约有6个孩子。

paras.en: "The ACT is experiencing a sustained and systemic increase in children's developmental vulnerability, with the proportion of children starting school with developmental vulnerability rising consistently in every AEDC cycle since 2015," a recent analysis of the data by Nuos Group stated.
paras.zh: Nuos Group 最近对数据进行的分析指出：“澳大利亚首都地区儿童的发育脆弱性正在持续、系统性地增加，自 2015 年以来，在每个 AEDC 周期中，发育脆弱的入学儿童比例持续上升。”

paras.en: The report, commissioned by the ACT government, found the decline was not driven by any particular demographic, but outer districts including Gungahlin, Tuggeranong and Belconnen were at risk of worsening outcomes.
paras.zh: 这份由首都领地政府委托编写的报告发现，人口下降并不是由任何特定人口造成的，但包括冈加林、塔格拉农和贝尔康宁在内的外围地区面临着结果恶化的风险。

paras.en: "In a way, [the data] challenges the narrative of an affluent territory," Early Childhood Education researcher at the University of Canberra
paras.zh: “在某种程度上，[数据]挑战了富裕地区的叙述，”堪培拉大学幼儿教育研究员

paras.en: "The decline is happening within groups of the population that otherwise could be considered similar, and is also happening across groups of population that could be considered advantaged. And this is a different pattern to what you would observe at the national level."
paras.zh: “这种下降发生在原本可以被认为相似的人口群体内，也发生在可以被认为处于优势的人口群体中。这与你在国家层面观察到的模式不同。”

paras.en: Professor Pino-Pasternak also said a high percentage of transient families in Canberra meant families had less support or understanding of where to seek help.
paras.zh: 皮诺-帕斯捷尔纳克教授还表示，堪培拉的临时家庭比例很高，这意味着家庭对去哪里寻求帮助的支持或了解较少。

paras.en: "What has been happening historically with families is the notion that families are becoming more and more nuclear, that the idea of a bigger village around the family is not there anymore," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“历史上家庭中发生的事情是，家庭变得越来越核心，以家庭为中心的更大村庄的想法已经不复存在。”

paras.en: 'Emotional regulation, anxiety, and behavioural intensity'
paras.zh: “情绪调节、焦虑和行为强度”

paras.en: The AEDC suggests the greatest challenges for children were in social, emotional and physical development, rather than academic or cognitive skills.
paras.zh: AEDC 认为，儿童面临的最大挑战是社交、情感和身体发展，而不是学术或认知技能。

paras.en: Teachers surveyed by Nuos said children struggled with "emotional regulation, anxiety, and behavioural intensity in both early childhood and school environments".
paras.zh: 诺斯调查的教师表示，孩子们在“幼儿期和学校环境中的情绪调节、焦虑和行为强度”方面挣扎。

paras.en: "[There are] more students now who will just shut down and retreat as opposed to push through that challenge,"
paras.zh: “现在有更多的学生会关闭并撤退，而不是克服这一挑战，”

paras.en: Screens affecting both parents and children
paras.zh: 影响父母和孩子的屏幕

paras.en: The report noted stresses on families, with stakeholders in the Health and Community Services sector reporting families being time-poor and less in tune with children's development, leading to a displacement of "critical parent/carer-child interactions".
paras.zh: 该报告指出，家庭面临压力，健康和社区服务部门的利益相关者报告称，家庭时间匮乏，且与儿童的发展不太协调，导致“关键的父母/看护者与儿童的互动”被取代。

paras.en: It pointed out that Canberra children were being read to less frequently, falling from 75 per cent in 2015 to 69 per cent in 2024.
paras.zh: 报告指出，堪培拉儿童读书的频率正在降低，从 2015 年的 75% 下降到 2024 年的 69%。

paras.en: "60 per cent of children who were not read to at home were developmentally vulnerable on two or more domains, compared with just 7.1 per cent of children who were read to regularly," the report said.
paras.zh: 报告称：“在家不读书的儿童中有 60% 在两个或更多领域存在发育缺陷，而经常读书的儿童中这一比例仅为 7.1%。”

paras.en: In 2022, approximately 21 per cent of ACT kindergarten children spent more than four hours on screens daily, with another 27 per cent spending between two and four hours per day on screens.
paras.zh: 2022 年，大约 21% 的澳大利亚首都地区幼儿园儿童每天在屏幕上花费的时间超过 4 小时，另有 27% 的儿童每天在屏幕上花费的时间为 2 到 4 小时。

paras.en: The sector, as well as kindergarten teachers, also reflected that pressures like workload, cost-of-living and fatigue were being managed through increasing screen use.
paras.zh: 该行业以及幼儿园教师也反映，工作量、生活成本和疲劳等压力正在通过增加屏幕使用来缓解。

paras.en: Professor Pino-Pasternak said at the same time, parents were using technology more, which was changing family relationships.
paras.zh: 皮诺-帕斯捷尔纳克教授同时表示，父母更多地使用科技，这正在改变家庭关系。

paras.en: "What we see across playgrounds in the nation is really sad these days, where you see that the adults are hooked to screens ... when the children are actually looking at them for validation, for praise, for help,"
paras.zh: “这些天我们在全国游乐场所看到的情况真的很悲伤，你看到成年人都沉迷于屏幕……而孩子们实际上是在看着它们寻求认可、赞扬和帮助，”

paras.en: "We are seeing a different generation not only of children, but a different generation of parents and family systems".
paras.zh: “我们不仅看到了不同一代的儿童，而且看到了不同一代的父母和家庭系统”。

paras.en: She said "integrated hubs" with social workers and children's nurses were increasingly important to give families "an enormous support that they currently don't have through this fragmented type of system".
paras.zh: 她说，社会工作者和儿童护士的“综合中心”越来越重要，可以为家庭提供“他们目前通过这种分散的系统所无法获得的巨大支持”。

articles.title: Adult and youth inmates in NT struggle to access health care, doctors say
articles.author: Elsie Lange

paras.en: NT custodial doctors say they have faced difficulties in accessing patients in Top End prisons.
paras.zh: 北领地的拘留医生表示，他们在接触北端监狱的病人时遇到了困难。

paras.en: A senior lawyer says some prisoners have not been receiving their medication or been able to easily access a doctor.
paras.zh: 一位资深律师表示，一些囚犯没有得到药物治疗或无法轻易去看医生。

paras.en: A corrections spokesperson said the department was working with NT Health to support safe and timely access to care.
paras.zh: 惩教发言人表示，该部门正在与北领地卫生局合作，支持安全、及时地获得护理。

paras.en: Some adult and youth prisoners in the Top End are struggling to access healthcare and medication amid soaring prisoner numbers in the NT, according to custodial doctors and a senior lawyer.
paras.zh: 据看守医生和一名资深律师称，随着北领地囚犯人数激增，北领地的一些成年和青少年囚犯正在努力获得医疗保健和药物。

paras.en: Two custodial doctors working in Darwin and across the Top End were among dozens of presenters who spoke at a Centre for Disease Control conference in Darwin this week.
paras.zh: 本周在达尔文举行的疾病控制中心会议上发表讲话的数十名演讲者中有两名在达尔文和北端地区工作的监护医生。

paras.en: The pair told the conference the sharp increase in prisoner numbers, which began under the former NT Labor government and accelerated after the Country Liberal Party took power in 2024, "creates huge challenges for looking after [their] patients".
paras.zh: 两人在会议上表示，囚犯人数的急剧增加始于前北领地工党政府的领导下，并在 2024 年乡村自由党上台后加速，“给照顾[他们的]病人带来了巨大的挑战”。

paras.en: The exact period the doctors' concerns related to was not made clear in their presentation but the latest data shows the number of people behind bars in the NT has surged from about 1,800 in 2021 to more than 2,800 in June last year.
paras.zh: 医生们的担忧并未在他们的陈述中明确说明，但最新数据显示，北领地入狱人数已从 2021 年的约 1,800 人激增至去年 6 月的 2,800 多人。

paras.en: One presenter, described as a long-standing prison doctor, said staffing pressures inside the Darwin Correctional Centre had also impacted the ability of medical practitioners to see their patients.
paras.zh: 一位被描述为长期监狱医生的主持人表示，达尔文惩教中心内部的人员压力也影响了医生看诊病人的能力。

paras.en: "When a prisoner goes externally for a medical appointment, they usually need at least two officers to go with them," she said.
paras.zh: “当囚犯外出就医时，通常需要至少两名警官陪同，”她说。

paras.en: "It's very time consuming, it takes officers off the block [and] could even cause a lockdown on the block because there's not enough officers left.
paras.zh: “这非常耗时，它会让警察离开街区，甚至可能导致街区被封锁，因为没有足够的警察留下。

paras.en: "It limits the number who can go day to day, and we often have to cancel if we've got too many people going out in one day."
paras.zh: “它限制了每天可以出去的人数，如果一天出去的人太多，我们常常不得不取消。”

paras.en: A Department of Corrections spokesperson said escort requirements varied according to the prisoner's circumstances and it would "not be accurate to characterise external medical appointments as automatically resulting in lockdowns".
paras.zh: 惩教部发言人表示，护送要求根据囚犯的情况而有所不同，“将外部医疗预约描述为自动导致封锁是不准确的”。

paras.en: "For example, the department's hospital in-patient procedures specify a minimum of two escorting officers for maximum, high, medium and low-security prisoners, while different arrangements apply to open-rated prisoners," they said.
paras.zh: 他们说：“例如，该部门的医院住院程序规定，最高、高、中和低安全级别的囚犯至少需要两名护送人员，而对于开放级别的囚犯则有不同的安排。”

paras.en: "The department manages staffing and prisoner activities daily to maintain safe and secure operations.
paras.zh: “该部门每天管理人员配置和囚犯活动，以维持安全可靠的运作。

paras.en: "Where staffing levels fluctuate, activities or services may be modified in accordance with the operating model."
paras.zh: “如果人员配备水平波动，活动或服务可能会根据运营模式进行修改。”

paras.en: The spokesperson said decisions about a prisoner's medical treatment were made by NT Health, which was supported by corrections in facilitating safe access to treatment and transfers to external health facilities.
paras.zh: 发言人说，有关囚犯医疗的决定是由NT Health做出的，该公司在促进安全获得治疗和转移到外部医疗机构方面得到了纠正的支持。

paras.en: The spokesperson said the department recognised the "operational pressures associated with delivering health services" in custodial settings and continued to work with NT Health to support safe and timely access to prisoners, but questions about the adequacy of service provision should be directed to NT Health.
paras.zh: 该发言人表示，该部门认识到在拘留环境中“与提供医疗服务相关的运营压力”，并继续与北领地卫生局合作，支持安全、及时地接触囚犯，但有关服务提供是否充分的问题应直接向北领地卫生局提出。

paras.en: NT Health was contacted for comment but did not respond by deadline.
paras.zh: 已联系NT Health征求意见，但未在截止日期前回复。

paras.en: The doctor also told the conference the inability of health workers to see their patients on demand, including in youth detention, exposed both them and prison staff to "moral injury".
paras.zh: 这位医生还告诉会议，卫生工作者无法按需看病，包括在青少年拘留期间，这使他们和监狱工作人员都面临“道德伤害”。

paras.en: "It reduces our ability to care and see these people and it's a cause of moral injury to us and to corrections," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“这降低了我们照顾和探望这些人的能力，也是对我们造成精神伤害和惩戒的一个原因。”

paras.en: "Some days we see very few people on our list, even when they're marked as high priority."
paras.zh: “有些时候，我们在名单上看到的人很少，即使他们被标记为高优先级。”

paras.en: Moral injury occurs when a person experiences psychological, social or spiritual damage when forced into a situation that violates their morals.
paras.zh: 当一个人被迫陷入违反道德的境地时，遭受心理、社会或精神损害，就会发生道德伤害。

paras.en: Long-time senior Darwin lawyer and former president of the NT Bar Association, John Lawrence SC, said the doctors' concerns were echoed by his clients and their families in prison.
paras.zh: 达尔文市资深律师、北领地律师协会前主席约翰·劳伦斯 SC 表示，他的当事人及其在狱中的家人也表达了医生的担忧。

paras.en: "I'm hearing countless times from prisoners and their families that they haven't got their medication, they never get to see their doctor, it's just not happening," he said.
paras.zh: “我无数次从囚犯和他们的家人那里听到他们没有得到药物，他们从来没有机会去看医生，这根本就没有发生，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Lawrence described the conditions inside NT correctional facilities due to "gross overcrowding" as a "volcano".
paras.zh: 劳伦斯先生将北领地惩教设施内的条件描述为“严重拥挤”，就像一座“火山”。

paras.en: "We need to remind ourselves that the territory has the second highest imprisonment level in the world," he said.
paras.zh: “我们需要提醒自己，该地区的监禁水平位居世界第二，”他说。

paras.en: "The health obligations that the corrections department have are in no way being fulfilled, in my opinion."
paras.zh: “我认为，惩戒部门的健康义务根本没有得到履行。”

articles.title: Passing of conversion practice ban a 'landmark day' for Tasmania
articles.author: Adam Langenberg

paras.en: A Greens bill to ban conversion practices has passed Tasmania's lower house of parliament.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚议会下议院通过了绿党禁止转换做法的法案。

paras.en: The bill had the support of Labor, three Liberal MPs and four of the seven independents.
paras.zh: 该法案得到了工党、三名自由党议员和七名独立议员中四名的支持。

paras.en: The bill will now be considered by the state's upper house.
paras.zh: 该法案现在将由该州上​​议院审议。

paras.en: Laws banning conversion practices have passed Tasmania's lower house in what advocates have heralded as a "landmark day" for survivors and the entire LGBTIQA+ community.
paras.zh: 禁止皈依行为的法律已在塔斯马尼亚下议院获得通过，倡导者们将这一天誉为幸存者和整个 LGBTIQA+ 社区的“里程碑式的一天”。

paras.en: The Greens legislation passed on the voices, meaning no formal vote was cast, with the support of Labor, four of the seven independent MPs and Liberals Jeremy Rockliff, Bridget Archer and Roger Jaensch.
paras.zh: 绿党立法在工党、七名独立议员中的四名以及自由党杰里米·罗克利夫（Jeremy Rockliff）、布里奇特·阿彻（Bridget Archer）和罗杰·詹施（Roger Jaensch）的支持下通过了投票，这意味着没有进行正式投票。

paras.en: The legislation bans the practices, defined as attempts to change, suppress or eradicate a person's sexual orientation or gender identity, four years after the Tasmanian Law Reform Institute recommended they be outlawed.
paras.zh: 在塔斯马尼亚法律改革研究所建议取缔这种做法四年后，这项立法禁止了这种试图改变、压制或根除一个人的性取向或性别认同的做法。

paras.en: Research by La Trobe University has found one in 20 young queer Tasmanians have experienced them, and that they are associated with a higher suicide risk.
paras.zh: 拉筹伯大学的研究发现，每 20 名年轻的塔斯马尼亚酷儿中就有 1 人经历过这种情况，而且这种情况与较高的自杀风险有关。

paras.en: The bill will progress to the upper house.
paras.zh: 该法案将提交至上议院。

paras.en: If the legislation passes, Western Australia and the Northern Territory will be the only Australian jurisdictions where conversion practices remain legal, although the West Australian Labor government has made multiple commitments to ban them.
paras.zh: 如果该立法通过，西澳大利亚州和北领地将成为澳大利亚仅有的皈依习俗仍然合法的司法管辖区，尽管西澳大利亚工党政府已多次承诺禁止此类做法。

paras.en: Equality Tasmania campaigner Rodney Croome said he was overjoyed for survivor-advocates that the "important and overdue" legislation had passed the House of Assembly.
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚平等活动家罗德尼·克鲁姆表示，他为幸存者倡导者感到欣喜若狂，因为这项“重要且早该”的立法已在众议院获得通过。

paras.en: "They have bared their souls. They've talked about some really traumatic events in their lives in order to see this legislation pass,"
paras.zh: “他们袒露了自己的灵魂。他们谈论了生活中一些真正的创伤事件，以便看到这项立法通过，”

paras.en: "So I'm really hoping that they feel that it was worthwhile and that they are optimistic for a Tasmania where these practices no longer occur."
paras.zh: “所以我真的希望他们觉得这是值得的，并且对塔斯马尼亚州不再发生这些做法持乐观态度。”

paras.en: "I'm particularly pleased that the bill has cross-party support and that none of the attempts to try and weaken the bill and to allow conversion practices to continue have been successful.
paras.zh: “我特别高兴的是，该法案得到了跨党派的支持，并且试图削弱该法案并允许转换做法继续进行的尝试都没有成功。

paras.en: "I think that sends a strong message to the Tasmanian Upper House, that this legislation has mainstream support, that it's not extreme in any way, and that it's time to get on and ban conversion practices in Tasmania once and for all."
paras.zh: “我认为这向塔斯马尼亚上议院发出了一个强烈的信息，这项立法得到了主流的支持，它在任何方面都不是极端的，现在是时候开始并一劳永逸地禁止塔斯马尼亚的皈依行为了。”

paras.en: Greens Leader Rosalie Woodruff said her party was "so proud" the bill had passed the lower house, which she said was a result of years of campaigning from the LGBTIQA+ community.
paras.zh: 绿党领袖罗莎莉·伍德拉夫 (Rosalie Woodruff) 表示，她的政党对这项法案在下议院获得通过感到“非常自豪”，她表示这是 LGBTIQ+ 社区多年竞选活动的结果。

paras.en: "Central to the debate were victim survivors who've bravely told their stories, and advocates, families of LGBTIQA+ Tasmanians who have spoken up against these devastatingly harmful practices," Ms Woodruff said.
paras.zh: 伍德拉夫女士说：“辩论的核心是勇敢讲述自己故事的受害者幸存者，以及公开反对这些毁灭性有害做法的 LGBTIQA+ 塔斯马尼亚人的倡导者和家庭。”

paras.en: Premier Jeremy Rockliff, who granted his Liberal MPs a conscience vote on the legislation, said Tasmania had, in his personal view, "taken a significant step forward today".
paras.zh: 州长杰里米·罗克利夫(Jeremy Rockliff)给予自由党议员对该立法进行良心投票的机会，他表示，在他个人看来，塔斯马尼亚“今天向前迈出了重要一步”。

paras.en: "One could never understate how meaningful the progress of this bill would be for victim-survivors of harmful conversion practices and their lived experience," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“人们永远无法低估这项法案的进展对于有害皈依行为的受害者幸存者及其生活经历的意义。”

paras.en: Lower house MPs debated the bill for almost 20 hours, with opponents, including Treasurer Eric Abetz and Deputy Premier Guy Barnett, labelling the legislation "overreach".
paras.zh: 下议院议员对该法案进行了近20个小时的辩论，包括财长埃里克·阿贝茨(Eric Abetz)和副州长盖伊·巴内特(Guy Barnett)在内的反对者称该法案“越权”。

paras.en: The bill states multiple things that are not defined as conversion practices, including a health practitioner providing health services that they consider appropriate, participating in online debate, religious prayer or parents discussing matters relating to sexual orientation, gender identity, sexual activity or religion with their children.
paras.zh: 该法案规定了多种未定义为皈依行为的事情，包括医疗从业者提供他们认为适当的医疗服务、参与在线辩论、宗教祈祷或父母与孩子讨论有关性取向、性别认同、性活动或宗教的问题。

paras.en: Multiple amendments to the legislation were made, including the removal of a clause which would have made employers legally liable for offences committed by their employees, unless the employer could not have known of or prevented the offending.
paras.zh: 对立法进行了多次修订，包括删除了一项条款，该条款将使雇主对其雇员的犯罪行为承担法律责任，除非雇主无法知道或阻止犯罪行为。

paras.en: Women Speak Tasmania's Isla MacGregor said the legislation was an "attack on freedom of speech", and said the bill should have been referred to a parliamentary committee to examine its "real ramifications and implications".
paras.zh: 塔斯马尼亚女性发言组织的麦格雷戈岛表示，这项立法是“对言论自由的攻击”，并表示该法案应该提交给议会委员会来审查其“真正的后果和影响”。

paras.en: Independent Bass MP George Razay's bid for the vote to be delayed until a parliamentary committee had examined the legislation was defeated yesterday evening.
paras.zh: 独立巴斯议员乔治·拉泽 (George Razay) 要求推迟投票直至议会委员会审查该立法，但昨天晚上被否决。

articles.title: Nearly 6 million people facing severe hunger in Haiti

paras.en: Nearly 6 million people facing severe hunger in Haiti
paras.zh: 海地近600万人面临严重饥饿

paras.en: Overall number of people suffering severe hunger expected to surge in months ahead
paras.zh: 预计未来几个月遭受严重饥饿的总人数将激增

paras.en: Nearly six million people in Haiti are experiencing severe hunger, with almost two million facing emergency conditions, according to a new report released Wednesday.
paras.zh: 根据周三发布的一份新报告，海地近 600 万人正在经历严重饥饿，近 200 万人面临紧急状况。

paras.en: The worsening crisis in the Caribbean country of nearly 12 million people is blamed on a surge in gang violence and displacement, combined with high food and fuel prices and an extreme El Niño weather phenomenon that is threatening food security.
paras.zh: 这个拥有近 1200 万人口的加勒比国家危机不断恶化，原因是帮派暴力和流离失所激增，加上粮食和燃料价格高涨，以及威胁粮食安全的极端厄尔尼诺天气现象。

paras.en: The UN's Food and Agriculture Organization noted Wednesday that the number of people experiencing high levels of acute food insecurity in Haiti — 5.94 million — is "one of the highest levels in the world today."
paras.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织周三指出，海地遭受严重粮食不安全的人数为 594 万人，是“当今​​世界最高水平之一”。

paras.en: It noted that more than half of Haiti's population struggles to eat every day.
paras.zh: 报告指出，海地一半以上的人口每天都在为吃饭而苦苦挣扎。

paras.en: About one in two Haitians are unable to consistently access sufficient food, and the overall number of people with severe hunger is expected to surge to 6.35 million people — more than half of Haiti's population — by mid-2027, according to the analysis published Wednesday by the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification, a multi-partner UN initiative that analyzes food insecurity and malnutrition worldwide.
paras.zh: 根据综合粮食安全阶段分类周三发布的分析报告，大约有二分之一的海地人无法持续获得充足的食物，到 2027 年中期，严重饥饿人口总数预计将激增至 635 万人，占海地人口的一半以上。

paras.en: The number of Haitians facing severe hunger increased by nearly a quarter of a million since the initiative's last report in April.
paras.zh: 自该倡议四月份发布上次报告以来，面临严重饥饿的海地人数增加了近 25 万。

paras.en: "The numbers are really, really alarming in comparison with other years," Maxime Ngalula, Action Against Hunger's country director for Haiti, said in a phone interview.
paras.zh: “与往年相比，这些数字确实非常令人震惊，”反饥饿行动海地国家主任马克西姆·恩加卢拉（Maxime Ngalula）在电话采访中表示。

paras.en: Many of those experiencing worsening hunger live in makeshift shelters and communities under fire by heavily armed gangs who are fighting Haiti's National Police and a UN-backed gang suppression force.
paras.zh: 许多遭受日益严重饥饿的人生活在临时避难所和社区，遭到全副武装的帮派的攻击，这些帮派正在与海地国家警察和联合国支持的帮派镇压部队作战。

paras.en: Widespread gang violence in Haiti's central region also has caused more hunger as farmers are chased from their lands and the main roads leading to Port-au-Prince and other areas are blocked, preventing goods from reaching the capital and other areas.
paras.zh: 海地中部地区广泛的帮派暴力也导致了更多的饥饿，因为农民被赶出自己的土地，通往太子港和其他地区的主要道路被封锁，货物无法到达首都和其他地区。

paras.en: A vehicle belonging to the Gang Suppression Force in Haiti is seen on patrol in Port-au-Prince last month. (Odelyn Joseph/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 上个月，一辆属于海地帮派镇压部队的车辆在太子港巡逻。 （奥德林·约瑟夫/美联社）

paras.en: "The negotiation with gangs can take one, two, three days," Ngalula said, adding that families sometimes travel up to 15 kilometres to find a food distribution site because organizations are unable to access certain areas. "It's not easy to serve them all."
paras.zh: 恩加卢拉说：“与帮派的谈判可能需要一、两天、三天。”他补充说，由于组织无法进入某些地区，家庭有时要长途跋涉 15 公里才能找到食物分发点。 “为他们所有人提供服务并不容易。”

paras.en: His organization distributes cash and food including rice and beans to help ease the hunger, but challenges remain, especially involving those left homeless by gang violence who are forced to move from one makeshift shelter to another.
paras.zh: 他的组织分发现金和包括大米和豆类在内的食物，以帮助缓解饥饿，但挑战仍然存在，特别是那些因帮派暴力而无家可归的人，他们被迫从一个临时避难所搬到另一个临时避难所。

paras.en: "The strategy now is how to accompany these people or follow them," Ngalula said.
paras.zh: “现在的策略是如何陪伴这些人或跟随他们，”恩加卢拉说。

paras.en: In 2014, only two per cent of Haiti's population was food insecure, but a devastating Hurricane Matthew in 2016 that destroyed crops followed by a surge in gang violence have sparked widespread hunger.
paras.zh: 2014年，海地只有2%的人口面临粮食不安全，但2016年毁灭性的马修飓风摧毁了农作物，随后帮派暴力激增，引发了大范围的饥饿。

paras.en: The UN's World Food Program noted it requires $78 million US to sustain its operations in Haiti through March as the report issued Wednesday warned that "humanitarian assistance should be urgently scaled up to meet immediate needs."
paras.zh: 联合国世界粮食计划署指出，需要 7800 万美元来维持其在海地的行动直至 3 月份，周三发布的报告警告称，“应紧急扩大人道主义援助以满足眼前的需求”。

paras.en: A woman crosses a trash- and debris-strewn street in Port-au-Prince earlier this month. (Patrice Noel/Reuters)
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，一名妇女穿过太子港一条垃圾和碎片散布的街道。 （帕特里斯·诺埃尔/路透社）

paras.en: Deepening hunger comes amid a spike in fighting between gangs and the UN-backed force after four Salvadorean aviation technicians went missing in an attack on Oct. 18 in Port-au-Prince. Since then, El Salvador has deployed more than 1,000 soldiers to Haiti.
paras.zh: 10 月 18 日，四名萨尔瓦多航空技术人员在太子港的一次袭击中失踪，帮派与联合国支持的部队之间的战斗加剧，饥饿加剧。此后，萨尔瓦多向海地派遣了1000多名士兵。

paras.en: "We are very concerned about this surge in violence in densely populated neighbourhoods of the capital," Davina Hayles, Doctors Without Borders head of mission in Haiti, said in a statement on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 无国界医生组织驻海地代表团团长达维娜·海尔斯周三在一份声明中表示：“我们对首都人口稠密社区的暴力事件激增感到非常担忧。”

paras.en: "We fear that this armed conflict will claim even more victims and displace even more people in the coming days, particularly with the arrival of additional international security forces."
paras.zh: “我们担心，这场武装冲突将在未来几天造成更多受害者，让更多人流离失所，特别是随着更多国际安全部队的到来。”

articles.title: Calgary-developed wound treatment used on battlefields in Ukraine
articles.author: Bill Graveland

paras.en: Calgary-developed wound treatment used on battlefields in Ukraine
paras.zh: 卡尔加里开发的伤口治疗方法用于乌克兰战场

paras.en: Lightweight, non-flammable gel applied directly to injuries on front lines
paras.zh: 轻质、不易燃的凝胶可直接涂抹在前线的伤处

paras.en: An innovative wound and burn treatment initially funded by Canada's Department of National Defence is now being delivered by drone to help wounded soldiers and civilians in war-torn Ukraine.
paras.zh: 最初由加拿大国防部资助的一种创新伤口和烧伤治疗方法现在正在通过无人机提供，以帮助饱受战争蹂躏的乌克兰的受伤士兵和平民。

paras.en: Calgary-based NanoTess received Health Canada approval for its NanoSALV Catalytic in 2022 and evaluated it by treating unhoused populations in encampments. It is now being used for military purposes.
paras.zh: 总部位于卡尔加里的 NanoTess 的 NanoSALV Catalytic 于 2022 年获得了加拿大卫生部的批准，并通过治疗营地中的无家可归人群对其进行了评估。它现在被用于军事目的。

paras.en: "We actually started this company with a grant from National Defence back in 2020 and then have had it come full circle here in 2026 to now be used in the front lines within Ukraine," said NanoTess co-founder and CEO Megan Leslie.
paras.zh: NanoTess 联合创始人兼首席执行官梅根·莱斯利 (Megan Leslie) 表示：“实际上，我们早在 2020 年就在国防部的拨款下创办了这家公司，然后在 2026 年又回到了原点，现在已在乌克兰前线使用。”

paras.en: The results of its use in Ukraine were presented at the CAN Health Network Annual Conference in Toronto on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周三在多伦多举行的 CAN 健康网络年会上公布了其在乌克兰的使用结果。

paras.en: Leslie said the NanoSALV catalyst is suspended in a lightweight and non-flammable gel that is directly applied. It can be flown by drone to the front line and used by people with limited medical training to treat a range of wounds.
paras.zh: Leslie说，NanoSALV催化剂悬浮在轻质且不易燃的凝胶中，可以直接使用。它可以通过无人机飞到前线，供受过有限医疗培训的人用来治疗各种伤口。

paras.en: NanoSALV was made available for use on the Ukrainian front lines in June and so far has been used to treat 6,000 wounded soldiers and civilians. The gel uses nanomaterials to speed up and work with the body's natural healing process. It lowers the amount of energy required for healing and fights germs and other infection-causing micro-organisms.
paras.zh: NanoSALV 于 6 月在乌克兰前线投入使用，迄今为止已用于治疗 6,000 名受伤士兵和平民。该凝胶使用纳米材料来加速并配合人体的自然愈合过程。它降低了愈合所需的能量并对抗细菌和其他引起感染的微生物。

paras.en: Clinical pharmacist Hailie Uren said the treatment is critical for buying time on the battlefield. Uren, with the Ukrainian Ministry of Health, said NanoSALV can be applied and go to work when there's only one nurse to care for up to 90 patients.
paras.zh: 临床药剂师 Hailie Uren 表示，治疗对于在战场上争取时间至关重要。乌克兰卫生部的 Uren 表示，当只有一名护士照顾多达 90 名患者时，可以使用 NanoSALV 并开始工作。

paras.en: Hailie Uren, an Australian clinical pharmacist, who has been in eastern Ukraine for the past four years and works for the Ukrainian Ministry of Health, is shown in this undated handout photo. (NanoTess/The Canadian Press)
paras.zh: 这张未注明日期的讲义照片中显示了澳大利亚临床药剂师 Hailie Uren，过去四年一直在乌克兰东部，为乌克兰卫生部工作。 （NanoTess/加拿大新闻社）

paras.en: "That wound can heal without consistent nursing intervention," Uren said.
paras.zh: 乌伦说：“无需持续的护理干预，伤口就可以愈合。”

paras.en: Uren said the catalytic gel is in demand.
paras.zh: 乌伦说，催化凝胶的需求很大。

paras.en: "[After] I receive a casualty when they first arrive at the hospital I will go and visit them the next day and will have a look at their wound," she said. "The other people in the room [then] try and find wounds just so I can use it on them as well."
paras.zh: “当伤员第一次到达医院时，我会在第二天去看望他们，看看他们的伤口，”她说。 “房间里的其他人[然后]尝试寻找伤口，这样我也可以对他们使用它。”

paras.en: Burn treatment for soldiers tragically came home to Canada earlier this month when a wind-whipped wildfire killed four Canadian soldiers and burned dozens more at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，加拿大温赖特军事基地的一场野火导致四名加拿大士兵死亡，数十名士兵被烧伤，士兵的烧伤治疗不幸回到了加拿大。

paras.en: "My colleagues were responding to some of the larger burn injuries in Edmonton," said Dr. Eric Fung, an Alberta-based surgeon who has spent time in Ukraine.
paras.zh: “我的同事正在处理埃德蒙顿的一些较大烧伤事故，”艾伯塔省的外科医生埃里克·冯（Eric Fung）医生说，他曾在乌克兰待过一段时间。

paras.en: He said using the gel in a mass casualty event can reduce strain on the system.
paras.zh: 他说，在大规模伤亡事件中使用凝胶可以减少系统的压力。

paras.en: "In a mass casualty event it really overloads our already overtaxed system, and we have to find room for these new patients and to accomplish that we need to get people in and out of hospital," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“在大规模伤亡事件中，我们已经负担过重的系统确实超负荷了，我们必须为这些新患者找到空间，并让人们进出医院。”

articles.title: Personal data of 40,000 U.S. Homeland Security employees leaked in security breach

paras.en: Personal data of 40,000 U.S. Homeland Security employees leaked in security breach
paras.zh: 40,000 名美国国土安全部员工的个人数据因安全漏洞而泄露

paras.en: Security breaches at FBI and U.S. War Department have also been exposed in the past month
paras.zh: 联邦调查局和美国陆军部的安全漏洞在过去一个月也被曝光

paras.en: The leak website Distributed Denial of Secrets said on Wednesday it has released data on more than 40,000 U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) employees, including details about officials working in sensitive fields such as surveillance and human intelligence.
paras.zh: 泄密网站 Distributed Denial of Secrets 周三表示，已公布了超过 40,000 名美国国土安全部 (DHS) 员工的数据，其中包括监视和人类情报等敏感领域工作的官员的详细信息。

paras.en: DHS said in a statement it was "aware of a potential breach and is actively working to address the situation swiftly and effectively." The agency said it was working to ensure its employees were properly protected and would update the public "when more information is available.”
paras.zh: 国土安全部在一份声明中表示，它“意识到潜在的违规行为，并正在积极努力迅速有效地解决这一问题。”该机构表示，正在努力确保其员工受到适当保护，并将“在获得更多信息时”向公众通报最新情况。

paras.en: The disclosure — which the non-profit data transparency group says draws on information obtained by an entity calling itself "Department of Peace" — is the third major government data leak to have made headlines in the past month.
paras.zh: 非盈利数据透明组织表示，此次披露利用了一个自称为“和平部”的实体获得的信息，这是过去一个月成为头条新闻的第三起重大政府数据泄露事件。

paras.en: In September, the hacking group ShinyHunters claimed the theft of a massive trove of data from the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), including sensitive job details and medical information from thousands of bureau employees. Last week, the U.S. War Department was hit with a class-action lawsuit following a breach that exposed data on millions of current and former military personnel.
paras.zh: 9 月，黑客组织 ShinyHunters 声称联邦调查局 (FBI) 的大量数据被盗，其中包括该局数千名员工的敏感工作详细信息和医疗信息。上周，美国陆军部因泄露数百万现任和前任军事人员数据的事件而受到集体诉讼。

paras.en: - ShinyHunters hackers say they won't leak sensitive FBI data
paras.zh: - ShinyHunters 黑客表示他们不会泄露 FBI 敏感数据

paras.en: - Dutch police arrest security professional in ShinyHunters investigation
paras.zh: - 荷兰警方在 ShinyHunters 调查中逮捕安全专业人士

paras.en: The DHS data includes names, phone numbers and email addresses of employees from Immigration and Customs Enforcement, Customs and Border Protection, Homeland Security Investigations, the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency, and other DHS component agencies.
paras.zh: 国土安全部数据包括移民和海关执法局、海关和边境保护局、国土安全调查局、网络安全和基础设施安全局以及其他国土安全部组成机构的员工的姓名、电话号码和电子邮件地址。

paras.en: Also included in the data were job titles and email groups, which, among other details, showed which agents were assigned to special operations, surveillance jobs, computer forensics and undercover work.
paras.zh: 数据中还包括职务和电子邮件组，其中除其他详细信息外，还显示哪些特工被分配到特殊行动、监视工作、计算机取证和卧底工作。

paras.en: In a statement, Distributed Denial of Secrets co-founder Emma Best said the hacktivist known as "maia arson crimew" developed a search tool for the data that would allow the public to browse it. Best said the tool would "replace anonymity with accountability" and empower journalists, guide public records requests and boost congressional oversight.
paras.zh: Distributed Denial of Secrets 联合创始人艾玛·贝斯特 (Emma Best) 在一份声明中表示，这位被称为“maia arsoncrimew”的黑客活动分子开发了一种数据搜索工具，允许公众浏览数据。贝斯特表示，该工具将“用问责制取代匿名”，并赋予记者权力、指导公共记录请求并加强国会监督。

paras.en: The Department of Peace did not immediately respond to a request for comment, but in a statement included with the data it said that DHS employees "have our information, so it's only fair that we have theirs" and that it hoped the data "can be used to limit further harm by the DHS and supports all efforts in that direction."
paras.zh: 和平部没有立即回应置评请求，但在一份包含数据的声明中表示，国土安全部员工“拥有我们的信息，因此我们拥有他们的信息是公平的”，并希望这些数据“可用于限制国土安全部的进一步伤害，并支持朝这个方向的所有努力。”

paras.en: The Department of Peace in March claimed responsibility for hacking DHS and posting documents related to contracts with outside vendors.
paras.zh: 和平部三月份声称对黑客入侵国土安全部并发布与外部供应商合同相关的文件负责。

paras.en: Best's statement said the Department of Peace harvested the data from the Okta sign-on service used by DHS. Reuters could not immediately corroborate the claim. Okta said in response to a Reuters query: "Okta is secure, and we have no evidence our data or systems were compromised."
paras.zh: 贝斯特的声明称，和平部从国土安全部使用的 Okta 登录服务中收集了数据。路透社无法立即证实这一说法。 Okta 在回应路透社的询问时表示：“Okta 是安全的，我们没有证据表明我们的数据或系统受到损害。”

paras.en: Reuters could not immediately verify the authenticity of the entire data trove but it was able to match personal information about six DHS employees named in the leak to credit bureau records and breach data carried by the dark web intelligence platform District 4 Labs. Reuters called three DHS employees directly and was able to confirm their phone numbers and other details. One said it was the first they had heard of a breach.
paras.zh: 路透社无法立即验证整个数据库的真实性，但它能够将泄密事件中点名的六名国土安全部员工的个人信息与暗网情报平台 District 4 Labs 携带的信用局记录和泄露数据进行匹配。路透社直接致电三名国土安全部员工，确认了他们的电话号码和其他详细信息。有人表示，这是他们第一次听说违规行为。

paras.en: In several cases, the data tracked information available on DHS employees' LinkedIn profiles. But in others, the data revealed non-public data about internal DHS organization charts or previously undisclosed programs or operations.
paras.zh: 在一些情况下，数据会跟踪国土安全部员工 LinkedIn 个人资料上的信息。但在其他情况下，这些数据揭示了有关国土安全部内部组织结构图或之前未公开的计划或运营的非公开数据。

articles.title: Is Iran headed to war or peace after Mecca alliance meeting?

paras.en: Amid rising fear that the US and Israel are preparing to launch new attacks on Iran after the US midterm election on November 3, three major Middle Eastern powers delivered a coordinated diplomatic message directly to Tehran.
paras.zh: 11月3日美国中期选举后，人们越来越担心美国和以色列准备对伊朗发动新的攻击，三个中东大国直接向德黑兰发出了协调一致的外交信息。

paras.en: Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir, Saudi Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman and Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin all traveled to Iran to meet Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and senior officials in Tehran this Monday. The three envoys serve as representatives for the Mecca defense pact — a military alliance of Islamabad, Riyad and Ankara, which was officially set up this summer.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦陆军总司令阿西姆·穆尼尔、沙特国防部长哈立德·本·萨勒曼和土耳其情报局局长易卜拉欣·卡林本周一均前往伊朗，在德黑兰会见伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安和高级官员。这三位特使是麦加防御条约的代表，该条约是伊斯兰堡、利雅得和安卡拉的军事联盟，于今年夏天正式成立。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia said the trip aims to open negotiating channels and "prevent the return of military escalation." Details on the agenda, however, remain scarce.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯表示，此行旨在打开谈判渠道并“防止军事升级再度升级”。然而，议程的细节仍然很少。

paras.en: A senior Pakistani official cited by the Reuters news agency said the talks focused on building a regional non-aggression network, in addition to US-Iran talks, Houthi rebels' attacks on Saudi Arabia, the Strait of Hormuz and the US naval blockade.
paras.zh: 路透社援引巴基斯坦高级官员的话说，除了美伊会谈、胡塞武装袭击沙特阿拉伯、霍尔木兹海峡和美国海上封锁之外，会谈的重点还包括建立地区互不侵犯网络。

paras.en: Another official said Pakistan's Munir presented Iran with a solution to the conflict that would offer something both to Washington and Iran, with the three Mecca states and Qatar acting as mediators. The source told Reuters US President Donald Trump previously gave Munir the go-ahead to try diplomacy.
paras.zh: 另一位官员表示，巴基斯坦穆尼尔向伊朗提出了解决冲突的方案，这对华盛顿和伊朗都有好处，而麦加三个国家和卡塔尔将充当调解人。消息人士告诉路透社，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普此前曾批准穆尼尔尝试外交努力。

paras.en: Tehran presents the meeting as a success
paras.zh: 德黑兰称这次会议取得了成功

paras.en: Iran hailed the "very positive atmosphere" during the Tehran talks, even though no breakthroughs were officially announced.
paras.zh: 伊朗称赞德黑兰会谈期间的“非常积极的气氛”，尽管官方并未宣布取得任何突破。

paras.en: "Very good discussions took place between us," Mohsen Rezaei, head of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, told state television. "I feel that a new atmosphere is emerging in the region."
paras.zh: 伊朗最高国家安全委员会主席穆赫森·雷扎伊对国家电视台表示：“我们之间进行了非常好的讨论。” “我感觉该地区正在出现一种新的氛围。”

paras.en: Rezaei argued that regional security should be built by countries in West Asia themselves and without outside intervention.
paras.zh: 雷扎伊认为，地区安全应由西亚国家自己建设，无需外部干预。

paras.en: A day later, Rezaei reportedly met Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. Iranian state media said Khamenei called for protecting Iran's interests and maintaining Tehran's conditions for ending both the war and the current state of "neither war nor peace."
paras.zh: 据报道，一天后，雷扎伊会见了最高领袖哈梅内伊。伊朗官方媒体称，哈梅内伊呼吁保护伊朗的利益，维持德黑兰结束战争和当前“非战非和”状态的条件。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian travelled to Moscow for the Gas Exporting Countries Forum, where he met Russian President Vladimir Putin and Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, with Pezeshkian and the emir also discussing the war and the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 与此同时，伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安前往莫斯科参加天然气出口国论坛，在那里他会见了俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京和卡塔尔埃米尔谢赫·塔米姆·本·哈马德·阿勒萨尼，佩泽什基安和埃米尔还讨论了战争和霍尔木兹海峡。

paras.en: These and other diplomatic contacts were framed by Tehran as evidence that the US is unable to diplomatically isolate the Iranian regime.
paras.zh: 这些和其他外交接触被德黑兰视为美国无法在外交上孤立伊朗政权的证据。

paras.en: Are Turkey and Pakistan closing ranks with Saudi Arabia?
paras.zh: 土耳其和巴基斯坦是否正在与沙特阿拉伯拉近关系？

paras.en: The united front presented by the three nations in Tehran, however, can also be seen as a show of force for the new Mecca defense alliance. It comes as the Saudis grow increasingly wary of the attacks on Saudi infrastructure launched by the Iran-allied Houthi militants.
paras.zh: 然而，三个国家在德黑兰提出的统一战线也可以被视为新麦加防御联盟的武力展示。与此同时，沙特人对伊朗盟友胡塞武装分子对沙特基础设施发动的袭击越来越警惕。

paras.en: Under the terms of the Mecca agreement, an outside attack on one of the member states is to be regarded as an attack on all of them. The visit also came on the same day as Egypt's parliament agreeing to give military help to Ryad and take "all necessary measures" to help Saudi Arabia defend itself, in addition to the looming threat of the US and Israel.
paras.zh: 根据麦加协议的条款，对其中一个成员国的外部攻击将被视为对所有成员国的攻击。这次访问的同一天，埃及议会同意向里亚德提供军事帮助，并采取“一切必要措施”帮助沙特阿拉伯自卫，此外还面临美国和以色列迫在眉睫的威胁。

paras.en: "The presence of the three senior representatives at the same time sent the message that these countries are acting as a bloc," Babak Dorbeiki, a London-based political analyst and former official at Iran's Strategic Research Center, told DW.
paras.zh: 伦敦政治分析家、伊朗战略研究中心前官员巴巴克·多尔贝基 (Babak Dorbeiki) 告诉德国之声：“三位高级代表同时出席，传达出这些国家正在作为一个集团行动的信息。”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has long been regarded as Iran's archrival in region. It has used its enormous wealth to counter Iran's influence, and now it can, at least in theory, also count on Pakistan's nuclear capability, and Turkey's conventional military strength.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯长期以来被视为伊朗在该地区的主要竞争对手。它利用其巨大的财富来对抗伊朗的影响力，现在至少在理论上，它还可以依靠巴基斯坦的核能力和土耳其的常规军事实力。

paras.en: At the same time, Dorbeiki argued that the Mecca pact is primarily designed for deterrence rather than offensive war. And having a defense pact does not mean its members want to fight Iran.
paras.zh: 与此同时，多尔贝基认为，麦加条约主要是为了威慑而不是进攻性战争。签署防务协议并不意味着其成员国想要与伊朗作战。

paras.en: Dorbeiki believes the message from the bloc could therefore work in two directions: It can provide mediation, but continued escalation could also alter that position.
paras.zh: 多贝基认为，欧盟发出的信息可以在两个方向发挥作用：它可以提供调解，但持续升级也可能改变这一立场。

paras.en: Ryad pushing for a 'diplomatic solution'
paras.zh: 里亚德推动“外交解决方案”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia faces the most immediate dilemma. Further Houthi attacks have damaged its infrastructure and economy, but a wider war with Iran could threaten the investment and development projects at the heart of Riyadh's economic strategy.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯面临着最直接的困境。胡塞武装的进一步袭击损害了利雅得的基础设施和经济，但与伊朗更广泛的战争可能会威胁到利雅得经济战略核心的投资和发展项目。

paras.en: "For Saudi Arabia, both the current situation and a war with Iran carry serious costs," Dorbeiki said. "Its preferred route is, therefore, a diplomatic solution."
paras.zh: 多贝基说：“对于沙特阿拉伯来说，当前局势以及与伊朗的战争都会带来严重代价。” “因此，它的首选途径是外交解决方案。”

paras.en: Moreover, Pakistan has spent months mediating between Washington and Tehran, and has important relations with both. A direct conflict would also distract Islamabad from its long-standing security concerns involving India.
paras.zh: 此外，巴基斯坦花了数月时间在华盛顿和德黑兰之间进行斡旋，并与两国都有重要关系。直接冲突还会分散伊斯兰堡对涉及印度的长期安全担忧的注意力。

paras.en: Turkey is a NATO member, but Dorbeiki said direct military support for Iran against the United States is highly improbable. The fact that Ankara sent intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin rather than its foreign or defense minister also suggests a cautious approach.
paras.zh: 土耳其是北约成员国，但多贝基表示，为伊朗提供针对美国的直接军事支持的可能性极小。安卡拉派出情报总监易卜拉欣·卡林而不是外交部长或国防部长这一事实也表明了其谨慎的做法。

paras.en: Iran pursues diplomacy while preparing for fighting
paras.zh: 伊朗在做好战斗准备的同时追求外交

paras.en: Ali Asghar Shafieian, media advisor for Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian, also rejected the perspective that the Mecca pact representatives were trying to present Tehran with an ultimatum.
paras.zh: 伊朗总统马苏德·佩泽什基安的媒体顾问阿里·阿斯加尔·沙菲安也否认了麦加条约代表试图向德黑兰发出最后通牒的观点。

paras.en: He told DW that the three countries may also have wanted to demonstrate their own growing coordination, while showing that Iran remains part of regional diplomacy.
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声，这三个国家可能还想展示自己日益加强的协调，同时表明伊朗仍然是地区外交的一部分。

paras.en: "You cannot conclude from this meeting alone that it was an ultimatum before an attack," Shafieian said.
paras.zh: 沙菲安说：“你不能仅从这次会议得出结论，这是袭击前的最后通牒。”

paras.en: He also noted that Iran, just like the US and Israel, could prepare for the possibility of further conflict while maintaining negotiations.
paras.zh: 他还指出，就像美国和以色列一样，伊朗可以在维持谈判的同时为进一步冲突的可能性做好准备。

paras.en: "Just as they use the opportunity to strengthen their military and defensive capabilities, Iran does the same," he said, adding that an agreement remains possible if Iran's political standing and what Tehran describes as its national dignity are respected.
paras.zh: 他说：“正如他们利用这个机会加强军事和防御能力一样，伊朗也会这样做。”他补充说，如果伊朗的政治地位和德黑兰所说的国家尊严得到尊重，达成协议的可能性仍然存在。

paras.en: Dorbeiki argued that Iran is following a familiar strategy of extending negotiations while avoiding real-world commitments.
paras.zh: 多贝基认为，伊朗正在遵循一种熟悉的策略，即扩大谈判，同时避免做出现实承诺。

paras.en: The Houthi rebels are central to Tehran's calculation.
paras.zh: 胡塞叛军是德黑兰算盘的核心。

paras.en: Tehran has not publicly offered the kind of guarantees over Houthi attacks that Riyadh would want. Dorbeiki believes Iran could seek to trade influence over such the attacks for concessions such as an end to US military pressure and broader steps toward ending the war.
paras.zh: 德黑兰尚未公开提供利雅得所希望的针对胡塞武装袭击的保证。多贝基认为，伊朗可能会寻求用对此类袭击的影响力换取让步，例如结束美国的军事压力和采取更广泛的措施来结束战争。

paras.en: The only apparent outcome of the Tehran meeting is to keep talking. For Iran, that might be enough of a signal that it is still a diplomatic partner rather than an enemy.
paras.zh: 德黑兰会议唯一明显的结果就是继续对话。对于伊朗来说，这可能足以表明它仍然是外交伙伴而不是敌人。
