articles.title: How do the US midterms work, and why are they so important for Trump's presidency?

paras.en: On November 3, United States citizens will vote in the midterm elections. These won't decide who gets to sit in the White House; instead, Americans will be voting on who they want to see in the Capitol.
paras.zh: 11月3日，美国公民将在中期选举中投票。这些不会决定谁能入主白宫；相反，美国人将投票决定他们希望在国会大厦看到谁。

paras.en: Midterm elections are held every four years, at the exact halfway point between presidential elections. The people of the United States decide who will represent them in the two chambers of the US Congress, the House of Representatives and the Senate. Some states are also voting for their governor. These are the decisions on the ballot paper — but they are not the only thing voters will be taking into account.
paras.zh: 中期选举每四年举行一次，恰好在总统选举的中间点举行。美国人民决定谁将在美国国会两院——众议院和参议院中代表他们。一些州也在投票选举他们的州长。这些是选票上的决定——但它们并不是选民唯一考虑的因素。

paras.en: J. Miles Coleman, an election analyst at the Center for Politics at the University of Virginia, explained before the last midterms that they were "often a referendum on the president and party currently in power." If the people are content, the party of the leader in the White House does better than if the people are predominantly dissatisfied. President Donald Trump's approval ratings are currently at a record low.
paras.zh: 弗吉尼亚大学政治中心的选举分析师 J. 迈尔斯·科尔曼 (J. Miles Coleman) 在上次中期选举前解释说，这次中期选举“通常是对现任总统和执政党的公投”。如果人民满意，那么白宫领导人所在的政党会比人民普遍不满意的情况下做得更好。唐纳德·特朗普总统的支持率目前处于历史最低水平。

paras.en: Who are Americans electing in the midterms?
paras.zh: 美国人在中期选举中选举谁？

paras.en: All the seats in the US House of Representatives are up for election. Its 435 members are elected by eligible voters across the country. Each member represents one electoral district. These are allocated based on population size. As a result, relatively large US states where few people live, such as Wyoming, have only one seat in the House of Representatives. New Jersey, a much smaller state by surface area but with a larger population, has 12. Representatives are elected for a two-year term of office.
paras.zh: 美国众议院所有席位都将进行选举。其 435 名成员由全国合格选民选举产生。每位成员代表一个选区。这些是根据人口规模分配的。因此，美国面积较大、人口稀少的州，例如怀俄明州，在众议院只有一个席位。新泽西州面积较小，但人口较多，有 12 名代表，任期两年。

paras.en: US senators, on the other hand, are elected for a six-year term. The Senate, the other chamber of the US Congress, has 100 seats: two for each of the 50 US states, regardless of size. Around one third of these senatorial seats come up for election every two years. This year there are 35, meaning that not every state will be electing a senator in these midterms.
paras.zh: 另一方面，美国参议员的任期为六年。参议院是美国国会的另一个议院，拥有 100 个席位：美国 50 个州，无论大小，每个州都有两个席位。这些参议员席位中约有三分之一每两年进行一次选举。今年有 35 个州，这意味着并非每个州都会在中期选举中选出参议员。

paras.en: Separately, voters in 36 states will elect their governor, whose term of office is four years in most states. Many decisions in the US are taken at state level, on everything from abortion law to education and electoral procedure. It can therefore make a considerable difference to people's lives whether Democrats or Republicans are the ones making these decisions in their state.
paras.zh: 另外，36个州的选民将选举州长，大多数州的州长任期为四年。美国的许多决定都是在州一级做出的，涉及从堕胎法到教育和选举程序的各个方面。因此，无论是民主党人还是共和党人在本州做出这些决定，都会对人们的生活产生相当大的影响。

paras.en: Who currently has a majority in the US Congress?
paras.zh: 目前谁在美国国会中拥有多数席位？

paras.en: At present, the Republicans, the party of President Trump, have a majority in both houses of Congress — but its margin is slim.
paras.zh: 目前，特朗普总统所在的共和党在国会参众两院均占多数席位，但优势微乎其微。

paras.en: The House of Representatives currently has 218 Republican deputies, 214 Democrats, and one independent, who usually votes with the Republicans. Two seats are vacant. Observers think it likely that the Democrats will seize the majority in this chamber in the upcoming elections. "It would be a surprise if the Democrats don't at least take the House [of Representatives]," Coleman told the American broadcaster CBS at the end of October.
paras.zh: 众议院目前有 218 名共和党议员、214 名民主党议员和一名通常投票支持共和党的无党派议员。两个座位空着。观察人士认为，民主党很可能在即将到来的选举中夺取众议院的多数席位。科尔曼十月底对美国广播公司哥伦比亚广播公司表示：“如果民主党至少不能拿下众议院，那将是令人惊讶的。”

paras.en: In the Senate there are currently 53 Republicans, 45 Democrats, and two independent senators who usually vote with the Democrats. When a vote in the Senate is deadlocked 50:50, the US vice president has the deciding vote. This means that currently, Trump's Vice President JD Vance would tip the scales if there were a tie in a Senate vote.
paras.zh: 参议院目前有 53 名共和党人、45 名民主党人以及两名通常支持民主党投票的独立参议员。当参议院投票陷入50:50僵局时，美国副总统拥有决定性一票。这意味着，目前如果参议院投票出现平局，特朗普的副总统万斯将扭转局势。

paras.en: Voter turnout is typically lower for midterms than for presidential elections, but the results will decisively influence US politics for the next few years. Despite the significant executive power delegated to the presidency, the majority of federal political decisions have to be approved by Congress before they can be implemented.
paras.zh: 中期选举的选民投票率通常低于总统选举，但选举结果将对未来几年的美国政治产生决定性影响。尽管总统被授予重要的行政权力，但大多数联邦政治决定必须得到国会批准才能实施。

paras.en: It is therefore considerably easier for Trump to govern the country as he chooses if the Republicans have a majority in both chambers of Congress. If the Democrats win a majority in one or both chambers, it will be more difficult for him to make changes to either domestic or foreign policy.
paras.zh: 因此，如果共和党在参众两院都占多数，特朗普就可以更容易地按照自己的选择来治理国家。如果民主党在参众两院获得多数席位，他将更难改变国内或外交政策。

paras.en: The Democrats only need to win four more seats in the House of Representatives to gain a majority. They would then have 218 representatives. Out of the 435 races, only a few are still considered toss-ups. These include districts in Iowa, Virginia and Montana.
paras.zh: 民主党只需再赢得众议院四个席位即可获得多数席位。那么他们将有 218 名代表。在 435 场比赛中，只有少数仍被认为是难以胜负的比赛。其中包括爱荷华州、弗吉尼亚州和蒙大拿州的地区。

paras.en: One senatorial race to watch is the one in Texas. Current polls put Democrat James Talarico level with his Republican rival, Ken Paxton. The Democrats need four more seats in the Senate to win a majority. The possibility that Texas could be one of them is already a sensation. No Democrat has won here at state level since 1994. Talarico now even has the support of some members of the Bush family, the Texas Republican dynasty of former presidents George H.W. Bush and George W. Bush, his son.
paras.zh: 一场值得关注的参议员竞选是德克萨斯州的一场。目前的民意调查显示，民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科（James Talarico）与共和党对手肯·帕克斯顿（Ken Paxton）持平。民主党需要在参议院再增加四个席位才能赢得多数席位。德克萨斯州可能成为其中之一的可能性已经引起了轰动。自 1994 年以来，还没有民主党人在州一级获胜。塔拉里科现在甚至得到了布什家族、前总统乔治·H·W·布什的德克萨斯州共和党王朝的一些成员的支持。布什和他的儿子乔治·W·布什。

paras.en: In the gubernatorial elections it is possible that, for the first time in US history, a Black woman could become state governor. In Minnesota, the Democrat Amy Klobuchar and the Black Republican Lisa DeMuth are vying for the position, while in Georgia the Black Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms is up against the Republican Rick Jackson.
paras.zh: 在州长选举中，黑人女性有可能成为美国历史上第一次州长。在明尼苏达州，民主党人艾米·克洛布查尔和黑人共和党人丽莎·德穆斯正在争夺这一职位，而在佐治亚州，黑人民主党人凯莎·兰斯·博顿斯正在与共和党人里克·杰克逊竞争。

paras.en: DeMuth is unlikely to win in Minnesota: The state generally votes Democrat, and Klobuchar, who has been state senator there for almost two decades, is much better known than her rival. In Georgia, however, the latest polls suggest it's neck-and-neck. Bottoms has a realistic chance of winning.
paras.zh: 德穆斯不太可能在明尼苏达州获胜：该州普遍投票给民主党，而克洛布查尔已经担任该州参议员近二十年，比她的竞争对手更出名。然而，在佐治亚州，最新民意调查显示，两者势均力敌。博顿斯有现实的获胜机会。

paras.en: This article has been translated from German.
paras.zh: 本文是从德文翻译而来。

articles.title: Flavio Bolsonaro lands in US, declares himself 'leader' of Brazil

paras.en: Brazilian right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro declared himself the rightful leader of Brazil after landing in Miami with his family on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 巴西右翼总统候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗周三与家人抵达迈阿密后宣布自己是巴西的合法领导人。

paras.en: Bolsonaro fled Brazil after the Supreme Court asked him to hand over his passports so he couldn't leave the country.
paras.zh: 在最高法院要求博尔索纳罗交出护照以免他离开巴西后，他逃离了巴西。

paras.en: The right-wing senator had not conceded defeat in Sunday's presidential election to rival, President Luiz Inacio "Lula"da Silva.
paras.zh: 这位右翼参议员并未承认在周日的总统选举中输给了竞争对手、总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·“卢拉”·达·席尔瓦。

paras.en: Bolsonaro lost elections on Sunday and alleged irregularities. His party has acknowledged the results of Sunday's elections and international observers have observed it was fair. The chief of the Brazilian electoral authority said Wednesday that vote proceeded normally and in full accordance with the country's laws and constitution.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗周日在选举中落败，并被指控存在违规行为。他的政党已经承认周日的选举结果，国际观察员也认为这是公平的。巴西选举当局负责人周三表示，投票正常进行，完全符合该国法律和宪法。

paras.en: In an initial open letter posted to X, Bolsonaro declared himself the "elected president." He then deleted the version and updated it with another letter in which he said he was the rightful "leader" of Brazil.
paras.zh: 在最初发布给 X 的公开信中，博尔索纳罗宣称自己是“当选总统”。然后他删除了该版本并更新了另一封信，他在信中称自己是巴西的合法“领导人”。

paras.en: Bolsonaro faces criminal investigations into alleged financial crimes before the country's Supreme Court. But he has cast those investigations as a political witch hunt against his family by left-leaning justices.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗面临该国最高法院涉嫌金融犯罪的刑事调查。但他将这些调查视为左倾法官对他家人的政治迫害。

paras.en: "I want to say, not only to my 60 million voters but to the Brazilian people, that I am the leader and that the criminals who stole Brazil’s election are part of a criminal organization that has established a tyranny," he said in the updated version.
paras.zh: 他在最新版本中表示：“我不仅想对我的 6000 万选民说，而且对巴西人民说，我是领导人，窃取巴西选举的犯罪分子是建立暴政的犯罪组织的一部分。”

paras.en: Asked by reporters at Joint Base Andrews about Bolsonaro's comments, US President Donald Trump declined to comment, reiterating earlier views on how it was "a very strange election."
paras.zh: 当安德鲁斯联合基地的记者询问博尔索纳罗的言论时，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普拒绝发表评论，并重申了早些时候关于这是“一场非常奇怪的选举”的观点。

paras.en: The US State Department has said it will grant Bolsonaro and his family US visas.
paras.zh: 美国国务院表示将向博尔索纳罗及其家人发放美国签证。

paras.en: When did Bolsonaro arrive and how did he reach Miami?
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗何时抵达以及如何抵达迈阿密？

paras.en: Bolsonaro, his wife and two daughters were seen disembarking a Gulfstream G400 plane and heading into the Miami-Opa Locka airport on Wednesday morning.
paras.zh: 周三早上，有人看到博尔索纳罗、他的妻子和两个女儿登上一架湾流 G400 飞机，前往迈阿密-奥帕洛卡机场。

paras.en: Their journey across the Americas had captured regional attention.
paras.zh: 他们穿越美洲的旅程引起了地区的关注。

paras.en: The quartet first flew into Argentina late on Tuesday, then took a private jet to the Ecuadorian city of Guayaquil. From there, they continued to Miami, in Florida.
paras.zh: 四人于周二晚间首先飞往阿根廷，然后乘坐私人飞机飞往厄瓜多尔市瓜亚基尔。从那里，他们继续前往佛罗里达州的迈阿密。

paras.en: Bolsonaro would lose his immunity from prosecution in February when his term in the Senate ends. On Monday, he had said in an Instagram post that he had no intention of leaving the country and that he would "hand over my passports and defend myself against this travesty, which is a clear attempt to intimidate me."
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗将于二月份参议院任期结束后失去起诉豁免权。周一，他在 Instagram 上发帖表示，他无意离开这个国家，他将“交出我的护照，并为自己辩护，免受这种嘲讽，这显然是在恐吓我。”

paras.en: According to the AFP news agency, Bolsonaro also holds Italian citizenship and so was able to travel despite his Brazilian and diplomatic passports being canceled.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，博尔索纳罗还拥有意大利公民身份，因此尽管他的巴西和外交护照被取消，但他仍然能够旅行。

paras.en: Potential source of strain between Trump's US and Lula's Brazil
paras.zh: 特朗普领导下的美国与卢拉领导下的巴西之间的潜在紧张根源

paras.en: Bolsonaro's departure and his arrival in Florida — like his father Jair Bolsonaro before him after Brazil's previous presidential elections — could deepen a rift between the two most populous countries in the Americas.
paras.zh: 博尔索纳罗的离开和抵达佛罗里达州——就像他的父亲贾尔·博尔索纳罗在巴西上次总统选举后在他之前所做的那样——可能会加深这两个美洲人口最多的国家之间的裂痕。

paras.en: During the election campaign, incumbent leftist President Lula had accused the Trump administration of colluding with the Bolsonaro family in a bid to help them return to power.
paras.zh: 在竞选期间，现任左翼总统卢拉曾指责特朗普政府与博尔索纳罗家族勾结，以帮助他们重新掌权。

paras.en: After the election results, Trump appeared to question the integrity of the vote, saying he thought the extension to voting times was a "very bad look." He had also alleged in the past that Jair Bolsonaro was the victim of judicial persecution in Brazil.
paras.zh: 选举结果公布后，特朗普似乎质疑投票的完整性，称他认为延长投票时间是“非常糟糕的表现”。他过去还声称雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗是巴西司法迫害的受害者。

paras.en: Bolsonaro senior is now in jail in Brazil on charges of leading a conspiracy designed to keep him in power despite defeat in 2022's presidential election.
paras.zh: 老博尔索纳罗目前在巴西入狱，罪名是领导一项阴谋，旨在让他在 2022 年总统选举中落败后继续掌权。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Russia says more than 600 drones launched towards Moscow overnight

paras.en: Russia has downed most of the 613 drones launched towards Moscow overnight, in a major attack on the Russian capital, Russian state news agency TASS has reported.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯国家通讯社塔斯社报道，俄罗斯在一夜之间击落了向莫斯科发射的 613 架无人机中的大部分，这是对俄罗斯首都的一次重大袭击。

paras.en: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said on Telegram that air defence forces destroyed 231 of the unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) on approach to the city, with the remainder neutralised on distant approaches between Wednesday evening and Thursday morning.
paras.zh: 莫斯科市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁 (Sergei Sobyanin) 在 Telegram 上表示，防空部队在周三晚间至周四上午期间摧毁了 231 架接近该市的无人机，其余无人机则在较远距离被摧毁。

paras.en: The attack marks the latest in a series of major drone assaults targeting the Moscow region, following a record attack in September during which air defence forces reported shooting down more than 1,600 drones.
paras.zh: 这次袭击是针对莫斯科地区的一系列重大无人机袭击中的最新一起，继 9 月份发生创纪录的袭击事件后，防空部队报告击落了 1,600 多架无人机。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Russia attacked Ukraine’s Kharkiv, the country’s second-biggest city, damaging an educational institution, Mayor Ihor Terekhov said on Telegram.
paras.zh: 与此同时，市长伊霍尔·捷列霍夫 (Ihor Terekhov) 在 Telegram 上表示，俄罗斯袭击了该国第二大城市哈尔科夫市，摧毁了一所教育机构。

articles.title: Can Turkiye’s Libya breakthrough reshape Eastern Mediterranean diplomacy?

paras.en: Istanbul, Turkiye – Once adversaries, Turkiye and the leadership of eastern Libya are now building closer political and military ties. Ankara has also repaired relations with Egypt in the past few years after previous hostility, but a maritime dispute is testing how far those reconciliations can go.
paras.zh: 土耳其伊斯坦布尔 — — 土耳其和利比亚东部领导人曾经是对手，现在正在建立更紧密的政治和军事关系。在经历了之前的敌对之后，安卡拉在过去几年也修复了与埃及的关系，但海上争端正在考验这些和解能走多远。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Turkiye’s Ministry of National Defence renewed its offer to sign a maritime boundary agreement with Cairo, arguing that Egypt could gain more than 15,000sq km (5,790sq miles) of maritime jurisdiction – a figure that is Ankara’s estimate – compared with a potential further agreement with Greece, with which Cairo signed a partial maritime deal in 2020.
paras.zh: 周三，土耳其国防部再次提出与开罗签署海上边界协议，称埃及可以获得超过 15,000 平方公里（5,790 平方英里）的海上管辖权（这是安卡拉的估计数字），而与希腊可能达成的进一步协议相比，开罗在 2020 年与希腊签署了部分海上协议。

paras.en: The offer came eight days after Libya’s eastern-based parliament in Tobruk reversed years of opposition and approved a maritime agreement signed between its rival, the internationally recognised government based in the Libyan capital, Tripoli, and Turkiye in 2019.
paras.zh: 八天前，位于托布鲁克的利比亚东部议会推翻了多年来的反对，并批准了其竞争对手、国际公认的利比亚首都的黎波里政府和土耳其于 2019 年签署的一项海事协议。

paras.en: The agreement delineates maritime jurisdiction areas claimed by Turkiye and Libya in the Mediterranean, but Greece, Cyprus and Egypt argued that it infringes on their sovereign rights while Turkiye maintains that it complies with international law.
paras.zh: 该协议划定了土耳其和利比亚在地中海主张的海洋管辖区，但希腊、塞浦路斯和埃及认为该协议侵犯了其主权权利，而土耳其则坚称其符合国际法。

paras.en: A senior Turkish official told Al Jazeera that eastern Libya’s leaders had come to recognise Ankara’s intentions.
paras.zh: 一名土耳其高级官员告诉半岛电视台，利比亚东部领导人已经认识到安卡拉的意图。

paras.en: “Turkiye is not there to use Libya for its own purposes,” the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“土耳其并不是为了自己的目的而利用利比亚。”

paras.en: “From the very beginning, we have supported a policy of one Libya,” the official added, stressing that the country’s stability and resources should benefit all Libyans.
paras.zh: 这位官员补充说：“从一开始，我们就支持一个利比亚的政策。”他强调，该国的稳定和资源应该惠及所有利比亚人。

paras.en: Turkiye helped repel a 2019-2020 offensive on Tripoli by forces loyal to renegade military commander Khalifa Haftar, leader of the military forces of the eastern government. Ankara has since expanded its relations with the eastern camp while maintaining ties with Tripoli.
paras.zh: 土耳其帮助击退了忠于叛变军事指挥官、东部政府军队领导人哈利法·哈夫塔尔的部队在 2019 年至 2020 年对的黎波里发动的攻势。此后，安卡拉扩大了与东部阵营的关系，同时保持了与的黎波里的关系。

paras.en: The senior official said Turkish security personnel based in Tripoli had remained in contact with eastern Libyan forces even during the confrontation.
paras.zh: 这位高级官员表示，即使在冲突期间，驻的黎波里的土耳其安全人员仍与利比亚东部部队保持联系。

paras.en: “There has actually been no change in our policy. Only the results it has produced have changed,” the official said.
paras.zh: “我们的政策实际上没有改变。只是它产生的结果发生了变化，”该官员表示。

paras.en: The diplomatic outreach has been accompanied by military and intelligence contacts.
paras.zh: 外交活动伴随着军事和情报接触。

paras.en: In May, Defence Minister Yasar Guler met Saddam Haftar, Khalifa Haftar’s son, and Abdulsalam al-Zoubi, a senior defence official in the Tripoli-based government.
paras.zh: 5月，国防部长亚萨尔·古勒会见了哈利法·哈夫塔尔的儿子萨达姆·哈夫塔尔和的黎波里政府高级国防官员阿卜杜勒萨拉姆·祖比。

paras.en: Turkish intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin also met Saddam Haftar in Benghazi on June 23. Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan followed in August, meeting both Khalifa and Saddam Haftar.
paras.zh: 土耳其情报局长易卜拉欣·卡林还于 6 月 23 日在班加西会见了萨达姆·哈夫塔尔。外交部长哈坎·菲丹随后于 8 月会见了哈利法和萨达姆·哈夫塔尔。

paras.en: A change in Libya’s eastern parliamentary leadership also preceded the maritime vote. On October 6, lawmakers replaced Aguila Saleh as parliament speaker with Al-Salhin Abdelnabi al-Obeidi, who previously chaired the Libyan-Turkish parliamentary friendship committee.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部议会领导层也在海上投票之前发生了变化。 10 月 6 日，立法者将阿吉拉·萨利赫 (Aguila Saleh) 替换为议会议长，此前曾担任利比亚-土耳其议会友好委员会主席的萨利欣·阿卜杜勒纳比·奥贝迪 (Al-Salhin Abdelnabi al-Obeidi)。

paras.en: Galip Dalay, a senior research fellow at Chatham House, sees Ankara’s engagement with its former adversaries as a strategic gain.
paras.zh: 查塔姆研究所高级研究员加利普·达莱认为，安卡拉与其前对手的接触是一种战略收益。

paras.en: “This is not merely a pragmatic or tactical gain. It is a strategic gain for Turkiye,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “这不仅仅是务实或战术上的收获。这对土耳其来说是战略上的收获，”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Dalay argued that closer relations with both Libyan camps make it harder to establish Eastern Mediterranean energy and security arrangements that exclude Turkiye.
paras.zh: 达莱认为，与利比亚两个阵营的密切关系使得建立排除土耳其的东地中海能源和安全安排变得更加困难。

paras.en: The rapprochement also reflects political calculations within the Haftar camp.
paras.zh: 和解也反映了哈夫塔尔阵营内部的政治算计。

paras.en: Tarek Megerisi, a visiting fellow at the European Council on Foreign Relations, believes Saddam Haftar hopes Ankara’s influence could strengthen his own political prospects with many believing that he eventually wants to lead Libya.
paras.zh: 欧洲外交关系委员会访问学者塔里克·迈格里西认为，萨达姆·哈夫塔尔希望安卡拉的影响力能够增强他自己的政治前景，许多人相信他最终想领导利比亚。

paras.en: The senior Turkish official said Ankara had made no specific political commitments to eastern Libyan officials beyond general principles and cooperation that would also benefit Libya.
paras.zh: 土耳其高级官员表示，除了也有利于利比亚的一般原则和合作外，安卡拉没有向利比亚东部官员做出任何具体政治承诺。

paras.en: Representatives of both Libyan camps held talks in Ankara on Friday about unifying their military structures, according to Libyan media reports. Differences over political oversight remain unresolved, and no final agreement has been announced.
paras.zh: 据利比亚媒体报道，利比亚两个阵营的代表周五在安卡拉就统一军事结构举行了会谈。政治监督方面的分歧仍未解决，最终协议尚未公布。

paras.en: But Anas El Gomati, director of the Sadeq Institute, cautioned that an understanding between Libya’s rival leaders would not necessarily produce an inclusive political settlement.
paras.zh: 但萨德克研究所所长阿纳斯·埃尔·戈马蒂警告说，利比亚敌对领导人之间的谅解不一定会产生包容性的政治解决方案。

paras.en: “An elite bargain between two camps can leave out everyone beyond them,” he said.
paras.zh: “两个阵营之间的精英讨价还价可能会排除除他们之外的所有人，”他说。

paras.en: The Libyan eastern parliament’s reversal has also complicated Egypt’s position. Cairo has traditionally supported the eastern leadership but opposes the maritime agreement it has now endorsed.
paras.zh: 利比亚东部议会的逆转也让埃及的立场变得复杂。开罗传统上支持东方领导层，但反对其现在认可的海事协议。

paras.en: On October 22, Greek Foreign Minister Giorgos Gerapetritis announced discussions with Egypt on extending their partial 2020 maritime delimitation agreement eastwards towards Cyprus.
paras.zh: 10月22日，希腊外长吉奥尔戈斯·杰拉佩特里蒂斯宣布与埃及就2020年部分海洋划界协议向东延伸至塞浦路斯进行讨论。

paras.en: Four days later, Egypt joined Greece, Cyprus, Bahrain, the United Arab Emirates and the European Union in a statement at the United Nations rejecting the Turkiye-Libya accord.
paras.zh: 四天后，埃及与希腊、塞浦路斯、巴林、阿拉伯联合酋长国和欧盟一起在联合国发表声明，拒绝土耳其-利比亚协议。

paras.en: Yet Cairo and Ankara have continued rebuilding their relationship.
paras.zh: 然而开罗和安卡拉仍在继续重建关系。

paras.en: Turkiye’s land forces commander, General Metin Tokel, arrived in Egypt on Monday for an official visit. The Turkish Defence Ministry has also announced a joint naval exercise in Alexandria from November 4 to 9.
paras.zh: 土耳其陆军司令梅廷·托克尔将军周一抵达埃及进行正式访问。土耳其国防部还宣布将于11月4日至9日在亚历山大举行联合海军演习。

paras.en: The senior Turkish official told Al Jazeera that Ankara remained open to cooperation on maritime boundaries and energy but would defend what it considers its rights.
paras.zh: 土耳其高级官员告诉半岛电视台，安卡拉仍然对海上边界和能源合作持开放态度，但会捍卫其认为的权利。

paras.en: “Just as other countries say they will not give up the rights they recognise as their own, the same applies to Turkiye,” the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“正如其他国家表示不会放弃自己承认的权利一样，土耳其也是如此。”

paras.en: Fidan has acknowledged Egypt’s concerns and discussed the possibility of cooperation with Italy. The official clarified, however, that no formal four-country negotiating mechanism between Turkiye, Libya, Italy and Egypt has been established.
paras.zh: 菲丹承认埃及的担忧，并讨论了与意大利合作的可能性。但该官员澄清说，土耳其、利比亚、意大利和埃及之间尚未建立正式的四国谈判机制。

paras.en: El Gomati believes Cairo’s ability to influence decisions in eastern Libya has diminished.
paras.zh: 戈马蒂认为，开罗影响利比亚东部决策的能力已经减弱。

paras.en: “Egypt still has influence, but it no longer has a veto,” he said.
paras.zh: “埃及仍然有影响力，但不再拥有否决权，”他说。

paras.en: Megerisi, meanwhile, argued that Turkiye’s relationship with Egypt has become too important to sacrifice over the maritime dispute. He sees room for accommodation, potentially involving Italy’s energy company Eni, which has interests in Egypt and Libya.
paras.zh: 与此同时，迈格里西认为，土耳其与埃及的关系已经变得太重要，不能因为海上争端而牺牲。他看到了妥协的空间，可能涉及意大利能源公司埃尼，该公司在埃及和利比亚拥有权益。

paras.en: Greece maintains that the maritime agreement disregards the rights of its islands, including Crete. Turkiye rejects those claims, arguing that islands should not automatically receive the same weight as mainland coastlines when mapping out maritime boundaries and exclusive economic zones.
paras.zh: 希腊坚称，该海事协议无视包括克里特岛在内的希腊岛屿的权利。土耳其拒绝了这些说法，认为在绘制海洋边界和专属经济区时，岛屿不应自动获得与大陆海岸线相同的权重。

paras.en: Megerisi said the eastern Libyan parliament’s approval strengthens the agreement’s domestic legal footing but does little to resolve the wider dispute between the countries of the Eastern Mediterranean.
paras.zh: 梅格里西表示，利比亚东部议会的批准加强了该协议的国内法律基础，但对解决东地中海国家之间更广泛的争端无济于事。

paras.en: “I think both sides are maximalist,” he said.
paras.zh: “我认为双方都是极端主义，”他说。

paras.en: The parliamentary vote gives Ankara greater political leverage, but it does not settle competing maritime claims or clear the way for offshore energy exploration.
paras.zh: 议会投票赋予安卡拉更大的政治影响力，但它并没有解决相互竞争的海事主张，也没有为海上能源勘探扫清道路。

paras.en: Ankara now wants to build on its gains in Libya and improving ties with Egypt to strengthen its position in the Eastern Mediterranean. Its aim is to develop new partnerships and regional cooperation rather than remain outside arrangements shaped largely by Greece, Cyprus and Israel.
paras.zh: 安卡拉现在希望扩大在利比亚的成果并改善与埃及的关系，以加强其在东地中海的地位。其目标是发展新的伙伴关系和区域合作，而不是留在主要由希腊、塞浦路斯和以色列制定的安排之外。

paras.en: But that will require finding common ground with countries that continue to challenge Turkiye’s maritime claims.
paras.zh: 但这需要与继续挑战土耳其海事主张的国家找到共同点。

paras.en: The senior Turkish official said Ankara’s improved relationship with Cairo had opened the door to discussing those differences directly.
paras.zh: 土耳其高级官员表示，安卡拉与开罗关系的改善为直接讨论这些分歧打开了大门。

paras.en: “We can now discuss every issue with Egypt, and we will discuss this one too,” the official said. “We do not have to seek the approval or consent of unrelated third countries.”
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“我们现在可以与埃及讨论每一个问题，我们也会讨论这个问题。” “我们不必寻求无关第三国的批准或同意。”

articles.title: Why a Democratic win in US midterms could adversely affect Europe

paras.en: The United States midterm elections appear stacked against the ruling Republicans, with polls suggesting the Democrats average an eight-point lead in the House of Representatives and the Senate. But if Democrats take one or both houses, could they affect upcoming elections in Europe?
paras.zh: 美国中期选举似乎对执政的共和党不利，民意调查显示民主党在众议院和参议院平均领先八个百分点。但如果民主党拿下一院或两院，是否会影响即将举行的欧洲选举？

paras.en: Not fundamentally, analysts and observers have told Al Jazeera, but besides a welcome improvement in transatlantic relations, they point to two potentially adverse effects.
paras.zh: 分析人士和观察家告诉半岛电视台，这并不是根本性的，但除了跨大西洋关系的可喜改善外，他们还指出了两个潜在的不利影响。

paras.en: First, a Democratic Congress might produce complacency among Europeans regarding their own far-right movements.
paras.zh: 首先，民主党代表大会可能会让欧洲人对自己的极右运动感到自满。

paras.en: Second, it might spur US President Donald Trump to raise pressure on Ukraine to make a deal it doesn’t want to make with Russia.
paras.zh: 其次，这可能会促使美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向乌克兰施加压力，要求其与俄罗斯达成协议。

paras.en: “If the Democrats win the House, let alone both houses, it will be read as, ‘you see democracies bounce back,’” said Catherine Fieschi, a nonresident scholar at Carnegie Europe, specialising in European far-right politics. It would introduce “the idea that these things don’t mean the advent of a fascist regime”, she said.
paras.zh: “如果民主党赢得众议院，更不用说两院了，就会被解读为，‘你会看到民主国家反弹’，”专门研究欧洲极右政治的卡内基欧洲非常驻学者凯瑟琳·费斯基(Catherine Fieschi)表示。她说，这将引入“这些事情并不意味着法西斯政权的出现”的想法。

paras.en: From her vantage point in Paris, Fieschi said she imagines a Democratic win leading to “a whole discussion about whether we should fear a Marine Le Pen election as much as some people say we should, or whether, in fact, it’s swings and roundabouts and, at some point, if people are really bad and really incompetent, then elections right the way,” she said.
paras.zh: 菲耶斯基说，从她在巴黎的有利位置来看，她想象民主党的胜利会导致“一场全面的讨论，讨论我们是否应该像一些人所说的那样害怕马琳·勒庞的选举，或者事实上，这是否是摇摆不定的，在某些时候，如果人们真的很坏、真的很无能，那么选举就是正确的方式，”她说。

paras.en: French right-wing politician Marine Le Pen is currently leading the field in polling for presidential elections scheduled for April 18, with surveys indicating she has about 34 percent of the popular vote.
paras.zh: 法国右翼政治家马琳·勒庞目前在定于 4 月 18 日举行的总统选举的民意调查中领先，调查显示她拥有约 34% 的民众选票。

paras.en: There is a precedent for the complacency Fieschi alludes to. In June 2025, the European Council on Foreign Relations (ECFR), a think tank, polled Europeans following Trump’s first six months in office. Clear majorities in Western Europe said the US political system was broken. In Eastern Europe, majorities said it was working well – though they were weighted towards right-wing voters.
paras.zh: 菲耶斯基提到的自满是有先例的。 2025 年 6 月，智库欧洲外交关系委员会 (ECFR) 在特朗普上任六个月后对欧洲人进行了民意调查。西欧明显多数人表示美国的政治体系已经崩溃。在东欧，大多数人表示这种做法运作良好——尽管他们偏向于右翼选民。

paras.en: Greek Migration Minister Thanos Plevris warned against giving too much credit to the US for what Europeans think and do, however.
paras.zh: 然而，希腊移民部长萨诺斯·普莱弗里斯(Thanos Plevris)警告称，不要将欧洲人的想法和行为过多地归功于美国。

paras.en: He said he believes European public opinion hardened against asylum and economic migration independently, but the US marked the shift by expressing it more violently, with military deportation flights and armed Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agents sweeping American cities.
paras.zh: 他表示，他相信欧洲公众舆论对庇护和经济移民的态度更加强硬，但美国以更加暴力的方式表达了这一转变，军事驱逐飞机和武装移民和海关执法人员席卷了美国城市。

paras.en: “I think there was a European about-turn on migration. We saw this in Germany, which had a welcoming attitude [to refugees] for many years, and they went to a more controlled policy. All northern European governments saw societies change,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “我认为欧洲在移民问题上出现了大转变。我们在德国看到了这一点，德国多年来一直对难民持欢迎态度，他们采取了更加受控的政策。所有北欧政府都看到了社会的变化，”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “But the US provided a change in tone, from induction and integration and benefaction to deterrence, border protection, increased returns and consequences if asylum is denied. I do think that pivot played a role in Europe,” Plevris added.
paras.zh: “但美国改变了语气，从引导、融合和善行转向威慑、边境保护、增加回报以及庇护被拒绝的后果。我确实认为这种转向在欧洲发挥了作用，”普莱弗里斯补充道。

paras.en: Should French voters decide that the only way out is through electing Le Pen – “like some kind of strong medicine that would wake us up to what we might lose”, as Fieschi put it – they would have to contend with three controversial propositions – cutting French financial contributions to the European Union’s federal budget to pay for earlier retirement, cutting military aid to Ukraine and possibly leaving the single currency, the euro, in favour of a devalued franc.
paras.zh: 如果法国选民认为唯一的出路是选举勒庞 — — 正如菲耶斯基所说，“就像某种猛药，让我们意识到我们可能会失去什么” — — 他们将不得不面对三个有争议的主张 — — 削减法国对欧盟联邦预算的财政贡献以支付提前退休的费用，削减对乌克兰的军事援助，并可能放弃单一货币欧元，转而采用贬值的瑞郎。

paras.en: Any one of those policy moves would be a major setback for the European project, which has coalesced around trade, money and now security. A cut in assistance to Ukraine would remove 3.5 percent of its foreign military aid, according to the Kiel Institute’s Ukraine Support Tracker, which other allies would have to make up.
paras.zh: 这些政策举措中的任何一项都将是欧洲计划的重大挫折，该计划围绕着贸易、货币和现在的安全展开。根据基尔研究所的乌克兰支持追踪系统，削减对乌克兰的援助将导致其对外军事援助减少 3.5%，而其他盟友则必须弥补这一缺口。

paras.en: At the same time, “we could end up in a situation where Trump is basically clinching deals with Putin as fast as he can,” said Fieschi, referring to the US-Russian strategy to coerce Ukraine into a peace agreement that involves sacrificing its eastern Donbas region – something Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said would be a strategic error leading to renewed war, and which a majority of Ukrainians are against.
paras.zh: 与此同时，“我们最终可能会陷入这样一种情况：特朗普基本上是在尽快与普京达成协议，”费斯基说。他指的是美俄战略，迫使乌克兰达成一项涉及牺牲东部顿巴斯地区的和平协议。乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，这将是一个战略错误，导致新一轮战争，而大多数乌克兰人都反对这种做法。

paras.en: Trump has already leveraged US early warning on incoming ballistics and Starlink satellite navigation against Ukraine. He has twice echoed Russian calls for Zelenskyy to be replaced.
paras.zh: 特朗普已经利用美国对乌克兰来袭弹道和星链卫星导航的预警。他曾两次响应俄罗斯要求泽伦斯基被替换的呼吁。

paras.en: Compounding this renewed pressure from a beleaguered White House, Russia could intensify its “all-domain war”, which many European governments believe it is already waging against them, said Victoria Vdovychenko, a Ukraine expert at Cambridge University’s Centre for Geopolitics.
paras.zh: 剑桥大学地缘政治中心的乌克兰问题专家维多利亚·弗多维琴科(Victoria Vdovychenko)表示，除了陷入困境的白宫再次施加的压力之外，俄罗斯可能会加剧其“全领域战争”，许多欧洲政府认为俄罗斯已经在针对它们发动这场战争。

paras.en: “Cognitive warfare never stopped on the European continent, and Russians are already using existing vulnerabilities to the utmost,” she told Al Jazeera. “I hope that the European partners will be staying very strong.”
paras.zh: “欧洲大陆的认知战从未停止过，俄罗斯人已经在最大限度地利用现有的漏洞，”她告诉半岛电视台。 “我希望欧洲合作伙伴能够保持强劲。”

paras.en: Trump’s abandonment of the world order the US and Europe established after World War II, his disregard for democracy and human rights, and his betrayal of Ukraine have already transformed European public opinion, observers say.
paras.zh: 观察人士称，特朗普对二战后美国和欧洲建立的世界秩序的放弃、对民主和人权的漠视以及对乌克兰的背叛已经改变了欧洲舆论。

paras.en: Only 31 percent of Europeans see the US as Europe’s “most trustworthy ally”, down from 51 percent in 2024, when Trump’s predecessor, Joe Biden, was in office, according to a poll for the German think tank Bertelsmann Stiftung.
paras.zh: 德国智库贝塔斯曼基金会的一项民意调查显示，只有 31% 的欧洲人认为美国是欧洲“最值得信赖的盟友”，低于 2024 年特朗普前任乔·拜登执政时的 51%。

paras.en: Seventy-three percent of Europeans across all age groups say Europe should “go its own way” rather than continue a close cooperation with the US, up from 63 percent in 2024, and that figure includes a clear majority among those on the centre-right and right.
paras.zh: 各个年龄段的欧洲人中，有 73% 的人表示欧洲应该“走自己的路”，而不是继续与美国密切合作，这一比例高于 2024 年的 63%，其中中右翼和右翼人士占绝大多数。

paras.en: In this year’s Spring Eurobarometer, a regular pulse-taking conducted by the European Commission, 68 percent of respondents wanted the EU’s role in protecting Europeans from global crises and security risks to increase, while 39 percent wanted it to be a top priority.
paras.zh: 在今年的春季欧洲晴雨表（欧盟委员会定期进行的一次脉搏调查）中，68%的受访者希望欧盟在保护欧洲人免受全球危机和安全风险影响方面发挥更大作用，而39%的受访者希望将其作为重中之重。

paras.en: In a June poll for the European Council on Foreign Relations, the description of the US as an “ally” fell from 22 percent in November 2024 to 11 percent across all territories polled in Eastern and Western Europe.
paras.zh: 欧洲外交关系委员会 6 月份的一项民意调查显示，在东欧和西欧所有接受调查的地区，将美国描述为“盟友”的比例从 2024 年 11 月的 22% 下降至 11%。

paras.en: In a June poll for the Pew Research Center, a Washington-based think tank, 76 percent of people polled in 36 countries, of which nine were EU members, expressed no confidence in Trump, and 57 percent expressed unfavourable views of the US.
paras.zh: 华盛顿智库皮尤研究中心 6 月份的一项民意调查显示，36 个国家（其中 9 个是欧盟成员国）的受访者中有 76% 的人对特朗普表示不信任，57% 的人对美国表达了负面看法。

paras.en: It would appear that such shifts against the US and especially Republicans, formed over two Trump terms, would be difficult to reverse in a single congressional election, especially with a Russian war ongoing in Europe.
paras.zh: 特朗普在两届任期内形成的针对美国、尤其是共和党的这种转变似乎很难在一次国会选举中扭转，尤其是在欧洲正在进行俄罗斯战争的情况下。

articles.title: Ex-Israeli diplomat calls opposition's refusal to work with Arab parties 'reckless'
articles.author: Steve Inskeep

paras.en: Ex-Israeli diplomat calls opposition's refusal to work with Arab parties 'reckless'
paras.zh: 以色列前外交官称反对派拒绝与阿拉伯政党合作是“鲁莽的”

paras.en: The strong showing by Arab-led parties in Israel's election has raised a question for the opposition: Will its leaders work with them to form a government?
paras.zh: 阿拉伯领导的政党在以色列选举中的强劲表现给反对派提出了一个问题：其领导人是否会与他们合作组建政府？

paras.en: Political observers doubt such a partnership will materialize, given the unwillingness of several opposition leaders to work with Arab-led parties. Alon Pinkas, an Israeli political analyst and former diplomat who advised former Prime Ministers Ehud Barak and Shimon Peres, called that reluctance "myopic and reckless."
paras.zh: 鉴于一些反对派领导人不愿意与阿拉伯领导的政党合作，政治观察家怀疑这种伙伴关系能否实现。以色列政治分析家、前外交官阿隆·平卡斯 (Alon Pinkas) 曾为前总理埃胡德·巴拉克 (Ehud Barak) 和西蒙·佩雷斯 (Shimon Peres) 提供咨询，他称这种不情愿是“短视且鲁莽的”。

paras.en: Pinkas told Morning Edition that opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot could either form a coalition with the parties or establish a minority government with their outside support, allowing them to back major legislation and confidence votes without formally joining the coalition.
paras.zh: 平卡斯告诉《早间版》，反对党领袖加迪·艾森科特可以与各党派组成联盟，也可以在外部支持下建立少数派政府，从而允许他们在不正式加入联盟的情况下支持重大立法和信任投票。

paras.en: But both Eisenkot and Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu have rejected working with Arab-led parties, which draw much of their support from Palestinian citizens of Israel. Netanyahu went further, calling the prospect of a government relying on their support "a shame and a disgrace."
paras.zh: 但艾森科特和总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡都拒绝与阿拉伯领导的政党合作，这些政党的大部分支持来自以色列的巴勒斯坦公民。内塔尼亚胡更进一步，称政府依赖他们的支持的前景“是一种耻辱”。

paras.en: Speaking with NPR's Steve Inskeep, Pinkas challenged arguments that relying on Arab-led parties would undermine Israel's identity as a Jewish state. He questioned why the same reasoning would not apply to ultra-Orthodox Jewish parties, which he said describe themselves as non-Zionist.
paras.zh: 平卡斯在接受美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的史蒂夫·英斯基普 (Steve Inskeep) 采访时，对依赖阿拉伯领导的政党会损害以色列作为犹太国家的身份的论点提出了质疑。他质疑为什么同样的推理不适用于极端正统犹太政党，他说这些政党将自己描述为非犹太复国主义者。

paras.en: Pinkas attributed growing support for Arab-led parties to rising crime and murder rates in Arab communities, particularly violence involving organized crime groups. He said Netanyahu's government had "willfully ignored their plight" by failing to deploy police or investigate the killings.
paras.zh: 平卡斯将阿拉伯人领导的政党越来越多的支持归因于阿拉伯社区犯罪和谋杀率上升，特别是涉及有组织犯罪集团的暴力行为。他说，内塔尼亚胡政府没有部署警察或调查杀戮事件，“故意忽视他们的困境”。

paras.en: As for Netanyahu's chances of forming a government, his assessment was emphatic: "Mr. Netanyahu cannot. I repeat, cannot form a government."
paras.zh: 至于内塔尼亚胡组建政府的机会，他的评估很强调：“内塔尼亚胡先生不能。我再说一遍，不能组建政府。”

paras.en: Listen to the full interview by clicking on the blue button above.
paras.zh: 单击上面的蓝色按钮即可收听完整采访。

paras.en: The digital version of this interview was edited by Treye Green.
paras.zh: 本次采访的数字版本由 Treye Green 编辑。

articles.title: Partial results from Israel's contentious election show no clear winner
articles.author: Daniel Estrin

paras.en: Partial results from Israel's contentious election show no clear winner
paras.zh: 以色列有争议的选举的部分结果显示没有明显的赢家

paras.en: TEL AVIV, Israel — With a majority of the votes counted on Wednesday morning, there was still no clear winner in Israel's pivotal parliamentary election, but Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was leading his main opposition rival, Gadi Eisenkot, in the official tally.
paras.zh: 以色列特拉维夫——周三上午，大多数选票已清点完毕，以色列关键的议会选举仍然没有明显的获胜者，但在官方计票中，总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领先于他的主要反对派竞争对手加迪·艾森科特。

paras.en: However, the various opposition groups as a whole, including a significant showing by two Arab-led factions, had more votes overall than Netanyahu's right-wing bloc of parties — indicating Israelis had turned out in their numbers to express their dissatisfaction with his government.
paras.zh: 然而，各个反对派团体作为一个整体，包括两个阿拉伯领导的派系的显着表现，总体上比内塔尼亚胡的右翼政党集团拥有更多的选票——这表明以色列人已经通过他们的人数来表达他们对他的政府的不满。

paras.en: Overnight Tuesday both leaders addressed supporters and hailed their early results, somewhat prematurely, each suggesting they had triumphed.
paras.zh: 周二晚间，两位领导人都向支持者发表讲话，并对他们的早期结果表示欢迎，但有些为时过早，两人都暗示自己已经取得了胜利。

paras.en: "We made history! The public has voted for change," said Eisenkot, a center-right former military chief of staff who has promised more diplomacy and less extremism.
paras.zh: “我们创造了历史！公众投票支持变革，”中右翼前军事参谋长艾森科特说，他承诺采取更多外交手段，减少极端主义。

paras.en: Netanyahu told supporters, "The right-wing bloc has a clear, decisive majority among the Zionist public."
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡对支持者说：“右翼集团在犹太复国主义公众中拥有明显的、决定性的多数。”

paras.en: But such a tight race means there could now be weeks of political gridlock.
paras.zh: 但如此激烈的竞争意味着现在可能会出现数周的政治僵局。

paras.en: The winning party needs a coalition of 61 lawmakers in the 120-seat Israeli parliament, or Knesset, in order to form a government. The final results will depend on the math and negotiations among broader alliances.
paras.zh: 获胜政党需要在拥有 120 个席位的以色列议会 (Knesset) 中组建由 61 名议员组成的联盟才能组建政府。最终结果将取决于更广泛联盟之间的计算和谈判。

paras.en: Arab voters make up about 20% of Israel's population, and two Arab-led parties — the socially conservative United Arab List, or Raam, and the left-wing Joint List — could be kingmakers, except that both Netanyahu and Eisenkot and his allies have resisted partnering with them.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯选民约占以色列人口的20%，两个阿拉伯人领导的政党——社会保守的阿拉伯联合名单党（Raam）和左翼联合名单党——可能成为国王的拥护者，但内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特及其盟友都拒绝与他们合作。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Netanyahu's Likud party claimed the elections were "stolen" by Arab parties, saying it was providing evidence to the police. Critics viewed the allegation as an attempt to prevent the opposition from partnering with Arab parties to unseat him.
paras.zh: 周三，内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团声称选举被阿拉伯政党“窃取”，并表示正在向警方提供证据。批评人士认为，这一指控是为了阻止反对派与阿拉伯政党合作推翻他。

paras.en: According to election officials, Israeli voter turnout on Tuesday was at more than 77%, the highest in more than two decades. Tens of thousands of expatriates flew in from abroad to cast their ballots in the first election since the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas-led attack and the war in Gaza.
paras.zh: 据选举官员称，周二以色列选民的投票率超过 77%，为二十多年来的最高水平。数万名侨民从国外飞来参加自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的袭击和加沙战争以来的首次选举。

paras.en: Netanyahu is Israel's longest-serving prime minister, with almost two decades in office across multiple tenures, but Israelis are divided over his leadership.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡是以色列任期最长的总理，在多个任期内任职近二十年，但以色列人对他的领导力存在分歧。

paras.en: Many question Netanyahu's ability to keep them safe after the Hamas attack, the deadliest day for Jews since the Holocaust. Nearly 1,200 people were killed when Hamas attacked army bases, residential communities and an outdoor music rave — and 251 people were taken hostage back to Gaza.
paras.zh: 许多人质疑内塔尼亚胡在哈马斯袭击后保护他们安全的能力，这是自大屠杀以来犹太人死亡最严重的一天。哈马斯袭击军事基地、住宅区和户外音乐狂欢，造成近 1,200 人死亡，251 人被劫为人质带回加沙。

paras.en: Israelis have been reeling from reports that the government had received repeated warnings from countries in the region that Hamas was planning a major assault on Israel.
paras.zh: 有报道称，以色列政府多次收到该地区国家的警告，称哈马斯正计划对以色列发动大规模袭击，以色列人对此感到震惊。

paras.en: What happened in return was an Israeli military onslaught that has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians, according to Gaza's Health Ministry, and left most of Gaza destroyed. Today, Israel is fighting back against charges of genocide while Netanyahu faces an international arrest warrant for alleged war crimes.
paras.zh: 据加沙卫生部称，以色列的军事攻击导致超过 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人死亡，加沙大部分地区被毁。如今，以色列正在反击种族灭绝指控，而内塔尼亚胡则因涉嫌战争罪而面临国际逮捕令。

paras.en: Israel's wars in Gaza and the region, and its policies in the occupied West Bank, have badly strained its relations with many international governments. Public support for Israel in the United States has plummeted, worrying many Israeli voters.
paras.zh: 以色列在加沙和该地区的战争及其在被占领的约旦河西岸的政策使其与许多国际政府的关系严重紧张。美国公众对以色列的支持率大幅下降，令许多以色列选民感到担忧。

paras.en: Still, many other Israelis are fed up with the world's rebuke over the Gaza war and more than 67 percent of Israelis in a July 2025 poll said they were not very troubled about the suffering of people in Gaza. Netanyahu's supporters have said the wars he has led across the region, from Gaza to Lebanon to Iran, have restored Israel's security.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，许多其他以色列人还是厌倦了世界对加沙战争的谴责，在 2025 年 7 月的一项民意调查中，超过 67% 的以色列人表示，他们对加沙人民的苦难并不太担心。内塔尼亚胡的支持者表示，他领导的整个地区的战争，从加沙到黎巴嫩再到伊朗，已经恢复了以色列的安全。

paras.en: At Netanyahu's election night party on Tuesday in Jerusalem, giant screens played Hollywood-style videos of soldiers marching, airstrikes blowing up buildings and other destruction. Some clips appeared to show massive explosions of villages in Lebanon, where Israeli destruction of civilian infrastructure has drawn condemnation from human rights groups as potential war crimes, which Netanyahu's government denies.
paras.zh: 周二，内塔尼亚胡在耶路撒冷举行的选举之夜派对上，大屏幕播放了好莱坞风格的视频，内容包括士兵行进、空袭炸毁建筑物和其他破坏。一些片段似乎显示黎巴嫩村庄发生大规模爆炸，以色列对当地民用基础设施的破坏引起了人权组织的谴责，称其为潜在的战争罪行，但内塔尼亚胡政府对此予以否认。

paras.en: The videos also repeatedly showed President Trump shaking hands with and endorsing Netanyahu. The two leaders have discussed plans to potentially launch major attacks against Iran, which could take place after U.S. midterm elections. Trump urged Israeli voters to reelect Netanyahu to "finish the job that we started."
paras.zh: 这些视频还多次显示特朗普总统与内塔尼亚胡握手并表示支持。两位领导人讨论了可能对伊朗发动重大袭击的计划，袭击可能发生在美国中期选举之后。特朗普敦促以色列选民连任内塔尼亚胡，以“完成我们开始的工作”。

paras.en: Supporters of his Likud party at the event struck a defiant tone. When asked if Israel went too far in the war in Gaza, 24-year-old Ori Hazan replied: "We will keep fighting them, and this is now the ideology, this is the policy. You fight us, we will kill you, OK? That's it."
paras.zh: 他的利库德集团的支持者在活动中发出了挑衅的语气。当被问及以色列在加沙战争中是否走得太远时，24岁的奥里·哈赞回答说：“我们将继续与他们作战，这就是现在的意识形态，这就是政策。你与我们作战，我们会杀了你，好吗？就是这样。”

paras.en: With the race so close, election officials told NPR they expect to finish counting votes — including hundreds of thousands of ballots from Israeli soldiers — by Thursday afternoon.
paras.zh: 由于选情如此接近，选举官员告诉美国公共广播电台，他们预计将在周四下午之前完成计票工作，其中包括来自以色列士兵的数十万张选票。

paras.en: President Isaac Herzog said he expects to be handed the official election results next week. Then he will "begin the process of the consultations here, hearing from each and every faction, asking questions, and holding discussions," he said.
paras.zh: 总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格表示，他预计将于下周收到正式选举结果。然后他将“在这里开始磋商过程，听取各派的意见，提出问题并进行讨论，”他说。

paras.en: Whichever candidate comes out on top is expected to get the first chance to try to form a governing coalition. The party will have six weeks to do that. Both blocs are expected to engage in major horse-trading to try to form a government. This has always been the case as no party in Israel's parliamentary system has ever won outright.
paras.zh: 无论哪位候选人获胜，都有望获得第一个尝试组建执政联盟的机会。该党将有六周的时间来做到这一点。预计两个集团将进行重大的讨价还价以试图组建政府。情况一直如此，因为以色列议会制度中没有任何政党能够彻底获胜。

paras.en: Herzog said he hopes there won't have to be an election do-over if the process breaks down.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格表示，他希望如果进程失败，不必重新进行选举。

paras.en: "We must do everything we can, certainly after yesterday, to avoid another round of elections. So I expect everyone who comes here to come with an open mind," he said.
paras.zh: “我们必须尽一切努力，尤其是在昨天之后，以避免另一轮选举。因此，我希望来到这里的每个人都保持开放的心态，”他说。

paras.en: Eisenkot's Yashar party includes figures from Israel's political center and moderate right. The opposition parties he would partner with range from the right and center to the liberal left. He has pledged not to join a government led by Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 艾森科特的亚沙尔党包括来自以色列政治中间派和温和右派的人物。他将与之合作的反对党包括右翼、中间派和自由左翼。他承诺不会加入内塔尼亚胡领导的政府。

paras.en: Yair Golan, leader of the Democrats party, which is part of Eisenkot's bloc, called on X for the bloc to form a coalition with the Arab parties.
paras.zh: 属于艾森科特集团的民主党领导人亚伊尔·戈兰（Yair Golan）呼吁该集团与阿拉伯政党组成联盟。

paras.en: "We have no future here if we don't stop being afraid. And if we don't stop with the racism," he said. Even though it would help the Eisenkot bloc win, since the 2023 attack on Israel there's been heightened mistrust of Arab political leaders.
paras.zh: “如果我们不停止恐惧，如果我们不停止种族主义，我们这里就没有未来，”他说。尽管这将有助于艾森科特集团获胜，但自 2023 年以色列遭受袭击以来，人们对阿拉伯政治领导人的不信任加剧。

paras.en: Another possible scenario is if neither side is able to form a government, leaving Netanyahu as a caretaker prime minister, with a repeat election held next year.
paras.zh: 另一种可能的情况是，如果双方都无法组建政府，内塔尼亚胡将担任看守总理，并于明年再次举行选举。

articles.title: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
articles.author: Carrie Kahn

paras.en: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
paras.zh: 失败的弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗抵达迈阿密，巴西政治戏剧上演

paras.en: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. He is facing multiple investigations in Brazil.
paras.zh: 落败的总统候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗及其家人在巴西当局命令他交出护照后抵达美国。他在巴西面临多项调查。

paras.en: This morning, Brazilians were glued to their screens watching a private plane land at an airport in Miami, Florida. Moments later, the man who had just lost Brazil's presidential election, Flávio Bolsonaro, stepped out onto the tarmac. His arrival capped three days of political drama since his stunning defeat to incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. NPR South America correspondent Carrie Kahn is on the line now. Hey, Carrie.
paras.zh: 今天早上，巴西人全神贯注地看着屏幕上一架私人飞机降落在佛罗里达州迈阿密的机场。片刻之后，刚刚在巴西总统选举中落败的弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗走上了停机坪。自他惨败于现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦以来，他的到来为三天的政治戏剧画上句号。 NPR 南美洲记者 Carrie Kahn 正在通话中。嘿，嘉莉。

paras.en: SUMMERS: So, Carrie, I want to make sure I understand this correctly. Bolsonaro lost Sunday's election, and by Wednesday, he was in the U.S.?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：嘉莉，我想确保我正确理解这一点。博尔索纳罗在周日的选举中落败，到了周三，他就到了美国？

paras.en: KAHN: Yes, it's been a wild ride the past three days. On Sunday, he refused to concede the election and said he would petition to annul the results. The next day, his party did accept the results. And in a video, Bolsonaro seemed to back down a bit but added that federal police demanded his passport after he was visiting his father, who is under house arrest for attempting to overturn his own electoral loss to Lula four years ago. By Tuesday - yesterday - rumors were flying that Bolsonaro had fled Brazil, and today he arrived in Miami and then later put out a statement first declaring himself as, quote, "the true elected president of Brazil." Then a bit later, he posted a new statement downgrading himself to the true elected leader of Brazil. He compared himself to liberation figures like Charles de Gaulle and María Corina Machado of Venezuela, amongst others.
paras.zh: 卡恩：是的，过去三天真是一段疯狂的旅程。周日，他拒绝承认选举结果，并表示将请愿废除选举结果。第二天，他的政党确实接受了结果。在一段视频中，博尔索纳罗似乎有所让步，但补充说，联邦警察在他探望父亲后要求他提供护照。他的父亲因四年前试图推翻自己在选举中输给卢拉而被软禁。到周二（昨天），谣言四起，称博尔索纳罗已逃离巴西，今天他抵达迈阿密，随后发表声明，首先宣称自己是“巴西真正的民选总统”。过了一会儿，他发表了一份新声明，将自己降级为巴西真正的民选领导人。他将自己与委内瑞拉的戴高乐和玛丽亚·科里娜·马查多等解放人物进行了比较。

paras.en: SUMMERS: Interesting. OK, lots of questions here. One is this - do we know how he managed to leave Brazil and get to the U.S.?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：有趣。好吧，这里有很多问题。其中之一是 - 我们知道他是如何离开巴西并到达美国的吗？

paras.en: KAHN: Argentine officials reported he crossed into the country last night, but Brazilian officials say they have no record of him crossing. Bolsonaro also has an Italian passport. From Argentina, he flew to Ecuador and then on to Miami. And in his letter today, he thanked Argentina's president, Javier Milei, for his support. And Milei is a far-right ally of Bolsonaro and Trump. And like Trump, Milei has still not recognized Brazil's election results. Trump was asked just a little while ago what he thought of Bolsonaro declaring himself leader of Brazil. Trump said he wasn't going to comment on that.
paras.zh: 卡恩：阿根廷官员报告说他昨晚越境进入该国，但巴西官员表示他们没有他越境的记录。博尔索纳罗还拥有意大利护照。他从阿根廷飞往厄瓜多尔，然后飞往迈阿密。在今天的信中，他感谢阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱的支持。米莱是博尔索纳罗和特朗普的极右翼盟友。和特朗普一样，米莱仍然不承认巴西的选举结果。不久前，特朗普被问到他对博尔索纳罗宣布自己为巴西领导人有何看法。特朗普表示他不会对此发表评论。

paras.en: SUMMERS: Got it. Why did Brazil's federal police revoke his passport?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：明白了。巴西联邦警察为何吊销他的护照？

paras.en: KAHN: That order came from a Supreme Court justice who said Bolsonaro was a flight risk because he's facing several investigations, and that justice oversaw the case against Bolsonaro's father, Jair. In his letter today, Flávio said that Brazil's judiciary has been, quote, "weaponized" against his entire family. The cases against Bolsonaro include a money laundering scheme tied to online gambling. Another involves questionable financing of a biopic about his father. Bolsonaro denies any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 卡恩：该命令来自最高法院的一位法官，他表示博尔索纳罗有潜逃风险，因为他面临多项调查，而且该法官负责监督针对博尔索纳罗父亲贾尔的案件。弗拉维奥在今天的信中表示，巴西的司法机构已经被“武器化”来对付他的整个家族。针对博尔索纳罗的案件包括与在线赌博有关的洗钱计划。另一个问题涉及一部关于他父亲的传记片的融资问题。博尔索纳罗否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: SUMMERS: And people in Brazil, what have they had to say about his sudden departure?
paras.zh: 萨默斯：巴西人民对于他的突然离开有何看法？

paras.en: KAHN: As you can imagine, the country has been captivated. You know, look, the election was decisive for Lula, but nearly 60 million people voted for Bolsonaro and his conservative movement. I spoke with Fábio Zanini, a political columnist with Folha, a newspaper in São Paulo, who says Flávio's departure could help that movement.
paras.zh: 卡恩：正如你可以想象的那样，这个国家已经被迷住了。你知道，看，这次选举对卢拉来说是决定性的，但有近 6000 万人投票给了博尔索纳罗和他的保守派运动。我采访了圣保罗报纸《Folha》的政治专栏作家法比奥·扎尼尼 (Fábio Zanini)，他表示弗拉维奥的离开可能有助于这一运动。

paras.en: FÁBIO ZANINI: Flávio will be in the United States now, close to the Trump administration, attacking Brazil, saying that he's a persecuted person and trying to portray himself as a victim of Brazilian persecution. That might give a new energy to the Bolsonarista movement.
paras.zh: 法比奥·扎尼尼：弗拉维奥现在将在美国，与特朗普政府关系密切，攻击巴西，称他是一个受迫害的人，并试图将自己描绘成巴西迫害的受害者。这可能会给博索纳里斯塔运动注入新的活力。

paras.en: KAHN: Many also say that claims of election tampering and political persecution are pretty hollow because Bolsonaro's party did make huge gains throughout the country. His stepmother and his brother were elected senators, and the party has now the largest majority in Congress.
paras.zh: 卡恩：许多人还说，选举篡改和政治迫害的说法相当空洞，因为博尔索纳罗的政党确实在全国取得了巨大进展。他的继母和兄弟当选为参议员，该党现在在国会中拥有最大多数席位。
