paras.zh: 埃及政治家穆斯塔法·巴克里(Mostafa Bakry)在X上写道，内塔尼亚胡和他的主要对手加迪·艾森科特“是同一枚硬币的两面”，此前出口民意调查似乎表明艾森科特获胜（这一点的争议越来越大），而且以色列-阿拉伯政党已经取代了内塔尼亚胡的极右翼盟友。 “阿拉伯人对内塔尼亚胡组建政府几近失败感到高兴，但这并不意味着即将发生的事情……与他的前任有很大不同。”

paras.en: "An Eisenkot government would likely be politically fragile, limiting its room for maneuver," Beth Oppenheim, a policy fellow in the Middle East and North Africa program at the European Council on Foreign Relations, wrote in a commentary last week. "The biggest differences from the current government would be at home: It would halt the judicial overhaul, open a state commission of inquiry into October 7th and pass a conscription law."
paras.zh: 欧洲外交关系委员会中东和北非项目政策研究员贝丝·奥本海姆上周在评论中写道：“艾森科特政府可能在政治上脆弱，限制了其回旋余地。” “与现任政府最大的不同在于国内：它将停止司法改革，在 10 月 7 日成立国家调查委员会，并通过征兵法。”

paras.en: However, Oppenheim explained, "when it comes to foreign policy, there would not be a fundamental transformation. Netanyahu's post-October 7th security doctrine — pre-empting threats, operating far beyond Israel's borders and holding 'buffer zones' in neighboring territories — has been embraced by nearly all Jewish Israeli parties."
paras.zh: 然而，奥本海姆解释说，“在外交政策方面，不会有根本性的转变。内塔尼亚胡在10月7日事件后的安全学说——先发制人的威胁，在以色列境外开展行动，并在邻近领土上占据‘缓冲区’——已被几乎所有犹太以色列政党所接受。”

paras.en: Palestinian Territories: No two-state solution
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦领土：没有两国解决方案

paras.en: One of the election campaign posters for Netanyahu's Likud party bore a stark message — "The right or Palestine" — the message being that if voters did not choose Netanyahu and his right-wing allies, his opponents would be too accommodating toward Israel's Arab-led political parties and would be open to the establishment of a Palestinian state.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团的一张竞选海报上传达了一个鲜明的信息——“右翼还是巴勒斯坦”——这个信息是，如果选民不选择内塔尼亚胡及其右翼盟友，他的对手就会对以色列阿拉伯领导的政党过于宽容，并对建立巴勒斯坦国持开放态度。

paras.en: But observers believe that message is exaggerated, and that the two-state solution is already dead.
paras.zh: 但观察人士认为，这一信息被夸大了，两国解决方案已经失效。

paras.en: "Support for Palestinian statehood has collapsed across most of the Jewish political spectrum, and permanent Israeli control over Palestinians has become normalized," Oppenheim pointed out. With the exception of one party, "all mainstream Jewish parties support, or at least acquiesce in, the settlement enterprise in some form and publicly oppose a Palestinian state on the 1967 lines."
paras.zh: 奥本海姆指出：“大多数犹太政治派别对巴勒斯坦建国的支持已经崩溃，以色列对巴勒斯坦人的永久控制已经正常化。”除一个政党外，“所有主流犹太政党都支持或至少默许某种形式的定居点事业，并公开反对在 1967 年的边界上建立巴勒斯坦国。”

paras.en: In August this year, Eisenkot himself said that, "there is no Palestinian state, and no Palestinian state will be established under the government we form."
paras.zh: 今年8月，艾森科特本人表示，“不存在巴勒斯坦国，在我们组建的政府下也不会建立巴勒斯坦国”。

paras.en: An Eisenkot-led government would, however, cooperate with more left-wing Israeli parties, which have previously supported a two-state solution. Any new coalition may also need the backing of Israel's Arab-led parties, who are currently thought to have increased their seats in parliament to around 19.
paras.zh: 然而，艾森科特领导的政府将与更多的左翼以色列政党合作，这些政党此前支持两国解决方案。任何新的联盟可能还需要以色列阿拉伯领导政党的支持，目前人们认为这些政党在议会中的席位已增加至 19 个左右。

paras.en: But as Mairav Zonszein, senior Israel analyst at the International Crisis Group, told the news agency Associated Press this week, "At best, [a new government] would be able to slow down the extremely crazy acceleration that we've seen in the last four years of every aspect of Israel's aggression in the occupied territories and inside Israel itself."
paras.zh: 但正如国际危机组织以色列高级分析师迈拉夫·宗泽因(Mairav Zonszein)本周对美联社表示的那样，“在最好的情况下，[新政府]能够减缓过去四年来以色列在被占领土和以色列境内各方面侵略的极其疯狂的加速。”

paras.en: A less extreme government would tone down religious messaging, might be less demanding when it came to conditions on disarming Hamas in Gaza, and could potentially move forward with the next stage of the Gaza ceasefire, agreed to in late 2025, but barely implemented. It might also do more to contain settler violence in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 一个不那么极端的政府会淡化宗教信息，在解除加沙哈马斯武装的条件方面可能会降低要求，并有可能推进下一阶段的加沙停火协议，该停火协议于 2025 年底达成，但几乎没有实施。它还可能在遏制西岸定居者暴力方面发挥更多作用。

paras.en: "That's because [settler extremism] is a phenomenon that doesn't enjoy the support of the majority of Israelis, damages Israel's international reputation, and suppressing it is feasible," Elizabeth Tsurkov, a senior fellow at the Washington-based think tank, the Middle East Policy Council, explained on social media.
paras.zh: “这是因为（定居者极端主义）是一种得不到大多数以色列人支持的现象，损害了以色列的国际声誉，镇压它是可行的，”华盛顿智库中东政策委员会高级研究员伊丽莎白·楚尔科夫在社交媒体上解释道。

paras.en: "[A new Israeli government] would keep expanding the settlements and Palestinian statehood would remain taboo," Oppenheim wrote. "Without a diplomatic track with the Palestinians, further flare-ups of violence in the West Bank and Gaza are inevitable, destabilizing the region — and normalization with Saudi Arabia will remain off the table."
paras.zh: 奥本海姆写道：“[以色列新政府]将继续扩大定居点，而巴勒斯坦建国仍将是禁忌。” “如果不与巴勒斯坦人建立外交轨道，西岸和加沙地带的暴力事件将不可避免地进一步爆发，从而破坏该地区的稳定——与沙特阿拉伯的正常化仍将是不可能的。”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia: Could anti-Netanyahu bloc bring normalization?
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯：反内塔尼亚胡集团能否带来正常化？

paras.en: After the October 7, 2023, attack on Israel by Hamas and Israel's ensuing military campaign, which has resulted in at least 70,000 Palestinians killed and Gaza devastated, Saudi Arabia's conditions for normalization with Israel have hardened.
paras.zh: 2023年10月7日，哈马斯对以色列发动袭击，以色列随后发动军事行动，造成至少7万名巴勒斯坦人死亡，加沙地带遭到破坏，沙特阿拉伯与以色列关系正常化的条件变得更加坚硬。

paras.en: The country, hugely influential in the Muslim world, has put out several statements saying there could be no path to normalizing relations with Israel without some progress on Palestinian statehood.
paras.zh: 这个在穆斯林世界具有巨大影响力的国家已发表多份声明，称如果巴勒斯坦建国问题上没有取得一些进展，就不可能与以色列实现关系正常化。

paras.en: Last week, at a meeting of foreign ministers from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Turkey and Egypt, the Saudis co-signed a communique in which the four countries said Israel was "the fundamental source of instability in the region and beyond."
paras.zh: 上周，在沙特阿拉伯、巴基斯坦、土耳其和埃及外长会议上，沙特共同签署了一份公报，其中这四个国家表示以色列是“该地区及其他地区不稳定的根本根源”。

paras.en: But there is some cooperation between the two countries behind the scenes. Analysts say that if a government less hardline than Netanyahu's gets into power in Israel, it will be easier for countries like Saudi Arabia — but also the United Arab Emirates, Jordan and Egypt, which all have varying levels of backchannel cooperation and contact with Israel — to admit to this kind of behind-the-scenes diplomacy.
paras.zh: 但两国在幕后有一些合作。分析人士表示，如果一个不像内塔尼亚胡政府那么强硬的政府在以色列掌权，那么沙特阿拉伯等国家以及阿联酋、约旦和埃及等国家将更容易承认这种幕后外交，这些国家都与以色列有不同程度的秘密合作和接触。

paras.en: According to a study published last week by Syrian think tank, Etana, Israeli troops have come as far as 1,160 kilometers (721 miles) into Syria from the two countries' disputed border, occupied Syrian land as far as 400 kilometers from it and carried out 1,996 ground operations in southwest Syria between January and September this year.
paras.zh: 根据叙利亚智库Etana上周发表的一份研究报告，今年1月至9月，以色列军队从两国有争议的边境进入叙利亚最远1,160公里（721英里），占领了距叙利亚最远400公里的土地，并在叙利亚西南部进行了1,996次地面行动。

paras.en: Before elections this week there was no chance of any kind of withdrawal from Syria because it would have been seen as "defeat," Ksenia Svetlova, an associate fellow at Chatham House and a former member of the Israeli parliament, told online publication Syria in Transition this month. But if the anti-Netanyahu bloc gets into power, that could change, she suggested.
paras.zh: 查塔姆研究所副研究员、以色列议会前议员克塞尼亚·斯维特洛娃本月对在线出版物《转型中的叙利亚》表示，在本周选举之前，不可能有任何形式的从叙利亚撤军，因为这会被视为“失败”。但她表示，如果反内塔尼亚胡集团掌权，情况可能会改变。

paras.en: "A security agreement with Syria will become more probable, as many potential stakeholders [in a new, more centrist Israeli government] have spoken favorably about it in the past," noted Svetlova, who is also director of the Tel Aviv-based Regional Organization for Peace, Economics and Security, which works on Israeli-Palestinian-Arab partnerships. "However I do expect that it will take time as this government will be constantly attacked by the extreme right."
paras.zh: 斯维特洛娃指出：“与叙利亚达成安全协议的可能性将变得更大，因为许多潜在的利益相关者（在一个更为中间派的以色列新政府中）过去曾对此表示赞成。”斯维特洛娃也是总部位于特拉维夫的和平、经济与安全区域组织的主任，该组织致力于以色列-巴勒斯坦-阿拉伯伙伴关系。 “但我确实预计这需要时间，因为本届政府将不断受到极右翼的攻击。”

paras.en: For months this year, Israel and Syrian diplomats negotiated a security agreement under the US' stewardship. But it came to nothing in late 2026 after Israel apparently refused to withdraw back to boundary lines established under a 1974 disengagement agreement.
paras.zh: 今年几个月来，以色列和叙利亚外交官在美国的主持下谈判达成了一项安全协议。但在 2026 年底，以色列显然拒绝撤回根据 1974 年脱离接触协议确定的边界线，这一计划最终落空。

paras.en: Observers and media commentators in Lebanon say the Lebanese government would prefer to have Eisenkot's anti-Netanyahu bloc in power.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩观察家和媒体评论员表示，黎巴嫩政府更愿意让艾森科特的反内塔尼亚胡集团掌权。

paras.en: Lebanon and Israel are continuing to negotiate an Israeli withdrawal from southern Lebanon, where the Israelis claim they have established a "buffer zone" to facilitate their fight against Lebanese militia group, Hezbollah. The Lebanese argue the Israelis have in fact invaded their country.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩和以色列正在继续谈判以色列从黎巴嫩南部撤军，以色列声称他们在那里建立了一个“缓冲区”，以方便他们与黎巴嫩民兵组织真主党的战斗。黎巴嫩人认为以色列人实际上入侵了他们的国家。

paras.en: And when it comes to negotiations around disarming Hezbollah and withdrawing Israeli troops, there's a perception in Lebanese political circles that Eisenkot would be easier to deal with than Netanyahu and his extremist allies.
paras.zh: 当谈到解除真主党武装和撤出以色列军队的谈判时，黎巴嫩政界有一种看法，认为艾森科特比内塔尼亚胡及其极端主义盟友更容易对付。

paras.en: This is despite the fact that Eisenkot is widely seen as the inventor of the so-called "Dahiyeh Doctrine," a military strategy that calls for asymmetric warfare in areas like Beirut's southern suburbs, where Hezbollah is based, to pressure both militants and their civilian support base.
paras.zh: 尽管艾森科特被广泛认为是所谓“达希耶主义”的发明者，这是一种军事战略，要求在真主党总部所在的贝鲁特南部郊区等地区发动不对称战争，向武装分子及其平民支持基地施压。

paras.en: A similar strategy is thought to be being implemented in southern Lebanon now, where whole villages continue to be razed by the Israeli military, even as active fighting has subsided.
paras.zh: 据信，黎巴嫩南部目前正在实施类似的战略，尽管激烈的战斗已经平息，但以色列军队仍在继续夷平整个村庄。

paras.en: Lebanese commentators are also optimistic that Eisenkot, former commander of the Israeli army, would have something in common with their own president, Joseph Aoun, who used to head Lebanon's armed forces.
paras.zh: 黎巴嫩评论家也乐观地认为，以色列前陆军司令艾森科特与曾领导黎巴嫩武装部队的黎巴嫩总统约瑟夫·奥恩有一些共同点。

paras.en: "When Netanyahu was ousted from power between 2021 and 2022 by Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid [now members of the camp led by Eisenkot], we were able to negotiate and conclude the maritime agreement," a Lebanese official told Lebanese daily, L'Orient Today, referring to a 2022 deal to share offshore territory.
paras.zh: “当内塔尼亚胡在 2021 年至 2022 年间被纳夫塔利·贝内特 (Naftali Bennett) 和亚伊尔·拉皮德 (Yair Lapid)（现为艾森科特领导的阵营成员）赶下台时，我们能够谈判并缔结海事协议，”一名黎巴嫩官员告诉黎巴嫩日报《今日东方报》，指的是 2022 年共享近海领土的协议。

articles.title: One year on, families seek justice after election violence

paras.en: Warning: This article contains descriptions of violence.
paras.zh: 警告：本文包含暴力描述。

paras.en: For one family member in Mwanza, Tanzania's second-largest city, justice could begin with a simple act: an apology.
paras.zh: 对于坦桑尼亚第二大城市姆万扎的一名家庭成员来说，正义可以从一个简单的行为开始：道歉。

paras.en: Raha, whose name has been changed for safety reasons, said her nephew, who she raised, was killed during protests that erupted following Tanzania's October 2025 general election.
paras.zh: 出于安全原因，化名的拉哈表示，她抚养的侄子在坦桑尼亚 2025 年 10 月大选后爆发的抗议活动中被杀。

paras.en: "The government should have asked for forgiveness for what happened. Even just offering condolences," Raha said.
paras.zh: “政府应该就所发生的事情请求原谅。即使只是表示哀悼，”拉哈说。

paras.en: A year later, the family is still waiting for answers about the death of their loved one.
paras.zh: 一年后，家人仍在等待亲人去世的消息。

paras.en: The violence followed an election campaign marked by the exclusion of the main opposition candidate.
paras.zh: 暴力事件发生在主要反对派候选人被排除在外的竞选活动之后。

paras.en: Tundu Lissu, leader of the opposition Tanzanian Party for Democracy and Progress, commonly known as Chadema, had been arrested and charged with treason in April 2025 and his party barred from contesting the election.
paras.zh: 反对派坦桑尼亚民主与进步党（俗称 Chadema）领导人 Tundu Lissu 于 2025 年 4 月被捕并被指控犯有叛国罪，他的政党被禁止参加选举。

paras.en: On election day and in the days that followed, protesters called for political reforms and the resignation of Tanzanian President Samia Suluhu Hassan.
paras.zh: 在选举日及随后的几天里，抗议者呼吁进行政治改革并要求坦桑尼亚总统萨米亚·苏鲁胡·哈桑辞职。

paras.en: A government-appointed commission, chaired by retired Chief Justice Mohamed Chande Othman and commonly referred to as the Chande Commission, found that at least 518 people died from "unnatural causes," many from gunshot wounds, and over 2,000 people were injured.
paras.zh: 由退休首席大法官穆罕默德·钱德·奥斯曼 (Mohamed Chande Othman) 担任主席、通常被称为钱德委员会 (Chande Commission) 的政府任命委员会发现，至少 518 人死于“非自然原因”，其中许多人死于枪伤，另有 2,000 多人受伤。

paras.en: Othman said the death toll could be higher because some families buried their loved ones without taking their bodies to morgues or reporting to the commission.
paras.zh: 奥斯曼表示，死亡人数可能会更高，因为一些家庭埋葬了亲人，但没有将尸体送往太平间或向委员会报告。

paras.en: Human Rights Watch (HRW) also said the actual number of people killed could be higher.
paras.zh: 人权观察组织（HRW）还表示，实际死亡人数可能更高。

paras.en: "It's very clear that it's far more than the 518 people that were presented by the commission," said Oryem Nyeko, HRW's senior Africa researcher.
paras.zh: 人权观察非洲高级研究员奥耶姆·尼科 (Oryem Nyeko) 表示：“很明显，这远远超过了委员会提出的 518 人。”

paras.en: Police likely acted beyond their guidelines
paras.zh: 警方的行为可能超出了他们的指导方针

paras.en: DW analyzed dozens of videos, interviewed sources, reviewed police guidelines and advocacy research, and obtained a leaked police report.
paras.zh: 德国之声分析了数十个视频，采访了消息来源，审查了警方的指导方针和宣传研究，并获得了一份泄露的警方报告。

paras.en: We could not determine the exact location or publication date of every video, as some of the footage was released later due to internet blackouts or anonymously, for fear of reprisals. However, elements in the footage, our sources, public reports, and an internal police report give strong indications that these videos do reveal pieces of what happened in the days following the election.
paras.zh: 我们无法确定每个视频的确切位置或发布日期，因为一些视频是由于互联网封锁而后来发布的，或者是匿名发布的，因为担心遭到报复。然而，视频中的元素、我们的消息来源、公开报告和警方内部报告都强烈表明，这些视频确实揭示了选举后几天发生的事情。

paras.en: The evidence DW has reviewed indicates that police likely acted beyond the scope of their guidelines and training. The material reviewed by DW included cases in which people were killed who were not protesting, where protesters were killed by head wounds, and where protesters were beaten or degraded by people in uniform.
paras.zh: 德国之声审查的证据表明，警方的行为可能超出了他们的指导方针和培训范围。德国之声审查的材料包括非抗议者被杀、抗议者头部受伤致死以及抗议者被穿制服的人殴打或侮辱的案例。

paras.en: The police's specialized Field Force Unit, identifiable in some footage by its red berets and riot-control equipment, helmets, shields and heavy weapons, appeared repeatedly in the material reviewed by DW.
paras.zh: 德国之声审查的材料中多次出现了警察的特种野战部队，在一些镜头中可以通过其红色贝雷帽和防暴设备、头盔、盾牌和重型武器来识别。

paras.en: Separately, the Centre for Information Resilience, an open-source investigation organization, documented incidents in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania's biggest city and commercial capital. In one, the uniformed people are beating civilians with sticks. In another, they are located close to where protesters were shot and killed.
paras.zh: 另外，开源调查组织信息复原中心记录了坦桑尼亚最大城市和商业首都达累斯萨拉姆发生的事件。其中一张，身穿制服的人正在用棍棒殴打平民。在另一处，它们位于抗议者被枪杀的地方附近。

paras.en: DW also identified incidents in which people who were not protesting appear to have been killed. In Mwanza, videos showed the bodies of young men reportedly killed by people in police uniforms while watching television in a video hall. The case was also cited by Human Rights Watch and flagged by the Chande Commission for further investigation.
paras.zh: 德国之声还发现了一些事件，其中没有抗议的人似乎被杀害。在姆万扎，视频显示，据报道，年轻男子的尸体在视频厅看电视时被穿着警察制服的人杀害。人权观察也引用了该案件，并由钱德委员会标记为进一步调查。

paras.en: Tanzania's police guidelines restrict the use of firearms to circumstances where they are absolutely necessary. Yet investigations by DW and human rights organizations documented incidents involving protesters with apparent gunshot wounds to the head and upper body and non-protesters shot while trying to flee or while outside during a government-imposed curfew.
paras.zh: 坦桑尼亚警方的指导方针将枪支的使用限制在绝对必要的情况下。然而，德国之声和人权组织的调查记录了一些事件，其中涉及头部和上半身明显枪伤的抗议者，以及在政府实施的宵禁期间试图逃离或在户外时非抗议者遭到枪击的事件。

paras.en: Security analyst Nicodemus Minde said the commission left crucial questions unanswered.
paras.zh: 安全分析师尼科迪姆斯·明德表示，该委员会没有回答一些关键问题。

paras.en: "The Commission did not really tell us who was responsible and why," he said.
paras.zh: “委员会并没有真正告诉我们谁应该负责以及原因，”他说。

paras.en: The presence of a police unit at an incident does not establish who ordered an operation or whether senior officials authorized unlawful force.
paras.zh: 警察部队在事件中的存在并不能确定是谁下令采取行动或高级官员是否授权使用非法武力。

paras.en: The Tanzanian President has described the unrest as an attempt to overthrow the government.
paras.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统将骚乱描述为推翻政府的企图。

paras.en: DW confronted the Tanzanian government on the allegations of excessive force by police. The Tanzanian Ministry of Home Affairs declined to comment, saying it would interfere with the legal process.
paras.zh: 德国之声就警察过度使用武力的指控与坦桑尼亚政府对质。坦桑尼亚内政部拒绝发表评论，称这将干扰法律程序。

paras.en: DW also asked the Tanzanian police for comment. No response had been received by the time of publication.
paras.zh: 德国之声还要求坦桑尼亚警方发表评论。截至发稿时尚未收到任何回复。

paras.en: The Chande Commission recommended further investigation but did not identify security bodies, individual officers or commanders who may have been responsible.
paras.zh: 钱德委员会建议进一步调查，但没有确定可能对此负责的安全机构、个别军官或指挥官。

paras.en: A second inquiry, chaired by retired Justice Shaban Ally Lila, began gathering evidence in August 2026 to further investigate. Its findings are still pending.
paras.zh: 由退休法官 Shaban Ally Lila 主持的第二次调查于 2026 年 8 月开始收集证据以进一步调查。其调查结果仍有待确定。

paras.en: For the family members of those killed, the inquiries have yet to restore trust.
paras.zh: 对于遇难者家属来说，调查尚未恢复信任。

paras.en: Zuri, whose name has been changed for safety reasons, said her brother and her son were killed in the post-election violence. She asked why the government had not visited affected families.
paras.zh: 出于安全原因，化名的祖里表示，她的兄弟和儿子在选举后的暴力事件中丧生。她询问为什么政府没有探望受影响的家庭。

paras.en: "We lost our children; we lost our brothers. Why hasn't the government taken any initiative to at least visit us?" Zuri asked.
paras.zh: “我们失去了我们的孩子；我们失去了我们的兄弟。为什么政府没有采取任何措施至少探望我们呢？”祖里问道。

paras.en: "They behave as if nothing happened. Is this justice? There is no justice in Tanzania."
paras.zh: “他们表现得好像什么都没发生过。这是正义吗？坦桑尼亚没有正义。”

articles.title: Evacuation from Oleshky: How are preparations going?

paras.en: Since a ceasefire took effect in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky in Ukraine's Kherson region on October 27, preparations have been underway to evacuate residents trapped there.
paras.zh: 自10月27日乌克兰赫尔松地区俄占城镇奥列什基停火生效以来，撤离被困居民的准备工作一直在进行。

paras.en: Following Russia's occupation of the town in 2022 and the flooding caused by the destruction of the nearby Kakhovka dam in 2023, residents were cut off from the outside world. All access routes to Oleshky, which lies on the Dnipro River, had been mined. Former Oleshky residents who managed to escape and talked to DW described hunger, no access to medicine, and no electricity or water. About 2,000 people are still living in the town.
paras.zh: 2022 年俄罗斯占领该镇，2023 年附近的卡霍夫卡大坝被毁引发洪水，居民与外界隔绝。所有通往位于第聂伯河沿岸的奥列什基的路线均已布满地雷。成功逃脱并接受德国之声采访的前奥列什基居民描述了饥饿、无法获得药品、没有电或水的情况。该镇仍有约2000人居住。

paras.en: According to the Save Ukraine Foundation, it has rescued at least 300 civilians from Oleshky over the past six months. DW spoke with lawyer Myroslava Kharchenko, who works for the organization, about preparations for the upcoming evacuation.
paras.zh: 据拯救乌克兰基金会称，过去六个月已从奥列什基救出了至少 300 名平民。德国之声采访了该组织的律师米罗斯拉瓦·哈琴科(Myroslava Kharchenko)，谈论了即将到来的疏散的准备工作。

paras.en: DW: A ceasefire is already in effect in Oleshky. Do you know whether any evacuation efforts have begun?
paras.zh: 德国之声：奥列什基的停火已经生效。您知道疏散工作是否已经开始吗？

paras.en: Myroslava Kharchenko: No, we do not have that information yet. What we do know is that the ceasefire came into effect on October 27 at 3 a.m. Kyiv time, which is 4 a.m. in Russia. Mine-clearing operations on the road began at around 8 a.m. What is happening inside Oleshky itself, however, is entirely within the military's remit. Everyone involved in this operation has been asked to maintain strict confidentiality. Any careless remark or action could jeopardize the entire evacuation effort.
paras.zh: Myroslava Kharchenko：不，我们还没有这些信息。我们所知道的是，停火于基辅时间10月27日凌晨3点生效，也就是俄罗斯凌晨4点。道路上的扫雷行动于上午 8 点左右开始。不过，奥列什基内部发生的事情完全属于军方的职权范围。参与此次行动的每个人都被要求严格保密。任何粗心的言论或行动都可能危及整个疏散工作。

paras.en: What I can see is that information is being actively collected through closed internal local chat groups. Registration lists and application forms are being shared, and people are filling them out themselves. Organizers are contacting those who previously requested evacuation to verify details such as their date of birth and current place of residence. They are also asking people to provide contact information for neighbors or relatives who may be nearby or in the same building, because communications are extremely unreliable.
paras.zh: 我看到的是，信息正在通过封闭的内部本地聊天组积极收集。登记名单和申请表正在共享，人们可以自己填写。组织者正在联系那些之前要求疏散的人，以核实他们的出生日期和当前居住地等详细信息。他们还要求人们提供可能在附近或同一栋大楼内的邻居或亲戚的联系信息，因为通讯极其不可靠。

paras.en: The organizers are also collecting information about the health conditions of those planning to leave. Among them are people who are ill, have limited mobility, or are recovering from recent injuries, including blast and mine-related wounds. We therefore expect those organizing the evacuation to ensure that medical assistance is available for those who need it.
paras.zh: 组织者还在收集有关计划离开的人的健康状况的信息。其中包括生病、行动不便或正在从最近受伤（包括与爆炸和地雷有关的伤口）中恢复的人。因此，我们希望组织疏散的人员能够确保为需要的人提供医疗援助。

paras.en: How exactly is the evacuation expected to take place? Will people be evacuated through Russian-controlled territory or via the Dnipro River? Have any routes already been agreed upon?
paras.zh: 预计疏散具体将如何进行？人们会通过俄罗斯控制的领土还是通过第聂伯河疏散？是否已商定任何路线？

paras.en: As far as we know, a river route would be extremely dangerous. We have not heard any confirmation that such an option has been approved. It therefore appears likely that the evacuation route will pass through the temporarily occupied Ukrainian territory and possibly through Russia before people are able to reach Ukraine. For security reasons, however, none of these details are being made public.
paras.zh: 据我们所知，河流路线极其危险。我们尚未听到任何有关此类选项已获得批准的确认消息。因此，疏散路线很可能会穿过暂时被占领的乌克兰领土，并可能穿过俄罗斯，然后才能到达乌克兰。然而，出于安全原因，这些细节均未公开。

paras.en: What do you know about the number of people expected to be evacuated?
paras.zh: 您对预计疏散的人数了解多少？

paras.en: We are actually very pleased that the evacuation is not expected to take place in a single day. That is important because we hope that those who manage to leave safely during the first stage will serve as an example for others.
paras.zh: 事实上，我们很高兴疏散预计不会在一天内完成。这很重要，因为我们希望那些在第一阶段安全离开的人能够为其他人树立榜样。

paras.en: People still trapped in Oleshky are extremely afraid. There have already been numerous provocations, and this is not the first attempt to establish such a route or humanitarian corridor.
paras.zh: 仍然被困在奥列什基的人们非常害怕。已经发生过多次挑衅，这并不是第一次尝试建立这样的路线或人道主义走廊。

paras.en: As a result, there is a great deal of suspicion. Those concerns are based largely on uncertainty, and some people may choose not to leave during the initial phase of the evacuation. Overall, however, we estimate that around 500 people may eventually be evacuated.
paras.zh: 因此，存在很大的怀疑。这些担忧很大程度上是基于不确定性，有些人可能会选择在疏散的初始阶段不离开。但总体而言，我们估计最终可能有约 500 人被疏散。

paras.en: How would you assess the role of Melania Trump in making this evacuation possible?
paras.zh: 您如何评价梅拉尼娅·特朗普在促成这次疏散中发挥的作用？

paras.en: We are immensely grateful to Melania Trump for drawing attention to the humanitarian catastrophe currently unfolding in Oleshky. What is taking place there is in fact genocide committed by the Russian Federation.
paras.zh: 我们非常感谢梅拉尼娅·特朗普提请人们关注奥列什基目前正在发生的人道主义灾难。那里正在发生的事情实际上是俄罗斯联邦犯下的种族灭绝罪行。

paras.en: We are thankful for her efforts and hope they will help make this evacuation possible. We will be even more grateful once most people are safely removed from the combat zone and arrive in Ukrainian government-controlled territory.
paras.zh: 我们感谢她的努力，并希望他们能够帮助使这次疏散成为可能。一旦大多数人安全地离开战区并抵达乌克兰政府控制的领土，我们将更加感激。

paras.en: When could the physical evacuation of civilians begin?
paras.zh: 什么时候可以开始疏散平民？

paras.en: I can't say how long it will take. What seems clear, however, is that time will be needed to clear mines from the roads leading into the city. We also understand that many streets inside Oleshky are mined, so additional work will be required to make routes within the city safe.
paras.zh: 我不能说需要多长时间。然而，显而易见的是，需要时间来清除通往城市的道路上的地雷。我们还了解到，奥列什基市内的许多街道都埋有地雷，因此需要进行额外的工作来确保城市内的路线安全。

paras.en: There is a hospital from which people need to be evacuated. Nearby is a morgue where bodies also need to be recovered.
paras.zh: 有一家医院，需要疏散人员。附近有一个太平间，尸体也需要在那里打捞。

paras.en: I do not know whether that will be included as part of this humanitarian corridor, but it is undoubtedly important. The bodies need to be identified and the causes of death established. That process will also take time, regardless of how quickly the military is able to work.
paras.zh: 我不知道这是否会被纳入这条人道主义走廊的一部分，但这无疑很重要。需要辨认尸体并确定死亡原因。无论军队的行动速度有多快，这一过程也需要时间。

paras.en: It is difficult to make any predictions because, as you can see, everything is being conducted under strict secrecy. Statements from both the Russian and Ukrainian sides have been extremely cautious, and that is clearly justified under the circumstances.
paras.zh: 很难做出任何预测，因为正如你所看到的，一切都是在严格保密的情况下进行的。俄罗斯和乌克兰双方的声明都极其谨慎，在这种情况下这显然是有道理的。

articles.title: Canada-EU summit: What do both sides want, and what’s at stake?

paras.en: Canada is set to host a summit with the European Union to bolster bilateral strategic and economic ties as its relations with its southern neighbour, the United States, are in sharp decline.
paras.zh: 由于加拿大与南部邻国美国的关系急剧恶化，加拿大将主办与欧盟的峰会，以加强双边战略和经济关系。

paras.en: The summit is scheduled for October 29 to 30 in Canada’s French-speaking city of Montreal, and is expected to focus on closer cooperation on trade, technology, defence, energy, critical minerals, artificial intelligence, research and financial services.
paras.zh: 此次峰会定于10月29日至30日在加拿大法语城市蒙特利尔举行，预计将重点关注贸易、技术、国防、能源、关键矿产、人工智能、研究和金融服务等领域更密切的合作。

paras.en: In September, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed opening the door for Canada to become the EU’s first “associate member”; Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed the move.
paras.zh: 9月，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩提议为加拿大成为欧盟首个“准成员国”打开大门；加拿大总理马克·卡尼对此举表示欢迎。

paras.en: What is the summit, and why is it happening now?
paras.zh: 峰会是什么？为什么现在举行？

paras.en: This will be the 21st Canada-EU summit and is expected to build on the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), which entered into force in 2017. It eliminates duties on up to 99 percent of all imported goods between the two sides, according to the European Council.
paras.zh: 这将是第 21 次加拿大-欧盟峰会，预计将以 2017 年生效的全面经济贸易协定 (CETA) 为基础。根据欧洲理事会的数据，该协定免除了双方高达 99% 的进口商品的关税。

paras.en: “In Montreal, we will take our partnership to the next level by launching our ‘Alliance for the Future’ to deepen our political, economic and institutional ties even further,” said European Council President Antonio Costa, who will be attending the summit along with Carney and von der Leyen. They are expected to issue a joint statement.
paras.zh: 将与卡尼和冯德莱恩一起出席峰会的欧洲理事会主席安东尼奥·科斯塔表示：“在蒙特利尔，我们将通过推出‘未来联盟’，进一步深化我们的政治、经济和机构联系，从而将我们的伙伴关系提升到一个新的水平。”预计他们将发表联合声明。

paras.en: The deepening Canada-EU alignment seems fuelled by US President Donald Trump’s policies, which imposed hefty tariffs on both Canadian and European exports to the US and pushed Canada to look for ways to reduce its economic dependence on the US. Before Trump’s tariffs whipsawed relations, Canada sent nearly 80 percent of its exports to the US.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的政策似乎推动了加拿大与欧盟的深化结盟，该政策对加拿大和欧洲对美国的出口产品征收高额关税，并迫使加拿大寻找减少对美国经济依赖的方法。在特朗普的关税破坏两国关系之前，加拿大近 80% 的出口产品销往美国。

paras.en: In August, trade talks between Ottawa and Washington, DC, broke down, and Trump imposed a 50 percent levy on $20bn of Canadian goods, or 5.5 percent of its exports. Canada responded with equivalent tariffs on US steel, dairy, appliances, farm equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics.
paras.zh: 8月，渥太华和华盛顿之间的贸易谈判破裂，特朗普对价值200亿美元的加拿大商品征收50%的关税，占加拿大出口额的5.5%。加拿大对美国钢铁、乳制品、电器、农业设备、纸浆和纸张以及电子产品征收同等关税作为回应。

paras.en: What do Canada and Europe want from each other?
paras.zh: 加拿大和欧洲希望从对方那里得到什么？

paras.en: Both sides are seeking opportunities that will open more options beyond the world’s largest economy.
paras.zh: 双方都在寻找机会，在世界最大经济体之外提供更多选择。

paras.en: “The opportunity is clear. The EU brings market power, research depth, and manufacturing strength. Canada brings abundant energy, critical minerals, world-class capabilities in space, artificial intelligence (AI), and quantum, and one of the world’s strongest banking systems,” Carney’s office said in a statement.
paras.zh: “机会是显而易见的。欧盟带来了市场力量、研究深度和制造实力。加拿大带来了丰富的能源、关键矿产、世界一流的太空、人工智能（AI）和量子能力，以及世界上最强大的银行系统之一，”卡尼办公室在一份声明中表示。

paras.en: The summit will give the two sides a chance to turn these “complementary strengths into concrete benefits for our peoples,” the statement added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说，此次峰会将为双方提供一个机会，将这些“优势互补转化为造福两国人民的具体利益”。

paras.en: Vina Nadjibulla, co-founder and CEO of the Centre for Strategic Statecraft, a think tank in Ottawa, Canada, sees benefits and challenges.
paras.zh: 加拿大渥太华智库战略治国中心联合创始人兼首席执行官维娜·纳德吉布拉 (Vina Nadjibulla) 看到了好处和挑战。

paras.en: “These fields could be beneficial for both sides, and we are likely to see specific announcements during the summit on these sectors,” she told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “这些领域可能对双方都有利，我们很可能会在峰会期间看到有关这些领域的具体公告，”她告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “The main challenge is how quickly the political momentum can turn into specific deals and projects to deliver specific economic results,” she added.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“主要挑战是政治势头能够多快转化为具体的交易和项目，以实现具体的经济成果。”

paras.en: The EU describes Canada as “the only non-European country” taking part in Security Action for Europe (SAFE), the EU’s 150 billion-euro ($167bn) loan programme that supports and expedites defence procurement by EU member states.
paras.zh: 欧盟将加拿大描述为参与欧洲安全行动 (SAFE) 的“唯一非欧洲国家”，这是欧盟 1500 亿欧元（1670 亿美元）的贷款计划，旨在支持和加快欧盟成员国的国防采购。

paras.en: The EU concluded its agreement with Canada, allowing it to participate under SAFE, in February, and it gives Canadian firms preferential access and treatment in defence procurements financed by the SAFE Instrument.
paras.zh: 欧盟于二月份与加拿大达成了协议，允许其参与国家外汇管理局的框架，并在由国家外汇管理局资助的国防采购中给予加拿大公司优惠准入和待遇。

paras.en: Could Canada become an associate member of the EU?
paras.zh: 加拿大能否成为欧盟准成员？

paras.en: Last month, von der Leyen proposed that Canada could become the EU’s first associate member, suggesting a deeper relationship spanning trade, technology, defence and economic security.
paras.zh: 上个月，冯德莱恩提议加拿大可以成为欧盟第一个准成员，这表明两国在贸易、技术、国防和经济安全等领域建立更深入的关系。

paras.en: Carney later welcomed the proposal’s ambition, describing his goal as a “unique alliance” rather than conventional EU membership.
paras.zh: 卡尼后来对该提案的雄心表示欢迎，并将他的目标描述为“独特的联盟”，而不是传统的欧盟成员国身份。

paras.en: However, the term “associate member” does not currently exist in EU treaties or its standard enlargement framework, according to the Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS), a Brussels-based think tank.
paras.zh: 然而，根据布鲁塞尔智库欧洲政策研究中心（CEPS）的说法，目前欧盟条约或其标准扩大框架中并不存在“准成员”一词。

paras.en: “The term does not actually matter; what is important is the practical deepening of the relationship and the actual results, no matter what the final term is,” Nadjibulla said.
paras.zh: “任期实际上并不重要；重要的是关系的实际深化和实际结果，无论最终任期是什么，”纳吉布拉说。

paras.en: “This is a partnership not against anyone else, but for our common strength,” von der Leyen said in her address to the European Parliament in Strasbourg last month, which Carney attended, making him the first foreign head of government to attend the annual “State of the European Union” address.
paras.zh: 冯德莱恩上个月在斯特拉斯堡向欧洲议会发表讲话时表示，“这种伙伴关系不是针对任何人，而是为了我们的共同力量。卡尼出席了这次会议，这使他成为第一位出席年度“欧盟国情”演讲的外国政府首脑。

paras.en: “I do not see that as an anti-US coalition. It is rather about diversification of economic and defence partnerships and building resilience for Canada. It is a continuation of Canadian Prime Minister Carney’s policies to create opportunities. A deeper alliance with Europe is essential to this agenda,” she said.
paras.zh: “我不认为这是一个反美联盟。它更重要的是经济和国防伙伴关系的多元化，以及增强加拿大的抵御能力。这是加拿大总理卡尼创造机会政策的延续。与欧洲建立更深层次的联盟对于这一议程至关重要，”她说。

paras.en: “President Trump will likely not appreciate this, but it is about Canada having more choices in an unpredictable world,” she added.
paras.zh: “特朗普总统可能不会欣赏这一点，但这关系到加拿大在不可预测的世界中拥有更多选择，”她补充道。

paras.en: Bob Rae, former premier of Ontario and Canada’s ambassador to the United Nations from 2020 to 2025, told Al Jazeera that “President Trump does not control our policy. We have been having long and productive relations with the Europeans for hundreds of years, but Trump chose to treat Canada in a way that does not respect our sovereignty”.
paras.zh: 前安大略省省长、2020年至2025年加拿大驻联合国大使鲍勃·雷告诉半岛电视台，“特朗普总统无法控制我们的政策。数百年来，我们与欧洲人一直保持着长期而富有成效的关系，但特朗普选择以不尊重我们主权的方式对待加拿大”。

paras.en: He added that “engaging in conversations with the EU is perfectly normal and is not directed at the US”.
paras.zh: 他补充说，“与欧盟进行对话是完全正常的，并不是针对美国的”。

paras.en: Trump has threatened the European Union with new tariffs over its proposal to make Canada the bloc’s first “associate member”, suggesting the move could be considered hostile to the US.
paras.zh: 特朗普威胁欧盟要对加拿大成为欧盟第一个“准成员国”的提议征收新关税，暗示此举可能被视为对美国怀有敌意。

paras.en: “If it’s a good intention, that’s fine. If it’s a bad intention, we’ll put very heavy tariffs on Europe,” Trump told reporters in Charlotte, North Carolina, in September.
paras.zh: “如果是善意，那也没关系。如果是恶意，我们将对欧洲征收非常高的关税，”特朗普九月在北卡罗来纳州夏洛特对记者表示。

paras.en: Trump dismissed the prospect of Canada joining the EU as “laughable” and called the US’s northern neighbour a “terrible trade partner”.
paras.zh: 特朗普认为加拿大加入欧盟的前景“可笑”，并称美国的北方邻国是“可怕的贸易伙伴”。

articles.title: Sudan war and inflation leave families struggling to survive in Khartoum

paras.en: Khartoum, Sudan – Rasha Abdelaziz Musa works every day for seven hours selling tea. But by the time she finishes for the day at 10pm, she’s still unsure if she has enough to feed her four children.
paras.zh: 苏丹喀土穆——拉沙·阿卜杜拉齐兹·穆萨 (Rasha Abdelaziz Musa) 每天工作七个小时，卖茶。但当她晚上 10 点结束一天的工作时，她仍然不确定自己是否有足够的钱养活四个孩子。

paras.en: Musa, 39, is doing her best, but her earnings are increasingly no longer enough to cover soaring food prices in the Sudanese capital.
paras.zh: 39 岁的穆萨正在尽力而为，但她的收入越来越不足以支付苏丹首都飞涨的食品价格。

paras.en: Her husband, a member of the Sudanese military, has spent more than eight months on the front lines of the country’s war, in which the military has been fighting the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces since 2023. Musa has not heard from him for months, and he has sent no money.
paras.zh: 她的丈夫是苏丹军方成员，在该国战争前线度过了八个多月的时间，自 2023 年以来，军队一直在与准军事快速支援部队作战。穆萨已经几个月没有收到他的消息，也没有寄过任何钱。

paras.en: In his absence, Musa has been left to provide for their children, who attend kindergarten, primary and secondary school.
paras.zh: 在他缺席的情况下，穆萨不得不抚养他们的孩子，他们的孩子正在上幼儿园、小学和中学。

paras.en: Musa told Al Jazeera that feeding her family costs about 40,000 Sudanese pounds per day ($4 at the parallel-market exchange rate) before accounting for rent, household essentials and other expenses.
paras.zh: 穆萨告诉半岛电视台，在考虑租金、家庭必需品和其他费用之前，养家糊口每天的费用约为 40,000 苏丹镑（按平行市场汇率计算为 4 美元）。

paras.en: Some of the family staples are ful medames, a dish of stewed fava beans, or lentils. When lentils are too expensive, Musa serves taamiya, or falafel, sandwiches.
paras.zh: 一些家庭主食是ful medames，一种炖蚕豆或扁豆。当扁豆太贵时，穆萨就会供应 taamiya 或沙拉三明治三明治。

paras.en: Prices regularly change, and Musa often ends the day in debt to the traders she gets her food from.
paras.zh: 价格定期变化，穆萨常常欠下从她那里获取食物的商人的债。

paras.en: Musa is not alone in struggling to cover her family’s daily expenses.
paras.zh: 穆萨并不是唯一一个为维持家庭日常开支而苦苦挣扎的人。

paras.en: Ahmed Youssef, 61, supports a family of 12 through his work in a butcher’s shop and as an occasional intermediary in livestock sales. He can earn 90,000 to 140,000 pounds ($9 to $14) when a deal succeeds, but that income is irregular.
paras.zh: 61 岁的艾哈迈德·优素福 (Ahmed Youssef) 通过在肉店工作以及偶尔担任牲畜销售中介来养活一个 12 口之家。当交易成功时，他可以赚取 90,000 到 140,000 英镑（9 到 14 美元），但这种收入是不稳定的。

paras.en: He told Al Jazeera that his household spends more than 100,000 Sudanese pounds ($10) daily and his income is no longer enough to support the family.
paras.zh: 他告诉半岛电视台，他的家庭每天花费超过 10 万苏丹镑（10 美元），而他的收入已不足以养家糊口。

paras.en: “One income is no longer enough to cover the family’s needs, and sometimes my older children have to work to help meet expenses,” Youssef told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 优素福告诉半岛电视台：“一份收入不再足以满足家庭的需求，有时我的大孩子必须工作来帮助支付开支。”

paras.en: Ali Fadil supports a family of 10. Without a permanent job, he goes to the market each morning to look for work. Some days, the 57-year-old earns enough to buy food, but on other days, he finds no work at all. And yet his daily expenses still reach about 70,000 pounds ($7), with rising prices adding to the financial pressure he faces.
paras.zh: Ali Fadil 养活着一个十口之家。由于没有固定工作，他每天早上都去市场找工作。有时候，这位 57 岁的人赚的钱足够买食物，但有时候，他根本找不到工作。然而，他的日常开支仍然达到约 70,000 英镑（7 美元），物价上涨加剧了他面临的财务压力。

paras.en: “Sometimes I skip meals so I can pay for school fees or medical costs,” he said. “I also borrow money to meet other obligations.”
paras.zh: “有时我不吃饭，这样我就可以支付学费或医疗费用，”他说。 “我还借钱来履行其他义务。”

paras.en: Food prices rise as Sudanese pound weakens
paras.zh: 苏丹镑走弱导致食品价格上涨

paras.en: A survey of four local markets in the Khartoum State area by Al Jazeera last week found that prices for several essential foods had risen sharply within days, making it increasingly difficult for families to plan their spending.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台上周对喀土穆州地区四个当地市场的调查发现，几种基本食品的价格在几天内大幅上涨，使家庭越来越难以计划支出。

paras.en: A kilogramme (2.2.lb) of sugar cost about 10,000 pounds ($1), up from 9,000 pounds ($0.90) two days earlier. A litre (1 quart) of cooking oil rose to 25,000 pounds ($2.50) from 20,000 pounds ($2) while a loaf of bread costs 500 pounds ($0.05), compared with 300 pounds ($0.03) a week earlier.
paras.zh: 一公斤（2.2.磅）糖的价格约为 10,000 磅（1 美元），而两天前为 9,000 磅（0.90 美元）。一升（1夸脱）食用油的价格从 20,000 磅（2 美元）上涨到 25,000 磅（2.50 美元），而一条面包的价格为 500 磅（0.05 美元），而一周前为 300 磅（0.03 美元）。

paras.en: Lentils cost about 10,000 pounds ($1) per kilogramme, up from 8,000 pounds ($0.80), and rice was priced at 13,000 pounds ($1.30) per kilogramme, up from 10,000 pounds ($1). Powdered milk reached 70,000 pounds ($7) per kilogramme, up from 60,000 ($6) two days earlier.
paras.zh: 小扁豆的价格约为每公斤 10,000 磅（1 美元），高于每公斤 8,000 磅（0.80 美元），大米的价格为每公斤 13,000 磅（1.30 美元），高于每公斤 10,000 磅（1 美元）。奶粉价格从两天前的每公斤 60,000 磅（6 美元）上涨至 70,000 磅（7 美元）。

paras.en: The Sudanese pound has also continued to weaken. According to exchange rates monitored by Al Jazeera, $1 was trading at 10,050 Sudanese pounds on the parallel market on Friday, compared with 9,500 the previous day.
paras.zh: 苏丹镑也持续走弱。根据半岛电视台监测的汇率，周五平行市场上1美元兑换10,050苏丹镑，而前一天为9,500苏丹镑。

paras.en: Food inflation adds to pressure on households
paras.zh: 食品通胀增加了家庭的压力

paras.en: Official figures offer further evidence of the rising cost of living, particularly in Khartoum and other urban areas.
paras.zh: 官方数据进一步证明生活成本不断上升，特别是在喀土穆和其他城市地区。

paras.en: According to Sudan’s Central Bureau of Statistics, prices across the country were 28 percent higher in September than a year earlier, up from 26 percent in August. Prices rose by 7.5 percent in September alone, more than double the increase recorded the previous month.
paras.zh: 据苏丹中央统计局称，9 月份全国物价同比上涨 28%，高于 8 月份的 26%。仅9月份价格就上涨了7.5%，是上个月涨幅的两倍多。

paras.en: Food prices have risen even faster. Across Sudan, food and beverages cost nearly 37 percent more in September than a year earlier, up from an annual increase of about 21 percent in August. In September alone, food prices jumped by more than 17 percent.
paras.zh: 食品价格上涨得更快。在整个苏丹，9 月份食品和饮料价格比去年同期上涨近 37%，高于 8 月份约 21% 的年增长率。仅9月份，食品价格就上涨了17%以上。

paras.en: The situation was particularly severe in Khartoum State, where prices were nearly 60 percent higher than a year earlier. Prices rose by more than 15 percent in September alone, following an increase of nearly 9 percent in August.
paras.zh: 喀土穆州的情况尤其严重，该州的物价比一年前上涨了近 60%。继 8 月份上涨近 9% 后，仅 9 月份价格就上涨了 15% 以上。

paras.en: That sharp increase comes as the capital region struggles to recover from widespread destruction caused by the war. Although displaced residents have begun returning and businesses are gradually reopening since the military recaptured the state from the RSF last year, damaged infrastructure and rising transport costs continue to constrain the availability of goods.
paras.zh: 这一急剧增长发生之际，首都地区正在努力从战争造成的广泛破坏中恢复过来。尽管自去年军方从无国界军手中夺回该州以来，流离失所的居民已经开始返回，企业也逐渐重新开业，但基础设施受损和运输成本上涨继续限制了货物的供应。

paras.en: The return of residents has also increased demand for essential supplies, further driving up prices. In September, fuel shortages hit the capital as consumption rose faster than supplies could be replenished.
paras.zh: 居民的回归也增加了对必需品的需求，进一步推高了价格。 9月份，由于消费增长速度快于供应补充速度，燃料短缺袭击了首都。

paras.en: Urban areas have generally been hit harder than rural communities. Food prices in towns and cities were 55 percent higher than a year earlier, up from about 40 percent in August. Overall, prices in urban areas rose by 40 percent over the past year, compared with about 21 percent in rural areas.
paras.zh: 城市地区普遍比农村社区受到的打击更严重。城镇食品价格比去年同期上涨 55%，高于 8 月份的约 40%。总体而言，过去一年城市地区的房价上涨了40%，而农村地区的房价上涨了约21%。

paras.en: The war is the main driver of these increases, disrupting livelihoods and supply chains. According to the World Bank, Sudan’s economy shrank by an estimated 29 percent in 2023 and a further 14 percent in 2024 as the war devastated businesses, disrupted agricultural production and eliminated jobs.
paras.zh: 战争是这些增长的主要驱动力，扰乱了生计和供应链。据世界银行称，由于战争摧毁了企业、扰乱了农业生产并减少了就业机会，苏丹的经济预计在 2023 年萎缩 29%，在 2024 年进一步萎缩 14%。

paras.en: The conflict has also forced millions of people from their homes with nearly 8.9 million people still internally displaced as of April, according to the International Organization for Migration.
paras.zh: 据国际移民组织称，冲突还迫使数百万人离开家园，截至 4 月份仍有近 890 万人在国内流离失所。

paras.en: Journalist and economic affairs specialist Khalid Teks said Sudan’s economic deterioration began long before the war. Falling oil production after South Sudan’s secession in 2011 worsened conditions as did the depreciation of the pound, cash shortages, international isolation, political conflict and corruption in the years preceding the removal of President Omar al-Bashir in 2019.
paras.zh: 记者兼经济事务专家哈立德·泰克斯表示，苏丹的经济恶化早在战前就开始了。 2011 年南苏丹分裂后石油产量下降，导致局势恶化，2019 年奥马尔·巴希尔总统下台前几年的英镑贬值、现金短缺、国际孤立、政治冲突和腐败也导致局势恶化。

paras.en: Teks said political instability during the power transition undermined Sudan’s economic performance, and deep reforms were not implemented before war broke out in 2023. The conflict devastated infrastructure and productive sectors, depleted savings and disrupted economic activity. The climate has also been a factor. Strong agricultural production in 2024 was followed by concern over limited rainfall this year and possible food shortages after the harvest begins in November.
paras.zh: 泰克斯表示，权力过渡期间的政治不稳定损害了苏丹的经济表现，并且在2023年战争爆发之前没有实施深入的改革。冲突摧毁了基础设施和生产部门，耗尽了储蓄并扰乱了经济活动。气候也是一个因素。 2024 年农业生产强劲之后，人们对今年降雨有限以及 11 月收获开始后可能出现粮食短缺的担忧。

paras.en: Teks told Al Jazeera that families increasingly deplete their savings and sell their possessions to cover everyday expenses.
paras.zh: 泰克斯告诉半岛电视台，越来越多的家庭耗尽积蓄并出售财产来支付日常开支。

paras.en: He also pointed to disruptions to remittance channels, which many Sudanese households rely on for financial support.
paras.zh: 他还指出，许多苏丹家庭依赖汇款渠道获得财务支持。

paras.en: Teks called for easier humanitarian access, an end to the war, direct support for vulnerable households and low-interest loans for small businesses and craft enterprises.
paras.zh: 特克斯呼吁更方便地提供人道主义援助、结束战争、为弱势家庭提供直接支持以及为小企业和手工艺企业提供低息贷款。

paras.en: “The government needs to provide direct support through dedicated funds and the Zakat Chamber, facilitate humanitarian organisations and offer affordable loans for small businesses and vocational activities,” Teks said. “This could help reopen markets and workshops and expand microfinance.
paras.zh: 泰克斯说：“政府需要通过专用资金和天课商会提供直接支持，为人道主义组织提供便利，并为小企业和职业活动提供负担得起的贷款。” “这可能有助于重新开放市场和研讨会并扩大小额信贷。

articles.title: Balad leader blasts ‘racist’ exclusion of Arab parties in Israel

paras.en: The leader of Israel’s Balad party has condemned the country’s main political leaders for refusing to form a coalition with Arab parties, even after a record showing in polls could make them kingmakers for the next parliament after no clear winner emerged.
paras.zh: 以色列巴拉德党领导人谴责该国主要政治领导人拒绝与阿拉伯政党结成联盟，尽管民调显示创纪录的成绩可能会让他们在没有明显获胜者出现的情况下成为下届议会的制王者。

paras.en: Sami Abu Shehadeh told Al Jazeera that Palestinian citizens of Israel, who make up about a fifth of the population, are being treated as illegitimate partners despite their turnout.
paras.zh: 萨米·阿布·谢哈德告诉半岛电视台，占以色列人口约五分之一的巴勒斯坦公民，尽管参加了投票，但仍被视为非法伙伴。

paras.en: “This is racism,” he said. “We are a legitimate elected leadership of the national minority. The vast majority of our people decided that we are their leadership.”
paras.zh: “这是种族主义，”他说。 “我们是合法选举产生的少数民族领导层。我们绝大多数人民认为我们是他们的领导层。”

paras.en: Arab parties are on course to win a record 19 seats, giving them potentially decisive leverage over the main political blocs. With 85 percent of the vote counted, Israel’s Central Elections Committee has Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc ahead with at least 53 seats, and the opposition bloc led by Gadi Eisenkot on 48.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯政党有望赢得创纪录的 19 个席位，这使它们对主要政治集团具有潜在的决定性影响力。以色列中央选举委员会已计完 85% 的选票，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 领导的集团领先至少 53 个席位，加迪·艾森科特 (Gadi Eisenkot) 领导的反对派集团获得 48 个席位。

paras.en: Both are short of the 61 needed to govern. Netanyahu says Israelis chose a strong right-wing government, while Eisenkot says they voted for change.
paras.zh: 两者都缺乏执政所需的 61 人。内塔尼亚胡表示，以色列人选择了一个强大的右翼政府，而艾森科特则表示，他们投票支持变革。

paras.en: Abu Shehadeh, who leads Balad, one of the Joint List’s three parties, was not a candidate.
paras.zh: 联合名单的三个政党之一巴拉德党的领导人阿布·谢哈德 (Abu Shehadeh) 并不是候选人。

paras.en: Israel’s elections committee voted to disqualify him at the request of far-right Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, who accused him of supporting the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack due to an article issued the following day in which Abu Shehadeh called it an “important historical event”.
paras.zh: 应极右翼安全部长伊塔马尔·本·格维尔 (Itamar Ben-Gvir) 的要求，以色列选举委员会投票取消了他的资格。伊塔马尔·本格维尔 (Itamar Ben-Gvir) 指责他支持 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击事件，因为第二天发表的一篇文章阿布·谢哈德 (Abu Shehadeh) 称这是“重要的历史事件”。

paras.en: Abu Shehadeh subsequently told the Supreme Court he did not support “armed struggle” but acknowledged that a paragraph in the article had been incorrectly worded. He said his intention was to call for moving the conflict towards a political process.
paras.zh: 阿布·谢哈德随后告诉最高法院，他不支持“武装斗争”，但承认文章中的一段措辞不正确。他说，他的目的是呼吁将冲突转向政治进程。

paras.en: He withdrew in October after a majority of the Supreme Court panel appeared willing to approve the disqualification. He rejects the grounds and said the court had made clear that Israel has “two different judicial systems, one for the Jews and one for the Arabs”.
paras.zh: 在最高法院陪审团的大多数成员似乎愿意批准取消资格后，他于 10 月退出。他拒绝接受这一理由，并表示法院已明确表示以色列有“两种不同的司法制度，一种针对犹太人，另一种针对阿拉伯人”。

paras.en: “We are very proud of the Arab Palestinian minority in Israel that went in this very high percentage of voting,” he told Al Jazeera. The community’s first promise to voters, he said, was to prevent “this gang of criminals” from returning to power, naming Netanyahu and far-right ministers Bezalel Smotrich and Ben-Gvir. “So our first promise, we can keep it from now .”
paras.zh: “我们为以色列的阿拉伯巴勒斯坦少数民族感到非常自豪，他们的投票比例非常高，”他告诉半岛电视台。他说，该社区对选民的第一个承诺是防止“这帮犯罪团伙”重新掌权，并点名内塔尼亚胡和极右翼部长贝扎雷尔·斯莫特里奇和本·格维尔。 “所以我们的第一个承诺，从现在开始我们就可以兑现了。”

paras.en: Numbers point to Arab parties but opposition bloc resistant
paras.zh: 数字显示阿拉伯政党支持，但反对派集团抵制

paras.en: Al Jazeera’s Nour Odeh, reporting from Ramallah in the occupied West Bank, said Netanyahu “has scared off everybody from talking to the Palestinian Israeli parties”, leaving him best placed to “call the shots”. She said that Eisenkot and his allies have indicated that they want a Zionist government and “do not want to form a government” with the Arab parties, leaving them few options.
paras.zh: 半岛电视台记者努尔·奥迪在被占领的约旦河西岸拉马拉报道称，内塔尼亚胡“吓跑了所有人，不敢与巴勒斯坦以色列各方对话”，让他最适合“发号施令”。她说，艾森科特和他的盟友已经表示，他们想要一个犹太复国主义政府，并且“不想与阿拉伯政党组建政府”，这让他们几乎没有选择。

paras.en: Danny Ayalon, a former Israeli ambassador to the United States, told Al Jazeera that turnout among Palestinian citizens of Israel came in “really unprecedented numbers” and that the parties “are going to have some significant clout”.
paras.zh: 前以色列驻美国大使丹尼·阿亚隆告诉半岛电视台，以色列巴勒斯坦公民的投票率“确实是前所未有的”，而且各方“将拥有一些重大影响力”。

paras.en: Mathematically, he said, Eisenkot’s bloc could join forces with the two Arab parties and pass the threshold, though it would take “political wizardry”. Yousef Jabareen, who leads the Joint List, has said his alliance’s “hands are extended” to oust Netanyahu.
paras.zh: 他说，从数学上讲，艾森科特的集团可以与两个阿拉伯政党联手并跨过门槛，尽管这需要“政治魔法”。联合名单领导者优素福·贾巴林表示，他的联盟“已伸出双手”驱逐内塔尼亚胡。

paras.en: Abu Shehadeh set out what Palestinian citizens want from the next government.
paras.zh: 阿布·谢哈德阐述了巴勒斯坦公民对下一届政府的期望。

paras.en: “We are against genocide and we are against apartheid. We want to promote a different political alternative, one which is based on the values of freedom, justice and equality for both people who are living between the river and the sea.”
paras.zh: “我们反对种族灭绝，我们反对种族隔离。我们希望促进一种不同的政治选择，一种基于生活在河流和海洋之间的人们的自由、正义和平等价值观的政治选择。”

paras.en: Of Netanyahu, he said: “Our problem … is that he is a war criminal.”
paras.zh: 谈到内塔尼亚胡，他说：“我们的问题……是他是一名战犯。”

paras.en: A UN commission said in a report published on Monday that Israel has continued to commit genocide in Gaza after last October’s US-brokered ceasefire in the enclave.
paras.zh: 联合国一个委员会在周一发布的一份报告中表示，去年 10 月美国斡旋在加沙飞地停火后，以色列继续在加沙实施种族灭绝。

paras.en: The Hague-based International Criminal Court issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu in 2024 for war crimes during the Gaza war.
paras.zh: 总部位于海牙的国际刑事法院于 2024 年对内塔尼亚胡发出逮捕令，罪名是在加沙战争期间犯下战争罪。

articles.title: Trump's relationship with Putin comes under fire ahead of the midterms
articles.author: Franco Ordoñez

paras.en: Trump's relationship with Putin comes under fire ahead of the midterms
paras.zh: 特朗普与普京的关系在中期选举前受到批评

paras.en: President Trump's relationship with Russia's Vladimir Putin is under scrutiny again as the president makes deals with Moscow ahead of the midterms.
paras.zh: 随着特朗普总统在中期选举前与莫斯科达成协议，他与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的关系再次受到密切关注。

paras.en: President Trump's relationship with Russia's Vladimir Putin is in question again. So is Trump's political judgment with less than a week before Election Day. The administration argues Trump is striking deals with Russia on things such as diesel to bring economic relief to Americans, but it's also testing the limits of his party's loyalty. NPR White House correspondent Franco Ordoñez is following this. Franco, so how does a history between Trump and Putin inform where they've ended up?
paras.zh: 特朗普总统与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的关系再次受到质疑。距离选举日不到一周，特朗普的政治判断也是如此。政府认为，特朗普正在与俄罗斯就柴油等问题达成协议，为美国人带来经济救济，但这也在考验其政党忠诚度的极限。 NPR 白宫记者 Franco Ordoñez 正在追踪此事。佛朗哥，那么特朗普和普京之间的历史如何告诉我们他们的结局呢？

paras.en: FRANCO ORDOÑEZ, BYLINE: Yeah, A, the relationship really has run hot and cold for many, many years. And while it did cool a bit last year after Trump himself acknowledged the possibility that he was being played by Putin, it's really warmed more recently as Trump looks for help with the domestic economy. I mean, you mentioned the deal for Russian diesel. Trump also waved sanctions that target Russian officials and banks. At the same time, he's blasting Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 弗兰科·奥尔多埃斯连线：是的，A，我们的关系确实时冷时热很多很多年了。去年，在特朗普本人承认自己可能被普京玩弄后，经济确实有所降温，但随着特朗普寻求国内经济方面的帮助，经济最近确实有所回暖。我的意思是，你提到了俄罗斯柴油交易。特朗普还取消了针对俄罗斯官员和银行的制裁。与此同时，他还抨击乌克兰总统泽连斯基。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Now, you mentioned how Trump said there was a chance that Putin was playing him last year. What about now? How does it - feel about it now?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：现在，你提到特朗普去年说普京有可能在玩弄他。那现在呢？现在感觉怎么样？

paras.en: ORDOÑEZ: Well, I mean, it's a really important question because that's being asked by many people right now. I spoke to Richard Fontaine, who served in the George W. Bush White House and now runs the Center for a New American Security. He told me it's important to remember that before becoming president, Putin was a KGB officer, where he was basically trained to do this just thing.
paras.zh: 奥尔多内斯：嗯，我的意思是，这是一个非常重要的问题，因为现在很多人都在问这个问题。我采访了理查德·方丹（Richard Fontaine），他曾在乔治·W·布什（George W. Bush）白宫任职，现在负责新美国安全中心。他告诉我，重要的是要记住，在成为总统之前，普京是一名克格勃官员，他基本上接受了做这件事的训练。

paras.en: RICHARD FONTAINE: Certainly, the Russians are trying to take advantage of this moment. I think they see an opportunity here, one that may be relatively fleeting because the midterms are not too far away, to try to offer something to the president that would not only potentially help with his problem, but certainly help with theirs.
paras.zh: 理查德·方丹：当然，俄罗斯人正试图利用这个时机。我认为他们在这里看到了一个机会，这个机会可能相对短暂，因为中期选举已经不远了，试图向总统提供一些东西，不仅可能有助于解决他的问题，而且肯定有助于解决他们的问题。

paras.en: ORDOÑEZ: Now, the problem that Trump has, at least Fontaine says, is it doesn't look like the U.S. is getting much out of this diesel deal. The price of diesel hasn't really budged much since the deal was made. So not much relief for people at the gas tank.
paras.zh: 奥多内斯：至少方丹说，现在特朗普面临的问题是，美国似乎并没有从这项柴油交易中获得太多好处。自交易达成以来，柴油价格并没有太大变化。因此，油箱旁的人们并没有多少缓解。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: But politically, I mean, isn't there value in the president doing something?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：但是从政治上来说，我的意思是，总统做某事难道没有价值吗？

paras.en: ORDOÑEZ: Yeah. It's important for any president, not just Trump, to be seen taking action on the most important issues that voters are most concerned about, and that's certainly been the cost of living, and gas is a part of that. The question is whether voters will reward the effort, especially considering Americans' critical views of Putin.
paras.zh: 奥尔多内斯：是的。对于任何一位总统来说，不仅仅是特朗普，重要的是要让人们看到他们在选民最关心的最重要问题上采取行动，这当然是生活成本，而天然气是其中的一部分。问题是选民是否会奖励这一努力，特别是考虑到美国人对普京的批评观点。

paras.en: Jon McHenry, a Republican pollster, told me it also puts a number of GOP lawmakers in a difficult position.
paras.zh: 共和党民意调查专家乔恩·麦克亨利告诉我，这也让一些共和党议员陷入了困境。

paras.en: JON MCHENRY: Because on the one hand, they don't want to cross or seem to cross President Trump, who's really important to midterm turnout. But on the other hand, most of them are pretty well established as being against Russia's attacks on Ukraine, against Putin in general.
paras.zh: 乔恩·麦克亨利：因为一方面，他们不想或似乎与特朗普总统发生冲突，而特朗普总统对中期选举投票率非常重要。但另一方面，他们中的大多数人都反对俄罗斯对乌克兰的攻击，总体上反对普京。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: Franco, long term, what could be some of the implications?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：佛朗哥，从长远来看，这可能会产生哪些影响？

paras.en: ORDOÑEZ: Yeah. I do think that's where it does get more interesting. Fontaine, who worked for Bush, was telling me that in terms of U.S. policy, all this should be looked at as one, basically, moment in time and not an irreversible policy or an indefinite shift in positions. And that's because as we've learned many times before - especially on these issues - that Trump often changes his mind.
paras.zh: 奥尔多内斯：是的。我确实认为这就是它变得更有趣的地方。为布什工作过的方丹告诉我，就美国政策而言，所有这一切基本上都应该被视为一个时间点，而不是一项不可逆转的政策或无限期的立场转变。这是因为正如我们之前多次了解到的那样——尤其是在这些问题上——特朗普经常改变主意。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: That's White House correspondent Franco Ordoñez. Franco, thanks.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：这是白宫记者弗朗哥·奥尔多涅斯。弗兰科，谢谢。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Dozens are dead in a high-speed train crash in Spain
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Dozens are dead in a high-speed train crash in Spain
paras.zh: 西班牙高速列车相撞事故已造成数十人死亡

paras.en: URDA, Spain — One high-speed Spanish train slammed into another that had stopped on the tracks Wednesday, killing at least 68 people and shredding carriages in the country's second deadly rail collision this year.
paras.zh: 西班牙乌尔达——周三，一列西班牙高速列车与另一列停在铁轨上的列车相撞，造成至少 68 人死亡，车厢被粉碎，这是该国今年第二起致命的铁路相撞事故。

paras.en: The regional government for Castilla La Mancha confirmed the death toll and said another 58 people needed medical treatment in hospital. Rescue workers continue to search in the wreckage for survivors and bodies.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚拉曼查地区政府证实了死亡人数，并表示另有 58 人需要在医院接受治疗。救援人员继续在废墟中搜寻幸存者和尸体。

paras.en: The accident comes with memories still fresh of another crash between high-speed trains in southern Spain in January involving trains from the same two companies.
paras.zh: 此次事故发生时，人们对一月份在西班牙南部发生的另一起高速列车相撞事故仍记忆犹新，事故涉及的是同一两家公司的列车。

paras.en: Spain's rail system operator ADIF said the crash occurred Wednesday morning in the province of Toledo, involving two high-speed trains carrying hundreds of passengers and heading in the same direction from the capital Madrid to Seville in southwestern Spain.
paras.zh: 西班牙铁路系统运营商ADIF表示，事故发生在周三早上，发生在托莱多省，两列载有数百名乘客的高速列车从首都马德里向同一方向开往西班牙西南部的塞维利亚。

paras.en: One train, run by the state-owned RENFE company, ran into the tail of the other train owned by private company IRYO that had stopped, knocking two of its cars off the track in a rural area between two villages.
paras.zh: 在两个村庄之间的农村地区，国有 RENFE 公司运营的一列火车撞上了另一辆私营公司 IRYO 所拥有的火车尾部，后者已停止运行，导致两节车厢脱离轨道。

paras.en: David Gómez, a construction worker, was working with his brother and another colleague nearby when they heard the crash and ran to help, he told the newspaper El País.
paras.zh: 建筑工人大卫·戈麦斯 (David Gómez) 告诉《国家报》(El País)，他当时正在与他的兄弟和另一位同事在附近工作，听到坠机声后，他们跑去帮忙。

paras.en: "People were trying to get out through the windows ... We cut through some fences to access the area and treated people with the first-aid kits we had brought," until emergency services arrived, he said. "As I was trying to pull a young woman out, there was a piece of a leg."
paras.zh: 他说：“人们试图从窗户逃出去……我们穿过一些栅栏进入该地区，并用我们带来的急救箱对人们进行治疗，”直到紧急服务人员到达。 “当我试图把一名年轻女子拉出来时，发现有一条腿断了。”

paras.en: Rail service was suspended between Madrid, Ciudad Real and Andalusia.
paras.zh: 马德里、雷阿尔城和安达卢西亚之间的铁路服务暂停。

paras.en: Until this year, there had been no fatal crash on Spain's dedicated high-speed lines since the network opened in 1992. It was a source of national pride.
paras.zh: 自 1992 年开通以来，西班牙专用高速线路至今尚未发生过致命事故。这是民族自豪感的源泉。

paras.en: Transport minister says crash was due to "inexplicable" decision
paras.zh: 交通部长表示事故是由于“莫名其妙”的决定造成的

paras.en: Spain's Transport Minister Óscar Puente said that the accident was caused by what he called the "inexplicable" order from a central command center for Spain's trains after a security system had failed. He said the train engineers were not to blame.
paras.zh: 西班牙交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特表示，这起事故是由于西班牙火车中央指挥中心在安全系统失效后发出的“莫名其妙”的命令造成的。他说火车工程师不应该受到责备。

paras.en: Puente said that at 8:30 a.m. the security system on a stretch of 63 kilometers (39 miles) stopped working due to a computer malfunction, causing all trains on that stretch to stop. But the central command told the RENFE train to start running again without any speed restrictions, and it ended up colliding with the stopped IRYO train at 8:53 a.m.
paras.zh: 普恩特说，上午8点30分，由于计算机故障，63公里（39英里）范围内的安全系统停止工作，导致该范围内的所有火车停止运行。但中央指挥部要求 RENFE 列车重新开始运行，不受任何速度限制，最终于上午 8 点 53 分与停止运行的 IRYO 列车相撞。

paras.en: Puente said that the train should never have been told to start moving again since there was still a "stop signal" active that line. And if it had, at least it should have been told to go at reduced speed.
paras.zh: 普恩特说，火车根本不应该被告知重新开始行驶，因为该线路仍然有“停止信号”。如果有的话，至少应该告诉它放慢速度。

paras.en: Puente said they were still studying information to see how fast the train was going, but it could have been at 200 kph (124 mph) for that stretch of the track.
paras.zh: Puente 表示，他们仍在研究信息以了解火车的行驶速度，但该路段的行驶速度可能为 200 公里/小时（124 英里/小时）。

paras.en: "I am not attributing responsibility to anyone, I am just stating the facts," Puente said.
paras.zh: “我不会将责任归咎于任何人，我只是陈述事实，”普恩特说。

paras.en: Everything went flying when the trains collided, a passenger said
paras.zh: 一名乘客说，火车相撞时一切都飞了起来

paras.en: The crash, which occurred in a flat stretch surrounded by olive fields in between the towns of Urda and Los Yébenes, left one car torn into bits of metal and other material, scattering debris down a gravel slope.
paras.zh: 事故发生在乌尔达镇和洛斯耶贝内斯镇之间一片橄榄田环绕的平坦地带，一辆汽车被撕成金属和其他材料的碎片，碎片散落到砾石斜坡上。

paras.en: Spanish Health Minister Mónica García said that emergency workers were focusing on rescuing survivors and bodies from the two most damaged train cars. She said that the injured are being sent to different hospitals in the area.
paras.zh: 西班牙卫生部长莫妮卡·加西亚表示，紧急救援人员正在集中精力从两节受损最严重的火车车厢中营救幸存者和尸体。她说，伤者正在被送往该地区的不同医院。

paras.en: "It was a high-speed impact, so we are expecting this to be a tragedy," García said.
paras.zh: 加西亚说：“这是一次高速撞击，因此我们预计这将是一场悲剧。”

paras.en: Passenger Ignacio Relaño was traveling on the RENFE train. He told state broadcaster TVE that the train had stopped momentarily on the line before it started again and then crashed into the IRYO.
paras.zh: 乘客 Ignacio Relaño 乘坐 RENFE 列车。他告诉国家电视台 TVE，火车在线路上短暂停留，然后再次启动，然后撞上了 IRYO。

paras.en: "We all felt the train abruptly slowing down and then the impact," he said. "The car leaned to one side like it was about to tip over. I hit my nose, everything went flying, luggage, cell phones. Everything shook."
paras.zh: “我们都感觉到火车突然减速，然后是撞击，”他说。 “汽车向一侧倾斜，就像要翻倒一样。我撞到了鼻子，所有东西都飞了起来，行李、手机。所有东西都摇晃起来。”

paras.en: Another passenger recounted to Cadena Ser radio how she felt the train slam on the brakes and was thrown forward in her seat, breaking the small table in front of her. She said she saw body parts and trapped people covered in blood.
paras.zh: 另一位乘客向 Cadena Ser 广播电台讲述了她如何感觉到火车猛踩刹车，她的座位被向前抛起，撞碎了她面前的小桌子。她说她看到尸体残骸和被困人员浑身是血。

paras.en: Padilla said that 397 passengers were in the RENFE train and 147 passengers in the IRYO train.
paras.zh: 帕迪拉说，RENFE列车上有397名乘客，IRYO列车上有147名乘客。

paras.en: IRYO, an Italian-owned company, said in a statement that it has "activated its security protocols and is closely working with authorities."
paras.zh: 意大利公司 IRYO 在一份声明中表示，该公司已“启动安全协议，并正在与当局密切合作”。

paras.en: The mayor of the nearby town of Urda, Manuel Galán, said civil protection authorities had asked his officials to prepare a sports pavilion to receive injured passengers.
paras.zh: 附近乌尔达镇的市长曼努埃尔·加兰表示，民防部门已要求其官员准备一个体育场馆来接收受伤乘客。

paras.en: A military emergency brigade was deployed to help emergency services, firefighters and police. Ambulances and medical helicopters made trips to and from the site, while unscathed survivors were put on buses.
paras.zh: 部署了一支军事紧急部队来帮助紧急服务人员、消防员和警察。救护车和医疗直升机往返于现场，而未受伤的幸存者则被送上巴士。

paras.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez canceled his agenda to focus on the crash. He wrote on X that he was "dismayed by the serious train accident in Toledo."
paras.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯取消了议程，转而关注坠机事件。他在 X 上写道，他“对托莱多发生的严重火车事故感到沮丧”。

paras.en: "Emergency services are working on site to attend to the affected passengers," wrote Sánchez, who faces a national election next month. "All my thoughts are with the victims and their families."
paras.zh: “紧急服务部门正在现场处理受影响的乘客，”下个月面临全国大选的桑切斯写道。 “我所有的想法都与受害者及其家人同在。”

paras.en: Spain's King Felipe VI visited the crash site. He and Queen Letizia said in a short statement on X that they were following news of the accident.
paras.zh: 西班牙国王费利佩六世视察了坠机现场。他和莱蒂齐亚王后在 X 上发表的一份简短声明中表示，他们正在关注事故的消息。

paras.en: "We are deeply saddened and concerned by the train accident in Urda (Toledo)," the royal couple said. "We share in the grief of the families and loved ones of those who lost their lives, and we send our heartfelt support to the injured and all those affected."
paras.zh: 这对王室夫妇表示：“我们对乌尔达（托莱多）发生的火车事故深感悲痛和担忧。” “我们对遇难者的家人和亲人感到悲痛，并向伤者和所有受影响的人表示衷心的支持。”

paras.en: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said "My heart goes out to the victims' families and loved ones. Today, Europe mourns with you."
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩表示：“我的心与遇难者家属和亲人同在。今天，欧洲与你们一起哀悼。”

paras.en: Spain's soccer federation postponed all 24 Copa del Rey games scheduled on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 西班牙足协推迟了原定于周三举行的全部 24 场国王杯比赛。

paras.en: Spain already suffered a devastating train crash this year
paras.zh: 西班牙今年已经遭受了毁灭性的火车相撞事故

paras.en: The wreckage of Wednesday's crash reminded many of the aftermath of another train collision in January, when 46 people died in southern Spain when a IRYO train jumped the track and hit an oncoming RENFE train. That sent the first two cars of the impacted train plummeting down a four-meter (13-foot) slope.
paras.zh: 周三事故的残骸让许多人想起一月份另一次火车相撞事故的后果，当时西班牙南部的一列 IRYO 火车冲出铁轨并撞上了迎面驶来的 RENFE 火车，造成 46 人死亡。这导致受影响列车的前两节车厢从 4 米（13 英尺）高的斜坡上垂直坠落。

paras.en: That crash was the deadliest in Spain since a 2013 crash that killed 80 people.
paras.zh: 那次事故是自 2013 年造成 80 人死亡的事故以来西班牙最严重的一次事故。

paras.en: The January incident shook confidence in the European country's extensive high-speed rail service.
paras.zh: 一月份的事件动摇了人们对这个欧洲国家广泛的高铁服务的信心。

paras.en: Over recent decades, Spain has invested heavily in high-speed rail — which the country's railway union defines as rails for trains going 250 kph (155 mph) and over — turning it into a world leader.
paras.zh: 近几十年来，西班牙大力投资高铁——该国铁路联盟将其定义为时速 250 公里（155 英里/小时）及以上的火车轨道——使其成为世界领先者。

paras.en: Spain has laid some 3,900 kilometers (2,400 miles) of such tracks over more than three decades for its 49 million residents. Only China, with 45,000 kilometers (28,000 miles) for its 1.4 billion people, has more high-speed track, according to the International Union of Railways.
paras.zh: 三十多年来，西班牙已为其 4,900 万居民铺设了约 3,900 公里（2,400 英里）的此类轨道。根据国际铁路联盟的数据，只有中国拥有更多的高速铁路，其总里程为 45,000 公里（28,000 英里），拥有 14 亿人口。

paras.en: Only recently did Spain open its rail network to private companies to compete against RENFE. IRYO started operating in Spain in 2022.
paras.zh: 直到最近，西班牙才向私营公司开放其铁路网络，以与 RENFE 竞争。 IRYO 于 2022 年开始在西班牙运营。

paras.en: A spokesperson for Spain's train workers' union, Joan Rodríguez, said that the increased traffic brought by privatization has put extra strain on rail infrastructure.
paras.zh: 西班牙火车工人工会发言人琼·罗德里格斯表示，私有化带来的交通量增加给铁路基础设施带来了额外的压力。

paras.en: "We are not convinced that the liberalization of the high-speed passenger rail service was matched by the necessary upkeep of the lines," Rodríguez told TVE. "I am not saying it was a determining factor (in the crashes), but yes, the increase in use of the network is a factor to keep in mind."
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯告诉 TVE：“我们不相信高速客运铁路服务的自由化会与线路的必要维护相匹配。” “我并不是说这是（崩溃）的决定性因素，但是，网络使用的增加是一个需要牢记的因素。”

articles.title: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
paras.zh: 以色列大选结果势均力敌。而且，埃博拉疫情爆发达到了严峻的里程碑

paras.en: Midterm ad spending has surpassed a record $11 billion, according to Ad Impact. An NPR analysis found that candidates in four major Senate races spent more than $15 million on fundraising ads in the 2025-26 election cycle. Meanwhile, President Trump has been campaigning in tight races across states like Texas, Mississippi, and Kansas.
paras.zh: 根据 Ad Impact 的数据，中期广告支出已超过创纪录的 110 亿美元。 NPR 分析发现，在 2025-26 年选举周期中，四场主要参议院竞选的候选人在筹款广告上花费了超过 1500 万美元。与此同时，特朗普总统一直在德克萨斯州、密西西比州和堪萨斯州等州进行激烈的竞选活动。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump has not been sticking with his standard midterm pitch, which includes touting GOP tax cuts and attacking Democrats, NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben tells Up First. His jokes, including comments about Ohio Sen. Jon Husted's physique, entertain rally crowds but distract from the key issues the median voter cares about, like the economy and gas prices. Midterm turnout is usually low, but the GOP base still supports him, suggesting many MAGA votes are available, Kurtzleben says. But Trump needing to rally votes in very red states indicates a potential problem for his party.
paras.zh: - NPR 的丹妮尔·库茨勒本 (Danielle Kurtzleben) 告诉 Up First，特朗普并没有坚持他的标准中期宣传，其中包括宣传共和党减税和攻击民主党。他的笑话，包括对俄亥俄州参议员乔恩·赫斯特德体格的评论，娱乐了集会人群，但分散了中间选民关心的关键问题的注意力，比如经济和汽油价格。库尔茨莱本说，中期选举投票率通常较低，但共和党基础仍然支持他，这表明有许多“让MAGA”选票可用。但特朗普需要在非常红的州拉票，这表明他的政党存在潜在问题。

paras.en: The election in Israel is too close to call after voters turned out in record numbers to decide whether to keep Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in office or oust him for an alternative. Netanyahu was in a tight race with his top rival Gadi Eisenkot, a center-right former military chief of staff. Final vote tallies may take time, and if no bloc secures a majority, it could take days or weeks for party leaders to form a governing coalition and determine the next prime minister.
paras.zh: 以色列的选举结果势均力敌，投票人数创历史新高，以决定是继续留任总理内塔尼亚胡还是罢免他以寻求替代方案。内塔尼亚胡与他的头号竞争对手、中右翼前军事参谋长加迪·艾森科特展开了激烈的竞争。最终计票结果可能需要时间，如果没有哪个集团获得多数席位，政党领导人可能需要数天或数周的时间才能组建执政联盟并确定下一任总理。

paras.en: - 🎧 Israelis went to bed thinking Eisenkot had the advantage, but by morning, Netanyahu pulled ahead, making the election too close to call, NPR's Daniel Estrin says. Election officials tell NPR that they expect to finish counting votes by tomorrow afternoon. The leading candidate will have six weeks to form a governing coalition, likely competing for support from defectors in each other's camps. Eisenkot could gain the majority of lawmakers' support in parliament, thanks to a strong showing from Arab-led parties eager to see him as prime minister. Eisenkot's camp is hesitant to form a coalition with Arab parties due to mistrust and demonization of Arab political leaders after the Oct. 7, 2023, attacks, Estrin says. He adds that both candidates don't have a clear path to a majority coalition.
paras.zh: - NPR 的丹尼尔·埃斯特林 (Daniel Estrin) 表示，以色列人上床睡觉时认为艾森科特占据优势，但到了早上，内塔尼亚胡领先，使得选举结果势均力敌。选举官员告诉 NPR，他们预计将于明天下午完成计票。领先的候选人将有六周的时间组建执政联盟，可能会争夺彼此阵营中叛逃者的支持。由于阿拉伯领导的政党渴望看到他担任总理，艾森科特可能会在议会中获得大多数议员的支持。埃斯特林表示，由于 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击事件后对阿拉伯政治领导人的不信任和妖魔化，艾森科特阵营对于与阿拉伯政党组建联盟犹豫不决。他补充说，两位候选人都没有明确的通往多数联盟的道路。

paras.en: The Federal Reserve typically combats inflation by raising interest rates. While prices are currently rising faster than average wages, investors don't expect a rate hike at today's meeting.
paras.zh: 美联储通常通过提高利率来对抗通货膨胀。尽管目前物价上涨速度快于平均工资，但投资者预计今天的会议上不会加息。

paras.en: - 🎧 The Labor Department's latest cost-of-living report shows consumer prices rose 3.7% in September compared to last year. NPR's Scott Horsley says that marks a larger annual increase than the previous month. Fed policymakers raised interest rates in September, but investors believe the central bank will remain low-key ahead of Election Day and may increase rates again in December.
paras.zh: - 🎧 劳工部最新生活成本报告显示，9月份消费者价格较去年上涨3.7%。 NPR 的斯科特·霍斯利 (Scott Horsley) 表示，这标志着年度增幅比上个月更大。美联储政策制定者在 9 月份加息，但投资者认为央行将在选举日之前保持低调，并可能在 12 月份再次加息。

paras.en: The Ebola outbreak has surpassed 10,000 people infected since its declaration in May, according to the latest figures from the Democratic Republic of Congo. This outbreak has spread faster than any in history. It is also the largest in geographic scope, spanning from Nigeria to Kenya, and is second in death toll with nearly 5,000 deaths. Around one-third of those who have died have been children.
paras.zh: 根据刚果民主共和国的最新数据，自 5 月份宣布埃博拉疫情爆发以来，感染人数已超过 10,000 人。这次疫情的传播速度比历史上任何一次都要快。它的地理范围也是最大的，从尼日利亚到肯尼亚，死亡人数排名第二，有近 5,000 人死亡。死亡者中约有三分之一是儿童。

paras.en: The results of the 2026 midterm elections will shape the final two years of President Trump's second term and serve as a precursor to the 2028 general election. This month, Morning Edition is reporting from six states that could change the balance of power in Washington.
paras.zh: 2026年中期选举的结果将决定特朗普总统第二任期的最后两年，并成为2028年大选的前兆。本月，《晨报》报道了六个可能改变华盛顿权力平衡的州。

paras.en: With Election Day less than a week away, Morning Edition's Michel Martin went to the Midwest to hear from voters about what is important to them this midterm cycle. In Springfield, Ohio, the Trump administration has conducted an aggressive campaign to deport Haitian residents who have been living legally in the country with Temporary Protected Status. The administration revoked TPS for Haitians during Trump's second term. And in Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed has narrowly won the Democratic Senate nomination, a victory for the party's progressive wing. The swing state is important to both parties, which is why Trump and former President Barack Obama campaigned for their party's Senate candidate over the weekend.
paras.zh: 距离选举日还有不到一周的时间，晨间版的米歇尔·马丁 (Michel Martin) 前往中西部，听取选民的意见，了解本次中期选举对他们来说最重要的事情。在俄亥俄州斯普林菲尔德，特朗普政府开展了一场积极的运动，驱逐在该国合法居住且具有临时保护身份的海地居民。在特朗普第二任期内，政府取消了海地人的 TPS。在密歇根州，阿卜杜勒·赛义德以微弱优势赢得了民主党参议院提名，这是该党进步派的胜利。这个摇摆州对两党都很重要，这就是特朗普和前总统巴拉克·奥巴马周末竞选本党参议员候选人的原因。

paras.en: Hear what voters in these two states had to say:
paras.zh: 听听这两个州的选民怎么说：

paras.en: - 🎧 In Michigan, many voters expressed burnout as they worry about gas prices and healthcare.
paras.zh: - 🎧 在密歇根州，许多选民因担心汽油价格和医疗保健而表示精疲力竭。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump's tariffs are hitting Michigan households harder than any other state because many people depend on cross-border trade. But voters affected said the issue isn't so clear-cut.
paras.zh: - 🎧 特朗普的关税对密歇根州家庭的打击比任何其他州都严重，因为许多人依赖跨境贸易。但受影响的选民表示，这个问题并不那么明确。

paras.en: - 🎧 Winning a statewide office in Michigan without Detroit is challenging, and El-Sayed didn't perform well there in the primary. Some Black Detroiters said they remain skeptical of him.
paras.zh: - 🎧 在没有底特律的情况下赢得密歇根州的全州办公室具有挑战性，埃尔赛义德在初选中表现不佳。一些底特律黑人表示，他们仍然对他持怀疑态度。

paras.en: - 🎧 Some Springfield, Ohio voters said they are voting early because they are angry about the administration's treatment of Haitians.
paras.zh: - 🎧 俄亥俄州斯普林菲尔德的一些选民表示，他们提前投票是因为他们对政府对待海地人的方式感到愤怒。

paras.en: The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中于一处 — 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: As the holidays approach and appointments and commitments begin to pile up, author Caroline Sylge recommends a "say no" retreat — a day dedicated to figuring out which obligations you want to decline in the coming weeks and months. While it may seem unconventional to devote an entire day to saying no, this approach can help create space for what truly matters to you. Sylge shared with Life Kit her suggested schedule for a "say no" retreat:
paras.zh: 随着假期的临近，约会和承诺开始堆积起来，作者卡罗琳·西尔吉（Caroline Sylge）建议进行一次“说不”静修——这一天专门用于弄清楚您在未来几周和几个月内想要拒绝哪些义务。虽然花一整天时间说“不”似乎不合常规，但这种方法可以帮助为对您真正重要的事情创造空间。 Sylge 与 Life Kit 分享了她建议的“说不”静修时间表：

paras.en: - 🙅 As soon as you wake up, list things you want to say no to. Identify the obvious tasks you want to avoid.
paras.zh: - 🙅 当你醒来时，列出你想要拒绝的事情。确定您想要避免的明显任务。

paras.en: - 🙅 Take a break, then return to your retreat space and expand your "say no" list. Review requests, appointments, volunteer work and commitments for the coming days, weeks and months. Note the tasks you want to decline, and why.
paras.zh: - 🙅 休息一下，然后返回您的休息空间并扩大您的“说不”清单。审查未来几天、几周和几个月的请求、约会、志愿者工作和承诺。记下您想要拒绝的任务以及原因。

paras.en: - 🙅 After another break, review your list and start saying no. Start with a small win, like crossing off a demanding task. Next, focus on the tougher rejections that may involve saying no to someone you care about or work with.
paras.zh: - 🙅 再次休息后，检查你的清单并开始说“不”。从一个小小的胜利开始，比如完成一项艰巨的任务。接下来，重点关注更严厉的拒绝，这可能涉及对你关心或共事的人说不。

paras.en: - The latest installment of Sarah J. Maas' A Court of Thorns and Roses came out on Tuesday, prompting thousands of fans to attend midnight release parties at bookstores nationwide.
paras.zh: - 莎拉·J·马斯 (Sarah J. Maas) 的《荆棘与玫瑰法庭》的最新一期于周二出版，促使成千上万的粉丝参加全国书店的午夜发行派对。

paras.en: - A federal judge has temporarily blocked the Trump administration's plans to further change East Potomac Park, the municipal D.C. golf course that the president wants to turn into a championship-level venue.
paras.zh: - 一名联邦法官暂时阻止了特朗普政府进一步改造东波托马克公园的计划，总统希望将东波托马克公园改造成锦标赛级场地。

paras.en: - Harvard astrophysicists have found what they believe is a previously undiscovered dwarf planet in our solar system. (via WGBH)
paras.zh: - 哈佛大学的天体物理学家在我们的太阳系中发现了他们认为以前未被发现的矮行星。 （来自 WGBH）

articles.title: It's official: now avoid credit card interest into 2024

paras.en: If you're on a Galaxy Fold, consider unfolding your phone or viewing it in full screen to best optimize your experience.
paras.zh: 如果您使用的是 Galaxy Fold，请考虑展开手机或全屏查看手机，以最大程度地优化您的体验。

paras.en: If you're carrying credit card debt — or expecting upcoming expenses — interest can make it harder to get ahead.
paras.zh: 如果你背负着信用卡债务——或者预计即将发生的开支——利息可能会让你更难取得成功。

paras.en: The Citi Simplicity® Card gives you a clear window to reset.
paras.zh: Citi Simplicity® 卡为您提供了清晰的重置窗口。

paras.en: With no interest for 18 months on both balance transfers and purchases, you can focus on paying down what you owe or covering new expenses without interest piling up.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均无需支付 18 个月的利息，因此您可以专注于偿还欠款或支付新费用，而不会产生利息累积。

paras.en: 0% intro APR for 18 months on Balance Transfers is one of the longest interest-free periods available today.
paras.zh: 余额转账 18 个月的 0% 年利率是当今最长的免息期之一。

paras.en: Balance Transfers: 0%, 18 months on Balance Transfers
paras.zh: 余额转账：0%，余额转账 18 个月

paras.en: Applicants with a good to excellent credit score (670+) typically have the best odds of approval.
paras.zh: 信用评分良好至优秀（670+）的申请人通常获得批准的几率最高。

paras.en: There is an intro balance transfer fee of 3% of each transfer (minimum $5) completed within the first 4 months of account opening. After that, your fee will be 5% of each transfer (minimum $5)
paras.zh: 开户后 4 个月内完成的每笔转账（最低 5 美元）需缴纳 3% 的介绍性余额转账费。此后，您的费用将为每次转账的 5%（最低 5 美元）

paras.en: That lower 3% intro fee can reduce your upfront cost compared to cards that charge 5% from the start.
paras.zh: 与从一开始就收取 5% 费用的信用卡相比，3% 的较低介绍费可以降低您的前期成本。

paras.en: If you want flexibility — whether that’s paying down debt, managing new expenses, or both — this card gives you a defined window to do it without interest.
paras.zh: 如果您想要灵活性——无论是偿还债务、管理新开支，还是两者兼而有之——这张卡为您提供了一个明确的窗口，让您可以无利息地做到这一点。

paras.en: With 18 months of 0% intro APR on both balance transfers and purchases, you can choose how to use it based on what you need most right now.
paras.zh: 余额转账和购买均可享受 18 个月的 0% 年利率，您可以根据当前最需要的情况选择使用方式。

paras.en: You won’t even pay an annual fee to hold the card, and applying takes just a few minutes from your phone or computer.
paras.zh: 您甚至不需要支付年费来持有该卡，并且只需几分钟即可通过手机或计算机进行申请。

paras.en: But don’t wait too long — we often see 0% intro APR periods get cut without notice, so it’s smart to act while this one’s still available.
paras.zh: 但不要等待太久——我们经常看到 0% 的年利率优惠期在没有通知的情况下被削减，所以趁这个优惠仍然可用时采取行动是明智之举。

paras.en: We're firm believers in the Golden Rule, which is why editorial opinions are ours alone and have not been previously reviewed, approved, or endorsed by included advertisers. Motley Fool Money does not cover all offers on the market. Motley Fool Money is 100% owned and operated by The Motley Fool. Our knowledgeable team of personal finance editors and analysts are employed by The Motley Fool and held to the same set of publishing standards and editorial integrity while maintaining professional separation from the analysts and editors on other Motley Fool brands.
