articles.title: Coalition talks loom in Israel as Netanyahu and Eisenkot blocs set to fall short of majority
articles.author: Julian Borger in Jerusalem

paras.en: Israel’s future hung in the balance on Wednesday as it became clear that Benjamin Netanyahu had lost his governing majority, and his political fate now depends on whether opposition Jewish parties are prepared to forge a common front with Palestinian parties, whose support surged in Tuesday’s elections.
paras.zh: 周三，以色列的未来悬而未决，因为本杰明·内塔尼亚胡显然失去了执政多数，他的政治命运现在取决于反对派犹太政党是否准备与巴勒斯坦政党建立共同战线，巴勒斯坦政党的支持率在周二的选举中激增。

paras.en: The leader of the Jewish opposition bloc, the retired general Gadi Eisenkot, appeared to rule out such a broad coalition in a premature declaration of victory overnight for what he called a “Zionist majority”.
paras.zh: 犹太反对派领导人、退役将军加迪·艾森科特(Gadi Eisenkot)似乎在一夜之间过早地宣布他所谓的“犹太复国主义多数派”取得胜利，从而排除了建立如此广泛联盟的可能性。

paras.en: As the vote count proceeded on Wednesday, initial exit poll projections that Eisenkot’s bloc would have a narrow lead over Netanyahu’s coalition looked increasingly in doubt as the prime minister’s bloc edged ahead, with the votes of deployed soldiers and other absentee ballots (about 14% of the total electorate) yet to be fully counted.
paras.zh: 随着周三计票的进行，最初的出口民意调查预测艾森科特的阵营将以微弱优势领先内塔尼亚胡的联盟，但随着总理阵营的领先，部署士兵的选票和其他缺席选票（约占选民总数的 14%）尚未完全清点，这一预测似乎越来越令人怀疑。

paras.en: With the remaining 86% of the votes tallied, both Jewish blocs looked certain to fall short of the 61 Knesset seats needed for a majority government, leaving Eisenkot and his allies facing a clear choice: either make a pact with Arab Israeli parties heading for a record result of 16-19 seats, or hand Netanyahu a political lifeline in the form of new elections or a unity government.
paras.zh: 计完剩余 86% 的选票后，两个犹太集团看来肯定达不到多数政府所需的 61 个议会席位，这让艾森科特及其盟友面临一个明确的选择：要么与阿拉伯以色列政党达成协议，争取创纪录的 16-19 个席位，要么以新选举或联合政府的形式为内塔尼亚胡提供政治生命线。

paras.en: Donald Trump took credit for Netanyahu’s better than expected performance so far, claiming his overt backing in the run-up to the vote had made the difference. “When the endorsement went out, it helped him a lot,” Trump said, adding that the result appeared to be heading for a stalemate or a Netanyahu win.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普将内塔尼亚胡迄今为止好于预期的表现归功于他，声称他在投票前的公开支持发挥了作用。特朗普说：“当支持结束后，这对他有很大帮助。”他补充说，结果似乎会陷入僵局或内塔尼亚胡获胜。

paras.en: Yair Golan, the leader of the centre-left Democrats, a junior partner in Eisenkot’s Change bloc, urged Eisenkot to negotiate with the two Palestinian parties, the Joint List and Ra’am (the United Arab List).
paras.zh: 中左翼民主党领袖、艾森科特变革集团的初级合伙人亚伊尔·戈兰敦促艾森科特与巴勒斯坦两个政党——联合名单党和阿拉伯名单党——进行谈判。

paras.en: “We have no future here if we don’t stop being afraid. And if we don’t put an end to racism. We can no longer accept Netanyahu’s racist distinction between Jewish and Arab votes,” Golan said in a post on X.
paras.zh: “如果我们不停止恐惧，我们就没有未来。如果我们不结束种族主义。我们不能再接受内塔尼亚胡对犹太人和阿拉伯人选票的种族主义区分，”戈兰在 X 上发帖说。

paras.en: “Anyone who tries to erase the votes of Arab citizens is surrendering to Netanyahu and giving up on Israel,” he added, pointing out that Netanyahu relied on ultra-Orthodox Jewish parties that were non-Zionist and opposed conscription for their constituents.
paras.zh: 他补充说：“任何试图抹去阿拉伯公民选票的人都是向内塔尼亚胡投降，放弃以色列。”他指出，内塔尼亚胡依赖的是非犹太复国主义、反对对其选民征兵的极端正统犹太政党。

paras.en: Noa Landau, a commenter writing in Haaretz, argued that by making Zionism the test for forming a coalition, excluding potential partners, while the prime minister had not, Eisenkot had fallen “into the trap Netanyahu laid for him over the course of the election campaign”.
paras.zh: 《国土报》的评论员诺亚·兰道认为，通过将犹太复国主义作为组建联盟的考验，排除潜在的合作伙伴，而总理却没有这样做，艾森科特“陷入了内塔尼亚胡在竞选过程中为他设下的陷阱”。

paras.en: The Joint List leader, Yousef Jabareen, said its strong performance meant it “can’t be ignored under any political scenario”. He said Netanyahu’s government, especially its extremist national security minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir, “has made life bitter for every Arab citizen”.
paras.zh: 联合名单领导人尤瑟夫·贾巴林 (Yousef Jabareen) 表示，其强劲表现意味着“在任何政治情况下都不能被忽视”。他说，内塔尼亚胡政府，特别是极端主义国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本格维尔，“让每个阿拉伯公民的生活变得痛苦”。

paras.en: “We will be ready to pave the way to oust the government of Netanyahu, Ben-Gvir and Smotrich – and send them home,” Jabareen said. Another Joint List official described the choice facing the Jewish opposition as “supremacy or building democracy”.
paras.zh: 贾巴林说：“我们将做好准备，为推翻内塔尼亚胡、本格维尔和斯莫特里奇政府铺平道路，并将他们送回国。”另一位联合名单官员将犹太反对派面临的选择描述为“至高无上或建设民主”。

paras.en: Counting all the votes could take another few days, with absentee ballots the last to be tallied. Most of those are from deployed soldiers. The army vote usually swings right, but that broad picture may be complicated by the fact that a lot of older, more moderate reservists are now on active duty.
paras.zh: 统计所有选票可能还需要几天时间，缺席选票是最后统计的。其中大部分来自已部署的士兵。军队的投票通常会向右倾斜，但由于许多年龄较大、较为温和的预备役军人现在正在服役，这一总体情况可能会变得复杂。

paras.en: Once all the votes are accounted for, it will be up to Israel’s president, Isaac Herzog, to give one of the party leaders six weeks to form a government. If the first choice fails, the opportunity passes to his rival. In the weeks of political wrangling likely to ensue, both Netanyahu and Eisenkot are expected to lure defectors from each other’s camps.
paras.zh: 一旦计算完所有选票，以色列总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格将给予其中一位党派领导人六周的时间组建政府。如果第一个选择失败，机会就会传递给他的对手。在可能随之而来的数周政治角力中，预计内塔尼亚胡和艾森科特都会从对方阵营中引诱叛逃者。

paras.en: Netanyahu would remain in office in a caretaker capacity until a new majority is formed. He might expect to benefit if the deadlock leads to another round of elections. Tens of thousands of diaspora Israelis who returned to vote on Tuesday, and were mostly opposed to the governing coalition, might not return for another vote, for example.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡将以看守身份继续留任，直至形成新的多数派。如果僵局导致另一轮选举，他可能会受益。例如，周二返回投票的数万名散居以色列人，他们大多反对执政联盟，可能不会再回来投票。

paras.en: The Palestinian parties and Jewish centre-left have been urging the opposition to focus on finding common cause in the Knesset, replacing the speaker and pursuing legislation that the factions can agree on, such as ordering an independent review into the security failures that led to the 7 October attack by Hamas in 2023.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦政党和犹太中左翼一直敦促反对派集中精力在议会中寻找共同目标，更换议长，并寻求各派能够达成一致的立法，例如下令对导致 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯袭击的安全失误进行独立审查。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Herzog urged all parties to keep an “open mind” in trying to build a new government coalition.
paras.zh: 周三，赫尔佐格敦促各方在试图建立新政府联盟时保持“开放态度”。

paras.en: “We must do everything we can, certainly after yesterday, to avoid another round of elections,” he said.
paras.zh: “我们必须尽一切努力，尤其是在昨天之后，以避免另一轮选举，”他说。

paras.en: The election happened in the midst of Israel’s war in Gaza – barely mentioned in the course of the campaign, despite the fact that Israel has been accused of committing genocide in Gaza and ethnic cleansing in the West Bank, and Netanyahu is wanted by the international criminal court for alleged war crimes.
paras.zh: 这次选举发生在以色列加沙战争期间——尽管以色列被指控在加沙实施种族灭绝和在约旦河西岸实施种族清洗，而且内塔尼亚胡因涉嫌战争罪而被国际刑事法院通缉，但在竞选过程中几乎没有提及。

paras.en: A UN commission of human rights experts reported on Monday that Israel had continued to commit genocidal acts against Palestinian civilians in Gaza after a ceasefire was declared in October 2025. Since then 1,431 Palestinians have been killed by the Israeli military, including 300 children.
paras.zh: 联合国人权专家委员会周一报告称，2025年10月宣布停火后，以色列继续对加沙的巴勒斯坦平民实施种族灭绝行为。自那时以来，已有1,431名巴勒斯坦人被以色列军队杀害，其中包括300名儿童。

paras.en: The report, by the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, said: “Israeli authorities and forces continue to commit genocidal acts with the genocidal intent to destroy, in whole or in part, the Palestinians in Gaza.”
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦被占领土独立国际调查委员会的报告称：“以色列当局和军队继续实施种族灭绝行为，其种族灭绝意图是全部或部分消灭加沙的巴勒斯坦人。”

paras.en: Israel’s ambassador to the UN, Daniel Meron, rejected the report as an “attempt to destroy the Jewish state” and “to undermine Israel’s legitimacy and deny its fundamental right to exist and defend itself”.
paras.zh: 以色列驻联合国大使丹尼尔·梅龙拒绝接受该报告，称其“企图摧毁犹太国家”并“破坏以色列的合法性并否认其生存和保卫自己的基本权利”。

paras.en: Eisenkot and much of his bloc support the war in Gaza, and sought to make the election a referendum on Netanyahu. The turnout was nearly 78%, the highest since 1999, with marked increases in the number of serving military members voting.
paras.zh: 艾森科特和他的大部分集团支持加沙战争，并试图使这次选举成为对内塔尼亚胡的全民公投。投票率接近78%，为1999年以来最高，现役军人投票人数显着增加。

paras.en: Political deadlock has led to repeated votes in the past. Between 2019 and 2022, Israel held five elections.
paras.zh: 政治僵局过去曾导致多次投票。 2019年至2022年间，以色列举行了五次选举。

paras.en: Netanyahu is Israel’s longest-serving prime minister, governing for 19 of the past 30 years, and its most tenacious political survivor. Entangled in a long-running corruption trial, he and his far-right coalition had stoked xenophobic fears and suggested Israel would be vulnerable to a nuclear attack without him.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡是以色列任期最长的总理，在过去 30 年中执政了 19 年，也是以色列最顽强的政治幸存者。他和他的极右翼联盟卷入了一场长期的腐败审判，引发了仇外恐惧，并暗示如果没有他，以色列将很容易遭受核攻击。

paras.en: The campaign, febrile even by Israeli standards, included Netanyahu posting a picture of a nuclear explosion devastating Tel Aviv on the eve of the polls opening.
paras.zh: 即使按照以色列的标准，这次竞选活动也很激烈，其中包括内塔尼亚胡在投票开始前夕发布了一张核爆炸摧毁特拉维夫的照片。

paras.en: Since the deadly attack launched by Hamas on Israel’s southern communities on 7 October 2023, Israel has devastated Gaza and killed more than 74,000 Palestinians, fought Hezbollah in Lebanon, occupied new territory in Syria and launched a war with the US against Iran.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯对以色列南部社区发动致命袭击以来，以色列摧毁了加沙，杀害了 74,000 多名巴勒斯坦人，在黎巴嫩与真主党作战，占领了叙利亚新领土，并与美国发动了针对伊朗的战争。

articles.title: ‘It all happened in a split-second’: survivors recount details of Spain’s second deadly train crash in 10 months
articles.author: Sam Jones in Urda

paras.en: Josimar Medina woke a little before 9am on Wednesday to find himself airborne and hurtling through his carriage on the fast train from Madrid to Seville.
paras.zh: 周三上午 9 点左右，乔西马尔·梅迪纳 (Josimar Medina) 醒来，发现自己在从马德里开往塞维利亚的高速列车上飞驰而过。

paras.en: “I remember flying through the air and looking for my girlfriend, who was also shooting through the air,” said Medina, a 37-year-old tourist from the northern Peruvian city of Chiclayo.
paras.zh: “我记得我在空中飞行并寻找我的女朋友，她也在空中射击，”来自秘鲁北部城市奇克拉约的 37 岁游客梅迪纳说。

paras.en: Once he landed, he looked around and realised just how lucky he and his girlfriend, Vitoria Maia, had been.
paras.zh: 着陆后，他环顾四周，意识到自己和女友维多利亚·玛亚 (Vitoria Maia) 是多么幸运。

paras.en: “I saw people with cuts, people covered in blood, people missing limbs, and I saw one person who had nothing left below the chest,” said Medina. “I saw people with their heads crushed and people with mutilated arms.”
paras.zh: 梅迪纳说：“我看到有人身上有伤口，有人浑身是血，有人失去四肢，我还看到一个人胸部以下什么都没有留下。” “我看到人们的头被压碎了，人们的手臂也被肢解了。”

paras.en: The Peruvian stood recounting the details of Wednesday’s deadly rail crash, in which at least 68 people were killed and dozens more were injured, wearing a light brown T-shirt stained with the blood of a young American man he had helped move to safety.
paras.zh: 这位秘鲁人站在那里讲述了周三致命的铁路事故的细节，这场事故造成至少 68 人死亡，数十人受伤，他穿着一件浅棕色 T 恤，上面沾满了他帮助转移到安全地带的一名美国年轻人的血迹。

paras.en: Medina and Maia had been in the seventh carriage of the state-operated Renfe train that smashed into the back of a train run by the private Iryo company on the same line from the capital to the south of Spain. Had they been any further forward, they could well have been among the accident’s fatalities.
paras.zh: 梅迪纳和玛雅乘坐的是国营 Renfe 火车的第七节车厢，该火车与私人 Iryo 公司运营的火车尾部相撞，该火车是从首都开往西班牙南部的同一条线路。如果他们再进一步的话，他们很可能就是事故的死者之一。

paras.en: As it was, the couple climbed out of the train and helped the injured while they waited for medics and Guardia Civil officers to arrive at the scene of the crash, which took place amid vineyards and olive groves near the small town of Urda in the central region of Castilla-La Mancha, near the city of Toledo.
paras.zh: 事实上，这对夫妇爬出火车并帮助伤者，同时等待医务人员和国民警卫队官员到达事故现场。事故发生在卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰中部地区乌尔达小镇附近的葡萄园和橄榄树林中，靠近托莱多市。

paras.en: Within hours of the crash, Urda had been transformed into a frantic emergency response centre, with a local sports centre pressed into service as a triage post for the walking wounded. Cars, vans and trucks from the emergency services in Castilla-La Mancha and neighbouring Madrid crowded the streets.
paras.zh: 事故发生后几个小时内，乌尔达就变成了一个疯狂的应急中心，当地的一个体育中心被迫作为步行伤员的分诊站。卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰和邻近马德里紧急服务部门的小汽车、货车和卡车挤满了街道。

paras.en: Fredrich and Arabella Barilea, a couple from the Philippines who now live in Dubai, were on the Iryo train, and Fredrich was sent flying by the impact.
paras.zh: 弗雷德里克和阿拉贝拉·巴里利亚是一对来自菲律宾、现居住在迪拜的夫妇，他们乘坐的是 Iryo 列车，弗雷德里克因撞击而飞了起来。

paras.en: “One guy was shouting, ‘Get out! Get out! Another train could hit!” said Fredrich. “We saw all the people were also getting off. Many of them had head injuries and were covered in blood. We just got as far away from the train as we could.”
paras.zh: “一个人喊道：‘滚出去！滚出去！另一列火车可能会撞上！’”弗雷德里希说。 “我们看到所有人都下车了。其中许多人头部受伤，浑身是血。我们只是尽可能远离火车。”

paras.en: Eventually, buses arrived to ferry the lightly injured survivors to Urda – although the Barileas said they were too shocked and confused to know where exactly they had been brought.
paras.zh: 最终，巴士抵达，将轻伤的幸存者送往乌尔达——尽管巴里利亚夫妇表示，他们太震惊和困惑，不知道他们到底被带到了哪里。

paras.en: “It all happened in a split second,” said Arabella. “The table we were sitting at just disappeared in the crash. I feel like we’re on our second life. You never know what could happen. We’re very grateful.”
paras.zh: “这一切都发生在一瞬间，”阿拉贝拉说。 “我们坐的桌子在车祸中消失了。我感觉我们已经有了第二次生命。你永远不知道会发生什么。我们非常感激。”

paras.en: Around the couple, people queued patiently on the street as they waited to board coaches. Wearing torn and bloodstained clothes and, in some cases, bandages on their heads, they stared, mute and uncomprehending. Spain may have been in mourning, as the prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, said during his visit to Urda, but many of those fortunate enough to survive Spain’s second fatal rail crash in less than a year were still too deep in shock to begin grieving.
paras.zh: 在这对夫妇周围，人们在街上耐心地排队等待上车。他们穿着破烂、血迹斑斑的衣服，有时头上还缠着绷带，他们盯着看，沉默不语，不理解。正如西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯在访问乌尔达时所说，西班牙可能一直在哀悼，但许多幸运地在西班牙不到一年的第二次致命铁路事故中幸存下来的人仍然处于震惊之中，无法开始悲伤。

paras.en: Ata Yelkaya, a young tourist from Turkey, usually takes the bus when he travels around Spain. On Wednesday, however, he had decided to try the Iryo. Sleepy and assuming his train had come to a halt at a station, he had switched off his tablet and pulled up his hood in preparation for a nap. At 8.53am, he felt what he would later learn was the impact of the Renfe train smashing into the carriages behind him.
paras.zh: 来自土耳其的年轻游客阿塔·耶尔卡亚 (Ata Yelkaya) 在西班牙旅游时通常乘坐公交车。然而周三，他决定尝试一下 Iryo。由于困倦，他以为自己的火车已经停在车站了，于是关掉了平板电脑，拉起引擎盖准备小睡。上午8点53分，他感觉到他后来了解到的是Renfe火车撞上了他身后车厢的冲击力。

paras.en: “I woke up with a bump and hit my head on the seat in front of me,” he said, “I looked across at an elderly couple near me and saw that the woman had a cut in her eyebrow. That’s when I knew something serious had happened.”
paras.zh: “我醒来时感到一阵颠簸，头撞到了前面的座位上，”他说，“我看了看旁边的一对老年夫妇，发现那位女士的眉毛被割伤了。那时我就知道发生了严重的事情。”

paras.en: When he looked out of the window, he saw the carriages behind his – carriage No 5 – had come off the track and that many people had been killed or injured.
paras.zh: 当他向窗外望去时，他看到后面的车厢——5号车厢——已经脱轨，许多人死伤。

paras.en: “Everyone was in shock but I tried to help other people get off the train,” he said. “I’m from Turkey and I lived through the 2023 earthquake there, so I stayed calm and tried to think about what to do and how to get out. It was only when I got out and saw some of the dead people that it hit me. I think everyone was in shock; too shocked even to panic or to scream.”
paras.zh: “每个人都感到震惊，但我试图帮助其他人下车，”他说。 “我来自土耳其，经历了 2023 年的地震，所以我保持冷静，试图思考该怎么做以及如何逃生。只有当我出去看到一些死者时，我才感到震惊。我想每个人都感到震惊；太震惊了，甚至没有惊慌或尖叫。”

paras.en: Wednesday’s disaster stirs memories of the Adamuz rail crash in January, in which 46 people died. Once again, a small town has found itself at the centre of a national disaster and, once again, local people have rallied to help, bringing food and water to a local hall that had been set up as a centre for those searching for their relatives.
paras.zh: 周三的灾难唤起了人们对 1 月份阿达穆斯铁路事故的记忆，那次事故造成 46 人死亡。一个小镇再次陷入全国性灾难的中心，当地人再次团结起来提供帮助，将食物和水送到当地的一个大厅，该大厅是为寻找亲人而设立的中心。

paras.en: But, as also happened at Adamuz, the solidarity and kindness on display is likely to turn to anger over the coming hours as people seek answers as to how one of Europe’s most modern and extensive high-speed rail networks could experience two deadly accidents that have between them claimed at least 114 lives in the space of just 10 months. With a snap general election just a month away, many voters could use their votes to register their fury over another rail disaster. The “inexplicable circumstances” that led to the crash – as Spain’s transport minister has called them – will need to be explained as swiftly thoroughly as possible.
paras.zh: 但是，正如阿达穆兹事件所发生的那样，在接下来的几个小时里，人们所表现出的团结和善意可能会变成愤怒，因为人们正在寻求答案，以了解欧洲最现代化、最广泛的高铁网络之一如何会发生两起致命事故，这两起事故在短短 10 个月的时间里夺去了至少 114 人的生命。距离提前大选仅剩一个月，许多选民可以用自己的选票来表达对另一场铁路灾难的愤怒。正如西班牙交通部长所说，导致坠机的“无法解释的情况”需要尽快得到彻底解释。

paras.en: For all the rush to action and unity on display, there was also a sickening sense of deja vu. One local woman from Urda, who had spent the morning driving people to town from the crash site, had few words to describe what she had seen and heard.
paras.zh: 尽管表现出匆忙的行动和团结，但也有一种令人作呕的似曾相识的感觉。一位来自乌尔达的当地妇女花了一上午的时间开车送人们从坠机地点到镇上，她几乎无法用言语来描述她的所见所闻。

paras.en: “Mejor no verlo,” she said – “it’s better not to see something like this”. Again.
paras.zh: “Mejor no verlo，”她说，“最好不要看到这样的事情”。再次。

articles.title: Death toll rises to 68 with dozens injured after high-speed train collision in Spain – latest updates
articles.author: Nadeem Badshah (now) and Jakub Krupa (earlier)

paras.en: At least 68 people have been killed after two passenger trains collided in Toledro province in central Spain, and the death toll may rise further.
paras.zh: 西班牙中部托莱德罗省两列旅客列车相撞事故已造成至少68人死亡，死亡人数可能进一步上升。

paras.en: A similar number of people remain hospitalised, including 15 in serious or critical state (15:44).
paras.zh: 类似数量的人仍在医院接受治疗，其中 15 人处于严重或危急状态 (15:44)。

paras.en: The two trains with 544 people on board in total (10:46) were travelling in the same direction on the high-speed line from the Spanish capital, Madrid, to Seville in the south-west of the country.
paras.zh: 两列共载有544人的列车（10时46分）在从西班牙首都马德里开往该国西南部塞维利亚的高铁线路上同向行驶。

paras.en: Video footage from the scene showed extensive damage to both trains (12:23, 13:52).
paras.zh: 现场视频显示两列火车均遭到严重损坏（12:23、13:52）。

paras.en: Spain’s prime minister Pedro Sánchez said the country was “in mourning” as he insisted the government will get to the bottom of incident and address potential failures with “utmost firmness” (15:49).
paras.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯表示，该国正在“哀悼”，他坚称政府将查明事件真相，并以“最坚定的态度”解决潜在的失败问题 (15:49)。

paras.en: Transport minister Óscar Puente said initial review of the evidence pointed to an “inexplicable” decision to order trains to go ahead after a signalling failure (15:01), implying a human error.
paras.zh: 交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特 (Óscar Puente) 表示，对证据的初步审查表明，在信号故障（15:01）后命令火车继续行驶的决定是“莫名其妙”的，这意味着人为错误。

paras.en: The investigation is likely to focus on 17 minutes between the trains were halted and the crash.
paras.zh: 调查可能集中在列车停止运行和事故发生之间的 17 分钟内。

paras.en: Spanish media reported that the controller responsible was questioned by investigators this afternoon (16:40).
paras.zh: 西班牙媒体报道称，责任人今天下午（16点40分）接受了调查人员的询问。

paras.en: Today’s collision is the second high-profile train crash in Spain this year (11:00), and the third deadliest incident on its railway in the last 50 years (12:55).
paras.zh: 今天的事故是西班牙今年发生的第二起备受瞩目的火车事故（11:00），也是该国铁路过去 50 年来第三次最严重的事故（12:55）。

paras.en: Spain is expected to declare three days of mourning later today (15:54).
paras.zh: 预计西​​班牙将于今天晚些时候（15:54）宣布三天哀悼。

paras.en: Both main parties suspended their campaigning activities ahead of next month’s parliamentary election, but the far-right Vox party continued with its rallies (12:11).
paras.zh: 两个主要政党在下个月的议会选举之前暂停了竞选活动，但极右翼的 Vox 党继续举行集会 (12:11)。

paras.en: A total of 36 people who were traveling on the trains involved in the Toledo train crash received medical attention at Atocha station, El Pais reported.
paras.zh: 据《国家报》报道，托莱多火车事故中共有 36 名乘客在阿托查车站接受了医疗救治。

paras.en: At the same location, around 40 relatives of those affected by the accident also received mental health support.
paras.zh: 在同一地点，大约 40 名受事故影响的亲属也获得了心理健康支持。

paras.en: There are no more injured people requiring medical attention at the site of the accident involving the AVE high-speed train and the Iryo train, sources told El Pais.
paras.zh: 消息人士告诉《国家报》，AVE高速列车和Iryo列车事故现场没有更多受伤人员需要医疗救治。

paras.en: Minister's comments show attempt to get ahead of growing anger over rail infrastructure - snap analysis
paras.zh: 部长的评论显示，他试图阻止人们对铁路基础设施日益增长的愤怒——快速分析

paras.en: The speed with which Spain’s transport minister has laid out the broad circumstances of the crash appears unusually fast for the aftermath of an accident, where politicians and industry leaders are anxious not to pre-empt investigations.
paras.zh: 西班牙交通部长阐述事故大致情况的速度对于事故发生后的情况来说显得异常快，政界人士和行业领袖都急于不要抢先进行调查。

paras.en: That may be due to the scale of the crash and the nature of the findings – but also owe much to the growing anger and concern about the state of the nation’s railway infrastructure. And perhaps a desire to demonstrate that, for this second horrific crash this year on the Madrid-Seville line, the circumstances were apparently very different.
paras.zh: 这可能是由于事故的规模和调查结果的性质所致，但也很大程度上归因于人们对国家铁路基础设施状况日益增长的愤怒和担忧。也许是想证明，今年在马德里-塞维利亚线上发生的第二起可怕的车祸，情况显然非常不同。

paras.en: Although the official investigation is yet to come, Óscar Puente has pointed towards human error as the predominant cause (15:01) – an “inexplicable decision” to tell trains to continue operations when the outage of the signalling system had brought services to a standstill.
paras.zh: 尽管官方调查尚未到来，但奥斯卡·普恩特指出人为错误是主要原因（15:01）——当信号系统中断导致服务陷入停顿时，告诉火车继续运行是一个“莫名其妙的决定”。

paras.en: That makes the crash – on one level – move from the narrative where the trains are literally coming off the rails, and the country metaphorically so, as elections approach.
paras.zh: 在某种程度上，这使得这次事故不再是火车脱轨的叙述，随着选举的临近，国家也隐喻地脱轨了。

paras.en: But questions will remain. The recent collision in Bedford in Britain was similar in its rarity: a train likewise hit the back of another stopped on the same line, albeit at a lower speed and with only one fatality. That crash continues to be investigated, but first findings show that while human error may have been the biggest cause, it arose from a set of unusual circumstances and a technical failure in the automated warning system which has yet to be fully explained.
paras.zh: 但问题仍然存在。最近在英国贝德福德发生的相撞事故也同样罕见：一列火车同样撞上了停在同一条线路上的另一列火车的车尾，尽管速度较低，而且只有一人死亡。该事故仍在调查中，但初步调查结果显示，虽然人为错误可能是最大的原因，但它是由一系列异常情况和自动预警系统的技术故障引起的，而该故障尚未得到充分解释。

paras.en: Spain has identified individual culprits in past disasters: prosecuting the train driver who sped recklessly round a corner in 2013 in Galicia, killing 79 people. Police are apparently questioning the line controller today.
paras.zh: 西班牙已经查明了过去灾难中的个人罪魁祸首：起诉了 2013 年加利西亚在拐角处鲁莽超速行驶并造成 79 人死亡的火车司机。警方今天显然正在询问线路管制员。

paras.en: But the public will want to know what led to the initial outage of a signalling system that was due to be phased out – and what circumstances or daily experience could have pressed someone to urge the trains to continue regardless, however tragically wrong that decision proved to be.
paras.zh: 但公众想知道是什么导致了本应逐步淘汰的信号系统最初的中断，以及什么情况或日常经验可能迫使某人敦促列车继续运行，无论这一决定被证明是多么错误。

paras.en: At least 68 people have been killed after two passenger trains collided in Toledro province in central Spain, and the death toll may rise further.
paras.zh: 西班牙中部托莱德罗省两列旅客列车相撞事故已造成至少68人死亡，死亡人数可能进一步上升。

paras.en: A similar number of people remain hospitalised, including 15 in serious or critical state (15:44).
paras.zh: 类似数量的人仍在医院接受治疗，其中 15 人处于严重或危急状态 (15:44)。

paras.en: The two trains with 544 people on board in total (10:46) were travelling in the same direction on the high-speed line from the Spanish capital, Madrid, to Seville in the south-west of the country.
paras.zh: 两列共载有544人的列车（10时46分）在从西班牙首都马德里开往该国西南部塞维利亚的高铁线路上同向行驶。

paras.en: Video footage from the scene showed extensive damage to both trains (12:23, 13:52).
paras.zh: 现场视频显示两列火车均遭到严重损坏（12:23、13:52）。

paras.en: Spain’s prime minister Pedro Sánchez said the country was “in mourning” as he insisted the government will get to the bottom of incident and address potential failures with “utmost firmness” (15:49).
paras.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯表示，该国正在“哀悼”，他坚称政府将查明事件真相，并以“最坚定的态度”解决潜在的失败问题 (15:49)。

paras.en: Transport minister Óscar Puente said initial review of the evidence pointed to an “inexplicable” decision to order trains to go ahead after a signalling failure (15:01), implying a human error.
paras.zh: 交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特 (Óscar Puente) 表示，对证据的初步审查表明，在信号故障（15:01）后命令火车继续行驶的决定是“莫名其妙”的，这意味着人为错误。

paras.en: The investigation is likely to focus on 17 minutes between the trains were halted and the crash.
paras.zh: 调查可能集中在列车停止运行和事故发生之间的 17 分钟内。

paras.en: Spanish media reported that the controller responsible was questioned by investigators this afternoon (16:40).
paras.zh: 西班牙媒体报道称，责任人今天下午（16点40分）接受了调查人员的询问。

paras.en: Today’s collision is the second high-profile train crash in Spain this year (11:00), and the third deadliest incident on its railway in the last 50 years (12:55).
paras.zh: 今天的事故是西班牙今年发生的第二起备受瞩目的火车事故（11:00），也是该国铁路过去 50 年来第三次最严重的事故（12:55）。

paras.en: Spain is expected to declare three days of mourning later today (15:54).
paras.zh: 预计西​​班牙将于今天晚些时候（15:54）宣布三天哀悼。

paras.en: Both main parties suspended their campaigning activities ahead of next month’s parliamentary election, but the far-right Vox party continued with its rallies (12:11).
paras.zh: 两个主要政党在下个月的议会选举之前暂停了竞选活动，但极右翼的 Vox 党继续举行集会 (12:11)。

paras.en: Their inquiries are part of an investigation opened by Spain’s railway accident investigation commission, CIAF, Europa press said.
paras.zh: 据 Europa Press 报道，他们的调查是西班牙铁路事故调查委员会 CIAF 展开的调查的一部分。

paras.en: Earlier today, Spain’s transport minister Óscar Puente pointed to an “inexplicable” call to resume traffic at full speed after a signalling failure, implying a potential human error behind the crash (15:01).
paras.zh: 今天早些时候，西班牙交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特 (Óscar Puente) 指出，在信号故障后，出现了“莫名其妙”的要求全速恢复交通的呼吁，暗示事故背后可能存在人为错误 (15:01)。

paras.en: Spain 'will be rightfully asking questions,' opposition leader says, as he calls for investigation, review of rail infrastructure
paras.zh: 反对派领导人表示，西班牙“将正确提出问题”，并呼吁对铁路基础设施进行调查和审查

paras.en: In the last few minutes, the opposition People’s party (PP)‘s leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo responded to the incident near Urda.
paras.zh: 在最后几分钟，反对党人民党（PP）领导人阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍（Alberto Núñez Feijóo）对乌尔达附近的事件做出了回应。

paras.en: In a sombre speech, Feijóo expressed his solidarity with all affected and their families, and thanked emergency services for their response.
paras.zh: 费乔在一次严肃的讲话中表达了他对所有受影响者及其家人的声援，并感谢紧急服务部门的反应。

paras.en: But he said that “our grief does not compel us to remain silent,” as he said the Spanish people will be “rightfully asking questions – and they deserve answers.”
paras.zh: 但他表示，“我们的悲痛并不迫使我们保持沉默”，因为他说西班牙人民将“正确地提出问题——他们应该得到答案。”

paras.en: He called for an immediate government investigation and a judicial inquiry into the crash, “utilising all available resources and free from interference.”
paras.zh: 他呼吁政府立即对坠机事件进行调查和司法调查，“利用一切可用资源，不受干扰”。

paras.en: He also demanded a response to growing concerns about the state of infrastructure, as he called for “a comprehensive, independent review of the entire railway network.”
paras.zh: 他还要求对基础设施状况日益增长的担忧做出回应，并呼吁“对整个铁路网络进行全面、独立的审查”。

paras.en: “This can no longer be delayed; the public has a right to full accountability for every euro.”
paras.zh: “这不能再拖延了；公众有权对每一欧元承担全部责任。”

paras.en: He also confirmed that his party has for now suspended all campaigning events ahead of next month’s parliamentary election as a sign of respect for the victims and their families (unlike the far-right Vox party).
paras.zh: 他还证实，他的政党目前已暂停下个月议会选举前的所有竞选活动，以表达对受害者及其家人的尊重（与极右翼 Vox 党不同）。

articles.title: What we know so far about deadly Spain train crash

paras.en: Two trains have collided in Spain just south of the capital Madrid on Wednesday morning.
paras.zh: 周三早上，西班牙首都马德里以南的两列火车相撞。

paras.en: Rail operator Adif says the incident occurred between a Renfe train and another of the Iryo company, which covers the Madrid to Seville route.
paras.zh: 铁路运营商阿迪夫表示，这起事件发生在西班牙国家铁路公司 (Renfe) 的一列火车和 Iryo 公司的另一列火车之间，该公司覆盖马德里至塞维利亚的路线。

paras.en: So far at least 68 people are confirmed to have died in the incident.
paras.zh: 截至目前，已确认至少68人在该事件中死亡。

paras.en: Here is what we know about the crash so far.
paras.zh: 以下是迄今为止我们对此次事故的了解。

paras.en: The two trains collided just after 09:00 (08:00 GMT) between municipalities Mora and Orgaz, and about 140km (100 miles) south of Madrid.
paras.zh: 两列火车于 09:00（格林威治标准时间 08:00）刚过，在马德里以南约 140 公里（100 英里）处的莫拉市和奥尔加斯市之间相撞。

paras.en: The accident happened when a high-speed train travelling from Madrid to the south of the country collided with another train that was apparently stationary. The crash caused at least two carriages to fall down an embankment.
paras.zh: 事故发生时，一列从马德里开往该国南部的高速列车与另一列显然静止的列车相撞。事故导致至少两辆马车坠落路堤。

paras.en: Broadcaster RTVE, quoting the transport ministry, said a Renfe train rear-ended an Iryo train.
paras.zh: RTVE广播公司援引交通运输部的话称，一辆Renfe列车追尾了一辆Iryo列车。

paras.en: Renfe is Spain's national state-owned railway company while Iryo is a private high-speed railway operator.
paras.zh: Renfe 是西班牙国家国有铁路公司，Iryo 是一家私营高速铁路运营商。

paras.en: All train traffic on this line has been stopped at stations along the route, Adif said.
paras.zh: 阿迪夫说，该线路上的所有火车交通均已在沿线车站停止。

paras.en: Renfe said services between Madrid, Ciudad Real and Andalusia remain suspended.
paras.zh: Renfe表示，马德里、雷阿尔城和安达卢西亚之间的服务仍然暂停。

paras.en: A passenger on board one of the trains told local media there was a heavy impact about 40 minutes into the journey.
paras.zh: 其中一列火车上的一名乘客告诉当地媒体，行程大约 40 分钟后发生了严重撞击。

paras.en: Iryo said its train was "struck from behind" by a Renfe train "due to causes that are still unknown.
paras.zh: Iryo表示，其列车被Renfe列车“从后面撞上”，“原因尚不清楚”。

paras.en: Transport minister Oscar Puente has said a computer failure led to the initial halt of six moving trains, including the two trains that subsequently collided.
paras.zh: 交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特表示，计算机故障导致六列行驶中的火车最初停止运行，其中包括随后相撞的两列火车。

paras.en: "In the event of a system failure, the control centre takes over," he said, adding it was the control centre which decided to allow the trains to move again, without any speed restrictions.
paras.zh: 他说：“如果系统出现故障，控制中心就会接管。”他补充说，是控制中心决定允许列车再次行驶，且不限速。

paras.en: That decision, Puente said, was made "under inexplicable circumstances". It resulted in the Renfe train crashing into the Iryo train, which was stationary on the tracks further ahead.
paras.zh: 普恩特说，这一决定是“在无法解释的情况下”做出的。结果，Renfe 列车撞上了停在前方铁轨上的 Iryo 列车。

paras.en: More than 500 people were believed to be on board both trains.
paras.zh: 据信两列火车上都有超过 500 人。

paras.en: Esther Padilla, spokesperson for the government of Castilla-La Mancha region, told TVE that one of the trains - managed by the Iryo company - was carrying 146 passengers plus one baby, while the Renfe-managed train had 397 passengers on board.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚-拉曼恰地区政府发言人 Esther Padilla 告诉 TVE，其中一列由 Iryo 公司管理的火车载有 146 名乘客和一名婴儿，而 Renfe 管理的火车上载有 397 名乘客。

paras.en: A former government minister was also among those reported missing.
paras.zh: 据报道失踪者中还包括一名前政府部长。

paras.en: The Spanish Confederation of Business Organizations (CEOE) posted on X that, FÃ¡tima BÃ¡Ã±ez - who heads the organization's foundation - was on board one of the trains involved in the crash.
paras.zh: 西班牙商业组织联合会 (CEOE) 在 X 上发布消息称，该组织基金会负责人法蒂玛·巴尼亚斯 (Fátima Báñez) 就在参与事故的一列火车上。

paras.en: The Castilla La Mancha regional government said 64 people are now confirmed to have died.
paras.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚拉曼恰地区政府表示，目前已确认有 64 人死亡。

paras.en: Speaking separately to Spanish media, he warned the death toll could increase further.
paras.zh: 他单独向西班牙媒体发表讲话，警告死亡人数可能会进一步增加。

paras.en: Eighty people are being treated for injuries, according to authorities, with 50 of the casualties said to be in a serious condition, and 15 more in a critical condition.
paras.zh: 据当局称，80 人正在接受治疗，其中 50 人伤势严重，另有 15 人情况危急。

paras.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro SÃ¡nchez has said "the whole of Spain is grieving" and that "lives have been shattered, families have been torn apart".
paras.zh: 西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯表示，“整个西班牙都在悲伤”，“生活支离破碎，家庭支离破碎”。

paras.en: "The pain is immense," he said on a visit to the crash site.
paras.zh: “痛苦是巨大的，”他在参观坠机现场时说道。

paras.en: The government was "trying to determine what was the origin of this tragedy, of this terrible accident," he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，政府正在“试图确定这场悲剧、这场可怕事故的根源是什么”。

paras.en: "We will get to the bottom of this, and if there has been any negligence, it will come to light.
paras.zh: “我们会追查到底，如果有任何疏忽，就会被揭露。

paras.en: "If there have been failures in the security system, they will be addressed with the utmost firmness."
paras.zh: “如果安全系统出现故障，我们将坚决予以解决。”

paras.en: SÃ¡nchez and other Spanish politicians have cancelled all public engagements on Wednesday, including campaigning for next month's parliamentary elections.
paras.zh: 桑切斯和其他西班牙政界人士取消了周三的所有公共活动，包括为下个月的议会选举进行竞选活动。

paras.en: Spain's royal family posted on X that it was "shocked and concerned" and expressed condolences for the relatives of the deceased and those affected by the crash.
paras.zh: 西班牙王室在X上发帖表示“感到震惊和担忧”，并向死者亲属和受空难影响的人们表示哀悼。

paras.en: A spokesperson for the EU said the bloc was ready to help Spain if needed.
paras.zh: 欧盟发言人表示，如有需要，欧盟已准备好帮助西班牙。

paras.en: A huge emergency response is under way with fire crews and helicopters at the scene.
paras.zh: 消防人员和直升机正在现场进行大规模紧急响应。

paras.en: Hospitals in the area have suspended planned surgeries as they deal with an influx of patients from the crash, Spanish media have reported.
paras.zh: 据西班牙媒体报道，该地区的医院因坠机事故导致大量患者涌入，已暂停计划中的手术。

paras.en: A blood transfusion centre in Madrid has also appealed for "urgent" donations. In a post on X, Centro de TransfusiÃ³n said it made the request "in the face of a possible sudden increase in care needs".
paras.zh: 马德里的一家输血中心也呼吁“紧急”捐款。 Centro de Transfusión 在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，它是“面对可能突然增加的护理需求”而提出这一请求的。

paras.en: It reported that facilities in Toledo, Ciudad Real and AlcÃ¡zar de San Juan have cancelled procedures as casualties from the crash begin to arrive.
paras.zh: 据报道，随着坠机事故中的伤亡人员陆续抵达，托莱多、雷阿尔城和圣胡安堡的设施已经取消了相关程序。

paras.en: This is the second high-speed rail tragedy in Spain this year.
paras.zh: 这是西班牙今年第二起高铁惨案。

paras.en: In January a high-speed train derailed in southern Spain, its rear carriages going into the path of a state-run Renfe train, claiming the lives of 46 people.
paras.zh: 1 月，一列高速列车在西班牙南部出轨，后车厢冲入国营 Renfe 列车的轨道，造成 46 人死亡。

articles.title: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash

paras.en: Watch: At the scene of Spain's deadly train crash
paras.zh: 观看：西班牙致命火车事故现场

paras.en: Dozens of people have died and others have been injured after two high-speed trains collided south of the Spanish capital Madrid.
paras.zh: 西班牙首都马德里以南两列高铁相撞，造成数十人死亡、多人受伤。

paras.en: Prime Minister Pedro SÃ¡nchez said it was "unacceptable" that Spain had suffered its second fatal rail crash in a year.
paras.zh: 首相佩德罗·桑切斯表示，西班牙一年内遭遇第二次致命铁路事故“令人无法接受”。

paras.en: The BBC's Guy Hedgecoe reports from the scene of the crash.
paras.zh: 英国广播公司 (BBC) 的盖伊·赫奇科 (Guy Hedgecoe) 在坠机现场进行报道。

articles.title: Netanyahu's bloc leading Israel election but short of majority, partial results show

paras.en: Partial results from Israel's general election show veteran Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is leading his rival, former military chief Gadi Eisenkot, but is still short of a majority in parliament.
paras.zh: 以色列大选的部分结果显示，资深总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡领先于他的竞争对手、前军事首长加迪·艾森科特，但仍缺乏议会多数席位。

paras.en: With 85% of ballots counted, Netanyahu's Likud party and its far-right and ultra-Orthodox Jewish allies were on track to win 53 seats in the 120-seat Knesset. Eisenkot's Yashar party and three other Jewish opposition parties in his bloc were set for 48.
paras.zh: 随着 85% 的选票清点完毕，内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团及其极右翼和极端正统犹太盟友有望在议会 120 个席位中赢得 53 个席位。艾森科特领导的亚沙尔党和他所在阵营中的其他三个犹太反对党的席位定为 48 席。

paras.en: Both leaders have said they will try to form a governing coalition.
paras.zh: 两位领导人都表示，他们将努力组建执政联盟。

paras.en: Arab-led parties, who are on course to win an unprecedented 19 seats, could emerge as kingmakers, but all but one of the Jewish parties have pledged not to work with them.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯领导的政党有望史无前例地赢得 19 个席位，它们可能会成为国王拥护者，但除一个犹太政党外，所有犹太政党都承诺不与他们合作。

paras.en: With between 430,000 and 480,000 absentee ballots from soldiers and diplomats yet to be counted, it could still take a day or two for the final election results to emerge.
paras.zh: 由于还有 43 万至 48 万张士兵和外交官缺席选票尚未清点，最终选举结果可能仍需要一两天才能揭晓。

paras.en: Once they are confirmed, President Isaac Herzog will hold consultations with all the political factions and invite the leader whom he believes has the best chance of success to form a government - a process that could take weeks.
paras.zh: 一旦确定，总统艾萨克·赫尔佐格将与所有政治派别进行磋商，并邀请他认为最有可能成功组建政府的领导人——这一过程可能需要数周时间。

paras.en: If they fail, then ultimately there would have to be another election.
paras.zh: 如果他们失败了，那么最终将不得不举行另一次选举。

paras.en: During a meeting at his residence in Jerusalem, Herzog praised the 77.7% turnout in Tuesday's election, which was the country's highest in more than two decades.
paras.zh: 赫尔佐格在耶路撒冷官邸举行的一次会议上赞扬了周二选举中 77.7% 的投票率，这是该国二十多年来的最高投票率。

paras.en: "It is a badge of honour for Israeli society, and it was remarkable to see how deep the desire for democracy is in Israel," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“这是以色列社会的荣誉徽章，看到以色列对民主的渴望有多么强烈，真是令人印象深刻。”

paras.en: He added that he expected to receive the official results next week, after which he would begin discussions with every faction.
paras.zh: 他补充说，他预计下周会收到正式结果，之后他将开始与各派进行讨论。

paras.en: "We must do everything we can, certainly after yesterday, to avoid another round of elections. So, I expect everyone who comes here to come with an open mind."
paras.zh: “我们必须尽一切努力，尤其是在昨天之后，以避免另一轮选举。因此，我希望每个来到这里的人都以开放的心态来。”

paras.en: Both the prime minister and his main rival have insisted that they should be tasked with forming a governing coalition.
paras.zh: 总理和他的主要竞争对手都坚持认为，他们的任务应该是组建一个执政联盟。

paras.en: Eisenkot declared that the public had "spoken in favour of change", after initial exit polls published by three Israeli broadcasters projected that his "Change Bloc" would emerge with between 52 and 53 seats in the Knesset, compared to 50 seats for Netanyahu's bloc.
paras.zh: 艾森科特宣称，公众已经“发声支持变革”，此前三个以色列广播公司发布的初步出口民意调查预计，他的“变革集团”将在议会中获得 52 至 53 个席位，而内塔尼亚胡的集团将获得 50 个席位。

paras.en: "The coalition of failure has lost the people's trust," he told supporters at Yashar's election headquarters in Tel Aviv. "I will work with my partners to ensure that the people's decision is translated into a Zionist government."
paras.zh: “失败的联盟已经失去了人民的信任，”他在特拉维夫的亚沙尔选举总部对支持者说。 “我将与我的合作伙伴合作，确保人民的决定转化为犹太复国主义政府。”

paras.en: Later, the broadcasters updated their exit polls, with two projecting that the rival blocs would be tied on 51 seats and one giving Netanyahu's bloc a narrow three-seat lead.
paras.zh: 随后，广播公司更新了出口民意调查，其中两项预测两个阵营将在 51 个席位上打成平手，另一项则预测内塔尼亚胡的阵营以 3 个席位微弱优势领先。

paras.en: Netanyahu then appeared at Likud's headquarters in Jerusalem and declared that his right-wing bloc had won a "great majority".
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡随后出现在耶路撒冷利库德集团总部，宣布他的右翼集团赢得了“绝大多数”。

paras.en: "We must put in place a strong right-wing national government," he said. "It is forbidden, simply forbidden, to endanger Israel by forming a government that relies on anti-Zionist Arab parties."
paras.zh: “我们必须建立一个强大的右翼国家政府，”他说。 “禁止，完全禁止，通过组建一个依赖反犹太复国主义阿拉伯政党的政府来危及以色列。”

paras.en: The leader of the left-wing Democrats party told its partners in Eisenkot's bloc on Wednesday that there was an "opportunity to form a change government in partnership" with the Arab parties and replace Netanyahu's coalition.
paras.zh: 左翼民主党领导人周三告诉艾森科特集团的合作伙伴，有一个“机会与阿拉伯政党合作组建变革政府”并取代内塔尼亚胡的联盟。

paras.en: "We have no future here if we don't stop being afraid. And if we don't put an end to racism," Yair Golan wrote on X.
paras.zh: “如果我们不停止恐惧，如果我们不结束种族主义，我们这里就没有未来，”Yair Golan 在 X 上写道。

paras.en: The two Arab parties - the United Arab List and the Joint List - appear to be heading for record representation because of a strong turnout among Arab Israelis, who account for about a fifth of the population and often describe themselves as Palestinian citizens of Israel.
paras.zh: 两个阿拉伯政党——阿拉伯联合名单和联合名单——似乎正朝着创纪录的代表权迈进，因为阿拉伯裔以色列人的投票率很高，他们约占总人口的五分之一，经常自称是以色列的巴勒斯坦公民。

paras.en: The chairman of the Joint List, which has talked of providing an electoral "safety net" for the Jewish opposition, said on Wednesday that it was "ready and prepared to pave the way to oust the Netanyahu government".
paras.zh: 联合名单主席曾谈到为犹太反对派提供选举“安全网”，周三表示，该名单“已准备好为推翻内塔尼亚胡政府铺平道路”。

paras.en: "Change runs through a Jewish-Arab partnership - a genuine and equal partnership. Nothing less, and nothing more," Yousef Jabareen wrote on X.
paras.zh: 尤瑟夫·贾巴林 (Yousef Jabareen) 在 X 上写道：“变革贯穿于犹太与阿拉伯的伙伴关系——一种真正平等的伙伴关系。不多也不少。”

paras.en: United Arab List leader Mansour Abbas, who served in a short-lived governing coalition formed after the 2021 elections, said on Tuesday night that he hoped "the numbers will work out and we, the Change Bloc and the UAL, can ensure that there are 61 Knesset seats".
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合名单领导人曼苏尔·阿巴斯曾在 2021 年选举后组建的短暂执政联盟中任职，他周二晚表示，他希望“数字能够发挥作用，我们、变革集团和联合联盟能够确保议会拥有 61 个席位”。

paras.en: Tuesday's election was the first since the deadly Hamas-led attacks on Israel on 7 October 2023 and the wars that followed in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.
paras.zh: 周二的选举是自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列发动致命袭击以及随后在加沙、黎巴嫩和伊朗爆发战争以来的首次选举。

paras.en: It was also seen by Israelis as one of the most consequential in the country's history, because it could decide not just their leadership but whether the country continues on its current hardline, religious-nationalist trajectory.
paras.zh: 它也被以色列人视为该国历史上最重要的事件之一，因为它不仅可以决定他们的领导地位，还可以决定该国是否继续走目前的强硬、宗教民族主义轨迹。

paras.en: Key campaign issues included accountability for the security failures that led to the 7 October attacks, the conduct of regional wars, conscripting ultra-Orthodox Jewish men into the military, judicial reforms and Israel's international standing.
paras.zh: 关键的竞选问题包括对导致 10 月 7 日袭击的安全失败的责任、地区战争的进行、征召极端正统犹太男子参军、司法改革和以色列的国际地位。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为#CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将出现在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.
paras.zh: 这种专业知识与我们卓越的规模和地理覆盖范围相结合，使我们成为可靠的合作伙伴，帮助我们的客户实现他们的目标，并为最终用户提供最好的设备。我们的知名品牌包括用于液压运动控制和稳定系统的 Power-Packer；用于操作员信息和人机界面系统的 CrossControl 和 maximatecc； Elliott Manufacturing 和 Weasler Engineering 通过柔性和刚性传动系统进行动力和力传输； Gits Manufacturing 提供高性能发动机热和排放控制解决方案；和 Carlisle Brake & Friction，为非公路制动和传动产品提供材料和机电一体化解决方案。如需了解有关 CentroMotion 的更多信息，请访问 www.centromotion.com。

articles.title: bauma 2025

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is one of five CentroMotion brands exhibiting at bauma, April 7–13 in Munich, booth A2, 402.
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 4 月 7 日至 13 日在慕尼黑举行的 bauma 展会上参展的五个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位 A2, 402。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the construction market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于建筑市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing product highlights from their industry-leading brake, transmissions/clutch and motion control systems.
paras.zh: 分享其行业领先的制动、变速箱/离合器和运动控制系统的产品亮点。

paras.en: Showcasing display and on-board computing platforms.
paras.zh: 展示显示和机载计算平台。

paras.en: Featuring the latest solutions in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, exhaust recirculation valves and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas, and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用最新的热管理解决方案，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、排气再循环阀和排气背压阀。

paras.en: Demonstrating micro-controller-based platforms for instrumentation and HMI.
paras.zh: 演示基于微控制器的仪器仪表和 HMI 平台。

paras.en: Exhibiting new electro-hydraulic actuators with a design focus on efficiency, perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications.
paras.zh: 展示新型电动液压执行器，其设计注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。

articles.title: Visit Us @Agritechnica 2025

paras.en: CarlisleCBF is one of seven CentroMotion brands exhibiting at Agritechnica, November 9 - 15, 2025, in Hanover, Germany, stand No. B35, hall 17.
paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是参加 2025 年 11 月 9 日至 15 日在德国汉诺威举行的 Agritechnica 展会的七个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位号为 B35，展厅 17。

paras.en: CentroMotion is a global manufacturing company specializing in friction, information, and controls, mechanical power transmission, and thermal and motion control products.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the agriculture market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于农业市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing a powerful lineup of brake system solutions engineered for the demands of modern agriculture equipment. Attendees can explore highlights from industry-leading brake assemblies, designed to deliver unmatched stopping power and durability in off-highway environments. The display will also feature both the EPD and N680 advanced friction technologies, built to optimize performance and reliability in high-torque applications. Together, these products represent a century of engineering excellence and a future-focused commitment to solving the toughest challenges in agricultural mobility.
paras.zh: 分享一系列强大的制动系统解决方案，专为满足现代农业设备的需求而设计。与会者可以探索行业领先的制动组件的亮点，这些组件旨在在非公路环境中提供无与伦比的制动力和耐用性。该显示器还将采用 EPD 和 N680 先进摩擦技术，旨在优化高扭矩应用中的性能和可靠性。这些产品共同代表了一个世纪以来的卓越工程技术和着眼于未来解决农业移动领域最严峻挑战的承诺。

paras.en: Showcasing the leading on-board computing platform for machine intelligence and HMI solutions. New products, designed specifically to meet the needs of agricultural machinery, include 10- and 12-inch smart terminals, central vehicle computing with monitors, and 5- and 7-inch displays featuring programmable soft keys for tactile control. The CCpilot V1090 and V1290 are the first displays with an integrated network switch that makes it easier to incorporate elements like camera systems, sensors and precision systems, into one display computer. The vehicle computer and monitors (CrossCore A100 with monitors from 10 to 12 inches) highlight the new centralized computing architecture. This approach provides a flexible, scalable platform for vehicle intelligence. It includes innovative component life cycle management and increased support for functional safety.
paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增强的功能安全支持。

paras.en: Highlighting how Elliott’s flexible planting products deliver precision performance, highly operational reliability and mechanical advantages without the need for additional power sources. The flexible drive and control shaft products bring enhanced performance to original equipment machinery, providing simple and dependable aftermarket upgrades for an ongoing return on your investment. Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Featuring the latest innovations in thermal management solutions, including intake throttle valves, hot- and cold-side exhaust gas recirculation valves, and exhaust back-pressure valves for diesel, gas and hydrogen internal combustion engines.
paras.zh: 采用热管理解决方案的最新创新，包括柴油、燃气和氢气内燃机的进气节流阀、热侧和冷侧废气再循环阀以及排气背压阀。

paras.en: Presenting the latest solutions to help operators sense, see and know more. Show attendees will find a broad portfolio of products, including displays, clusters and sensors for vehicle and equipment monitoring in demanding applications. The displays are built on a microcontroller architecture which offers lean performance with inherent support for key features including fast boot (typically around a second for instant access to machine data). Visitors to Agritechnica can get a hands-on look at the display range, from 1.3 to 4.3 inches, with demos to show general I/O, CAN channel support and application examples. The displays can share multiple screens of information, with intuitive navigation, including diagnostic codes and machine status. The platform offers devices with robust and compact housings suitable to withstand the toughest environments and designed to easily fit 52 or 86 mm SAE case sizes to make installation simple for new and existing cabins.
paras.zh: 呈现最新的解决方案，帮助操作员感知、看到和了解更多。展会与会者将发现广泛的产品组合，包括用于在要求苛刻的应用中监控车辆和设备的显示器、仪表组和传感器。这些显示器基于微控制器架构构建，可提供精益性能以及对快速启动（通常大约一秒即可即时访问机器数据）等关键功能的固有支持。 Agritechnica 的参观者可以亲身体验从 1.3 英寸到 4.3 英寸的显示屏范围，并通过演示展示通用 I/O、CAN 通道支持和应用示例。这些显示器可以共享多个信息屏幕，并具有直观的导航功能，包括诊断代码和机器状态。该平台提供的设备具有坚固而紧凑的外壳，适合承受最恶劣的环境，并可轻松安装 52 或 86 毫米 SAE 外壳尺寸，使新的和现有的驾驶室的安装变得简单。

paras.en: Showcasing the Power-Packer portfolio of manual and electric pumps and cylinders for hydraulic cab tilt and hood-lift applications, as well as the latest electro-hydraulic actuator. All products are designed with a focus on efficiency and perfectly suited for power-on-demand functions in mobile applications. Hydraulic solutions offer precise motion control and ensure reliable performance in the most demanding environments.
paras.zh: 展示用于液压驾驶室倾斜和发动机罩升降应用的手动和电动泵和油缸的 Power-Packer 产品组合，以及最新的电动液压执行器。所有产品的设计都注重效率，非常适合移动应用中的按需供电功能。液压解决方案提供精确的运动控制，并确保在最苛刻的环境中提供可靠的性能。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. Products are engineered for reliability and precision, ensuring the seamless operation and longevity of agricultural equipment.
paras.zh: 了解 Weasler 的产品系列，从传动轴和扭矩限制器到阻尼器和其他组件，所有产品均采用最佳技术设计，旨在解决客户的动力传输问题。产品的设计注重可靠性和精度，确保农业设备的无缝运行和使用寿命。

articles.title: Enterprise Expands Support of SCRS RDE at 2026 SEMA Show
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Enterprise, the flagship brand of Enterprise Mobility, will partner with the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) as a supporting sponsor of Repairer Driven Education (RDE) and the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit at the 2026 SEMA Show Nov. 3–6 in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Enterprise Mobility 的旗舰品牌 Enterprise 将与碰撞修复专家协会 (SCRS) 合作，作为维修驱动教育 (RDE) 的支持赞助商，并在 11 月 3 日至 6 日于拉斯维加斯举行的 2026 年 SEMA 展会上举办 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会。

paras.en: In addition to its continued support of the educational program, Enterprise is expanding its involvement in SEMA Show initiatives by providing vehicles from its Nevada fleet for the new ADAS Showcase, an interactive experience designed to help collision repair professionals understand the technologies integrated into modern vehicles and the considerations necessary to preserve their functionality throughout the repair process.
paras.zh: 除了继续支持教育计划外，Enterprise 还扩大了对 SEMA Show 活动的参与，为新的 ADAS 展示提供其内华达车队的车辆，这是一种互动体验，旨在帮助碰撞修复专业人员了解集成到现代车辆中的技术以及在整个修复过程中保留其功能所需的注意事项。

paras.en: As vehicle technology advances, Enterprise — a provider of replacement mobility when a driver’s vehicle is in the shop — notes the importance of the collision repair industry having the knowledge, resources and technical capabilities necessary to properly repair increasingly sophisticated vehicles. Its continued investment in SCRS education reflects a broader commitment to supporting the repair professionals responsible for returning those vehicles to the road safely.
paras.zh: 随着车辆技术的进步，Enterprise（当驾驶员的车辆在店里时提供更换移动性的提供商）注意到碰撞修复行业拥有正确修复日益复杂的车辆所需的知识、资源和技术能力的重要性。它对 SCRS 教育的持续投资反映了对支持负责将这些车辆安全返回道路的维修专业人员的更广泛承诺。

paras.en: “Technology is transforming the vehicles we put on the road, and it’s equally important that the collision repair industry is prepared to service and repair those vehicles correctly,” said Yvette Burke, vice president, Global Sales, Replacement & Leisure, Enterprise Mobility. “We see tremendous value in supporting programs that bring repair professionals together with the engineers and technical experts responsible for developing these technologies. Our partnership with SCRS, and our involvement in the ADAS Showcase, are opportunities to help strengthen that connection between innovation, education and the real-world repair process.”
paras.zh: “技术正在改变我们在道路上行驶的车辆，同样重要的是，碰撞修复行业做好了正确保养和维修这些车辆的准备，”企业移动全球销售、更换和休闲副总裁 Yvette Burke 表示。 “我们看到了支持计划的巨大价值，这些计划将维修专业人员与负责开发这些技术的工程师和技术专家聚集在一起。我们与 SCRS 的合作伙伴关系以及我们对 ADAS 展示会的参与，都是帮助加强创新、教育和实际维修过程之间联系的机会。”

paras.en: Bringing Vehicle Technology to the Show Floor
paras.zh: 将车辆技术带到展厅

paras.en: New for 2026, the ADAS Showcase will provide SEMA Show attendees opportunities to explore ADAS through interactive demonstrations, vehicle displays, and direct conversations with OEM engineering and technical experts.
paras.zh: 2026 年新增的 ADAS 展示将为 SEMA 展会与会者提供通过互动演示、车辆展示以及与 OEM 工程和技术专家直接对话来探索 ADAS 的机会。

paras.en: The showcase is designed to connect the technologies incorporated into today’s vehicles with the practical realities of collision repair, including sensor functionality, diagnostic requirements, calibration considerations and the potential consequences of changes to vehicle components or sensor positioning.
paras.zh: 该展示旨在将当今车辆中采用的技术与碰撞修复的实际情况联系起来，包括传感器功能、诊断要求、校准注意事项以及车辆组件或传感器位置变化的潜在后果。

paras.en: Enterprise’s contribution of vehicles to the showcase will help facilitate these hands-on experiences, giving attendees an opportunity to examine vehicle systems and understand how advanced technologies influence repair planning, procedures and verification.
paras.zh: Enterprise 在展示中提供的车辆将有助于促进这些实践体验，让与会者有机会检查车辆系统并了解先进技术如何影响维修计划、程序和验证。

paras.en: The initiative reinforces a shared objective between Enterprise and SCRS: ensuring that advancements in vehicle safety technology are supported by corresponding advancements in collision repair knowledge and capability.
paras.zh: 该计划强化了 Enterprise 和 SCRS 之间的共同目标：确保车辆安全技术的进步得到碰撞修复知识和能力的相应进步的支持。

paras.en: Supporting Education that Connects Engineering and Repair
paras.zh: 支持连接工程和维修的教育

paras.en: Enterprise will continue its support of SCRS’ RDE program, which brings collision repair professionals together for four days of education focused on technical advancement, business operations, industry challenges and emerging opportunities.
paras.zh: Enterprise 将继续支持 SCRS 的 RDE 计划，该计划将碰撞修复专业人员聚集在一起，进行为期四天的教育，重点关注技术进步、业务运营、行业挑战和新兴机遇。

paras.en: The program includes the IDEAS Collide Showcase on Wednesday, Nov. 4, featuring fast-paced, 10-minute presentations. Topics for 2026 include artificial intelligence, ADAS diagnostics, business growth, vehicle safety, legal considerations and technician development.
paras.zh: 该计划包括 11 月 4 日星期三举行的 IDEAS Collide Showcase，其中包括 10 分钟的快节奏演示。 2026 年的主题包括人工智能、ADAS 诊断、业务增长、车辆安全、法律考虑和技术人员发展。

paras.en: On Thursday, Nov. 5, the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit will present three connected sessions examining vehicle safety from national policy objectives through engineering development and the collision repair process:
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日星期四，OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会将举办三场相互关联的会议，从国家政策目标到工程开发和碰撞修复过程来审查车辆安全：

paras.en: - 12:30-1:30 p.m. – The National Safety Objective: Safer Vehicles, Safer Roads. National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Deputy Administrator Lee White joins SCRS Executive Director Aaron Schulenburg for a discussion of federal vehicle safety priorities and the technologies shaping future roadway safety.
paras.zh: - 中午 12:30-1:30 – 国家安全目标：更安全的车辆、更安全的道路。美国国家公路交通安全管理局 (NHTSA) 副局长 Lee White 与 SCRS 执行董事 Aaron Schulenburg 一起讨论联邦车辆安全优先事项和塑造未来道路安全的技术。

paras.en: - 2-3 p.m. – Engineering the Safety Benefit: From Requirement to Real-World Performance. Vehicle safety and ADAS engineering leaders explore how safety objectives are translated into vehicle technologies, systems and measurable real-world performance.
paras.zh: - 下午 2-3 点– 设计安全效益：从要求到实际性能。车辆安全和 ADAS 工程领导者探索如何将安全目标转化为车辆技术、系统和可测量的实际性能。

paras.en: - 3:30-4:30 p.m. – Preserving the Safety System: Sensors, Calibration and Repairability. Engineering experts from General Motors, Ford and Rivian examine sensor capabilities, calibration requirements and the importance of preserving engineered safety functions throughout the repair process.
paras.zh: - 下午 3:30-4:30 – 保护安全系统：传感器、校准和可修复性。来自通用汽车、福特和 Rivian 的工程专家研究了传感器功能、校准要求以及在整个维修过程中保留工程安全功能的重要性。

paras.en: Together, these sessions reinforce the relationship between the development of advanced vehicle safety technologies and the technical knowledge required to maintain their intended performance following a collision.
paras.zh: 这些会议共同加强了先进车辆安全技术的开发与碰撞后保持其预期性能所需的技术知识之间的关系。

paras.en: Enterprise’s involvement in both the classroom program and the ADAS Showcase extends those conversations beyond the presentation stage, connecting education with vehicle technologies and practical repair considerations.
paras.zh: Enterprise 参与课堂项目和 ADAS 展示，将这些对话扩展到演示阶段之外，将教育与车辆技术和实际维修考虑因素联系起来。

paras.en: SCRS encourages attendees to consider the RDE Full Series Pass, which provides access to all RDE classroom sessions, the IDEAS Collide Showcase, all three OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit sessions and one ticket to the SCRS Sky Villa Afterparty on Thursday evening.
paras.zh: SCRS 鼓励与会者考虑 RDE 全系列通行证，该通行证提供所有 RDE 课堂会议、IDEAS 碰撞展示、所有三场 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会会议的访问权限，以及一张周四晚上 SCRS 天空别墅余兴派对的门票。

paras.en: For Full Series Pass registration, click here.
paras.zh: 如需注册全系列通行证，请点击此处。

paras.en: For OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit registration, click here.
paras.zh: 如需注册 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会，请点击此处。

paras.en: For additional information about the program, visit scrs.com/rde.
paras.zh: 有关该计划的更多信息，请访问 scrs.com/rde。

articles.title: AkzoNobel Gears Up for SEMA 2026 in Las Vegas
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: AkzoNobel’s vehicle refinishes team will appear at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas with product news, vehicle unveilings, custom color announcements and autograph sessions from Nov. 3-6, 2026. Dave Kindig, host of Kindig-It Design AllAccess and creator of Kindig-It Design, will appear with the team.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔的车辆修补漆团队将于 2​​026 年 11 月 3 日至 6 日亮相拉斯维加斯 2026 年 SEMA 车展，展示产品新闻、车辆揭幕、定制颜色公告和签名会。Kindig-It Design AllAccess 主持人兼 Kindig-It Design 创始人 Dave Kindig 将与该团队一起亮相。

paras.en: Booth no. 35144 on the second floor of the South Hall will feature interactive displays highlighting AkzoNobel’s digital body shop workflow control solution, Carbeat. The system is part of Acoat Selected, AkzoNobel’s business development program for Sikkens customers. Acoat Selected crew members will provide demonstrations and answer questions.
paras.zh: 展位号南厅二楼的 35144 将设有交互式显示屏，重点介绍阿克苏诺贝尔的数字车身车间工作流程控制解决方案 Carbeat。该系统是阿克苏诺贝尔为新肯客户提供的业务开发计划 Acoat Selected 的一部分。 Acoat 精选船员将进行演示并回答问题。

paras.en: Sikkens Autowave Optima and AutoClear 2.0 will be featured as a one-stop solution to increase shop throughput and efficiency.
paras.zh: Sikkens Autowave Optima 和 AutoClear 2.0 将作为一站式解决方案来提高车间吞吐量和效率。

paras.en: “Our team has been laser focused and embedded with customers to understand their needs on the product and services side,” said Maximilien Schröder, commercial director for AkzoNobel’s North American Automotive & Specialty Coatings business. “We’re bringing new updates to both at SEMA to help drive restoration, collision and shop performance.”
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔北美汽车和特种涂料业务商务总监 Maximilien Schröder 表示：“我们的团队一直专注于客户，深入了解他们在产品和服务方面的需求。” “我们在 SEMA 上为这两个项目带来了新的更新，以帮助推动修复、碰撞和车间绩效。”

paras.en: Silver Lot no. 80041 will feature the Kindig-It rig with three custom vehicle unveilings and new custom colors added to the Modern Classikk paint portfolio. Tuesday morning will open with Dave Kindig unveiling a custom 1969 Dodge Super Bee “Killer Bee” and two new custom versions of Kindig-It Design’s CF1. Each vehicle features Modern Classikk powered by Sikkens colors, with new custom colors for SEMA 2026.
paras.zh: 银牌批号80041 将采用 Kindig-It 装备，推出三款定制车辆，并在 Modern Classikk 油漆组合中添加新的定制颜色。周二上午，戴夫·金迪 (Dave Kindig) 将揭幕一辆定制的 1969 年道奇超级蜜蜂“Killer Bee”和两款新的 Kindig-It Design CF1 定制版本。每辆车都配备了由新肯颜色提供支持的 Modern Classikk，并为 SEMA 2026 提供了新的定制颜色。

paras.en: The team will unveil a new refinish product line Wednesday addressing OEM color matches for restorers, builders and enthusiasts. Dave Kindig and the Kindig-It Design crew will host meet-and-greet and celebrity signings each day of the show. Morning sessions will be from 9:30-10:30 a.m. and 4-5 p.m. on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. Friday sessions will be from 9:30-10:30 a.m. and 1:15-2:15 p.m.
paras.zh: 该团队将于周三推出新的修补漆产品线，为修复者、建筑商和爱好者解决 OEM 颜色匹配问题。 Dave Kindig 和 Kindig-It Design 团队将在展会每天举办见面会和名人签名会。上午的会议时间为上午 9:30-10:30 和下午 4-5 点。周二、周三和周四。周五会议时间为上午 9:30-10:30 和下午 1:15-2:15。

paras.en: Additional AkzoNobel Appearances at SEMA
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔在 SEMA 上的其他亮相

paras.en: AkzoNobel paint products will be featured throughout the SEMA show floor, including:
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔涂料产品将在整个 SEMA 展厅展出，包括：

paras.en: - Kindig Fastback CF1 #029 painted with Modern Classikk in the Keyston Bros. booth
paras.zh: - Keyston Bros. 展位上的 Kindig Fastback CF1 #029 涂有 Modern Classikk

paras.en: - 1968 Pontiac Bonneville painted with Modern Classikk in the Dynamat booth
paras.zh: - Dynamat 展位上涂有 Modern Classikk 的 1968 年 Pontiac Bonneville

paras.en: - 1957 Corvette SS Concept painted with Modern Classikk in the Borla booth
paras.zh: - Borla 展位上涂有 Modern Classikk 的 1957 Corvette SS Concept

paras.en: - 1977 Ford F-150 painted with Sikkens Technology in the Bendpak rig
paras.zh: - 1977 年福特 F-150 在 Bendpak 装置中采用新劲技术涂装

paras.en: - Kindig Cabriolet CF1 #027 painted with Modern Classikk at Wynn Concourse
paras.zh: - Kindig Cabriolet CF1 #027 在 Wynn Concourse 涂有 Modern Classikk

paras.en: - Kindig Fastback CF1 #030 painted with Modern Classikk at Wynn Concourse
paras.zh: - Kindig Fastback CF1 #030 在 Wynn Concourse 涂有 Modern Classikk

paras.en: - 1997 Honda Civic EK-G/Projext NEXT painted with Sikkens in Silver Lot SV-0041
paras.zh: - 1997 本田 Civic EK-G/Projext NEXT 涂有新劲 (Sikkens) 银色批次 SV-0041

paras.en: - OMF Car Craft Carbon Fiber Bronco painted with Sikkens and competing in Battle of the Builders, at HRIA reception and out front of Central Hall
paras.zh: - OMF Car Craft 碳纤维野马采用新劲涂装，并在 HRIA 接待处和中央大厅前参加建造者之战

paras.en: The team will sponsor the RDE classroom sessions, IDEAS Collide Showcase and the OEM Collision Repair Technology Summit.
paras.zh: 该团队将赞助 RDE 课堂课程、IDEAS 碰撞展示和 OEM 碰撞修复技术峰会。

paras.en: “Repairers are being asked to do more with less leverage, and improving that position starts with what happens inside the shop every day,” said Nada Jokic, business service manager for AkzoNobel. “The programs SCRS delivers through RDE give repairers practical, actionable tools they can put to work right away. We’re proud to stand alongside SCRS in supporting education that helps businesses operate with more confidence and clarity.”
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔业务服务经理纳达·约基奇（Nada Jokic）表示：“维修人员被要求以更少的杠杆做更多的事情，而改善这一状况要从车间内每天发生的事情开始。” “SCRS 通过 RDE 提供的计划为维修人员提供了实用、可操作的工具，他们可以立即投入工作。我们很自豪能够与 SCRS 一起支持教育，帮助企业更加自信和清晰地运营。”

paras.en: AkzoNobel’s Tim Ronak, senior services consultant, will join Sean Preston, managing attorney at Coverall Law, to present “The 3 Daily Mistakes Repair Shops Make That Empower Insurers” on Wednesday, Nov. 4, from 9:30-11 a.m. The session examines how routine shop practices can inadvertently give insurers leverage in negotiations and disputes. Built around three key categories — protection, payment, and Process – the presentation introduces 30 steps shops can implement. The format encourages audience participation and discussion about how these concepts apply to attendees’ businesses.
paras.zh: 阿克苏诺贝尔的高级服务顾问蒂姆·罗纳克 (Tim Ronak) 将于 11 月 4 日星期三上午 9:30 至 11 点与 Coverall Law 的执行律师肖恩·普雷斯顿 (Sean Preston) 共同演讲“维修店每日犯的 3 个错误，赋予保险公司权力”。会议探讨了维修店的日常做法如何无意中为保险公司在谈判和纠纷中提供筹码。该演示围绕三个关键类别（保护、支付和流程）介绍了商店可以实施的 30 个步骤。该形式鼓励观众参与并讨论这些概念如何应用于与会者的业务。

paras.en: Learn more about AkzoNobel’s Vehicle Refinish business at akzonobel.com.
paras.zh: 如需了解有关阿克苏诺贝尔车辆修补漆业务的更多信息，请访问 akzonobel.com。

articles.title: Entegral and GEICO partner for automotive claims process
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: Entegral and GEICO have entered into a partnership to “enhance the automotive claims experience through improved claim routing, repair coordination, and customer communication,” a press release states.
paras.zh: 一份新闻稿称，Entegral 和 GEICO 已建立合作伙伴关系，“通过改进索赔路线、维修协调和客户沟通来增强汽车索赔体验”。

paras.en: The claims technology platform is a subsidiary of Enterprise Mobility that streamlines the automotive claims process for all stakeholders, according to the release. The technology will support GEICO with additional tasks such as clearer appointment communication and “more informed repairer-provider selection, creating a simpler and more transparent experience for policyholders and repair partners.”
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，该索赔技术平台是 Enterprise Mobility 的子公司，旨在为所有利益相关者简化汽车索赔流程。该技术将为 GEICO 提供额外的支持，例如更清晰的预约沟通和“更明智的维修服务提供商选择，为保单持有人和维修合作伙伴创造更简单、更透明的体验。”

paras.en: “At GEICO, we’re focused on delivering a seamless, first-class experience for millions of customers, from their initial quote through claim resolution,” said Shane Wheeler, GEICO chief claims officer. “With a 97% customer satisfaction rating, we know the standard our customers expect. Working with Entegral helps us deliver a more connected and efficient claims process while making it easier for customers to navigate repairs.”
paras.zh: GEICO 首席索赔官 Shane Wheeler 表示：“在 GEICO，我们致力于为数百万客户提供无缝、一流的体验，从最初的报价到索赔解决。” “凭借 97% 的客户满意度，我们了解客户期望的标准。与 Entegral 合作帮助我们提供更加互联、高效的索赔流程，同时让客户更轻松地进行维修。”

paras.en: Joe Rector, Entegral vice president, says in the release that today’s claims environment requires solutions that help insurers, repairers, and customers navigate the process with greater clarity, speed, and confidence.
paras.zh: Entegral 副总裁 Joe Rector 在新闻稿中表示，当今的理赔环境需要解决方案来帮助保险公司、维修商和客户以更清晰、更快速和更自信的方式驾驭整个流程。

paras.en: “Our partnership with GEICO reflects a shared commitment to leveraging technology and insights to simplify the claims process, improve repair-network coordination and deliver better outcomes for policyholders,” Rector says.
paras.zh: Rector 表示：“我们与 GEICO 的合作体现了我们的共同承诺，即利用技术和见解来简化索赔流程、改善维修网络协调并为保单持有人提供更好的结果。”

paras.en: According to the release, the partnership aims to drive improvements across key claims touchpoints. The two companies will align data, workflows, repair-network capabilities, and mobility touchpoints to improve visibility, enhance coordination, and create a more consistent customer experience from claim reporting through vehicle repair.
paras.zh: 据新闻稿称，此次合作旨在推动关键索赔接触点的改进。两家公司将协调数据、工作流程、维修网络功能和移动接触点，以提高可视性、加强协调，并从索赔报告到车辆维修创造更一致的客户体验。

paras.en: Rector urged collision industry stakeholders to break down silos and better connect their systems during the IDEAS Collide Showcase at the SEMA Show last year.
paras.zh: 去年 SEMA 展会上的 IDEAS Collide Showcase 期间，Rector 敦促碰撞行业利益相关者打破孤岛，更好地连接他们的系统。

paras.en: The collision industry is made up of many partners, Rector said. There are OEMs, insurance providers, and tow, glass, and salvage companies.
paras.zh: Rector 表示，碰撞行业由许多合作伙伴组成。其中包括原始设备制造商、保险提供商以及拖车、玻璃和废品回收公司。

paras.en: “Collision repair facilities are very unique in the fact that you have your own value chain outside of just the partners across the industry,” Rector said.
paras.zh: “碰撞修复设施非常独特，因为除了整个行业的合作伙伴之外，您还拥有自己的价值链，”Rector 说。

paras.en: He gave other examples of ADAS sublets and paint, parts, and equipment providers.
paras.zh: 他还举了 ADAS 转租以及油漆、零件和设备供应商的其他例子。

paras.en: Customers are the middle of the ecosystem, he explained.
paras.zh: 他解释说，客户是生态系统的中间部分。

paras.en: “The customer doesn’t care about the entire value chain that surrounds them,” Rector said. “These are all back-end services. They may not know every company that level of customer service that they expect. What they are looking for is a timely repair and one that’s done safe and in proper manner.”
paras.zh: “客户并不关心他们周围的整个价值链，”雷克托说。 “这些都是后端服务。他们可能不知道每家公司的客户服务水平都达到他们所期望的水平。他们所寻求的是及时的维修，并且是以安全、正确的方式完成的。”

paras.en: This means one company is not more important than another, he said. This also means multiple shop operators, sole proprietors, and direct repair programs all look the same to the customers.
paras.zh: 他说，这意味着一家公司并不比另一家公司更重要。这也意味着多家商店经营者、独资经营者和直接维修计划对客户来说都是一样的。

paras.en: “But what is interesting about our customers is that they are not just in the middle of our industry; they’re actually an active participant helping connect and move information around,” he said.
paras.zh: “但我们的客户的有趣之处在于，他们不仅仅是我们行业的中间人；他们实际上是帮助连接和移动信息的积极参与者，”他说。

paras.en: When a customer has a claim, they have to contact the insurance company, select a repair facility, schedule a shop appointment, schedule transportation while their car is in for repair, and possibly arrange towing to the proper location, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，当客户提出索赔时，他们必须联系保险公司，选择维修机构，安排商店预约，安排汽车维修期间的运输，并可能安排拖车到正确的位置。

paras.en: “There’s a lot of information being exchanged before the car is even repaired with a number of parties in our ecosystem,” Rector said. “It all runs through the customer. It doesn’t run around the customer. The customer is interacting with each of these other businesses to get on their way.”
paras.zh: “在汽车维修之前，我们的生态系统中的多方就已经交换了大量信息，”Rector 说。 “这一切都是通过客户来运行的。它不会围绕客户运行。客户正在与其他每个企业进行互动，以继续他们的工作。”

paras.en: If something goes wrong, for example, the repair facility can’t complete the necessary repair, meaning numerous extra steps for the consumer has to take. For example, they have to schedule a new repair shop, a new tow, and inform the insurance company.
paras.zh: 例如，如果出现问题，维修机构无法完成必要的维修，这意味着消费者必须采取许多额外的步骤。例如，他们必须安排新的维修店、新的拖车，并通知保险公司。

paras.en: “I think we honestly can do better than that,” he said. “If you go just beyond the onset of the repair, look at what happens when the customer is within the repair,” Rector said. “They’re relying on an accurate estimate and completion date to pick the car back up and get on the road. But that information is equally valuable to the rest of the industry as well and getting it not just in the hands of the customer but also the rental car providers, to the insurance carriers to handle invoicing appropriately.”
paras.zh: “我认为我们确实可以做得更好，”他说。 “如果你刚超出维修开始时间，看看客户在维修期间会发生什么，”雷克托说。 “他们依靠准确的估计和完成日期来提车并上路。但这些信息对于行业的其他部分也同样有价值，不仅可以交到客户手中，还可以交到租车提供商手中，交到保险公司手中，以便适当处理发票。”

paras.en: If the information is inaccurate to one member, then the consumer has to make more phone calls, he said. He added that every member of the industry has to start calling each other.
paras.zh: 他说，如果一名会员的信息不准确，那么消费者就必须拨打更多电话。他补充说，该行业的每个成员都必须开始互相打电话。

paras.en: “It sounds a little chaotic,” he said. “It does not sound like harmony.”
paras.zh: “听起来有点混乱，”他说。 “听起来不太和谐。”

paras.en: He asked what would happen if all of the partners were connected.
paras.zh: 他询问如果所有合作伙伴都连接起来会发生什么。

paras.en: “Let’s say the body shop and their scheduling and their data on their drop-off and repair status is connected seamlessly to the rental car providers and to the insurance carriers,” Rector said. “When the customer makes selections throughout the process everyone is informed without the need to call each other.”
paras.zh: “假设车身修理厂及其日程安排以及还车和维修状态的数据与租车提供商和保险公司无缝连接，”雷克托说。 “当客户在整个过程中做出选择时，每个人都会收到通知，而无需互相打电话。”

articles.title: SCRS education at SEMA: Documenting repairs, bringing mechanical in-house, and more
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: Repair planning tips, how to document OEM repair procedures and get paid for following them, and in-house mechanical work — those are just three of several topics covered during the Society of Collision Repair Specialists (SCRS) Repairer Driven Education (RDE) sessions at this year’s SEMA Show.
paras.zh: 维修计划技巧、如何记录 OEM 维修程序并通过遵循这些程序获得报酬，以及内部机械工作 — 这些只是今年 SEMA 展会上碰撞维修专家协会 (SCRS) 维修人员驱动教育 (RDE) 会议涵盖的几个主题中的三个。

paras.en: Justin Lewis, president of Accurate Auto Body in Washington, will lead “Reclaiming Technical Authority: Earning Consumer Authorization,” focused on the collision repair shop’s role in repair planning.
paras.zh: 华盛顿 Accurate Auto Body 总裁贾斯汀·刘易斯 (Justin Lewis) 将领导“夺回技术权威：赢得消费者授权”，重点关注碰撞维修店在维修计划中的作用。

paras.en: “The whole point of the presentation is essentially to establish the shop is building a repair plan that the customer is the person authorizing that, and the insurer’s role is indemnification,” Lewis said. “And too many times shops are relying on the insurer’s cost estimate to dictate repairs and giving up their technical authority. In turn, it’s causing them liability issues.”
paras.zh: 刘易斯说：“演示的重点是确定商店正在制定维修计划，客户是授权人，而保险公司的角色是赔偿。” “很多时候，商店依赖保险公司的成本估算来决定维修并放弃他们的技术权威。反过来，这又给他们带来了责任问题。”

paras.en: He added that the session will explain how shops can:
paras.zh: 他补充说，会议将解释商店如何：

paras.en: - Gain customer authorization to make repair decisions in their best interest;
paras.zh: - 获得客户授权，根据他们的最佳利益做出维修决定；

paras.en: - Support documentation with OEM repair procedures; and
paras.zh: - OEM 维修程序的支持文档；和

paras.en: - Separate those three items so that one doesn’t control the other.
paras.zh: - 将这三项分开，以便其中一项无法控制另一项。

paras.en: Lewis said he’ll cover what proper documentation looks like, when and how thoroughly to complete it, and how to get the customer’s buy-in.
paras.zh: 刘易斯表示，他将介绍什么是正确的文档、何时以及如何彻底完成文档，以及如何获得客户的认可。

paras.en: Backing up repair plans with documented OEM repair procedures and explaining that process builds a foundation of trust with customers, Lewis said.
paras.zh: Lewis 说，用记录的 OEM 维修程序来支持维修计划，并解释该流程可以为客户建立信任的基础。
