paras.en: The targeted party, People of Israel, is led by Ofer Winter, a former Israeli brigadier general with hawkish views on national security. Some polls show that much of Mr. Winter’s support comes from voters who would normally choose Likud. Mr. Winter has faced claims that a vote for his party will be wasted or may end up going to the leading challengers.
paras.zh: 目标政党“以色列人民”由前以色列准将奥弗·温特领导，他对国家安全持鹰派观点。一些民意调查显示，温特先生的大部分支持来自通常会选择利库德集团的选民。温特先生面临着这样的说法，即他的政党的选票将被浪费，或者最终可能会落到主要挑战者手中。

paras.en: While Mr. Winter initially said that he would support Mr. Netanyahu, he has refused any deals to withdraw from the race and has since signaled the pledge may have been premature.
paras.zh: 虽然温特先生最初表示他将支持内塔尼亚胡先生，但他拒绝了任何退出竞选的协议，并表示这一承诺可能为时过早。

paras.en: Israeli election officials have said there is no evidence of threats to the integrity of this election in terms of widespread fraud or vote counting irregularities. But experts are concerned about disinformation campaigns undermining the vote or thwarting turnout.
paras.zh: 以色列选举官员表示，没有证据表明广泛的舞弊或计票违规行为对这次选举的公正性构成威胁。但专家们担心虚假信息活动会破坏投票或阻碍投票率。

paras.en: Critics fear that some moves by the governing right-wing coalition may cast doubt on the outcome even before the vote happens or may thwart turnout among some voters.
paras.zh: 批评者担心，执政的右翼联盟的一些举动可能会在投票发生之前就对结果产生怀疑，或者可能会阻碍一些选民的投票率。

paras.en: Absentee voting is mostly prohibited in Israel. But by some estimates, tens of thousands of Israelis living abroad were expected to fly in to vote, a factor that could potentially swing the outcome.
paras.zh: 以色列基本上禁止缺席投票。但据估计，数万名居住在国外的以色列人预计将飞来投票，这一因素可能会影响结果。

paras.en: Likud had filed a lawsuit challenging an initiative to fly in Israeli voters from abroad — a move widely perceived as an effort to limit opposition voters from showing up. The party had said the nonpartisan program provided benefits that could sway voters in violation of Israeli law. But it withdrew the suit this month after the initiative’s organizers agreed to limit flights and not to defray travelers’ costs.
paras.zh: 利库德集团已提起诉讼，质疑一项从国外飞往以色列选民的倡议——此举被广泛认为是为了限制反对派选民到场。该党曾表示，这项无党派计划提供的好处可能会影响选民，违反了以色列法律。但在该倡议的组织者同意限制航班且不支付旅客费用后，该公司于本月撤回了诉讼。

paras.en: Likud and other right-wing parties also filed motions to limit participation of several Arab candidates in the election.
paras.zh: 利库德集团和其他右翼政党也提出了限制几名阿拉伯候选人参加选举的动议。

paras.en: The Central Elections Committee can vote to bar candidates or lists on certain grounds, such as expressing support for armed conflict against Israel. But the nation’s Supreme Court gets the final say. This month, it rejected a challenge to the Joint List, a merger of three majority-Arab parties, and to Raam, a historically Islamist party led by Mansour Abbas, who is running with Yoav Segalovitz, a former deputy minister of national security who was previously in the centrist Zionist party There Is a Future.
paras.zh: 中央选举委员会可以以某些理由投票禁止候选人或名单，例如表达支持针对以色列的武装冲突。但国家最高法院拥有最终决定权。本月，它拒绝了对“联合名单”（三个占多数阿拉伯政党的合并）以及对由曼苏尔·阿巴斯领导的历史上伊斯兰主义政党拉姆的挑战，阿巴斯与前国家安全部副部长约阿夫·塞加洛维茨一起竞选，后者曾在中间派犹太复国主义政党“有未来”中任职。

paras.en: In 2022, turnout in five of the largest Arab localities in Israel was lower, sometimes significantly, than the national figures. This year, officials in Arab communities worked to get voters to the polls in larger numbers and prepared for potential resistance.
paras.zh: 2022 年，以色列五个最大的阿拉伯地区的投票率低于全国数字，有时甚至显着低于全国数字。今年，阿拉伯社区的官员努力让更多选民参加投票，并为潜在的阻力做好了准备。

paras.en: Likud and the Religious Zionism party announced plans this month to deploy thousands of religious Jewish “observers” to “prevent fraud in voting and vote-counting in Arab communities.”
paras.zh: 利库德集团和宗教犹太复国主义党本月宣布计划部署数千名宗教犹太“观察员”，以“防止阿拉伯社区的投票和计票欺诈”。

paras.en: Critics contend that the presence of such observers, likely from far-right Zionist parties, was intended to intimidate Arab citizens of Israel, who make up 20 percent of the population and could be critical to the election’s outcome.
paras.zh: 批评者认为，这些观察员的出现可能来自极右犹太复国主义政党，目的是恐吓以色列的阿拉伯公民，他们占以色列人口的 20%，可能对选举结果至关重要。

paras.en: “The main issue we want to avoid is ‘fake news,’” said Abed Shahada, who leads voter turnout efforts for an organization representing mayors and other officials in Arab localities.
paras.zh: “我们要避免的主要问题是‘假新闻’，”代表阿拉伯地区市长和其他官员的组织负责选民投票率工作的阿贝德·沙哈达 (Abed Shahada) 说。

paras.en: One major issue expected to drive voters is high crime in Arab communities. But if there are reports of or disinformation about criminal or violent episodes on Election Day that could keep people from the polls, Mr. Shahada said, teams are preparing by setting up a system to share verified information.
paras.zh: 预计将推动选民投票的一大问题是阿拉伯社区的高犯罪率。但沙哈达表示，如果选举日有关于犯罪或暴力事件的报道或虚假信息可能导致人们无法参加投票，各团队正在准备建立一个系统来共享经过验证的信息。

paras.en: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel accused Arab citizens of “trying to steal the elections” on Tuesday, as he repeatedly used brazen and overtly racial appeals to push his right-wing base to vote.
paras.zh: 周二，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡指责阿拉伯公民“试图窃取选举”，因为他多次利用公然和公开的种族诉求来推动其右翼基地投票。

paras.en: “There are buses heading to the polls and long lines in Arab towns. Meanwhile, right-wing strongholds have yet to wake up!” he said on social media. “If we don’t go vote now, we will find ourselves with a government of Arab parties.”
paras.zh: “有巴士前往投票站，阿拉伯城镇里排着长队。与此同时，右翼据点还没有苏醒！”他在社交媒体上说道。 “如果我们现在不去投票，我们就会发现自己是一个由阿拉伯政党组成的政府。”

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu has a long track record of appealing to his supporters by invoking the specter of the Arab vote. Arab citizens represent about 20 percent of Israel’s population, but have long complained that they are treated as second-class citizens and subject to discrimination.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡先生长期以来一直通过援引阿拉伯投票的幽灵来吸引他的支持者。阿拉伯公民约占以色列人口的 20%，但长期以来一直抱怨他们被视为二等公民并受到歧视。

paras.en: In 2015, Mr. Netanyahu called on right-wing Israelis to vote because “Arabs were heading in droves to the polls.” His comments were widely condemned at home and abroad, including by the Obama administration. Mr. Netanyahu was accused of race-baiting and was forced to issue an apology for the remark.
paras.zh: 2015年，内塔尼亚胡先生呼吁右翼以色列人投票，因为“阿拉伯人成群结队地前往投票站”。他的言论遭到国内外的广泛谴责，其中包括奥巴马政府。内塔尼亚胡被指控进行种族诱饵，并被迫为该言论道歉。

paras.en: On Tuesday, as initial data showed high turnout in Arab cities and towns, Mr. Netanyahu again used almost the same language to vilify Arab voters in several different statements over the course of the day.
paras.zh: 周二，初步数据显示阿拉伯城镇的投票率很高，内塔尼亚胡先生在当天的几份不同声明中再次使用几乎相同的语言来诽谤阿拉伯选民。

paras.en: “They say their voters are heading to the polls in droves. You too must head to the polls in droves,” Mr. Netanyahu said in a video statement, addressing right-wing voters.
paras.zh: “他们说他们的选民将成群结队地前往投票站。你们也必须成群结队地前往投票站，”内塔尼亚胡在视频声明中对右翼选民说道。

paras.en: Yousef Jabareen, who leads the Joint List alliance of Arab parties, accused Mr. Netanyahu of “inciting against Arab citizens and undermining the legitimacy of our vote.”
paras.zh: 阿拉伯政党联合名单联盟的领导人优素福·贾巴林指责内塔尼亚胡“煽动反对阿拉伯公民并破坏我们投票的合法性”。

paras.en: “I’m telling you: the Arab community knows how to punish you,” Mr. Jabareen said. “Today we’re sending you and your bloodstained government packing.”
paras.zh: “我告诉你：阿拉伯社会知道如何惩罚你，”贾巴林先生说。 “今天我们要送你和你沾满血迹的政府走人。”

paras.en: Arab citizens have tended to vote at lower rates than their Jewish counterparts. But in the run-up to this election, surveys suggested that they would turn out in higher numbers in an effort to vote out Mr. Netanyahu and his far-right allies. In Rahat, a large Bedouin town in southern Israel, turnout just before 5 p.m. was already at 60 percent — matching the town’s final turnout in the previous election.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯公民的投票率往往低于犹太公民。但在这次选举前夕，调查显示，为了推翻内塔尼亚胡先生及其极右翼盟友，他们的投票人数会更高。在以色列南部的一个贝都因人大城镇拉哈特，下午 5 点左右就有人参加投票。已经达到 60%——与该镇上次选举的最终投票率相当。

paras.en: Mr. Netanyahu’s Likud party and some hard-right ministers in his government have also deployed incendiary messaging to appeal to supporters to vote.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团和政府中的一些极右翼部长也发布了煽动性信息，呼吁支持者投票。

paras.en: The Likud party released images suggesting that there had been higher turnout in the Arab city of Rahat than Bat Yam, a Likud stronghold, which it called “a state of emergency.”
paras.zh: 利库德集团发布的图像显示，阿拉伯城市拉哈特的投票率高于利库德集团据点巴特亚姆，该党称其为“紧急状态”。

paras.en: Another poster showed women in Muslim religious veils with the caption: “Right-wing voters, don’t stay home.”
paras.zh: 另一张海报上展示了戴着穆斯林宗教面纱的妇女，并配上标题：“右翼选民，不要呆在家里。”

paras.en: Itamar Ben-Gvir, the far-right national security minister, joined in the prime minister in trying to stoke fears over high Arab turnout. In a video filmed near the entrance of the Arab town of Kufr Qassim in central Israel, he said that Arab voters were heading to the polls “at hitherto never-before-seen rates,” threatening Israel’s Jewish character.
paras.zh: 极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔 (Itamar Ben-Gvir) 与总理一起试图引发人们对阿拉伯国家高投票率的担忧。在以色列中部阿拉伯小镇库夫尔卡西姆入口附近拍摄的一段视频中，他说阿拉伯选民“以前所未有的速度”前往投票站，这威胁到了以色列的犹太性格。

paras.en: The prime minister also pointed to the arrests of three people suspected of planning to bribe voters for Raam, an Arab Israeli party, on Tuesday. Dean Livne, the acting director of Israel’s central elections committee, told reporters that there were no reports of widespread irregularities.
paras.zh: 总理还指出，周二逮捕了三名涉嫌计划向阿拉伯以色列政党拉姆选民行贿的人。以色列中央选举委员会代理主任迪安·利夫内告诉记者，没有关于普遍存在违规行为的报道。

paras.en: Lia Lapidot and Johnatan Reiss contributed reporting.
paras.zh: 利亚·拉皮多特和乔纳坦·赖斯贡献了报道。

paras.en: Several people whose relatives were killed or taken hostage in the Hamas-led attack on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, are running for office in Tuesday’s election, the first national vote since the assault, which shook the country’s foundations and ignited its longest war.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击中，有几名亲属被杀或被劫为人质，他们正在周二的选举中竞选公职，这是袭击事件发生以来的首次全国投票，这次袭击动摇了该国的根基，并引发了最长的战争。

paras.en: The October 2023 assault looms large over this week’s vote. There are sharp divisions over who was to blame for failing to prevent the worst military, intelligence and policy disaster in Israel’s history.
paras.zh: 2023 年 10 月的袭击事件在本周的投票中显得尤为突出。对于谁应该为未能阻止以色列历史上最严重的军事、情报和政策灾难承担责任，存在着尖锐的分歧。

paras.en: About 1,200 civilians and soldiers were killed that day, according to the Israeli authorities, and roughly 250 were taken hostage to Gaza. Many of the family members of hostages held by Hamas rose to prominence as they campaigned for their loved ones in television interviews and at nationwide protests.
paras.zh: 据以色列当局称，当天约 1,200 名平民和士兵被杀，约 250 人在加沙被扣为人质。许多被哈马斯扣押的人质家属因在电视采访和全国抗议活动中为亲人争取权益而声名鹊起。

paras.en: Most of them called for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to take responsibility for the government’s failures of Oct. 7 and to prioritize negotiating the release of the hostages over continued fighting. Others supported Mr. Netanyahu’s right-wing government and urged it to keep up the military pressure on Hamas and Israel’s other enemies.
paras.zh: 他们中的大多数人呼吁总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡对政府10月7日的失败承担责任，并优先考虑释放人质的谈判而不是继续战斗。其他人支持内塔尼亚胡的右翼政府，并敦促其继续对哈马斯和以色列的其他敌人施加军事压力。

paras.en: Parties from across Israel’s political spectrum have recruited candidates from what have become known as the Oct. 7 families. Here are some of the candidates with a chance to win a seat in Parliament:
paras.zh: 以色列各个政治派别的政党都从所谓的“10 月 7 日家族”中招募了候选人。以下是一些有机会赢得议会席位的候选人：

paras.en: Shira Shapiro is running with Yashar, the centrist party led by Mr. Netanyahu’s main political rival, Gadi Eisenkot. Ms. Shapiro’s son, Staff Sgt. Aner Shapiro, was on leave from the army on Oct. 7 when he attended the Nova music festival, one of the bloodiest targets of the Hamas-led attack. He took shelter in a crowded roadside bomb shelter and stationed himself by the entrance when gunmen attacked it. As the militants hurled grenades inside, Sergeant Shapiro repeatedly caught the grenades and threw them back out, until he was killed, according to surviving witnesses.
paras.zh: 希拉·夏皮罗与内塔尼亚胡主要政治对手加迪·艾森科特领导的中间派政党“亚沙尔”一起竞选。夏皮罗女士的儿子，参谋军士。 10 月 7 日，阿纳尔·夏皮罗 (Aner Shapiro) 正在休假，当时他参加了诺瓦音乐节，这是哈马斯领导的袭击中最血腥的目标之一。他躲进了一个拥挤的路边防空洞，并在枪手袭击时站在入口处。据幸存的目击者称，当武装分子向里面投掷手榴弹时，夏皮罗中士多次接住手榴弹并将其扔出去，直到他被杀。

paras.en: Zvi Mor, the father of a released hostage, Eitan Mor, is running as a candidate for the far-right party Religious Zionism, headed by Bezalel Smotrich. While Eitan was in captivity, Mr. Mor, an educator, founded a forum of right-wing parents of hostages and soldiers who opposed making deals with Hamas and pushed for Israel to defeat the group militarily.
paras.zh: 兹维·莫尔 (Zvi Mor) 是被释放人质埃坦·莫尔 (Eitan Mor) 的父亲，他正在作为贝扎雷尔·斯莫特里奇 (Bezalel Smotrich) 领导的极右翼政党宗教犹太复国主义的候选人竞选。在埃坦被囚禁期间，教育家莫尔先生成立了一个由人质和士兵的右翼父母组成的论坛，他们反对与哈马斯达成协议，并推动以色列在军事上击败该组织。

paras.en: Omri Ronen, a reserve soldier, is running with the left-wing Democrats, led by Yair Golan. His grandmother, Nira Ronen, was killed in her home in Kfar Aza, one of the border communities worst hit in the October 2023 attack, along with her Filipina caregiver, Angelyn Aguirre. Before Oct. 7, Mr. Ronen had been one of the leaders of a grass-roots group of reservists protesting the government’s plan to overhaul the judiciary. He said in a recent television interview that Mr. Netanyahu, whom he called “Mr. Oct. 7,” must go. “The word responsibility has meaning,” he said.
paras.zh: 预备役士兵奥姆里·罗南 (Omri Ronen) 与亚伊尔·戈兰 (Yair Golan) 领导的左翼民主党一起竞选。他的祖母尼拉·罗南 (Nira Ronen) 在位于卡法阿扎 (Kfar Aza) 的家中丧生，卡法阿扎是 2023 年 10 月袭击中受灾最严重的边境社区之一，她的祖母尼拉·罗南 (Nira Ronen) 和她的菲律宾看护人安吉琳·阿吉雷 (Angelyn Aguirre) 一起丧生。 10 月 7 日之前，罗南是草根预备役军人团体的领导人之一，抗议政府改革司法系统的计划。他在最近的一次电视采访中表示，被他称为“10 月 7 日先生”的内塔尼亚胡先生必须下台。 “责任这个词是有意义的，”他说。

paras.en: Rafael Ben Shitrit, a former mayor of Beit Shean in northern Israel, is in Yisrael Beitenu, a right-wing opposition party led by Avigdor Liberman. Mr. Ben Shitrit used to belong to Mr. Netanyahu’s conservative Likud party, but abandoned it after his son, Staff Sgt. Elroy Ben Shitrit, was killed in battle on Oct. 7 near the Gaza border. He has been an advocate for an independent state inquiry into what went wrong that day. Mr. Netanyahu has refused such an inquiry, and the opposition parties have pledged to establish one if they are elected.
paras.zh: 以色列北部拜特谢安市前市长拉斐尔·本·希特里特 (Rafael Ben Shitrit) 是阿维格多·利伯曼 (Avigdor Liberman) 领导的右翼反对党以色列贝特努 (Yisrael Beitenu) 党员。本·希特里特曾属于内塔尼亚胡领导的保守派利库德集团，但在他的儿子参谋军士。埃尔罗伊·本·希特里特 (Elroy Ben Shitrit) 于 10 月 7 日在加沙边境附近的战斗中阵亡。他一直主张对当天发生的问题进行独立的国家调查。内塔尼亚胡先生拒绝了这样的调查，而反对党则承诺如果当选，将进行这样的调查。

paras.en: Sharon Sharabi, also on Yisrael Beitenu’s list of candidates, is the brother of Eli Sharabi, a former hostage who was released from Gaza only to learn that his wife and two teenage daughters had been killed during the Oct. 7 attack. Another brother, Yossi Sharabi, was also taken hostage and killed after 100 days in captivity. Sharon Sharabi campaigned tirelessly for his brothers’ return. When Eli Sharabi was finally released, many Israelis were outraged over how emaciated he looked. “I was shocked,” Sharon said at the time. “I’d been told he would be thin, but I didn’t imagine how thin. It was extreme.”
paras.zh: 莎伦·沙拉比 (Sharon Sharabi) 也在以色列贝特努 (Yisrael Beitenu) 的候选人名单上，他是前人质伊莱·沙拉比 (Eli Sharabi) 的兄弟，后者从加沙获释后才得知他的妻子和两个十几岁的女儿在 10 月 7 日的袭击中丧生。另一位兄弟尤西·沙拉比 (Yossi Sharabi) 也被扣为人质，并在被囚禁 100 天后被杀害。莎朗·沙拉比不知疲倦地为他兄弟的回归而努力。当伊莱·沙拉比最终被释放时，许多以色列人对他憔悴的样子感到愤怒。 “我很震惊，”莎伦当时说道。 “有人告诉我他会很瘦，但我没想到会瘦到什么程度。这太极端了。”

paras.en: Tali Gvili, running with Mr. Netanyahu’s Likud party, is the mother of Master Sgt. Ran Gvili, a member of a police counterterrorism unit who was shot and severely wounded in combat on Oct. 7 and then dragged into Gaza. His remains were recovered and returned to Israel in January 2026. The Gvili and Netanyahu families have become close, and the prime minister attended Sergeant Gvili’s state funeral, saying, “Our souls are bound with yours.”
paras.zh: 塔利·格维利 (Tali Gvili) 是内塔尼亚胡领导的利库德集团的竞选人，也是军士长的母亲。兰·格维利 (Ran Gvili) 是一名警察反恐部队成员，10 月 7 日在战斗中中弹并受重伤，随后被拖入加沙。他的遗体于 2026 年 1 月被找到并送回以色列。格维利和内塔尼亚胡家族关系密切，总理出席了格维利中士的国葬，并表示：“我们的灵魂与你们息息相关。”

paras.en: Michal Hirsch Negri is running with Together, a joint slate led by right-wing politician Naftali Bennett and the centrist Yair Lapid. Ms. Hirsch Negri’s son Maj. Roee Negri was killed fighting in Kibbutz Be’eri near the Gaza border on Oct. 7.
paras.zh: 米哈尔·赫希·内格里 (Michal Hirsch Negri) 与“Together”一起竞选，该组织由右翼政治家纳夫塔利·贝内特 (Naftali Bennett) 和中间派亚伊尔·拉皮德 (Yair Lapid) 领导。赫希·内格里 (Hirsch Negri) 女士的儿子罗伊·内格里 (Roee Negri) 少校于 10 月 7 日在加沙边境附近的贝埃里基布兹 (Kibbutz Be’eri) 的战斗中丧生。

paras.en: Maj. Shahar Varon, a commander in the reserves, is another Together candidate. He fought that day in Kfar Aza, another border community, and later went to fight in Gaza. He was wounded in battle, then went back into Gaza to fight again. “There is life before October 7th, and there is life after,” he wrote recently, adding, “Our government disappeared that morning — but our people showed up instead.”
paras.zh: 预备队指挥官沙哈尔·瓦隆少校是另一位“团结起来”的候选人。那天他在另一个边境社区卡法阿扎作战，后来又前往加沙作战。他在战斗中受伤，然后返回加沙再次参加战斗。 “10 月 7 日之前还有生活，之后也有生活，”他最近写道，并补充道，“那天早上我们的政府消失了，但我们的人民却出现了。”

paras.en: For decades, Israel had virtually unanimous support among Republicans and Democrats in Congress, a reflection of a broader consensus in the United States in favor of strong backing for the Jewish state.
paras.zh: 几十年来，以色列几乎得到了国会共和党和民主党的一致支持，这反映出美国国内更广泛的共识，即大力支持这个犹太国家。

paras.en: But that consensus began to fray several years ago and has recently threatened to unravel altogether as Democrats have shifted drastically and rapidly from unequivocal support for Israel, reflecting a sea change in Americans’ views.
paras.zh: 但这种共识几年前就开始出现问题，并且最近有可能完全瓦解，因为民主党迅速彻底改变了对以色列的明确支持，反映出美国人观点的巨大变化。

paras.en: Since the Hamas-led attack on Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, and the war in Gaza that followed, a growing number of Democrats have been under pressure from younger and progressive voters who are a crucial part of their base.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年 10 月 7 日哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击以及随后的加沙战争以来，越来越多的民主党人一直面临来自年轻和进步选民的压力，这些选民是他们的基本盘的重要组成部分。

paras.en: Lawmakers have begun rebuking Israel in ways that were once unimaginable. They have pointed to tens of thousands of Palestinian civilians killed in Gaza and focused much of their ire on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel, whose actions and policies have left his country diplomatically isolated and who has become a political lightning rod in the United States. That has put at risk the bipartisan support for military aid that Israel has always counted on from American lawmakers.
paras.zh: 立法者开始以以前难以想象的方式谴责以色列。他们指出数以万计的巴勒斯坦平民在加沙被杀，并将大部分愤怒集中在以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡身上，内塔尼亚胡的行动和政策使以色列在外交上受到孤立，并已成为美国的政治避雷针。这使得以色列一直指望美国立法者对军事援助的两党支持面临风险。

paras.en: A handful of far-right Republicans and libertarians in Congress have also questioned U.S. support for Israel, raising concern about Palestinian deaths and spending American money to defend a far-off ally. But the skepticism is far more widespread among Democrats.
paras.zh: 国会中的少数极右翼共和党人和自由主义者也质疑美国对以色列的支持，引发了对巴勒斯坦人死亡的担忧，并花费美国的钱来保卫一个遥远的盟友。但这种怀疑在民主党人中更为普遍。

paras.en: The midterm elections have been shaped in part by Democratic voters’ mounting hostility toward Israel. Party leaders now view the issue as one of the major fault lines they will have to contend with next year if they win back control of Congress in November.
paras.zh: 中期选举的部分原因是民主党选民对以色列日益增长的敌意。党派领导人现在认为，如果他们在 11 月重新夺回国会的控制权，他们明年必须应对的主要问题之一就是这个问题。

paras.en: Over the past year, almost half of House Democrats voted to cut off aid to Israel. Democratic leaders who have long been staunch allies have said that the U.S.-Israeli relationship needs a fundamental reset, including a rethinking of the 10-year memorandum of understanding that commits billions of dollars of annual security aid to Israel, which will soon expire.
paras.zh: 去年，近一半的众议院民主党人投票决定切断对以色列的援助。长期以来一直是坚定盟友的民主党领导人表示，美以关系需要从根本上重新调整，包括重新考虑即将到期的十年谅解备忘录，该备忘录每年向以色列提供数十亿美元的安全援助。

paras.en: And Senator Chuck Schumer, Democrat of New York and the minority leader, who is the highest-ranking Jewish official in the nation, has condemned Mr. Netanyahu on the Senate floor and called for new leadership in Israel.
paras.zh: 纽约民主党参议员查克·舒默(Chuck Schumer)、少数党领袖、全国最高级别的犹太官员在参议院谴责了内塔尼亚胡先生，并呼吁以色列建立新的领导层。

paras.en: In recent weeks, top Democrats in the House and the Senate have proposed legislation that would impose sanctions on Israel for building settlements, making clear to Israeli companies and banks that they could be penalized for ties to such activity.
paras.zh: 最近几周，众议院和参议院的民主党高层提出了一项立法，将对以色列修建定居点实施制裁，向以色列公司和银行明确表示，他们可能会因与此类活动有关而受到惩罚。

paras.en: Those moves are in line with what lawmakers are hearing from voters.
paras.zh: 这些举措与立法者从选民那里听到的内容一致。

paras.en: A New York Times/Siena national poll conducted in May found that 74 percent of Democratic voters opposed providing additional economic and military support to Israel. A Pew Research Center poll in April found that eight in 10 Democrats and Democratic-leaning independents had an unfavorable view of Israel.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》/锡耶纳 5 月份进行的一项全国民意调查发现，74% 的民主党选民反对向以色列提供额外的经济和军事支持。皮尤研究中心四月份的一项民意调查发现，十分之八的民主党人和倾向民主党的独立人士对以色列持负面看法。

articles.title: Billboard Latin Music Awards 2026 Was a Ratings Hit
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: The numbers are in: The 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards was a No. 1 hit.
paras.zh: 数据如下： 2026 年公告牌拉丁音乐奖排名第一。

paras.en: Presented Thursday, Oct. 22, the annual celebration of Latin music enjoyed a “strong multiplatform performance,” broadcaster Telemundo reports, to rank No. 1 in Spanish-language television for the 7pm-11pm primetime spot.
paras.zh: 广播公司 Telemundo 报道称，10 月 22 日星期四举行的拉丁音乐年度庆典享受了“强大的多平台表演”，在晚上 7 点至 11 点黄金时段在西班牙语电视节目中排名第一。

paras.en: The broadcaster averaged 335,000 adults (18-49) and 1.1 million total viewers, according to data provided by Nielsen, peaking at 8:30pm with 400,000 adults (18-49) and 1.2 million total viewers.
paras.zh: 根据尼尔森提供的数据，该广播公司平均有 335,000 名成年人（18-49 岁）和 110 万总观众，高峰时间为晚上 8:30，有 400,000 名成年人（18-49 岁）和 120 万总观众。

paras.en: At the same time, Telemundo’s digital platforms and social channels captured 306 million total views, up 57% from the 2025 edition, with fans watching a combined 29.7 million minutes, a 41% gain against 2025.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Telemundo 的数字平台和社交渠道总观看次数达到 3.06 亿次，比 2025 年增长 57%，粉丝观看时间总计 2970 万分钟，比 2025 年增长 41%。

paras.en: The 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards also powered “significant social engagement,” according to Talkwalker Social Content Ratings, for a No. 1 ranking across all TV in total social video views and the leading broadcast program of the day, regardless of language. Facebook, TikTok and Instagram led the way, while on YouTube, viewing minutes more than doubled (+101% vs. 2025), fueled by expanded livestream coverage.
paras.zh: 根据 Talkwalker 社交内容评级，2026 年 Billboard 拉丁音乐奖还推动了“显着的社交参与度”，在所有电视节目中，其社交视频总观看次数和当天领先的广播节目（无论语言如何）均排名第一。 Facebook、TikTok 和 Instagram 处于领先地位，而在 YouTube 上，由于直播覆盖范围扩大，观看时间增加了一倍多（与 2025 年相比增加 101%）。

paras.en: With eight awards, plus the Billboard Vanguard Award, Fuerza Regida was the big winner at the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards. Although not present, Bad Bunny was close behind with seven trophies, while Karol G, Peso Pluma and Romeo Santos won four each. Rosalía, Tito Double P and Prince Royce each took home three.
paras.zh: Fuerza Regida 凭借八项大奖以及 Billboard Vanguard 奖成为 2026 年 Billboard 拉丁音乐奖的大赢家。尽管没有出席，Bad Bunny 仍紧随其后，获得了 7 个奖杯，而 Karol G、Peso Pluma 和 Romeo Santos 各赢得了 4 个奖杯。 Rosalía、Tito Double P 和 Prince Royce 各获得三枚。

paras.en: The ceremony aired live on Telemundo and Peacock from James L. Knight Center in Miami, FL, and featured 47 categories spanning major Latin music genres such as pop, tropical, Latin rhythm and regional Mexican. Additionally, for the first time fans had a historic opportunity to choose one of the night’s winners through a new award, Fan Favorite Artist, which went to Karol G.
paras.zh: 颁奖典礼在佛罗里达州迈阿密 James L. Knight 中心的 Telemundo 和 Peacock 频道现场直播，共有 47 个类别，涵盖流行、热带、拉丁节奏和墨西哥地方音乐等主要拉丁音乐流派。此外，粉丝们第一次有历史性的机会通过新奖项“粉丝最喜爱艺术家”来选择当晚的获奖者之一，该奖项颁给了 Karol G.

paras.en: During the show, Cristian Castro was saluted with the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award for his enduring and exceptional career; and Rubén Blades received the Billboard Icon Award, celebrating his timeless career in Latin music.
paras.zh: 演出期间，克里斯蒂安·卡斯特罗因其持久而杰出的职业生涯而获得公告牌终身成就奖。和 Rubén Blades 获得了公告牌偶像奖，庆祝他在拉丁音乐领域永恒的职业生涯。

articles.title: Zara Larsson Smashes Venue Record at NZ’s Spark Arena
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: Zara Larsson is in a record-breaking mood.
paras.zh: 扎拉·拉尔森 (Zara Larsson) 的心情打破了纪录。

paras.en: The Swedish pop star has just completed her sold-out Midnight Sun Tour of Australia and New Zealand, which wrapped with an historic two-night stand at Auckland’s Spark Arena.
paras.zh: 这位瑞典流行歌星刚刚完成了她的澳大利亚和新西兰午夜阳光巡演，门票全部售完，巡演最后在奥克兰 Spark Arena 举行了历史性的两晚演出。

paras.en: Larsson welcomed 12,796 fans to her first show on Sunday, Oct. 25, busting Spark Arena’s all-time record, according to Live Nation, which promoted the tour and operates the venue.
paras.zh: 据宣传此次巡演并运营该场馆的 Live Nation 称，拉尔森于 10 月 25 日星期日迎来了 12,796 名粉丝参加她的首场演出，打破了 Spark Arena 的历史纪录。

paras.en: The following night, Oct. 26, she raised the bar again with 12,798 attendees. That’s 25,594 fans across the two nights, another record for the country’s biggest arena, which opened its doors to the public in 2007.
paras.zh: 第二天晚上，也就是 10 月 26 日，她再次提高了参加人数，达到了 12,798 名。两晚共吸引了 25,594 名球迷，这是该国最大体育场的另一项纪录，该体育场于 2007 年向公众开放。

paras.en: “Zara’s meteoric rise is unparalleled and a reflection of her talent, her warmth, and the genuine connection she has with fans around the world,” comments Mike Ross, tour promoter, Live Nation. “Breaking the all-time record at Spark Arena is a rarefied achievement amongst the many legendary names who have played the venue over the last 19 years – to do it twice, on consecutive nights, is incredible.”
paras.zh: Live Nation 巡演发起人 Mike Ross 评论道：“Zara 的迅速崛起是无与伦比的，反映了她的才华、她的热情以及她与世界各地粉丝的真诚联系。” “对于过去 19 年来在 Spark Arena 打球的众多传奇人物来说，在 Spark Arena 打破历史记录是一项罕见的成就 - 连续两晚打破这一记录真是令人难以置信。”

paras.en: Linkin Park previously held the record with 12,736 tickets sold for a show in March 2026.
paras.zh: Linkin Park 此前保持着 2026 年 3 月演出门票售出 12,736 张门票的纪录。

paras.en: “We are thrilled that Zara has broken the house record,” adds Mark Gosling, GM, Spark Arena. “It’s great to see artists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible at the arena, and Zara has set a figure that may be hard to beat. Congratulations to Zara and her team from all of us at Spark Arena.”
paras.zh: Spark Arena 总经理 Mark Gosling 补充道：“我们很高兴 Zara 打破了室内纪录。” “很高兴看到艺术家们在竞技场上突破了可能的界限，Zara 树立了一个难以超越的形象。Spark Arena 的所有人都向 Zara 和她的团队表示祝贺。”

paras.en: Earlier, on Friday, Oct. 23, she performed the biggest headline show of her career to almost 18,000 fans at Afterpay Arena in Sydney.
paras.zh: 早些时候，10 月 23 日星期五，她在悉尼 Afterpay Arena 向近 18,000 名粉丝表演了她职业生涯中最盛大的头条秀。

paras.en: For her debut headline tour of Australia and New Zealand, Larsson swept in with 10 shows across six cities, all of them sold out.
paras.zh: 拉尔森在澳大利亚和新西兰的首次头条巡演中，在六个城市举办了 10 场演出，但全部门票全部售空。

paras.en: Larsson got her break at just 10 years of age when she won Talang, the Swedish edition of Got Talent, in 2008. Four years later, she signed a record deal and began building a pop career that would land her seven appearances – and counting – on the Billboard Hot 100 with “Midnight Sun,” “Lush Life,” “Never Forget You” and more.
paras.zh: 2008 年，年仅 10 岁的拉尔森赢得了瑞典版《达人秀》Talang 冠军，从而获得了事业上的突破。四年后，她签署了一份唱片合约，开始了自己的流行事业，凭借《Midnight Sun》、《Lush Life》、《Never Forget You》等歌曲进入公告牌百强单曲榜七次，而且这一数字还在不断增加。

paras.en: She earned a Grammy nomination in February for “Midnight Sun” (for best dance pop recording) and received the breakthrough award at Billboard‘s Women in Music event at the Hollywood Palladium in April.
paras.zh: 2 月份，她凭借《Midnight Sun》获得了格莱美提名（最佳舞曲流行唱片），并于 4 月份在好莱坞 Palladium 举行的公告牌女性音乐活动中获得了突破奖。

paras.en: Earlier this month, The Trevor Project, the leading suicide prevention and crisis intervention organization for LGBTQ+ young people, presented Larsson with its 2026 mental health champion of the year award, celebrating her longstanding advocacy for LGBTQ+ people and her openness about mental health.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，针对 LGBTQ+ 年轻人的领先自杀预防和危机干预组织 The Trevor Project 向 Larsson 颁发了 2026 年度心理健康冠军奖，以表彰她对 LGBTQ+ 人群的长期倡导以及对心理健康的开放态度。

articles.title: BMG Signs Australia’s Parcels to Global Publishing Deal
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: BERLIN, Germany — Parcels is the latest addition to BMG’s music publishing roster.
paras.zh: 德国柏林——Parcels 是 BMG 音乐出版名册上的最新成员。

paras.en: The independent music company will represent the Australian five-piece on a global basis, after signing a deal at the company’s European headquarters in Berlin.
paras.zh: 在该公司位于柏林的欧洲总部签署协议后，这家独立音乐公司将在全球范围内代表澳大利亚五人组。

paras.en: Formed 2014 in Byron Bay, the picturesque beach spot on the most easterly point of Australia, Parcels relocated to the German capital in the mid-2010s, where they set about building their audience and shaping their sound.
paras.zh: Parcels 于 2014 年在澳大利亚最东端风景如画的海滩胜地拜伦湾成立，并于 2010 年代中期迁至德国首都，在那里他们开始培养听众并塑造他们的声音。

paras.en: It proved to be the right move. Daft Punk co-produced their 2017 single “Overnight,” which blew up and opened the gates for an international following, and festival spots everywhere from Coachella to Glastonbury. Parcels have accumulated more than 1.5 billion total career streams across three studio albums and several live efforts.
paras.zh: 事实证明这是正确的举动。 Daft Punk 于 2017 年联合制作了他们的单曲《Overnight》，该单曲一炮而红，为国际追随者以及从科切拉 (Coachella) 到格拉斯顿伯里 (Glastonbury) 等各地的音乐节打开了大门。 Parcels 的三张录音室专辑和多场现场演出已积累了超过 15 亿的职业生涯总流量。

paras.en: Through the new partnership, announced today (Oct. 28), BMG’s global network will “support Parcels’ international ambitions,” a statement reads.
paras.zh: 一份声明称，通过今天（10 月 28 日）宣布的新合作伙伴关系，BMG 的全球网络将“支持 Parcels 的国际雄心”。

paras.en: The publishing agreement was led by Jasper Niebuhr, managing director, BMG Germany / Switzerland / Austria, in close collaboration with the company’s publishing teams across continental Europe, the United Kingdom, North America, and Australia, with key contributions from Alistair Norbury, Monti Olson, and Heath Johns.
paras.zh: 该出版协议由 BMG 德国/瑞士/奥地利董事总经理 Jasper Niebuhr 牵头，与该公司位于欧洲大陆、英国、北美和澳大利亚的出版团队密切合作，其中 Alistair Norbury、Monti Olson 和 Heath Johns 做出了重要贡献。

paras.en: “Parcels are one of the most distinctive and compelling bands of their generation,” comments Niebuhr in a statement. “Their extraordinary musicianship, songwriting, and creative vision have enabled them to build a truly global career on their own terms, without compromising what makes them unique.”
paras.zh: “Parcels 是他们这一代中最独特、最引人注目的乐队之一，”尼布尔在一份声明中评论道。 “他们非凡的音乐才能、歌曲创作和创意视野使他们能够按照自己的方式建立真正的全球职业生涯，同时又不影响他们的独特之处。”

paras.en: With their “Australian roots, creative history in Berlin, and strong presence in the U.S., they embody a truly international spirit,” Niebuhr continues. “We share their ambition to keep pushing boundaries and are excited to bring the strength of our global network to the next chapter of their remarkable journey.”
paras.zh: 尼布尔继续说道，凭借“澳大利亚根源、柏林的创意历史以及在美国的强大影响力，他们体现了真正的国际精神”。 “我们与他们一样有不断突破界限的雄心，并且很高兴能够利用我们全球网络的优势，开启他们非凡旅程的下一个篇章。”

paras.en: The electronic-leaning indie-pop band — Anatole Serret, Jules Crommelin, Louie Swain, Noah Hill, and Patrick Hetherington — dropped a third studio album, LOVED, in 2025, and supported the collection with a world tour that included first-ever U.S. arena headline dates.
paras.zh: 这支偏向电子音乐的独立流行乐队——Anatole Serret、Jules Crommelin、Louie Swain、Noah Hill 和 Patrick Hetherington——于 2025 年发行了第三张录音室专辑《LOVED》，并通过世界巡演支持该专辑，其中包括首次在美国舞台上的头条演出。

paras.en: Ahead of the BMG announcement, Hetherington and Crommelin launched a new project, Dream Boat, which released its debut single “Real!“ on Oct. 21. Separately, Hills launched his own solo project with the album Ok ok now, which dropped last month.
paras.zh: 在 BMG 宣布之前，Hetherington 和 Crommelin 启动了一个新项目 Dream Boat，该项目发行了首张单曲“Real!” 10 月 21 日。另外，Hills 推出了自己的个人项目，专辑《Ok ok now》于上个月发行。

paras.en: “What really stood out to us was the genuine excitement for Parcels across the entire BMG team,” comments Parcels manager Birger Luedemann. “From Berlin to London, the U.S., and Australia, we felt a shared understanding of the band’s vision and a real ambition to build something special together. We’re incredibly excited about this partnership and look forward to bringing some amazing projects to life as we look ahead to what’s next for Parcels.”
paras.zh: “真正让我们印象深刻的是整个 BMG 团队对 Parcels 的真正兴奋，”Parcels 经理 Birger Luedemann 评论道。 “从柏林到伦敦、美国和澳大利亚，我们对乐队的愿景有共同的理解，也有共同打造一些特别的东西的真正雄心。我们对这次合作感到非常兴奋，并期待着在我们展望 Parcels 的下一步的同时，将一些令人惊叹的项目变为现实。”

articles.title: Hollywood Power Players (Like Bela Bajaria and Richard Weitz) Toast Honorees David Nevins and Peter Friedlander at Milestone Saban Clinic Gala
articles.author: Chris Gardner

paras.en: Hollywood power players turned out in full force at Saban Community Clinic’s milestone 50th anniversary gala on Monday evening to toast a few of their own inside the Beverly Hills Hotel’s Crystal Ballroom.
paras.zh: 周一晚上，好莱坞大咖们齐聚一堂，参加了萨班社区诊所 (Saban Community Clinic) 具有里程碑意义的 50 周年庆典，并在比佛利山庄酒店 (Beverly Hills Hotel) 的水晶宴会厅 (Crystal Ballroom) 举杯庆祝。

paras.en: The event raised a whopping $2.2 million for Saban — a network with seven clinics across Los Angeles (and a new 12,000-sq.ft outpost on the way in the Crenshaw corridor) that provide quality healthcare to anyone who walks through the doors — and it did so by packing the ballroom with A-list studio and network executives, agency partners, producers, actors and show creators like Dan Fogelman, Sam Levinson and Jonathan Nolan.
paras.zh: 这次活动为 Saban 筹集了高达 220 万美元的善款。Saban 是一个在洛杉矶拥有 7 家诊所的网络（以及克伦肖走廊上的一个新的 12,000 平方英尺的前哨站），为所有走进大门的人提供优质的医疗服务。为此，Saban 的舞厅里挤满了一流的工作室和网络高管、代理合作伙伴、制片人、演员以及 Dan Fogelman、Sam Levinson 和 Jonathan Nolan 等节目创作者。

paras.en: A majority came to support the cause (growing more urgent by the day) and celebrate the night’s headliner honorees, Amazon MGM Studios’ Peter Friedlander and former Showtime chief David Nevins, while others, however, quipped they couldn’t escape the gravitational pull of event linchpin Ellen Hoberman or longtime Saban champions like event chair Richard Weitz. The WME co-chairman was also responsible for one of the night’s heartwarming moments as he led an impromptu and thunderous round of applause for ousted Netflix chief content officer Bela Bajaria, his fellow event chair, during shared time at the podium at top of the show.
paras.zh: 大多数人来支持这一事业（日趋紧迫），并庆祝当晚的头条新闻获奖者亚马逊米高梅影业的彼得·弗里德兰德和前 Showtime 首席执行官大卫·内文斯，而其他人则打趣说，他们无法逃脱活动关键人物艾伦·霍伯曼或活动主席理查德·韦茨等长期萨班冠军的引力。这位 WME 联合主席还为当晚的一个温馨时刻负责，他在节目顶部的讲台上为被罢免的 Netflix 首席内容官、他的活动主席贝拉·巴贾里亚 (Bela Bajaria) 即兴鼓掌。

paras.en: Weitz first congratulated Friedlander and Nevins for their awards before turning attention to Bajaria, “someone who has tirelessly worked for the industry, been a part of the clinic, and honestly somebody who has changed, I think, the face of Netflix — that’s my friend Bela,” he said. Weitz noted that his comments were not on the teleprompter but he wanted to take a moment to “give it up for her” because “she deserves the love.” Bajaria was ousted and replaced by Peter Rice in a major Netflix shakeup that saw her exit the streamer amid mass layoffs of 1,000 staffers. Weitz also acknowledged that he and Bajaria were Saban honorees together a few years back, “so it’s only fitting that we’re doing this together.”
paras.zh: 韦茨首先祝贺弗里德兰德和内文斯获奖，然后将注意力转向巴贾里亚，“他不知疲倦地为这个行业工作，是诊所的一部分，老实说，我认为他改变了 Netflix 的面貌 - 这就是我的朋友贝拉，”他说。韦茨指出，他的评论不是在提词器上，但他想花点时间“为她放弃它”，因为“她值得爱。”在 Netflix 的一次重大改组中，巴贾里亚被赶下台，并由彼得·赖斯 (Peter Rice) 取代，导致她在大规模裁员 1,000 名员工的情况下退出流媒体。韦茨还承认，几年前他和巴贾里亚一起获得了萨班奖，“所以我们一起做这件事是再合适不过的了。”

paras.en: It wasn’t the only nod to industry tumult from the podium but more on that — and Bajaria’s response to the ballroom love in her first interview since exiting Netflix — later. The current political landscape also played into the night’s festivities. Also at the top of the program, Hoberman noted how President Donald Trump and his administration have rolled back healthcare policies and cut programs like Medicaid, making it harder for vulnerable populations to get care. “If you want change, please vote,” said Hoberman, a philanthropist and longtime Saban advocate who is married to prominent entertainment attorney Tom Hoberman. “We must vote for leaders who will protect healthcare.”
paras.zh: 这并不是唯一一次在讲台上对行业骚动的认可，但后来还有更多这样的事情——以及巴贾里亚在退出 Netflix 后的第一次采访中对舞厅热爱的回应。当前的政治形势也影响了当晚的庆祝活动。同样在该计划的顶部，霍伯曼指出唐纳德·特朗普总统和他的政府如何取消医疗保健政策并削减医疗补助等计划，使弱势群体更难获得护理。 “如果你想要改变，请投票，”霍伯曼说，他是一位慈善家，也是萨班的长期倡导者，嫁给了著名的娱乐律师汤姆·霍伯曼。 “我们必须投票给能够保护医疗保健的领导人。”

paras.en: Jimmy Smits and Wanda De Jesus also shared the podium to praise Saban’s work in the Los Angeles area and introduce an emotional video featuring a woman named Heidy and her family, a clip that detailed their personal story of challenges and triumph under the clinic’s care. Smits also flagged that the current administration has removed longstanding protections against immigration enforcement at clinics, at hospitals, schools and places of worship, a decision he noted that “has left families afraid to seek care and forcing doctors and nurses to take on the added burden of trying to protect patients from fear and intimidation instead of what they’re trained to do, care for others.”
paras.zh: 吉米·斯密茨 (Jimmy Smits) 和万达·德·耶稣 (Wanda De Jesus) 也登上讲台，赞扬萨班在洛杉矶地区的工作，并介绍了一段情感视频，主角是一位名叫海蒂 (Heidy) 的妇女和她的家人，该视频详细介绍了他们在诊所护理下面临的挑战和胜利的个人故事。斯米茨还指出，现任政府取消了诊所、医院、学校和礼拜场所针对移民执法的长期保护措施，他指出，这一决定“让家庭不敢寻求护理，迫使医生和护士承担起额外的负担，试图保护患者免受恐惧和恐吓，而不是他们接受的训练，照顾他人。”

paras.en: Following their remarks, Hoberman’s two children, Eric and Sarah, took the stage in a surprise moment that was not on the program as they honored their mother’s tireless work on behalf of Saban for more than four decades. They offered a heartfelt tribute as their mother looked on in shock before she took to the stage to accept a glass trophy.
paras.zh: 讲话结束后，霍伯曼的两个孩子埃里克和莎拉登上了舞台，这是节目中没有的一个令人惊讶的时刻，因为他们向母亲四十多年来为萨班所做的不懈努力表示敬意。他们表达了由衷的敬意，而他们的母亲在上台接受玻璃奖杯之前震惊地看着。

paras.en: Sarah said she sends invitations by hand, assembles centerpieces, convinces musicians and comedians to donate their time and even dyes towels black to meet performer’s backstage riders. “No task is too big, no detail is too small, and there is absolutely nothing that she won’t do for the clinic. She, along with the doctors and the staff, are quite simply the heartbeat of this organization,” Sarah Hoberman said.
paras.zh: 莎拉说，她亲自发送邀请函，组装中心装饰品，说服音乐家和喜剧演员贡献自己的时间，甚至将毛巾染成黑色，以迎接表演者的后台骑手。 “没有什么任务太大，没有细节太小，她绝对不会为诊所做任何事情。她与医生和工作人员一起，简直就是这个组织的心跳，”莎拉·霍伯曼说。

paras.en: David Hoberman added: “To everyone in this room who’s ever seen Ellen Hoberman’s name pop up on their phone and thought, ‘Oh God, what does she want now?’ Just remember, she’s not calling for herself. She’s calling for the person who needs an eye exam so they can keep working. The child who needs dental care so they can go back to school or the young mother who needs medical care because she has nowhere else to turn.”
paras.zh: 大卫·霍伯曼补充道：“对这个房间里的每个人，如果他们看到艾伦·霍伯曼的名字出现在手机上，就会想，‘天哪，她现在想要什么？’请记住，她不是为自己打电话。她是在为需要眼科检查的人打电话，以便他们能够继续工作。为需要牙科护理的孩子，以便他们能够重返学校，为需要医疗护理的年轻母亲，因为她无处可去。”

paras.en: Actor and comedian Alex Edelman hosted the affair, and took the stage following a dinner break that saw the majority of power executives and attendees break from the their tables and mingle throughout the ballroom. Nevins and Friedlander fielded well wishes, Bajaria stood near the center of the room and chatted up many friends and former colleagues, Levinson caught up with presenter Connie Britton and Edelman shuffled through his notecards.
paras.zh: 演员兼喜剧演员亚历克斯·埃德尔曼 (Alex Edelman) 主持了这次活动，并在晚餐休息后登上舞台，大多数高管和与会者从桌子上站起来，在整个舞厅里混在一起。内文斯和弗里德兰德表达了良好的祝愿，巴贾里亚站在房间中央附近，与许多朋友和前同事聊天，莱文森赶上了主持人康妮·布里顿，埃德尔曼翻阅着他的记事卡。

paras.en: The comedian delivered a brief but rousing set that also touched on politics before hitting on the state of the industry and his own connection to the cause with a father, Elazer Reuven Edelman, who works as a cardiologist at Boston’s Mass General hospital and as a professor at Harvard Medical School.
paras.zh: 这位喜剧演员发表了一段简短而激动人心的演讲，其中也涉及到政治，然后谈到了行业状况以及他自己与父亲埃拉泽·鲁文·埃德尔曼 (Elazer Reuven Edelman) 事业的关系。埃拉泽·鲁文·埃德尔曼是波士顿麻省总医院的心脏病专家，也是哈佛医学院的教授。

paras.en: “Hello, ladies, gentlemen, agents, Ellen’s family, Paramount+ executives holding on for dear life and people too afraid of Richard Weitz to not buy a table,” said Edelman in front of a room that hosted Skydance TV boss George Cheeks, who oversees Paramount+. “By the way, I was sitting next to Walton Goggins and I’ve had two Negronis, so this could go in any direction. What an interesting time for this gala. The entertainment industry obviously is going through some really tough changes, and if you’d like an example, look no further than this podium. A dinner that was hosted by [Conan O’Brien] two years ago and Jimmy Kimmel last year is now being presided over by the seventh lead on Peacock’s The Office spin-off, The Paper, a show that some of you are hearing about for the very first time.”
paras.zh: “大家好，女士们、先生们、经纪人、艾伦的家人、派拉蒙+的高管们以及那些因为害怕理查德·韦茨而不敢不买桌子的人，”埃德尔曼在接待派拉蒙+的Skydance TV老板乔治·奇克斯(George Cheeks)的房间前说道。 “顺便说一句，我坐在沃尔顿·戈金斯旁边，我喝了两杯内格罗尼，所以这可以朝任何方向发展。这个晚会真是一个有趣的时刻。娱乐业显然正在经历一些非常艰难的变化，如果你想要一个例子，看看这个讲台就知道了。两年前由[柯南·奥布莱恩]和去年吉米·金梅尔主持的晚宴现在由《孔雀》衍生剧《办公室》的第七位主演主持， 《澎湃新闻》，你们中的一些人还是第一次听说这个节目。”

paras.en: Then came the political quip with a dig at Trump. “There are so many incredible people in this room, philanthropists, talents, pioneers, previous honorees, like Bela, Pearlena and [Orly Adelson], board members like Dan Fogelman. Dan created Paradise, a show set in the future about an assassinated president, which is both sci-fi and aspirational,” he said as he crossed his fingers with a smirk. “Ellen told me I could do that joke. I’m not kidding.”
paras.zh: 然后是讽刺特朗普的政治俏皮话。 “这个房间里有很多令人难以置信的人，慈善家、人才、先驱、以前的获奖者，如贝拉、皮雷娜和奥利·阿德尔森，还有丹·福格曼等董事会成员。丹创作了《天堂》，这是一部以未来为背景、讲述被暗杀总统的电视剧，既科幻又充满抱负，”他笑着交叉手指说道。 “艾伦告诉我我可以开这个玩笑。我不是在开玩笑。”

paras.en: Britton had the honor of presenting the night’s honoree tribute to Nevins, someone she called “the best TV man I know, and that is no offense to a room full of amazing, amazing TV men.” His trophy, the Lenny Somberg Volunteer Award, came his way for embodying values like “compassion, selfless service, and an unwavering commitment to make a difference and to healthcare as a human right,” Britton said.
paras.zh: 布里顿有幸向内文斯致以当晚的获奖者敬意，她称内文斯为“我认识的最好的电视人，这对一屋子令人惊叹的电视人来说并不是冒犯。”布里顿说，他的奖杯——莱尼·松伯格志愿者奖——体现了“同情心、无私服务、坚定不移地致力于做出改变和将医疗保健作为一项人权”等价值观。

paras.en: “I met David 20 years ago when we started shooting the TV series Friday Night Lights. David was with Imagine at that time and very much in the keeping of all of our experiences on that show, David had a passion and a commitment that far exceeded what his job as an executive producer might have required. Right away, David became part of the fabric of the show,” Britton explained. “He popped up in Austin so often I assumed he had relocated. He would go out for dinner and drinks with all of us after a day of shooting during which he could be usually spotted behind the monitor in tears. We loved when David was around. He was one of us.”
paras.zh: “20 年前，当我们开始拍摄电视剧《星期五夜之光》时，我认识了大卫。当时大卫在 Imagine 工作，并且非常保留了我们在这部剧中的所有经验。大卫的热情和奉献精神远远超出了他作为执行制片人的工作要求。很快，大卫就成为了这部剧的一部分，”布里顿解释道。 “他经常出现在奥斯汀，我以为他已经搬家了。一天的拍摄结束后，他会和我们大家一起出去吃晚饭、喝酒，期间他经常在监视器后面流泪。我们喜欢大卫在身边的时候。他是我们中的一员。”

paras.en: Nevins became such a close collaborator that he even helped Britton lug boxes out of her apartment at the end of the first season. “I think he was wearing a suit jacket. My comforter dragged on the ground as he shoved it into the car. It was generosity at its purest,” she. “That is David.”
paras.zh: 内文斯成为了如此亲密的合作者，他甚至在第一季结束时帮助布里顿将箱子从她的公寓里拖出来。 “我认为他穿着一件西装外套。当他把我的被子塞进车里时，我的被子拖在地上。这是最纯粹的慷慨，”她。 “那是大卫。”

paras.en: “For 30 years, David has given his time, his heart, and his energy to helping the clinic fulfill its promise of compassionate care to those who need it most. His relentless commitment reminds us of the profound difference that one person can make,” she continued. “I’m so proud to call you my friend.”
paras.zh: “30 年来，大卫奉献了自己的时间、真心和精力，帮助诊所兑现为最需要帮助的人提供富有同情心护理的承诺。他不懈的承诺提醒我们一个人可以带来深远的影响，”她继续道。 “我很自豪能称你为我的朋友。”

paras.en: In accepting, Nevins noted how his research into the award’s namesake revealed that Somberg had been killed 50 years ago this week in a botched robbery at the clinic office. “The free clinic that Lenny volunteered in the late ’60s and he eventually ran until his murder was created as a place for people had nowhere else to turn. It was short of money and resources, but it had very clear conviction that people who were poor were undocumented, which wasn’t such an issue in the 1960s, but it’s a huge issue today. People struggling with addiction or living outside the boundaries of what we call respectable society still deserve thoughtful medical care,” he detailed. “And Lenny Somberg was first among those who helped turn that conviction into a reality.”
paras.zh: 内文斯在接受获奖时指出，他对该奖项的同名研究表明，松伯格于 50 年前的本周在诊所办公室的一次拙劣抢劫中被杀。 “莱尼在 60 年代末自愿开设了一家免费诊所，后来他最终经营了一家免费诊所，直到他的谋杀案被创建为一个无处可去的地方。它缺乏资金和资源，但它非常明确地相信穷人没有证件，这在 1960 年代不是一个问题，但在今天却是一个大问题。那些与毒瘾作斗争或生活在我们所谓的受人尊敬的社会界限之外的人仍然应该得到周到的医疗护理，”他详细介绍道。 “莱尼·松伯格是第一个帮助将这一信念变成现实的人。”

paras.en: He then thanked the staff, volunteers, doctors and donors who refuse to let the clinic’s mission disappear. “You turned a small struggling free clinic into a bedrock institution in this city, a city that, by the way, just so happens to have the largest concentration of uninsured patients in the country,” said Nevins, who saved a few charming words for fellow honoree Friedlander. “Even though you’ve only been on the job for a year [at Amazon], you are now the steward of the most stable company in all of Hollywood. So listen, all of us in the Hollywood creative community are rooting hard for you, my friend.”
paras.zh: 然后，他感谢工作人员、志愿者、医生和捐助者，他们拒绝让诊所的使命消失。内文斯说：“你把一家苦苦挣扎的小免费诊所变成了这座城市的基础机构，顺便说一句，这座城市恰好是全国无保险患者最集中的城市。”他为另一位获奖者弗里德兰德保留了几句迷人的话。 “尽管你（在亚马逊）只工作了一年，但你现在是好莱坞最稳定的公司的管理者。所以听着，我们好莱坞创意界的所有人都在努力支持你，我的朋友。”

paras.en: Those in the room cheering him on included Amazon’s Albert Cheng and Sue Kroll, NBCUniversal’s Pearlena Igbokwe, CBS Entertainment President Amy Reisenbach, Sony Pictures Television’s Katherine Pope, Skydance TV’s George Cheeks, Netflix’s Jinny Howe, Warner Bros. TV’s Brett Paul, Fox’s Nick Grad, former Fox Television Group CEO Gary Newman, former NBC and FOX entertainment chief Kevin Reilly, A24 co-founder Ravi Nandan, CAA’s Chris Silbermann and Mitch Rose, attorney Ken Ziffren, Bruce Rosenblum, Jim Packer, A+E’s Barry Jossen, Gersh’s Bob Gersh, attorney Marty Singer, Sony’s Keith LeGoy and Jay Levine, Disney’s Joshua Sussman, Warner Bros.’ Adam Glick and Brett Paul, Lionsgate’s Jim Packer, Sam and Ashley Levinson, actress Peri Gilpin, producer David Friendly, WME’s Sylvie Rabineau and Hilary Zaitz Michael and many more.
paras.zh: 房间里为他加油的人包括亚马逊的Albert Cheng和Sue Kroll、NBCUniversal的Pearlena Igbokwe、CBS娱乐总裁Amy Reisenbach、索尼影视电视台的Katherine Pope、Skydance TV的George Cheeks、Netflix的Jinny Howe、华纳兄弟电视台的Brett Paul、福克斯的Nick Grad、前福克斯电视集团首席执行官加里·纽曼、前NBC和FOX娱乐主管凯文Reilly、A24 联合创始人 Ravi Nandan、CAA 的 Chris Silbermann 和 Mitch Rose、律师 Ken Ziffren、Bruce Rosenblum、Jim Packer、A+E 的 Barry Jossen、Gersh 的 Bob Gersh、律师 Marty Singer、索尼的 Keith LeGoy 和 Jay Levine、迪士尼的 Joshua Sussman、华纳兄弟的 Adam Glick 和 Brett Paul、狮门影业的 Jim Packer、 Sam 和 Ashley Levinson、演员 Peri Gilpin、制片人 David Friends、WME 的 Sylvie Rabineau 和 Hilary Zaitz Michael 等等。

paras.en: A brief musical interlude came courtesy of Aloe Blacc, who performed a three-song set that included “I Need a Dolla,” a tribute to his hero Bill Withers with “Lean on Me” and his hit “Wake Me Up.” Edelman then welcomed Goggins to the stage for the final award of the night, to his good buddy and onetime neighbor Friedlander. But not before a video tribute from some famous faces like Keri Russell, Matthew Rhys, Amanda Seyfried, Uzo Aduba, Noah Centineo, Tom Hanks, Gary Goetzman and Callum Turner.
paras.zh: Aloe Blacc 带来了一段简短的音乐插曲，他表演了一首三首歌曲，其中包括《I Need a Dolla》，用《Lean on Me》和他的热门歌曲《Wake Me Up》向他的英雄 Bill Withers 致敬。随后，爱德曼欢迎戈金斯上台，将当晚的最后一个奖项颁发给他的好朋友、曾经的邻居弗里德兰德。但在此之前，克里·拉塞尔、马修·里斯、阿曼达·塞弗里德、乌佐·阿杜巴、诺亚·琴蒂内奥、汤姆·汉克斯、加里·戈兹曼和卡勒姆·特纳等一些名人的视频致敬。

paras.en: Goggins opened his tribute by detailing how he first met Friedlander 14 years ago when he bought his dream home in a “very, very cool neighborhood,” and it just so happened to be a few doors down from the executive who, at the time, worked at Netflix.
paras.zh: 戈金斯在致辞中详细介绍了 14 年前他第一次见到弗里德兰德的情景，当时弗里德兰德在一个“非常非常酷的社区”买下了自己的梦想之家，而这套房子恰好距离当时在 Netflix 工作的高管只有几扇门。

paras.en: “Now, for the actors in this room, you know exactly what that means. My brain was on fire. I’m living two doors down from a studio executive, Peter Friedlander from Netflix,” he recalled. “I just thought, ‘Man, Peter Friedlander, a studio executive from Netflix is going to get every single idea I’ve ever had.'”
paras.zh: “现在，对于这个房间里的演员来说，你确切地知道这意味着什么。我的大脑着火了。我和工作室主管、Netflix 的彼得·弗里德兰德 (Peter Friedlander) 住的地方只有两扇门，”他回忆道。 “我只是想，‘伙计，Peter Friedlander，Netflix 的工作室主管，他会明白我曾经有过的每一个想法。’”

paras.en: Those pitch meetings never came to fruition, but what filled the void was a lasting friendship. “Most executives, nothing wrong with this, but they learn the business from behind a desk. But Peter learned it standing on a set at five o’clock in the morning in the rain and figuring out finally how to get the thing made,” said Goggins, who now works on an Amazon Prime show in Fallout. “And when you’ve done the work, you never forget the people who do the work. Peter loves talent. He believes in talent, actors, writers, directors. When Peter looks at a set, he doesn’t just see a production. I know this firsthand. He sees every single person who’s pouring themselves into it and he’s got their back. I know because in the last year, he’s had my back.”
paras.zh: 这些推介会议从未取得成果，但填补这一空白的是持久的友谊。 “对于大多数高管来说，这并没有错，但他们是在办公桌后面学习业务的。但彼得是在凌晨五点冒着雨站在片场学习的，并最终弄清楚了如何制作产品，”戈金斯说，他现在在《辐射》的亚马逊 Prime 节目中工作。 “当你完成工作时，你永远不会忘记那些做这项工作的人。彼得热爱人才。他相信人才、演员、编剧、导演。当彼得看布景时，他看到的不仅仅是作品。我亲身经历过这一点。他看到每一个全身心投入其中的人，并且他得到了他们的支持。我知道，因为在去年，他得到了我的支持。”

paras.en: Friedlander, who started his career as a driver for actor Gary Sinise before going on to work for Hanks and Goetzman at Playtone, took a quick walk down memory lane. He recalled how he moved to Los Angeles not to chase Hollywood dreams but to “fulfill my childhood dream and every child’s dream of becoming a career bureaucrat for the city of Los Angeles.” A career in city planning didn’t come to be, but he learned enough about how an urban sprawl functions to know the crucial role of a place like Saban Community Clinic.
paras.zh: 弗里德兰德的职业生涯始于为演员加里·西尼斯 (Gary Sinise) 担任司机，后来又在 Playtone 为汉克斯和戈茨曼工作，他快速地回忆了一遍。他回忆说，他搬到洛杉矶并不是为了追逐好莱坞梦想，而是为了“实现我儿时的梦想，以及每个孩子成为洛杉矶市职业官僚的梦想。”城市规划的职业生涯并没有成为现实，但他对城市扩张的运作方式有了足够的了解，知道像萨班社区诊所这样的地方的关键作用。

paras.en: Friedlander also name-checked a few power players, including Hanks and Goetzman, “the impressive trio” of Cindy Holland, Channing Dungey and Bela at Netflix, and “the formidable” Mike Hopkins at Amazon. It is worth nothing that Friedlander has been in his post at Amazon MGM Studios for a little more than a year overseeing the company’s original TV portfolio in the U.S., global tentpoles and MGM Television and MGM Alternative projects, among other duties. He joined for the chief role after exiting Netflix under Bajaria and Ted Sarandos following a long 14-year tenure.
paras.zh: 弗里德兰德还点名了一些实力人物，包括汉克斯和戈兹曼、Netflix 的“令人印象深刻的三人组”辛迪·霍兰德、查宁·邓吉和贝拉，以及亚马逊的“令人敬畏的”迈克·霍普金斯。弗里德兰德在亚马逊米高梅工作室任职一年多一点，负责监督该公司在美国的原创电视组合、全球主打项目以及米高梅电视和米高梅另类项目等，这一点毫无价值。在巴贾里亚和特德·萨兰多斯领导下的 Netflix 任职长达 14 年之后，他退出了 Netflix，并担任了主要角色。

paras.en: In closing, Friedlander thanked his parents, including his mother who was in the room, and his father who was recuperating at home after falling and undergoing an emergency hip replacement. “I keep thinking about how lucky he was to be able to begin his recovery that quickly, that safely, and that’s not something everyone gets. That’s exactly the point of tonight. Whatever we can do to guarantee that all the people around us, all of them have that same right to that same immediate dignified care, that is what would make tonight a real success.”
paras.zh: 最后，弗里德兰德感谢了他的父母，包括当时在房间里的母亲，以及摔倒后正在家中接受紧急髋关节置换术的父亲。 “我一直在想，他能够这么快、这么安全地开始康复是多么幸运，这不是每个人都能得到的。这正是今晚的重点。无论我们能做什么来保证我们周围的所有人，所有人都拥有同样的权利，立即获得同样有尊严的护理，这将使今晚取得真正的成功。”

paras.en: The night felt like a success for Bajaria, too. After all the awards had been handed out and the event concluded, The Hollywood Reporter asked the veteran executive what it felt like to be making some high-profile rounds so soon after exiting Netflix, and she was direct in keeping her comments focused solely on Saban. But she did say that she’s felt the love since news of her exit broke, and there was never a chance that she would skip attending such a special gathering of friends, colleagues, Saban supporters and industry heavyweights. “It’s just one of those nights,” she said. “It’s such a warm room.”
paras.zh: 对于巴贾里亚来说，这个夜晚也感觉很成功。所有奖项颁发完毕、活动结束后，《好莱坞报道》询问这位资深高管，在退出 Netflix 后这么快就进行一些高调的巡演有何感受，她直接将评论只集中在萨班身上。但她确实表示，自从她退出的消息传出后，她就感受到了人们的爱，她绝不会错过参加这样一个由朋友、同事、萨班支持者和行业重量级人物组成的特殊聚会。 “这只是那些夜晚之一，”她说。 “真是一个温暖的房间。”

paras.en: “I have been part of the Saban Community Clinic for many, many years. I’ve been on the board and I’m a previous honoree. What I love about this event and being here today is it has always been the coming together of the TV community — always. This room is so warm and generous and we support each other,” she said. “And I will say the outpouring that I’ve received in the last couple of weeks has been so beautiful and amazing. I’ve been in television for 30 years, and at this point I have worked with what feels like nearly every single person from agents and producers to writers and actors. I love it. I’m so grateful for the career I have had to date, with lots more to come.”
paras.zh: “我多年来一直是萨班社区诊所的一员。我一直是董事会成员，也是之前的获奖者。我喜欢这次活动以及今天来到这里，因为它一直是电视社区的聚集——一直如此。这个房间如此温暖和慷慨，我们互相支持，”她说。 “我要说的是，过去几周我所收到的热情是如此美丽和令人惊叹。我在电视行业工作了 30 年，在这一点上，我几乎与每一个人合作过，从经纪人、制片人到编剧和演员。我喜欢它。我非常感谢我迄今为止的职业生涯，还有更多的未来。”

articles.title: ‘Snowfall’ Spinoff Boss Malcolm Spellman Lays Out Multi-Season Plan for ‘The Drop,’ Why Season One Was Just a “Dash of What’s Coming”
articles.author: Hilary Lewis

paras.en: [The following story contains spoilers from the first season of Snowfall spinoff The Drop, including the season finale “Hercules.”]
paras.zh: [以下故事包含《降雪》衍生剧《The Drop》第一季的剧透，包括季终集“大力神”。]

paras.en: By the first-season finale of FX‘s Snowfall spinoff The Drop, the record label execs that Wanda (Gail Bean) and Lamar (Asante Blackk) were eager to do business with earlier in the season have turned sinister. After Artillery (Simmie “Buddy” Sims III) and Dara’s (Aleyse Shannon) close friend Keith (Hanad Abdi) is murdered, the label execs try to use his death to drum up free publicity. Then they rush out Artillery and Lamar’s album, swapping in other artists and making it a compilation. Ultimately Wanda, Lamar and Artillery seem to end the season in control of their own destiny. But, according to The Drop showrunner Malcolm Spellman, this is “just the beginning” of the series’ central family’s dalliance with a music industry that doesn’t have its artists’ best interests at heart.
paras.zh: 在 FX 的《Snowfall》衍生剧《The Drop》第一季大结局中，旺达（盖尔·比恩饰）和拉马尔（阿桑特·布莱克饰）在本季早些时候渴望与之开展业务的唱片公司高管变得阴险起来。在 Artillery（西米·“巴迪”·西姆斯三世饰）和达拉（阿丽丝·香农饰）的密友基思（哈纳德·阿卜迪饰）被谋杀后，该厂牌高管试图利用他的死来进行免费宣传。然后他们赶出阿炮利和拉马尔的专辑，交换其他艺术家并将其制作成合辑。最终，旺达、拉马尔和阿炮似乎掌控了自己的命运，结束了这个赛季。但是，根据《The Drop》剧集主管马尔科姆·斯佩尔曼的说法，这只是该剧的核心家族与一个不把艺术家的最大利益放在心上的音乐产业调情的“开始”。

paras.en: “What the audience is seeing in that finale, in the last three episodes, will be completely normal all throughout season two,” Spellman tells The Hollywood Reporter.
paras.zh: “观众在最后三集中看到的结局在整个第二季中都是完全正常的，”斯佩尔曼告诉《好莱坞报道》。

paras.en: Though The Drop has yet to be renewed and Spellman says he has yet to hear from FX about renewal prospects, he says he’s “not worried” and remains confident based on community feedback that the show is a hit.
paras.zh: 尽管《The Drop》尚未续订，而且斯佩尔曼表示他还没有收到 FX 的续订前景，但他表示自己“并不担心”，并且根据社区的反馈，该剧很受欢迎，他仍然充满信心。

paras.en: And he already has a larger vision for the show, including seasons two and three.
paras.zh: 他已经对该剧有了更大的愿景，包括第二季和第三季。

paras.en: “Eventually, the reality of what happens in this story is that money and gangs ruin it from the inside and from the outside. Record executives took a culture and decided it was easier for them to make money pushing violence and gangs and all that shit than conscious hip-hop, and these labels literally destroyed an entire dimension of hip-hop and took it into the gutter over the next 30 years. And I want to show that, and I want to show in a way that is realistic and show the audience how cynical that decision making is, and how inescapable it is,” Spellman says. “I think for season two and moving forward, what I want to get into gradually over let’s call it season two and three because it’s moving very gradually, is the labels, manipulation and destruction of our culture and our burden. How we allow gang culture and money and materialism to rot us from the inside as far as conflict.”
paras.zh: “最终，这个故事中发生的现实是金钱和帮派从内部和外部毁掉了它。唱片公司的高管们接受了一种文化，并认为他们比有意识的嘻哈更容易通过暴力和帮派以及所有这些狗屎来赚钱，而这些标签实际上摧毁了嘻哈的整个维度，并在接下来的 30 年里将其带入阴沟。我想展示这一点，我想以一种现实的方式展示并向观众展示这个决定是多么愤世嫉俗制造就是如此，而且它是多么不可避免，”斯佩尔曼说。 “我认为，对于第二季以及未来，我想逐渐进入第二季和第三季，因为它进展非常缓慢，是对我们的文化和负担的标签、操纵和破坏。就冲突而言，我们如何允许帮派文化、金钱和物质主义从内部腐烂我们。”

paras.en: Speaking to THR, Spellman talks about how even though Wanda and Lamar end the season on their own, the labels will continue to have “all the leverage,” what the future holds for central couple Wanda and Leon (Isaiah John) and why the series is ultimately about family.
paras.zh: 斯佩尔曼在接受《好莱坞报道》采访时谈到，即使旺达和拉马尔独自结束了本季，唱片公司仍将继续拥有“所有影响力”、中心情侣旺达和莱昂（以赛亚·约翰饰）的未来以及为什么该剧最终是关于家庭的。

paras.en: Conceptually where did you want to get the narrative to by the end of the first season?
paras.zh: 从概念上讲，您希望在第一季结束时将叙事发展到什么程度？

paras.en: Narratively, I wanted to thoroughly introduce each of the characters and bring them all to various forms of a crisis point that either exposes their best and worst inclinations. And by the end of season one, they’re just getting into the music business, and the audience should now be indoctrinated to these characters enough that once season two begins, we will have seen everyone either succumb to their inner monster or overcome it. But we know those traits are there. So I wanted to, in a nutshell, end it narratively with they finally broke through, right? But what is really the issue is what these people are on the inside when tested against this kind of journey into the music business. And just really indoctrinating the audience to the era. There is so much people really don’t understand. Like, people are gonna get mad at the masters storyline, the heist, because they don’t understand that’s how primitive the world was back then. If you take the tapes, there is no recourse. These kids who are in the show were like, “This doesn’t make sense.” And I’m like, “You don’t understand.” This is a time where you could have an emergency, and it takes you three days to find the person you love to tell them. Just because they weren’t at home when you called.
paras.zh: 在叙事上，我想彻底介绍每个角色，并将他们全部带到各种形式的危机点，暴露他们最好和最坏的倾向。到第一季结束时，他们刚刚进入音乐行业，观众现在应该对这些角色进行足够的灌输，一旦第二季开始，我们将看到每个人要么屈服于内心的怪物，要么克服它。但我们知道这些特征是存在的。所以我想，简而言之，以他们终于突破的叙事方式结束它，对吗？但真正的问题是，当这些人在音乐行业的这种旅程中经历测试时，他们的内心是什么样的。并且真正向观众灌输了这个时代。确实有很多人不明白。就像，人们会对大师的故事情节、抢劫感到愤怒，因为他们不明白当时的世界是多么原始。如果你拿走了磁带，就没有追索权。节目中的这些孩子会说：“这没有道理。”我说：“你不明白。”这段时间你可能会遇到紧急情况，你需要三天的时间才能找到你爱的人告诉他们。只是因为你打电话时他们不在家。

paras.en: Why did you want to have Wanda and Lamar be betrayed by the label and tease out how the label execs weren’t really protecting and interested in helping them so early on?
paras.zh: 为什么你想让万达和拉马尔被厂牌背叛，并嘲笑厂牌高管为何这么早就没有真正保护他们，也没有兴趣帮助他们？

paras.en: Because I think this is just the beginning of that. If I had 20 episodes, we’d have even gone deeper, but that’ll be season two. If you think about it like this, up ’til episode five, it’s all indoctrination, and then six, seven and eight are very different feeling. They’re a bit more plotty because we’re dealing with a record business story. In real life, these motherfuckers were taking out life insurance policies on the rappers, because you could legally do that back then, and not telling the family or anything. And then when they died, they’d get a million dollars. What you see in those last three episodes is the label is behaving completely normally, and in the ’90s, artists were far less compliant. Artists really considered themselves artists. One of the things we’re going to explore in season two, and what you’re seeing the setup with the label doing this, is this is just as ’91 is when gangster rap begins to overcome and destroy conscious rap, and that is by design by the labels. It was easier for them to make money with negativity, and they just leaned all the way in, and a whole genre of rap died.
paras.zh: 因为我认为这只是一切的开始。如果我有 20 集，我们甚至会更深入，但这将是第二季。这样想的话，到第五集都是灌输，到了第六集、第七集、第八集，感觉就很不一样了。它们更加情节化，因为我们正在处理一个唱片公司的故事。在现实生活中，这些混蛋为说唱歌手购买了人寿保险，因为当时你可以合法地这样做，而不需要告诉家人或任何事情。然后当他们死后，他们会得到一百万美元。在最后三集里你可以看到，唱片公司的行为完全正常，而在 90 年代，艺术家们的顺从程度要低得多。艺术家确实认为自己是艺术家。我们将在第二季中探索的一件事，以及你所看到的厂牌这样做的设置，就是就像 91 年黑帮说唱开始克服并摧毁有意识的说唱一样，这是厂牌设计的。对他们来说，用消极的态度赚钱更容易，他们就全力以赴，整个说唱流派就此消亡。

paras.en: We definitely see that foreshadowing with the label wanting to get publicity around Keith’s death and rush out the album. For Wanda and Lamar, they seemingly end the season on their own. Do you see them as like being independent going forward, or are they still trying to work with the industry?
paras.zh: 我们肯定看到了厂牌想要宣传基思的死并匆忙推出专辑的预兆。对于旺达和拉马尔来说，他们似乎自己结束了这个赛季。您认为他们未来会独立发展，还是仍在尝试与该行业合作？

paras.en: That [going independent] wasn’t really a thing then. The label has all the leverage, and they are going to be forced into very uncomfortable situations, and there is no place to go. There is no other option. Like, what I was trying to tell someone in the comments section is there is no rap industry yet. Rap is not on mainstream radio yet. That happened with Dr. Dre and The Chronic. Rap is not on mainstream radio. What are you gonna do? You’re not gonna do anything. This is it.
paras.zh: 那时[独立]并不是什么真正的事情。厂牌拥有所有的筹码，他们将被迫陷入非常不舒服的境地，而且无处可去。没有其他选择。就像，我想在评论部分告诉某人的是，还没有说唱行业。说唱尚未出现在主流广播电台中。 《Dr. Dre》和《The Chronic》就是这样。说唱不在主流广播中。你要做什么？你什么也不会做。就是这样。

paras.en: With Lamar, we see him return home and apologize for how he reacted when he found out about his mother. He was beaten up, but what do you think it is that makes him come home and apologize and want to seek forgiveness from Mama G (Nicki Micheaux) and be connected to that family again?
paras.zh: 和拉马尔一起，我们看到他回到家，并为他得知母亲的事情后的反应道歉。他被殴打了，但你认为是什么让他回家道歉并想寻求G妈妈（妮琪·米肖饰）的原谅并再次与那个家庭建立联系？

paras.en: So that’s sort of the soul of the show, right? The story of the mother is going to be the story of Lamar, and he’s clinging to that safe place, but he’s going to get pulled away from it in the next season. In a nutshell, for a soundbite: This is a show about a family, a makeshift family, including Artillery and all of them. The music business destroys families, and this family will spend its entire existence in this show trying to survive. What we just saw was a dash of what’s coming.
paras.zh: 所以这就是这部剧的灵魂，对吧？母亲的故事将成为拉马尔的故事，他紧紧抓住那个安全的地方，但他将在下一季中被拉离。简而言之，这是一个关于一个家庭的节目，一个临时家庭，包括炮兵和他们所有人。音乐事业摧毁了家庭，而这个家庭将在这部剧中度过一生，努力生存。我们刚刚看到的只是即将发生的事情的一小部分。

paras.en: What’s Lamar’s headspace at the end of the first season, after he spent so much of it trying to break away from the family?
paras.zh: 在第一季结束时，拉马尔花了这么多时间试图脱离家庭，他的头脑是什么？

paras.en: I just felt like Lamar had a coming of age. Lamar is a genuinely Christian boy who believes in those values and this family. We’ll see it in season two. They’re not just church kids; they believe in those values. Remember when Pastor Rodney (Wren T. Brown) says the line about the prodigal son? We dropped where they had a scene together where they talked about that: the prodigal son has returned from his journey. He is more mature. He will be less selfish, though that will always dwell inside of him. And he now knows after tasting the fires of what the music business is going to be, he needs his family, particularly Wanda and James (Peyton Alex Smith), for him to survive this. So he’s retreating to what he understands and the culture that saved him.
paras.zh: 我只是觉得拉马尔已经成熟了。拉马尔是一个真正的基督徒男孩，他相信这些价值观和这个家庭。我们会在第二季看到它。他们不仅仅是教堂里的孩子；他们也是教堂里的孩子。他们相信这些价值观。还记得罗德尼牧师（雷恩·T·布朗饰）说过关于浪子的那句话吗？我们在他们一起拍戏的地方停下来，他们谈论了这样的事：浪子归来。他更加成熟了。他会变得不那么自私，尽管那将永远存在于他的内心。在经历了音乐行业的火焰之后，他现在知道，他需要他的家人，特别是旺达和詹姆斯（佩顿·亚历克斯·史密斯饰），才能让他生存下去。所以他正在退回到他所理解的以及拯救他的文化中。

paras.en: We see Leon getting much more involved in the music industry throughout the season. And at the end, he gets involved in the scheme against DG (Brandon Mychal Smith) and shoots and kills Deon (Quincy Chad). He’s packing up the legal clinic. Does that mean that Leon’s back in the game and more involved professionally with Wanda and her ambitions going forward?
paras.zh: 我们看到莱昂在整个赛季中更多地参与了音乐行业。最后，他参与了针对DG（布兰登·麦查尔·史密斯饰）的阴谋，并射杀了德昂（昆西·查德饰）。他正在收拾法律诊所。这是否意味着莱昂又回到了游戏中，并且更多地专业地参与了万达及其未来的雄心壮志？

paras.en: Leon had a very mythical journey in season one, and for Isaiah, it was super important for us to get that character to a place that if we want Leon to function as Leon has in Snowfall, he had to go through a redemption thing and deal with his mourning, because of all the shit he went through in the original series. Once that happens, Big Daddy (Mykelti Williamson) sort of sets him free with that story he tells them. That’s Big Daddy’s way of saying men of our age understand that violence is part of the world, as is murder and death. That story he told is the true story of how my wife’s family came to California. People have to understand, the North Hollywood shootout, that’ll never happen again. But we grew up in an era where men put on full body armor and took on the cops. It was a different fucking time in America. And so, for Big Daddy, the lesson he helped Leon learn is that violence will be necessary. And if you’re protecting my family, even stuff like killing that kid in Snowfall has to be excused because you are in these circumstances. So when he picks up that gun, we know Leon is finally ready to get into the music business and protect his family.
paras.zh: 里昂在第一季中经历了一段非常神话般的旅程，对以赛亚来说，让这个角色达到一个高度对我们来说非常重要，如果我们想让里昂像《雪花》中的里昂那样发挥作用，他就必须经历救赎并处理他的哀悼，因为他在原系列中经历了所有的狗屎。一旦发生这种情况，大爸爸（麦凯尔泰·威廉姆森饰）就用他告诉他们的故事让他自由了。这是老爹的说法，我们这个时代的男人明白暴力是世界的一部分，谋杀和死亡也是如此。他讲的这个故事是我妻子的家人如何来到加利福尼亚的真实故事。人们必须明白，北好莱坞的枪战再也不会发生了。但我们成长在一个男人穿上全身盔甲并与警察较量的时代。那是美国的一个不同的时代。因此，对于大爸爸来说，他帮助莱昂学到的教训是暴力是必要的。如果你是在保护我的家人，即使是像在《降雪》中杀死那个孩子这样的事情也必须得到原谅，因为你正处于这种情况下。因此，当他拿起那把枪时，我们知道莱昂终于准备好进入音乐行业并保护他的家人。

paras.en: You can tell he feels reluctant to take a more violent route.
paras.zh: 你可以看出他不愿意采取更暴力的路线。

paras.en: Yeah, it’s killing him. Like that scene in episode five, that’s real, man. He’s looking at all the ghosts. And he’s killed a lot of people.
paras.zh: 是的，这要了他的命。就像第五集中的那个场景一样，那是真的，伙计。他看着所有的鬼魂。而且他杀了很多人。

paras.en: And he was trying to pave a path that was more about helping people and being on the up-and-up.
paras.zh: 他试图开辟一条更多地帮助人们并积极向上的道路。

paras.en: To be a righteous Black man from this environment in ’91, that was a task. Kids complain about shitty jobs today and say we had it easier. And I explain what unemployment means, which is unemployment meant literally for me to get jobs, I had to put in applications at every fast food restaurant throughout the city, and most times they would just say there is no work. That’s what like seven and eight percent unemployment gets you, and it was higher than that sometimes in the ’90s for Black people. So this is it. This is their journey. They do not have other options. And for Leon to go on this journey, it’s going to be very similar to the one he went on in the original Snowfall.
paras.zh: 要在 91 年的这种环境中成为一名正义的黑人，这是一项任务。孩子们抱怨今天的工作很糟糕，并说我们过得更轻松。我解释失业意味着什么，失业实际上意味着我要找到工作，我必须在全市的每一家快餐店提出申请，大多数时候他们只会说没有工作。这就是 7% 和 8% 的失业率所带来的结果，而且这个数字比 90 年代黑人的失业率还要高。所以就是这样。这是他们的旅程。他们没有其他选择。对于莱昂来说，踏上这段旅程将与他在原版《降雪》中经历的旅程非常相似。

paras.en: I’m sure you can’t give too much away, but what would you say about what the future holds for Leon and Wanda as a couple? There’s clearly a deep connection and past there.
paras.zh: 我相信你不能透露太多，但你对莱昂和旺达夫妇的未来有何看法？那里显然有很深的联系和过去。

paras.en: In my opinion, they are the heart of the show, and will they or won’t they should be a major question every fucking season. And sometimes they will find a way to make it work with each other, and sometimes it’ll fall apart. And what season one does is, I think, introduces real stakes, meaning that you really feel like Leon is kind of done with her after that. And we need that for the audience to believe when season two begins that they have to fight for their love. Their story is based on me and my wife’s story. Here’s what the show is: Leon and Wanda is will they, won’t they every season, close calls, falling outs, and everything. And by the end of the [series], they have a wedding. I think they will ultimately be an uplifting story because it’s based on me and my wife, who went through all this shit.
paras.zh: 在我看来，他们是这部剧的核心，他们是否应该成为每个赛季的主要问题。有时他们会找到一种方法使其相互协作，有时又会崩溃。我认为第一季所做的是引入了真正的赌注，这意味着你真的觉得莱昂在那之后就和她结束了。我们需要让观众相信，当第二季开始时，他们必须为自己的爱情而战。他们的故事是根据我和我妻子的故事改编的。这部剧的内容是这样的：莱昂和旺达每一季都会，他们会不会，千钧一发，吵架等等。在[系列]结束时，他们举行了婚礼。我认为它们最终将是一个令人振奋的故事，因为它是基于我和我的妻子经历的所有这些事情。

paras.en: As the show has rolled out, you’ve also released the songs from the series. How has that helped having that original music out there?
paras.zh: 随着节目的推出，你们也发布了该系列的歌曲。这对原创音乐的推出有何帮助？

paras.en: This to me feels like a private party for Black folk right now, and it’s the most fun until the mainstream audience comes. I’m not even saying that’ll ruin it, but right now, with the way the songs are being received and the way the communities [are responding], it’s just been fucking amazing. I just went to San Quentin. Every single prison in this country is locked in on our show, and those are our fans, people who came from this era and who saw it. Those are the people that if we can convince them, then we did the shit right.
paras.zh: 对我来说，这感觉就像是黑人的私人派对，在主流观众到来之前这是最有趣的。我什至不是说这会毁了它，但现在，从歌曲被接受的方式和社区[正在回应]的方式来看，这真是太棒了。我刚去了圣昆廷。这个国家的每一个监狱都锁定了我们的节目，那些人是我们的粉丝，来自这个时代并看到它的人。这些人认为，如果我们能说服他们，那么我们就做得对了。

paras.en: All episodes of the first season of The Drop: A Snowfall Saga are now streaming on Hulu.
paras.zh: 《The Drop: A Snowfall Saga》第一季的所有剧集现已在 Hulu 上播出。
