articles.title: Astronomers discover the secrets of 'string of pearls' supernova relic and the zombie star at its heart
articles.author: Robert Lea

paras.en: Scientists are still learning about a cosmic "string of pearls," a unique celestial relic left by a supernova explosion that humanity witnessed around 850 years ago.
paras.zh: 科学家们仍在了解宇宙“珍珠链”，这是大约 850 年前人类目睹的超新星爆炸留下的独特天体遗迹。

paras.en: That is thanks to the most detailed observation of the dandelion-shaped chains of gas and supernova debris that comprise Pa 30, the only supernova remnant of its type observed in the Milky Way. What makes Pa 30 even more unique is that it has a rare "zombie star" at its heart.
paras.zh: 这要归功于对蒲公英形状的气体链和超新星碎片的最详细的观察，这些气体链和超新星碎片构成了Pa 30，这是在银河系中观察到的唯一的同类超新星遗迹。让Pa 30更加独特的是，它的心脏里有一颗罕见的“僵尸明星”。

paras.en: Supernovas like the one that created Pa 30 are called Type Ia supernovas; they happen when a dead star called a white dwarf overfeeds on a companion star like a cosmic vampire. This overfeeding triggers a runaway nuclear explosion that usually destroys the white dwarf. But on rare occasions, the supernova doesn't completely destroy the star, and a shattered stellar body remains, called a zombie star. These events are called Type Iax supernovas.
paras.zh: 像创造 Pa 30 的超新星这样的超新星被称为 Ia 型超新星；当一颗被称为白矮星的死亡恒星像宇宙吸血鬼一样过度吞噬伴星时，就会发生这种情况。这种过度供给会引发失控的核爆炸，通常会摧毁白矮星。但在极少数情况下，超新星不会完全摧毁恒星，破碎的恒星体仍然存在，称为僵尸星。这些事件被称为 Iax 型超新星。

paras.en: Pa 30 was first identified in 2013 by a citizen scientist in 2013, but scientists soon linked it to a cosmic explosion recorded independently in the year 1181 in Japanese, Chinese, and Arabic historical documentation. That makes this one of only five supernovas seen before the invention of the telescope.
paras.zh: Pa 30 于 2013 年首次被一位公民科学家发现，但科学家们很快将其与日本、中国和阿拉伯历史文献中独立记录的 1181 年宇宙爆炸联系起来。这使得它成为望远镜发明之前仅有的五颗超新星之一。

paras.en: "Reliable historical records of stellar explosions extend back only about a thousand years. For all we know, there might well be similar remnants still lurking in the dark in our own galaxy," team member Ilaria Caiazzo, assistant professor at the Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA), said in a statement.
paras.zh: “恒星爆炸的可靠历史记录只能追溯到大约一千年前。据我们所知，在我们银河系的黑暗中很可能仍然潜伏着类似的遗迹，”团队成员、奥地利科学技术研究所（ISTA）助理教授伊拉里亚·卡亚佐（Ilaria Caiazzo）在一份声明中说。

paras.en: "Today, we are lucky to study an intriguing object we know was observed by astronomers who made three independent historical records of the event centuries before the invention of the telescope."
paras.zh: “今天，我们很幸运地研究了一个有趣的物体，我们知道天文学家在望远镜发明几个世纪之前就观察到了这一事件的三项独立历史记录。”

paras.en: Pa 30 is a good laboratory to study supernovas because, at around 7,500 light-years away, it is relatively close to Earth on cosmic scales. For instance, the heart of our galaxy is around 26,000 light-years away. "We can see this much detail because of Pa 30's proximity to Earth," said Caiazzo. "This proximity makes Pa 30 uniquely valuable for study."
paras.zh: Pa 30 是研究超新星的一个很好的实验室，因为它距地球约 7,500 光年，在宇宙尺度上与地球相对较近。例如，我们银河系的中心距离我们大约 26,000 光年。卡亚佐说：“由于 Pa 30 距离地球很近，我们可以看到这么多细节。” “这种邻近性使得 Pa 30 具有独特的研究价值。”

paras.en: It is also an important subject of study because it is the only supernova remnant in which we can see a zombie star.
paras.zh: 它也是一个重要的研究课题，因为它是我们可以看到僵尸星的唯一超新星遗迹。

paras.en: Using the Gemini North telescope, Caiazzo and colleagues zoomed in on Pa 30, discovering knots along the strands of gas radiating out from the site of the cosmic explosion, like pearls on a string.
paras.zh: Caiazzo 和同事使用双子座北望远镜放大了 Pa 30，发现了从宇宙爆炸现场辐射出来的气体束上的结，就像绳子上的珍珠一样。

paras.en: These pearls are each wide enough to encompass the orbit of Neptune, the most distant planet from the sun, ten times over.
paras.zh: 这些珍珠每颗的宽度都足以包围海王星（距离太阳最远的行星）的轨道十倍以上。

paras.en: "The planetary region of our solar system could fit in each knot about ten times with room to spare," said Caiazzo. "The knots are quite strikingly uniform. We are excited to try to model them."
paras.zh: 卡亚佐说：“我们太阳系的行星区域可以容纳每个结大约十次，并且还有剩余空间。” “这些结非常均匀。我们很高兴尝试对它们进行建模。”

paras.en: The team also discovered that the zombie star sits almost perfectly at the heart of Pa 30. When these cosmic explosions happen, they should provide any debris, including zombie stars, with a kick. The fact that this "living dead" star still sits dead center of this wreckage suggests that when this explosion happened, it was roughly symmetrical and the kick was relatively light.
paras.zh: 研究小组还发现，僵尸恒星几乎完美地位于 Pa 30 的中心。当这些宇宙爆炸发生时，它们应该会向包括僵尸恒星在内的任何碎片提供冲击力。事实上，这颗“活死人”恒星仍然位于残骸的正中心，这表明当这次爆炸发生时，它大致是对称的，并且冲击力相对较轻。

paras.en: "Explosions conserve momentum. If the explosion itself was perfectly symmetric, the ejecta should also be symmetric, and the surviving star should not receive a substantial kick," Caiazzo said. "We were able to measure a precise upper limit of the remnant star's transverse kick speed, showing that it was surprisingly small. We practically don't see the star moving away at all."
paras.zh: 卡亚佐说：“爆炸会守恒动量。如果爆炸本身是完全对称的，那么喷射物也应该是对称的，幸存的恒星不应该受到实质性的冲击。” “我们能够测量残余恒星横向踢速度的精确上限，表明它小得惊人。我们实际上根本没有看到恒星移动。”

paras.en: While there are still many mysteries surrounding Pa 30 and its zombie occupant, one of the most exciting prospects emerging from this research is the possibility it will help identify the wreckage of other Type Iax supernovas in our galaxy.
paras.zh: 虽然围绕 Pa 30 及其僵尸居住者仍有许多谜团，但这项研究出现的最令人兴奋的前景之一是，它将有助于识别我们银河系中其他 Iax 型超新星的残骸。

paras.en: "While we can see Type Iax supernovas in distant galaxies as point sources of light, resolving the remnants of such explosions is only possible in our own galaxy and in very few nearby ones," Caiazzo concluded. "Eventually, we plan to use Pa 30's distinctive properties to search the Milky Way and nearby galaxies for similar objects."
paras.zh: 卡亚佐总结道：“虽然我们可以在遥远的星系中看到 Iax 型超新星作为点光源，但只有在我们自己的星系和极少数附近的星系中才能解决此类爆炸的残留物。” “最终，我们计划利用 Pa 30 的独特特性在银河系和附近星系中搜索类似的天体。”

paras.en: The team's research was published in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

paras.en: Robert Lea is a science journalist in the U.K. whose articles have been published in Physics World, New Scientist, Astronomy Magazine, All About Space, Newsweek and ZME Science. He also writes about science communication for Elsevier and the European Journal of Physics. Rob holds a bachelor of science degree in physics and astronomy from the U.K.’s Open University. Follow him on Twitter @sciencef1rst.
paras.zh: 罗伯特·李 (Robert Lea) 是一位英国科学记者，其文章发表在《物理世界》、《新科学家》、《天文学杂志》、《All About Space》、《新闻周刊》和《ZME Science》上。他还为爱思唯尔和《欧洲物理学杂志》撰写有关科学传播的文章。 Rob 拥有英国开放大学物理和天文学理学学士学位。在 Twitter 上关注他@sciencef1rst。

articles.title: How 'spacewalking' underwater made me feel like I was really in space
articles.author: Michaela Musilova

paras.en: I was breathing just fine through my life support systems, but I kept feeling an urge to double check that everything was ok with my "spacesuit" before heading out on this "spacewalk." I have worn many different types of spacesuits on Earth during my career, but for the first time in my life, I knew that I couldn’t just stop to breathe the air outside if there were an emergency. That's because I was underwater.
paras.zh: 我通过我的生命支持系统呼吸得很好，但在开始这次“太空行走”之前，我一直有一种冲动要仔细检查我的“宇航服”是否一切正常。在我的职业生涯中，我在地球上穿过许多不同类型的宇航服，但这是我一生中第一次知道，如果出现紧急情况，我不能停下来呼吸外面的空气。那是因为我在水下。

paras.en: On this excursion, I was leading a simulated space mission underwater called SEA STAR. My "spacesuit" was actually scuba diving gear, and the simulated spacewalks, or EVAs (Extra-Vehicular Activities), included outings where we explored underwater environments. Being underwater, if we encountered a major problem with our gear, we would have had to treat it as seriously as if we were astronauts on the International Space Station. There was no immediate "out." This was serious.
paras.zh: 在这次旅行中，我领导了一项名为“SEA STAR”的水下模拟太空任务。我的“太空服”实际上是水肺潜水装备，模拟太空行走或 EVA（舱外活动）包括我们探索水下环境的郊游。在水下，如果我们的装备遇到重大问题，我们必须像国际空间站上的宇航员一样认真对待。没有立即“出局”。这很严重。

paras.en: Before this underwater mission, I had worked as the commander of nearly 40 analog missions that simulated crewed missions to the moon and Mars. The goal of these types of missions is to test what living and working in lunar or Martian environments might be like. We study everything from the psychology of living in extreme conditions, or in isolation, to the technology that astronauts might use to complete those missions successfully.
paras.zh: 在这次水下任务之前，我曾担任近 40 个模拟载人月球和火星任务的模拟任务的指挥官。此类任务的目标是测试在月球或火星环境中生活和工作的情况。我们研究一切，从极端条件下或与世隔绝的生活心理学，到宇航员成功完成这些任务可能使用的技术。

paras.en: Testing spacesuit technology is also an important part of these analog space missions. These suits are usually a much simpler version of the ones astronauts use in space, which can weigh around 310 pounds (141 kilograms) when fully equipped with life support systems.
paras.zh: 测试宇航服技术也是这些模拟太空任务的重要组成部分。这些宇航服通常是宇航员在太空中使用的宇航服的简单版本，在完全配备生命支持系统时重约 310 磅（141 公斤）。

paras.en: Analog spacesuits usually weigh a maximum of 30 pounds (14 kg). While there are many differences between suits designed for use in space and these suits designed for testing on Earth, the biggest one is that, on an analog mission, crew members can open their helmets and breathe the outside air if necessary.
paras.zh: 模拟宇航服的最大重量通常为 30 磅（14 公斤）。虽然专为太空使用而设计的宇航服与为地球测试而设计的宇航服之间存在许多差异，但最大的区别是，在模拟任务中，机组人员可以在必要时打开头盔并呼吸外部空气。

paras.en: Astronauts in space don’t have that advantage. But neither do aquanauts, those performing a simulated space mission underwater.
paras.zh: 太空中的宇航员没有这种优势。但潜水员也没有，他们在水下执行模拟太空任务。

paras.en: Aquanauts spend at least 24 hours underwater in a so-called state of saturation. That’s a physiological condition achieved by a person who breathes underwater long enough for the body’s tissues to absorb the maximum possible amount of inert gas (like nitrogen), for a specific depth and pressure.
paras.zh: 潜水员至少 24 小时在水下处于所谓的饱和状态。这是一个人在水下呼吸足够长的时间以使身体组织在特定深度和压力下吸收最大可能量的惰性气体（如氮气）所达到的生理条件。

paras.en: Water leaking into our suits or into our underwater habitat can pose serious risks for the crew, as well as health problems related to the higher pressures underwater, amongst other challenges unique to this environment.
paras.zh: 水渗入我们的防护服或水下栖息地可能会给船员带来严重的风险，以及与水下较高压力相关的健康问题，以及该环境特有的其他挑战。

paras.en: This is what pushed me to be extra thorough, and perhaps even a bit paranoid, when preparing for my scuba diving "spacewalks." While scuba diving, the dangers of your equipment failing or decompression sickness can be as lethal as some of the difficulties astronauts face during their spacewalks. That’s why we follow strict protocols when preparing to go on underwater EVAs and during the outings themselves.
paras.zh: 这促使我在准备水肺潜水“太空行走”时更加彻底，甚至可能有点偏执。在水肺潜水时，设备故障或减压病的危险可能与宇航员在太空行走中面临的一些困难一样致命。这就是为什么我们在准备进行水下 EVA 和外出活动时遵循严格的协议。

paras.en: As an experienced scuba diver, I wasn’t concerned with the scuba diving aspect of the mission itself. In many ways, it was much easier than some dives in pitch black water I performed in the open ocean or cave dives. But for these EVAs, I was more on edge because I was the Commander of the SEA STAR crew living 22 feet (7 meters) underwater in the station, called the Jules’ Undersea Lab, in Florida. Being responsible for other people’s lives made me extra cautious and also more worried than usual when diving.
paras.zh: 作为一名经验丰富的水肺潜水员，我并不关心任务本身的水肺潜水方面。在很多方面，这比我在公海中进行的一些漆黑水域潜水或洞穴潜水要容易得多。但对于这些 EVA，我更加紧张，因为我是 SEA STAR 船员的指挥官，住在佛罗里达州朱尔斯海底实验室水下 22 英尺（7 米）的空间站中。对他人生命负责让我在潜水时比平时更加​​谨慎，也更加担心。

paras.en: Despite the many challenges of these underwater EVAs, these experiences and lessons learned can teach us a lot about what we still need to improve for future long-duration space missions.
paras.zh: 尽管这些水下舱外活动面临许多挑战，但这些经验和教训可以教会我们很多关于未来长期太空任务仍需要改进的地方。

paras.en: Our aquanaut "spacesuits" were essentially the same as scuba gear, with the exception of two important accessories that aren’t always necessary for normal dives. Those were gloves and flashlights. We needed the gloves as protection from a number of factors in the environment around us, like barnacles and other sharp natural formations. They also made using cameras and vacuums for environmental cleaning underwater more challenging, which was a good approximation for how gloves limit astronauts’ dexterity during spacewalks.
paras.zh: 我们的潜水员“宇航服”本质上与水肺潜水装备相同，但两个重要配件除外，这两个配件对于正常潜水来说并不总是必需的。那些是手套和手电筒。我们需要手套来保护我们免受周围环境中的许多因素的影响，例如藤壶和其他尖锐的自然构造。它们还使使用相机和真空吸尘器进行水下环境清洁变得更具挑战性，这很好地模拟了手套如何限制宇航员在太空行走时的灵活性。

paras.en: The underwater environment around us had very low visibility, which is why the flashlights were a mandatory component of our EVAs. They helped us to navigate through the darkness and find each other. Even still, with just the small flash of light we could only see a couple of feet ahead of us. That is why it was also vital that we worked together and moved side-by-side.
paras.zh: 我们周围的水下环境能见度非常低，这就是为什么手电筒是我们的 EVA 的必备组件。他们帮助我们穿越黑暗并找到彼此。即使如此，仅凭着微弱的闪光，我们也只能看到前方几英尺的地方。这就是为什么我们共同努力、并肩前进也至关重要。

paras.en: Good communication skills were another crucial component of our underwater simulated space mission. Before each EVA, we prepared a plan, talked about backup plans and went over emergency procedures. During the EVA, we used standard scuba diving sign language to communicate, and we created some new mission-specific signals as well. This visual communication is very useful during simulated space missions on land, too, especially in situations when our communications technologies have not worked properly.
paras.zh: 良好的沟通技巧是我们水下模拟太空任务的另一个重要组成部分。在每次 EVA 之前，我们都会准备一份计划，讨论备用计划并讨论应急程序。在舱外活动期间，我们使用标准水肺潜水手语进行交流，并且还创建了一些新的特定任务信号。这种视觉通信在陆地模拟太空任务中也非常有用，特别是在我们的通信技术无法正常工作的情况下。

paras.en: No matter how much we prepared, though, the fear of the unknown and of getting lost can still get to a crew. A common safety protocol when diving is to safely return to the surface if you get lost or separated from your team and cannot find them. However, during the SEA STAR mission, we planned on staying underwater for the full five-day duration of our mission. That meant that such an option was out of the question, except of course in emergency scenarios.
paras.zh: 然而，无论我们准备得多么充分，对未知和迷路的恐惧仍然会影响到船员。潜水时常见的安全协议是，如果您迷路或与团队失散并且找不到他们，请安全返回水面。然而，在 SEA STAR 任务期间，我们计划在整个任务期间呆在水下五天。这意味着这样的选择是不可能的，当然除非是在紧急情况下。

paras.en: Personally, I enjoyed the challenge of the low visibility in new terrain. It allowed me to hone my orientation and navigation skills, as well as my abilities as a leader in challenging environments. Though I was more vigilant than I perhaps needed to be, once I dove out of our submerged station, I went straight into my favorite mode: exploration. Despite not being able to see very much ahead of me, and all while keeping a watchful eye on my crewmembers, I finally truly felt like an astronaut on a spacewalk. Darkness was all around me, but my determination and curiosity propelled me toward exploring the unknown.
paras.zh: 就我个人而言，我喜欢在新地形中低能见度的挑战。它让我磨练了我的定位和导航技能，以及在充满挑战的环境中作为领导者的能力。尽管我比我需要的更加警惕，但一旦我跳出水下空间站，我就直接进入了我最喜欢的模式：探索。尽管看不清前方，并且一直密切关注我的机组人员，但我终于真正感觉自己像一名在太空行走的宇航员。黑暗笼罩着我，但我的决心和好奇心驱使我去探索未知。

paras.en: You can follow Dr. Michaela Musilova at her website and on social media: @astro_michaela (Instagram, TikTok and Threads), @Dr. Michaela Musilova (Facebook) and @astro-michaela.bsky.social (Bluesky).
paras.zh: 您可以在 Michaela Musilova 博士的网站和社交媒体上关注她：@astro_michaela（Instagram、TikTok 和 Threads）、@Dr. Michaela Musilova (Facebook) 和@astro-michaela.bsky.social (Bluesky)。

paras.en: Dr. Michaela Musilova is an award-winning astrobiologist, explorer, professional speaker and author. Michaela has been conducting space-related research at institutions around the world, including NASA, ESA, CalTech, the Canada-France-Hawaii telescope and many others. She was the Commander of 40 simulated missions to the Moon and Mars — the most missions led to date.
paras.zh: 米凯拉·穆西洛娃 (Michaela Musilova) 博士是一位屡获殊荣的天体生物学家、探险家、专业演讲家和作家。米凯拉一直在世界各地的机构进行与太空相关的研究，包括美国宇航局、欧洲航天局、加州理工学院、加拿大-法国-夏威夷望远镜等。她是 40 次月球和火星模拟任务的指挥官，这是迄今为止执行次数最多的任务。

articles.title: Space Nuclear Power Corporation Awarded DARPA Agreement for Ground Test of Autonomous Nuclear Reactor Controller
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M. — October 21, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes) announced today that the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) has awarded the company an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under the Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program. Managed by Dr. Tabitha Dodson in DARPA’s Defense Sciences Office, the Fat Cat program seeks to advance autonomous reactor operation for national security missions. The contract supports development and ground testing of advanced reactor control technologies that extend the demonstrated capability of American nuclear power.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯 — 2026 年 10 月 21 日 — 太空核电公司 (SpaceNukes) 今天宣布，国防高级研究计划局 (DARPA) 已根据快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划授予该公司一份其他交易协议 (OTA)。 Fat Cat 项目由 DARPA 国防科学办公室的 Tabitha Dodson 博士管理，旨在推进国家安全任务的自主反应堆运行。该合同支持先进反应堆控制技术的开发和地面测试，以扩展美国核电的展示能力。

paras.en: The award extends a continuous line of nuclear power development and builds directly on SpaceNukes’ successful nuclear power demonstration heritage. In 2018, key members of the SpaceNukes team, while employed by Los Alamos National Laboratory and NASA, performed the foundational Kilopower Reactor Using Stirling Technology (KRUSTY) work — conducting the only full-power ground test of a new American space reactor in five decades. Under the current agreement, SpaceNukes and Los Alamos National Laboratory will design, build, and conduct a follow-on nuclear ground test of a Kilopower reactor incorporating active control rod operation—an advancement beyond the passively controlled architecture demonstrated in the 2018 KRUSTY test.
paras.zh: 该奖项延伸了核电开发的连续路线，并直接建立在 SpaceNukes 成功的核电示范遗产之上。 2018 年，SpaceNukes 团队的主要成员在受雇于洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室和 NASA 的同时，进行了使用斯特林技术的千功率反应堆 (KRUSTY) 的基础工作——对美国新型太空反应堆进行了 5 年来唯一的全功率地面测试。根据目前的协议，SpaceNukes 和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室将设计、建造并进行后续的 Kilopower 反应堆核地面测试，该反应堆采用主动控制棒操作，这是超越 2018 年 KRUSTY 测试中展示的被动控制架构的进步。

paras.en: “This award recognizes the maturity and continuity of the team that designed, built, and tested KRUSTY in 2018,” said Patrick McClure, COO of SpaceNukes. “We are proud to work alongside Dr. Dodson and Los Alamos National Laboratory to deliver the next demonstrated step in American nuclear power.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席运营官帕特里克·麦克卢尔 (Patrick McClure) 表示：“该奖项是对 2018 年设计、建造和测试 KRUSTY 团队的成熟度和连续性的认可。” “我们很自豪能够与多德森博士和洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室合作，在美国核电领域迈出下一步。”

paras.en: The phased program structure includes design, procurement, and integration gates leading to the ground demonstration, producing both nuclear-tested hardware and the engineering basis for autonomous, actively-controlled reactor operation. Integration work will be conducted at SpaceNukes’ workshop in Medina, Ohio, led by Chief Engineer Marc Gibson. The work positions American industry to provide reliable nuclear power across a broader range of mission profiles, including those requiring dynamic power management and rapid response under varying operational conditions.
paras.zh: 分阶段的计划结构包括设计、采购和集成，直至地面演示，生产核试验硬件和自主、主动控制反应堆运行的工程基础。集成工作将在 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的车间进行，由总工程师 Marc Gibson 领导。这项工作使美国工业界能够在更广泛的任务范围内提供可靠的核电，包括那些需要动态电力管理和在不同操作条件下快速响应的任务。

paras.en: “There is no substitute for demonstrated technology when American national security objectives are at stake,” said Andy Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “This award lets us advance the work begun in the KRUSTY program and bring another tested capability forward for the nation.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安迪·菲尔普斯 (Andy Phelps) 表示：“当美国国家安全目标受到威胁时，已证实的技术是无可替代的。” “这个奖项让我们能够推进 KRUSTY 计划中开始的工作，并为国家带来另一种经过考验的能力。”

paras.en: About Space Nuclear Power Corporation (SpaceNukes)
paras.zh: 关于太空核电公司（SpaceNukes）

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corporation was founded on the belief that nuclear power is essential to our future, both on Earth and in space. The company’s goal is to enable the successful deployment of fission reactors in space. SpaceNukes brings together the core engineering and program management team behind the foundational KRUSTY demonstration in 2018. David Poston (CTO) and Patrick McClure (COO) performed this work at Los Alamos National Laboratory; Marc Gibson (Chief Engineer) led the program at NASA Glenn Research Center. The team is joined by Omar Mireles (formerly NASA Marshall Space Flight Center) and Andy Phelps (CEO). SpaceNukes holds a license from Los Alamos National Laboratory for the Kilopower technology and operates from headquarters in Los Alamos, New Mexico, and workshops in Los Alamos with additive 3D printing and in Medina, Ohio, with thermal and vacuum capabilities.
paras.zh: 太空核电公司的成立基于这样的信念：核电对我们的未来至关重要，无论是在地球上还是在太空中。该公司的目标是在太空成功部署裂变反应堆。 SpaceNukes 汇集了 2018 年 KRUSTY 基础演示背后的核心工程和项目管理团队。David Poston（首席技术官）和 Patrick McClure（首席运营官）在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室执行了这项工作；马克·吉布森（首席工程师）在美国宇航局格伦研究中心领导了该项目。该团队由 Omar Mireles（前 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心）和 Andy Phelps（首席执行官）加入。 SpaceNukes 持有洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的 Kilopower 技术许可证，总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，在洛斯阿拉莫斯设有增材 3D 打印车间，在俄亥俄州麦地那设有热力和真空能力的车间。

articles.title: Nov. 5: Satellite Mission Management at the Edge
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: Satellite operations are growing more complex. For national security missions, that means faster decisionmaking, greater resilience and the ability to adapt on orbit is needed. Today’s operators must modernize mission management, integrate new technologies and deliver capabilities without compromising security, reliability or operational control.
paras.zh: 卫星操作变得越来越复杂。对于国家安全任务来说，这意味着需要更快的决策、更强的弹性和在轨道上的适应能力。当今的运营商必须在不影响安全性、可靠性或运营控制的情况下实现任务管理现代化、集成新技术并提供功能。

paras.en: Join SpaceNews and RTX on Nov. 5 for a virtual event exploring how emerging technologies and commercial capabilities are transforming satellite operations and enabling more dynamic, resilient and affordable national security space missions.
paras.zh: 11 月 5 日与 SpaceNews 和 RTX 一起参加虚拟活动，探讨新兴技术和商业能力如何改变卫星运营并实现更具活力、更有弹性和负担得起的国家安全太空任务。

paras.en: Speakers will discuss advances in mission management, edge computing, automation and cloud-native architectures, as well as the challenges of integrating new capabilities with legacy systems. The conversation will examine how modular approaches can accelerate technology upgrades, strengthen mission assurance and improve affordability.
paras.zh: 演讲者将讨论任务管理、边缘计算、自动化和云原生架构方面的进步，以及将新功能与遗留系统集成的挑战。对话将探讨模块化方法如何加速技术升级、加强任务保证并提高可承受性。

articles.title: Ukrainian startup, GomSpace test satellite for future communications network
articles.author: Sandra Erwin

paras.en: WASHINGTON — A Ukrainian defense technology company and a Danish satellite manufacturer have begun operating an experimental communications satellite in orbit.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——一家乌克兰国防技术公司和一家丹麦卫星制造商已经开始在轨道上运行一颗实验通信卫星。

paras.en: Ukrainian startup Himera and Denmark’s GomSpace said Oct. 27 that their Obria Nano satellite, launched Oct. 1 aboard the SpaceX Transporter-18 rideshare mission, is undergoing tests. The companies plan to design a constellation that would provide communications coverage across Ukraine.
paras.zh: 乌克兰初创公司 Himera 和丹麦 GomSpace 于 10 月 27 日表示，他们的 Obria Nano 卫星于 10 月 1 日搭载 SpaceX Transporter-18 拼车任务发射，目前正在进行测试。两家公司计划设计一个星座，为整个乌克兰提供通信覆盖。

paras.en: The project is one of at least two European-backed initiatives aimed at giving Ukraine greater control over satellite communications, following disruptions this month to SpaceX’s Starlink and Starshield services that affected Ukrainian military operations.
paras.zh: 该项目是至少两项欧洲支持的举措之一，旨在让乌克兰更好地控制卫星通信，本月 SpaceX 的 Starlink 和 Starshield 服务中断，影响了乌克兰的军事行动。

paras.en: The announcement comes five days after Finnish satellite manufacturer Iceye and telecommunications equipment maker Nokia signed a letter of intent with Ukraine’s Defense Ministry to explore developing a sovereign broadband satellite communications network.
paras.zh: 五天前，芬兰卫星制造商 Iceye 和电信设备制造商诺基亚与乌克兰国防部签署了一份意向书，探讨开发主权宽带卫星通信网络。

paras.en: Ukraine has relied heavily on SpaceX’s satellite services for battlefield communications since Russia’s invasion in 2022. The services have become essential to military command networks, drone operations and communications in areas where terrestrial infrastructure has been destroyed or disrupted.
paras.zh: 自俄罗斯 2022 年入侵乌克兰以来，乌克兰一直严重依赖 SpaceX 的卫星服务进行战场通信。这些服务对于地面基础设施遭到破坏或中断的地区的军事指挥网络、无人机操作和通信至关重要。

paras.en: But restrictions imposed in mid-October limited satellite connectivity, interfering with Ukrainian drone operations, including efforts to intercept Russian attack drones.
paras.zh: 但十月中旬实施的限制限制了卫星连接，干扰了乌克兰无人机的行动，包括拦截俄罗斯攻击无人机的努力。

paras.en: Ukraine said Oct. 24 that Starlink and Starshield services had returned to normal operating speeds. The disruptions prompted a dispute over responsibility, with SpaceX chief executive Elon Musk and U.S. officials offering conflicting explanations about who had authorized the limits.
paras.zh: 乌克兰10月24日表示，星链和星盾服务已恢复正常运行速度。这些干扰引发了责任纠纷，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克和美国官员对于谁授权了这些限制给出了相互矛盾的解释。

paras.en: Himera and GomSpace said the Obria Nano project is intended to establish a communications system under Ukrainian control, with plans eventually to manufacture satellites and ground terminals domestically.
paras.zh: Himera 和 GomSpace 表示，Obria Nano 项目旨在建立乌克兰控制下的通信系统，并计划最终在国内制造卫星和地面终端。

paras.en: “For us, this project is about more than launching a satellite. It is an opportunity to lay the foundation for an independent communications network for Ukraine,” said Misha Rudominski, Himera’s co-founder and chief executive.
paras.zh: Himera 联合创始人兼首席执行官 Misha Rudominski 表示：“对我们来说，这个项目不仅仅是发射一颗卫星。这是一个为乌克兰独立通信网络奠定基础的机会。”

paras.en: “We are starting by testing technologies in orbit, while our long-term goal is to develop capabilities that will strengthen the country’s strategic security and reduce dependence on external communications providers,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们首先在轨道上测试技术，而我们的长期目标是发展加强国家战略安全并减少对外部通信提供商的依赖的能力。”

paras.en: Himera, founded in 2022, develops secure tactical radio systems for military forces, including equipment designed to operate in environments affected by electronic warfare.
paras.zh: Himera 成立于 2022 年，为军队开发安全战术无线电系统，包括设计用于在受电子战影响的环境中运行的设备。

paras.en: GomSpace, headquartered in Aalborg, Denmark, manufactures small satellites, communications payloads and spacecraft subsystems.
paras.zh: GomSpace 总部位于丹麦奥尔堡，生产小型卫星、通信有效载荷和航天器子系统。

paras.en: The companies said Obria Nano is operating in orbit and undergoing testing that will inform the design of a constellation. They did not disclose the satellite’s specifications, communications capacity, project financing or the number of satellites envisioned for the network.
paras.zh: 两家公司表示，Obria Nano 正在轨道上运行并正在进行测试，这将为星座的设计提供信息。他们没有透露卫星的规格、通信能力、项目融资或网络中设想的卫星数量。

paras.en: Neither European initiative is expected to replace Starlink’s extensive global network. Smaller national constellations could provide dedicated communications for selected military operations while supplementing commercial services.
paras.zh: 预计这两项欧洲举措都不会取代星链广泛的全球网络。较小的国家星座可以为选定的军事行动提供专用通信，同时补充商业服务。

articles.title: NASA Invites Media to Crew Completion of Yearlong Mars Simulation
articles.author: Lauren E. Low

paras.en: The four volunteers who lived and worked in a simulated NASA Mars mission for more than a year will exit their habitat on Saturday, Oct. 31, after 378 days of isolation in a facility at the agency’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. Health and performance data collected from the simulation can help NASA develop methods to counter human spaceflight risks for future Artemis and Moon Base missions.
paras.zh: 在模拟 NASA 火星任务中生活和工作了一年多的四名志愿者将在 NASA 休斯敦约翰逊航天中心的设施中隔离 378 天后，于 10 月 31 日星期六离开他们的栖息地。从模拟中收集的健康和性能数据可以帮助美国宇航局开发方法来应对未来阿耳忒弥斯和月球基地任务的载人航天风险。

paras.en: Beginning at 3 p.m. EDT, NASA will provide live coverage of the volunteers’ departure from the Crew Health and Performance Exploration Analog (CHAPEA, pronounced cha-pea’-ah) mission habitat. The exit ceremony will be streamed on NASA Johnson’s YouTube and social accounts.
paras.zh: 下午 3 点开始美国东部时间，美国宇航局将现场报道志愿者离开船员健康和绩效探索模拟（CHAPEA，发音为 cha-pea’-ah）任务栖息地的情况。退出仪式将在 NASA Johnson 的 YouTube 和社交账户上进行直播。

paras.en: Johnson Center Director Vanessa Wyche and NASA astronaut Jack Hathaway will provide remarks. The CHAPEA crew members Ross Elder, Ellen Ellis, James Spicer, and Matthew Montgomery also will provide remarks.
paras.zh: 约翰逊中心主任凡妮莎·威奇和美国宇航局宇航员杰克·海瑟薇将发表讲话。 CHAPEA 船员罗斯·埃尔德、艾伦·埃利斯、詹姆斯·斯派塞和马修·蒙哥马利也将发表讲话。

paras.en: Media are invited to watch the CHAPEA Mission 2 ceremony live at NASA Johnson on a screen outside the hangar holding the CHAPEA facility, after which a subject matter expert will be available in person to answer questions. Media will have the opportunity to capture the moment the crew exits the building, stepping outside for the first time in more than a year.
paras.zh: 媒体受邀在 NASA 约翰逊中心的 CHAPEA 设施机库外的屏幕上现场观看 CHAPEA 任务 2 仪式，之后将有主题专家亲自回答问题。媒体将有机会捕捉到工作人员离开大楼的那一刻，这是一年多以来首次走出大楼。

paras.en: U.S. media interested in attending the activities in person, or media interested in speaking virtually with the CHAPEA Mission 2 crew members in the days following completion of their mission, must contact the NASA Johnson newsroom no later than 2 p.m., Friday, Oct. 30, at jsc-newsroom@mail.nasa.gov.
paras.zh: 有兴趣亲自参加这些活动的美国媒体，或有兴趣在任务完成后几天内与 CHAPEA Mission 2 机组人员进行虚拟交谈的媒体，必须在 10 月 30 日星期五下午 2 点之前联系 NASA Johnson 新闻编辑室，邮箱为 jsc-newsroom@mail.nasa.gov。

paras.en: The second CHAPEA mission began on Oct. 19, 2025. Four crew members have lived and worked inside a 3D-printed 1,700-square-foot facility, simulating Mars mission operations, conducting simulated spacewalks, exercising, performing habitat maintenance, growing plants, and more, while operating under stressors that future deep space crews will likely experience. These included communication delays, resource limitations, and isolation.
paras.zh: 第二次 CHAPEA 任务于 2025 年 10 月 19 日开始。四名宇航员在一个 1,700 平方英尺的 3D 打印设施内生活和工作，模拟火星任务操作、进行模拟太空行走、锻炼、进行栖息地维护、种植植物等，同时在未来深空宇航员可能会经历的压力下进行操作。其中包括通信延迟、资源限制和隔离。

paras.en: Data from the mission can aid preparation for NASA’s lunar missions by optimizing food system design, efficient use of crew time, bandwidth on NASA’s Deep Space Network, and other aspects of living in deep space. In addition, data can help flight doctors and psychologists strengthen spaceflight medical care and behavioral support practices to ensure crew readiness and performance.
paras.zh: 该任务的数据可以通过优化食品系统设计、有效利用机组人员时间、美国宇航局深空网络带宽以及深空生活的其他方面，帮助为美国宇航局月球任务做好准备。此外，数据还可以帮助飞行医生和心理学家加强航天医疗护理和行为支持实践，以确保机组人员的准备状态和表现。

paras.en: To learn more about NASA’s CHAPEA mission, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关 NASA CHAPEA 任务的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: The Land of the Standing-Up Rocks

paras.en: Some 27 million years ago, a volcano in what's now southeastern Arizona unleashed a spectacular series of eruptions, strewing more than 1,000 times as much volcanic material across the landscape as Mount St. Helens did in 1980.
paras.zh: 大约 2700 万年前，位于现在亚利桑那州东南部的一座火山爆发了一系列壮观的火山喷发，所喷洒的火山物质数量是 1980 年圣海伦斯火山喷发量的 1000 多倍。

paras.en: The explosive eruptions blanketed the region, part of the Chiricahua Apache Nation’s traditional lands, with ash and pumice. Layered into this were massive pyroclastic flows that hardened into deposits of welded rhyolitic tuff that in some areas were nearly 1,600 feet (500 meters) thick, about three times the height of the Washington Monument. As the magma chamber emptied, the ground above it collapsed, leaving a gaping depression—the Turkey Creek caldera—that was roughly 12 miles (19 kilometers) wide and 4,900 feet (1,500 meters) deep.
paras.zh: 爆炸性的喷发覆盖了该地区，这是奇里卡瓦阿帕奇族传统土地的一部分，火山灰和浮石覆盖了该地区。其中分层的是大量的火山碎屑流，这些火山碎屑流硬化成焊接流纹岩凝灰岩沉积物，在某些地区厚达近 1,600 英尺（500 米），大约是华盛顿纪念碑高度的三倍。当岩浆库排空时，其上方的地面塌陷，留下一个巨大的洼地——土耳其溪火山口——宽约 12 英里（19 公里），深 4,900 英尺（1,500 米）。

paras.en: An array of geologic processes, including erosion and weathering, gradually sculpted the welded layer of tuff into the collection of dramatic spires, hoodoos, and canyons that visitors to the caldera area encounter today.
paras.zh: 包括侵蚀和风化在内的一系列地质过程逐渐将凝灰岩熔接层塑造成如今参观火山口地区的游客所见到的一系列引人注目的尖顶、石林和峡谷。

paras.en: The Apache called the area "The Land of the Standing-Up Rocks" for good reason. Hiking through Rhyolite Canyon or driving through Bonita Canyon means encountering a dizzying maze of rock pinnacles, some hundreds of feet tall. Others, like Big Balanced Rock, have surprisingly large boulders precariously perched on top. Meanwhile, those at Heart of Rocks and Massai Point are gathered into groups of hundreds.
paras.zh: 阿帕奇人将该地区称为“直立岩石之地”是有充分理由的。徒步穿过流纹岩峡谷或开车穿过博尼塔峡谷意味着会遇到令人眼花缭乱的岩石尖峰迷宫，大约有数百英尺高。其他的，比如大平衡岩石，上面有令人惊讶的大巨石摇摇欲坠。与此同时，岩石之心和马赛角的人们聚集成数百人的群体。

paras.en: The area was designated a national monument in 1924 to preserve its remarkable geology. In October 2026, it was redesignated as Chiricahua National Park (pronounced cheery-cow-ah). The OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 9 captured this cloud-free image of the new national park on July 2, 2026.
paras.zh: 1924 年，该地区被指定为国家纪念碑，以保护其非凡的地质。 2026 年 10 月，它被重新指定为奇里卡瓦国家公园（发音为 Chery-cow-ah）。 Landsat 9 上的 OLI（运营陆地成像仪）于 2026 年 7 月 2 日拍摄到了这张新国家公园的无云图像。

paras.en: Individual rock spires are too small to distinguish, but the eroding rhyolitic tuff landscape appears gray. Stream valleys dense with trees and other vegetation, including Rhyolite Canyon and Bonita Canyon, snake across the landscape. With four biogeographic regions converging in the park—the Sonoran Desert, the Chihuahuan Desert, the Rocky Mountains, and the Sierra Madre—it is a haven of plant diversity.
paras.zh: 单个岩石尖顶太小而无法区分，但侵蚀的流纹岩凝灰岩景观呈现出灰色。溪谷茂密，树木和其他植被茂密，包括流纹岩峡谷和博尼塔峡谷，蜿蜒穿过整个景观。公园内汇聚了四个生物地理区域——索诺兰沙漠、奇瓦瓦沙漠、落基山脉和马德雷山脉——这里是植物多样性的天堂。

paras.en: Among the 1,000 species growing within the park's varied desert, grassland, chaparral, deciduous forest, and coniferous forest ecosystems are agaves, prickly pear cacti, yuccas, manzanita, pine, fir, cypress, sycamore, juniper, and oak. The park's location within the Chiricahua Mountains puts it among several "sky islands" in Arizona—isolated mountain ranges that emerge from the surrounding desert "sea." According to the National Park Service, the range's highest point (outside the park) rises 2,986 meters (9,795 feet) above sea level, more than 1,800 meters above the surrounding valley.
paras.zh: 公园内的各种沙漠、草原、丛林、落叶林和针叶林生态系统中生长着 1,000 种植物，其中包括龙舌兰、仙人掌、丝兰、曼萨尼塔、松树、冷杉、柏树、悬铃木、杜松和橡树。该公园位于奇里卡瓦山脉内，位于亚利桑那州的几个“天空岛屿”之中，这些岛屿是从周围的沙漠“海洋”中升起的孤立山脉。据国家公园管理局称，该山脉的最高点（公园外）海拔 2,986 米（9,795 英尺），比周围山谷高出 1,800 多米。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory image by Lauren Dauphin, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Story by Adam Voiland.
paras.zh: NASA Earth Observatory image by Lauren Dauphin, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey.亚当·沃伊兰的故事。

articles.title: Curiosity Blog, Sols 5043-5049: Preparing to Drill at ‘Nazca’

paras.en: Written by Lucy Lim, Planetary Scientist at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center
paras.zh: 作者：Lucy Lim，美国宇航局戈达德太空飞行中心的行星科学家

paras.en: Earth planning date: Friday, Oct. 16, 2026
paras.zh: 地球规划日期：2026 年 10 月 16 日星期五

paras.en: Following the Basque Lakes drill campaign, Curiosity has returned to a spot just a few meters away from the "Chiu Chiu" block to conduct our next drill campaign. "Chiu Chiu" itself wasn't a good candidate for drilling but the block just beyond it was much more promising, so it became our drive target during Monday's planning. I was on planning Friday as Geology and Mineralogy Science Theme Lead when we received our close-up views of the neighbor block from the post-drive imaging and our team was happy to see that it was jam-packed with the "disc- and needle-" shaped lumps, just like "Chiu Chiu." We quickly gave the science go-ahead to proceed with preparations for drilling at the newly named "Nazca" site.
paras.zh: 巴斯克湖演习结束后，好奇号返回距离“Chiu Chiu”区块仅数米的地点，进行下一次演习。 “Chiu Chiu”本身并不是一个很好的钻探候选地，但它后面的区块更有希望，因此它成为我们周一计划中的驱动目标。当我作为地质学和矿物学科学主题负责人计划周五时，我们从驾驶后成像中收到了邻近区块的特写视图，我们的团队很高兴看到它挤满了“盘状和针状”形状的肿块，就像“Chiu Chiu”一样。我们很快就批准了在新命名的“纳斯卡”地点进行钻探的准备工作。

paras.en: One major hypothesis about how the "discs and needles" texture formed is that the characteristic shapes were originally created during the growth of crystals, or "crystal forms." Minerals will tend to grow into specific shapes depending on their microscopic crystal structure, similar to the salt crystals that you can grow in your kitchen as a home science project. (Maybe you have grown one of those for a science class in school!) The relatively large sizes of the crystal forms at "Nazca" and "Chiu Chiu" are providing clues about the temperature at the time when they grew and the availability of salts and fluids. However, we can't necessarily assume that the modern-day composition represents the original mineral because sometimes mineral crystals are replaced by other minerals some time after original crystallization. The new minerals are then known as "pseudomorphs" because they have the same shape as the first minerals but not the same composition or molecular structure.
paras.zh: 关于“盘状和针状”纹理如何形成的一个主要假设是，特征形状最初是在晶体或“晶体形式”生长过程中形成的。矿物质往往会根据其微观晶体结构生长成特定的形状，类似于您可以在厨房中作为家庭科学项目生长的盐晶体。 （也许你已经在学校的科学课上种植了其中一个！）“纳斯卡”和“Chiu Chiu”中相对较大的晶体形态提供了有关它们生长时的温度以及盐和液体的可用性的线索。然而，我们不一定假设现代的成分代表原始矿物，因为有时矿物晶体在原始结晶后一段时间会被其他矿物取代。新矿物被称为“假晶”，因为它们具有与第一种矿物相同的形状，但成分或分子结构不同。

paras.en: As we prepared for the drill preload test, we also planned several special observations aimed at highly detailed characterization of the crystal forms. MAHLI will execute a Quantitative Relief Model ("QRM") observation consisting of five overlapping images at slightly different geometries. The combination of these will enable a detailed three-dimensional relief model to be constructed. In addition, MAHLI will also add extra frames to its highest-resolution imaging by doubling the number of focus mechanism steps. Together, these observations will increase the resolution of the 3D models we will have of the crystal forms.
paras.zh: 当我们准备钻头预紧测试时，我们还计划了几次专门观察，旨在对晶体形态进行高度详细的表征。 MAHLI 将执行定量浮雕模型（“QRM”）观测，该观测由五个几何形状略有不同的重叠图像组成。这些的结合将能够构建详细的三维浮雕模型。此外，MAHLI 还将通过将对焦机制步骤数量加倍来为其最高分辨率成像添加额外帧。总之，这些观察结果将提高我们所获得的晶型 3D 模型的分辨率。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the ChemCam LIBS will conduct a "depth profile" experiment to obtain compositional information from slightly deeper layers within a nearby crystal-form-rich target, "Toucan". Normally the 150 LIBS laser shots from each sol's observation are spaced out over a five-point raster at 30 shots per point, but this time we are concentrating all 150 laser shots on the same spot on the rock. Since each laser shot vaporizes a very small amount of the rock to form a plasma, the 150-shot profile should penetrate approximately five times deeper than a normal 30-shot point observation. We will thus be able to observe the composition deeper inside the exposed crystal form and see whether it's different from the surface-level composition. There are several reasons this could be the case including exposure of the surface to the modern Martian environment and also the circumstances in which the crystal form developed originally, so it's an experiment worth pursuing.
paras.zh: 与此同时，ChemCam LIBS 将进行“深度剖面”实验，以从附近晶体形态丰富的目标“Toucan”内稍深的层中获取成分信息。通常情况下，每个溶胶观测的 150 次 LIBS 激光发射分布在一个五点光栅上，每点 30 次发射，但这次我们将所有 150 次激光发射集中在岩石上的同一点上。由于每次激光发射都会蒸发极少量的岩石以形成等离子体，因此 150 次发射的剖面应该比正常的 30 次发射点观测的穿透深度大约五倍。因此，我们将能够观察暴露晶体形态内部更深处的成分，并查看它是否与表面成分不同。造成这种情况的原因有多种，包括表面暴露在现代火星环境中，以及晶体最初形成的环境，所以这是一个值得进行的实验。

paras.en: The LIBS, DRT and APXS will also be applied to the "Nazca" spot before the preload test to characterize its surface composition as thoroughly as possible before drilling. The third LIBS of the plan will go to "Condor," a nearby block in which a finely layered texture is exposed.
paras.zh: LIBS、DRT 和 APXS 还将在预载测试之前应用于“纳斯卡”点，以便在钻孔前尽可能彻底地表征其表面成分。该计划的第三个 LIBS 将前往“Condor”，这是附近的一个街区，其中暴露出精细的分层纹理。

paras.en: We also continued to observe the modern Martian environment as twilight cloud season begins. In this plan we included some nighttime imaging of the larger and brighter of Mars' two satellites, Phobos. Capturing images of Phobos and the nearby sky when Phobos is full can show sunlight reflecting off the moon and scattering in the Martian atmosphere, providing a good way to estimate the particle sizes in the Martian clouds. We can do similar measurements sometimes with solar observations, but the Phobos data allow us to measure cloud particle sizes later in the night. We expect to be measuring high-altitude carbon dioxide (CO2) clouds in this observation.
paras.zh: 随着暮云季节的开始，我们还继续观察现代火星环境。在这个计划中，我们对火星的两颗卫星火卫一中较大、较亮的卫星进行了一些夜间成像。当火卫一满时捕捉火卫一和附近天空的图像可以显示阳光从月球反射并在火星大气中散射，这提供了估计火星云中颗粒大小的好方法。有时我们可以通过太阳观测进行类似的测量，但火卫一的数据使我们能够在夜间测量云颗粒的大小。我们期望在这次观测中测量高空二氧化碳（CO2）云。

articles.title: Security Council LIVE: Women and girls face greater dangers in war

paras.en: Security Council LIVE: Women and girls face greater dangers in war
paras.zh: 安理会直播：妇女和女童在战争中面临更大危险

paras.en: From Gaza to Yemen, women and girls are facing ever greater dangers this year simply surviving in war zones. The Security Council meets Tuesday to debate the best way to improve security for women caught up in conflict.
paras.zh: 从加沙到也门，妇女和女孩今年在战区生存面临着更大的危险。安理会周二举行会议，讨论改善陷入冲突的妇女安全的最佳方式。

paras.en: - War is growing deadlier for women and girls, according to the UN Secretary-General’s annual report
paras.zh: - 根据联合国秘书长的年度报告，战争对妇女和女孩造成的死亡越来越严重

paras.en: - Women and girls accounted for one in four of the more than 37,000 civilians killed in armed conflict last year – double the figure in 2021
paras.zh: - 去年在武装冲突中丧生的 37,000 多名平民中，妇女和女童占四分之一 - 2021 年这一数字将翻倍

paras.en: - At least 25 women and girls are killed every day in conflict settings
paras.zh: - 每天至少有 25 名妇女和女童在冲突环境中被杀害

paras.en: - Some 750 million women and girls now live within 50 kilometres of an active conflict, 40 million more than in 2024 and more than at any time since 1990
paras.zh: - 目前约有 7.5 亿妇女和女童生活在冲突激烈的 50 公里范围内，比 2024 年增加了 4000 万，比 1990 年以来的任何时候都多

paras.en: - As civilian deaths mount, sexual violence is surging
paras.zh: - 随着平民死亡人数增加，性暴力激增

paras.en: - Women continue to be largely shut out of peace talks
paras.zh: - 妇女仍然基本上被排除在和平谈判之外

articles.title: Gaza: Families brace for fourth winter in tents as aid operations remain stymied

paras.en: Gaza: Families brace for fourth winter in tents as aid operations remain stymied
paras.zh: 加沙：援助行动仍受阻，各家各户在帐篷里准备迎接第四个冬天

paras.en: Families in Gaza are bracing for a fourth winter in tents and makeshift shelters as UN aid operations face mounting obstacles, with transport suspended on Tuesday due to Israel’s closure of the key Kerem Shalom crossing for election day.
paras.zh: 由于联合国援助行动面临越来越多的障碍，加沙的家庭正在帐篷和临时避难所中准备迎接第四个冬天，由于以色列在选举日关闭关键的凯雷姆沙洛姆过境点，周二交通暂停。

paras.en: The UN project services agency in the field (UNOPS) reported three incidents affecting its convoys and premises over three consecutive days in the past week alone.
paras.zh: 联合国实地项目服务机构 (UNOPS) 仅在过去一周就连续三天报告了三起影响其车队和房舍的事件。

paras.en: Executive Director Jorge Moreira da Silva said these included close-proximity explosions, drivers detained at checkpoints, and multiple small-arms rounds striking one of the procurement agency’s guesthouses.
paras.zh: 执行董事豪尔赫·莫雷拉·达席尔瓦表示，这些事件包括近距离爆炸、司机在检查站被拘留，以及多发小型武器袭击采购机构的一间宾馆。

paras.en: The safety of UNOPS staff has been compromised too many times, he said, stressing that all parties to the fighting in Gaza must uphold their obligations to protect civilians and humanitarian personnel.
paras.zh: 他说，项目署工作人员的安全已经多次受到损害，并强调加沙战斗各方必须履行保护平民和人道主义人员的义务。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Secretary-General António Guterres continues to express his deep alarm over the intensifying violence in the West Bank as an Israeli offensive in Hebron continues.
paras.zh: 与此同时，随着以色列在希伯伦的攻势继续，秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯继续对西岸暴力加剧深表震惊。

paras.en: Associate Spokesperson Daniela Gross told journalists at the daily briefing in New York that the UN chief is following the situation there closely.
paras.zh: 副发言人丹妮拉·格罗斯在纽约举行的每日新闻发布会上告诉记者，联合国秘书长正在密切关注那里的局势。

paras.en: “He is deeply alarmed for this offensive…the intensifying violence in the West Bank. He condemns the violence. And he also firmly opposed the settler attacks in the region.”
paras.zh: “他对这次攻势……西岸不断加剧的暴力行为深感震惊。他谴责暴力行为。他还坚决反对该地区定居者的袭击。”

paras.en: Between January 2025 and the end of September 2026, 331 Palestinians, including 77 children, were killed in the West Bank, and more than 42,000 have been displaced, according to the UN aid coordination office. OCHA. Over the same period, 21 Israelis were killed in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 据联合国援助协调办公室称，2025年1月至2026年9月底，包括77名儿童在内的331名巴勒斯坦人在西岸被杀，超过42,000人流离失所。人道协调厅。同一时期，21 名以色列人在约旦河西岸被杀。

paras.en: OCHA also recorded 3,684 attacks by Israeli settlers during the period that resulted in casualties or property damage.
paras.zh: 人道协调厅还记录了以色列定居者在此期间发动的 3,684 次袭击，造成人员伤亡或财产损失。

paras.en: Despite restrictions and funding shortfalls, the UN and its partners continue to bring limited supplies into Gaza. On Monday, UN teams brought in food, blankets, winter clothes, school items and fuel, according to OCHA.
paras.zh: 尽管存在限制和资金短缺，联合国及其合作伙伴仍继续向加沙提供有限的物资。据人道协调厅称，周一，联合国工作组带来了食物、毯子、冬衣、学习用品和燃料。

paras.en: Over the past week, partners distributed school bags to more than 8,000 children. The week before, they provided stationery to about 22,000 boys and girls and furnished some 300 classrooms supporting around 60,000 children.
paras.zh: 过去一周，合作伙伴向 8000 多名儿童分发了书包。前一周，他们为大约 22,000 名男孩和女孩提供了文具，并为大约 60,000 名儿童提供了大约 300 间教室。

paras.en: Many families are living in deteriorating tents and shelters with little protection from the cold, wind and rain. Around 950,000 people are living in displacement sites at medium to high risk of flooding, and stocks of supplies to support them are insufficient, a shelter assessment found.
paras.zh: 许多家庭住在破旧的帐篷和避难所里，几乎无法抵御寒冷、风雨。一项住房评估发现，约有 95 万人生活在面临中度至高度洪水风险的流离失所地点，而支持他们的物资库存不足。

paras.en: Also on Tuesday, Francesca Albanese, the UN Special Rapporteur on the situation of human rights in the Palestinian territory occupied, briefed journalists virtually on her latest report, which focuses on the media.
paras.zh: 同样在周二，联合国巴勒斯坦被占领土人权状况特别报告员弗朗西斯卡·阿尔巴内塞以虚拟方式向记者介绍了她最新的报告，该报告重点关注媒体。

paras.en: She reminded reporters that she was unable to attend in person because of sanctions imposed on her by the United States.
paras.zh: 她提醒记者，由于美国对她实施制裁，她无法亲自出席。

paras.en: According to Ms. Albanese, nearly 300 journalists and media workers have been killed in Gaza, citing UN sources, and more than 100 have been detained, many of them tortured.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯女士援引联合国消息称，近 300 名记者和媒体工作者在加沙被杀，100 多人被拘留，其中许多人遭受酷刑。

paras.en: Some 150 media centres and offices – 80 per cent of Gaza’s media infrastructure – have been destroyed, she said, while in the West Bank more than 139 attacks on journalists have recently been recorded.
paras.zh: 她说，约 150 个媒体中心和办公室（占加沙媒体基础设施的 80%）已被摧毁，而在西岸，最近记录了超过 139 起针对记者的袭击事件。

paras.en: She also criticized Israel’s ban on foreign journalists entering Gaza and said there had been no accountability for the killing of Palestinian journalist Shireen Abu Akleh.
paras.zh: 她还批评以色列禁止外国记者进入加沙，并表示没有对巴勒斯坦记者希琳·阿布·阿克莱被杀负责。

paras.en: Her report also documents intimidation and repression of Palestinian journalists by Hamas in Gaza and the Palestinian Authority in the West Bank, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，她的报告还记录了加沙哈马斯和约旦河西岸巴勒斯坦权力机构对巴勒斯坦记者的恐吓和镇压。

articles.title: General Assembly weighs US embargo against Cuba ahead of 34th vote

paras.en: General Assembly weighs US embargo against Cuba ahead of 34th vote
paras.zh: 大会在第34次投票前权衡美国对古巴的禁运

paras.en: The General Assembly opened its annual debate on the US economic embargo against Cuba on Tuesday. On Wednesday, 28 October, Member States will vote for the 34th time on a resolution calling for it to end.
paras.zh: 联合国大会周二就美国对古巴经济封锁展开年度辩论。 10 月 28 日星期三，会员国将第 34 次投票表决一项要求结束该协议的决议。

paras.en: Every year at around this time, the assembly – where each of the UN’s 193 Member States has one vote – takes up the “necessity of ending the economic, commercial and financial embargo imposed by the United States of America against Cuba”.
paras.zh: 每年大约这个时候，联合国 193 个会员国每个成员国都拥有一票的大会就会讨论“结束美利坚合众国对古巴的经济、商业和金融封锁的必要性”。

paras.en: And every year, whatever the political climate, the issue generates plenty of diplomatic heat. The debate usually spills over two days as countries and regional groups take the floor to explain their positions.
paras.zh: 每年，无论政治气候如何，这个问题都会引发大量外交热议。辩论通常会持续两天，各国和地区组织都会发言解释其立场。

paras.en: The assembly has called for an end to the embargo, first imposed in 1960, on 33 previous occasions.
paras.zh: 大会此前曾 33 次呼吁终止 1960 年首次实施的禁运。

paras.en: Support has grown markedly since the first vote in 1992, when 59 countries backed the resolution, three opposed it, 71 abstained and 46 did not vote.
paras.zh: 自1992年第一次投票以来，支持率显着增加，当时有59个国家支持该决议，3个国家反对，71个国家弃权，46个国家没有投票。

paras.en: It peaked at 191 votes in favour in 2015, 2016 and 2017, during the thaw in relations under US President Barack Obama. The United States and Israel voted against in 2015 and 2017; in 2016, both abstained.
paras.zh: 2015年、2016年和2017年，美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)领导下两国关系解冻期间，该票数达到峰值191票赞成。美国和以色列在2015年和2017年投了反对票； 2016年，两人都投了弃权票。

paras.en: Some countries have shifted position as governments have changed, but many have held the same line for decades. Canada, China and Russia have long voted in favour, while the United States, backed by Israel, has voted against every year bar one.
paras.zh: 一些国家随着政府的更迭而改变了立场，但许多国家几十年来一直坚持同样的路线。加拿大、中国和俄罗斯长期以来一直投赞成票，而以色列支持的美国每年都投反对票，只有一次。

paras.en: This year’s debate comes as the Trump administration has tightened the embargo – a move that has led to an energy crisis and possible humanitarian collapse, according to the UN Resident Coordinator in Cuba, Francisco Pichon.
paras.zh: 联合国驻古巴协调员弗朗西斯科·皮雄表示，今年的辩论正值特朗普政府收紧禁运之际，此举导致了能源危机，并可能导致人道主义崩溃。

paras.en: The World Health Organization (WHO) has also warned that energy shortages are taking a toll on health.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）也警告说，能源短缺正在对健康造成损害。

paras.en: In May, senior UN officials reported that more than 100,000 surgical procedures had been postponed. Cuban authorities have repeatedly pointed to further damage to the health system, including delays to vaccination programmes and patients with chronic illnesses unable to get a stable supply of medicines.
paras.zh: 5 月，联合国高级官员报告称，超过 10 万例外科手术已被推迟。古巴当局一再指出卫生系统受到进一步损害，包括疫苗接种计划的延误以及慢性病患者无法获得稳定的药品供应。

paras.en: This year, President Donald Trump has also raised the possibility of military intervention in Cuba.
paras.zh: 今年，唐纳德·特朗普总统还提出了对古巴进行军事干预的可能性。

paras.en: Successive UN High Commissioners for Human Rights and independent UN experts have condemned the embargo and other unilateral US sanctions, warning that they threaten Cubans’ rights to health, life, food and development.
paras.zh: 历任联合国人权事务高级专员和联合国独立专家均谴责美国的禁运和其他单方面制裁，警告称它们威胁到古巴人的健康权、生命权、食物权和发展权。

paras.en: Those tensions were on display in the chamber on Tuesday when Cuba’s Foreign Minister, Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla, interrupted the US Ambassador, Mike Waltz, on a point of order midway through his statement.
paras.zh: 周二，当古巴外交部长布鲁诺·罗德里格斯·帕里利亚(Bruno Rodríguez Parrilla)在美国大使迈克·瓦尔兹(Mike Waltz)就程序问题发言时打断了他的发言时，这种紧张局势在会议厅中得到了体现。

paras.en: The exchange escalated into a heated row between the two, prompting the President of the General Assembly to briefly suspend the session. The debate later resumed without further incident.
paras.zh: 两人之间的交锋升级为激烈争吵，促使大会主席暂时休会。辩论随后继续进行，没有发生进一步事件。

paras.en: Mr. Waltz rejected the premise of the debate, arguing that Cuba’s crisis was the fault of its own government, not the embargo.
paras.zh: 瓦尔兹拒绝了这场辩论的前提，他认为古巴的危机是古巴政府的错，而不是禁运的错。

paras.en: “There is no blockade,” he said. If there were, he argued, there would be no explaining US exports to Cuba – which he put at more than $876 million in the first eight months of 2026 – or shipments from Canada, Spain, Mexico, China, Russia, the European Union and UN agencies.
paras.zh: “没有封锁，”他说。他认为，如果有的话，就无法解释美国对古巴的出口（他预计 2026 年前 8 个月的出口额超过 8.76 亿美元）或来自加拿大、西班牙、墨西哥、中国、俄罗斯、欧盟和联合国机构的出口。

paras.en: The country’s wealth had not vanished, he said, but had “simply” passed from ordinary Cubans into the hands of the ruling elite.
paras.zh: 他说，国家的财富并没有消失，只是“简单地”从普通古巴人转移到了统治精英的手中。

paras.en: Mr. Rodríguez is due to deliver his statement on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯先生定于周三发表声明。

paras.en: As in previous years, the Cuban-drafted text reaffirms the sovereign equality of States and the principles of non-intervention and non-interference in their internal affairs, as well as freedom of international trade and navigation – all enshrined in numerous international legal instruments.
paras.zh: 与往年一样，古巴起草的案文重申了各国主权平等、不干预和不干预其内政的原则以及国际贸易和航行自由 — — 所有这些都载入了众多国际法律文书中。

paras.en: It also voices concern over laws such as the Helms-Burton Act, enacted by the United States on 12 March 1996, whose extraterritorial effects, it says, undermine the sovereignty of other States, the legitimate interests of people and entities under their jurisdiction and freedom of trade and navigation.
paras.zh: 它还对美国 1996 年 3 月 12 日颁布的《赫尔姆斯-伯顿法案》等法律表示关切，该法案的域外效力损害了其他国家的主权、其管辖下的人民和实体的合法利益以及贸易和航行自由。

paras.en: It calls on all States to refrain from adopting such measures and urges those that still apply them to repeal them.
paras.zh: 它呼吁所有国家不要采取此类措施，并敦促仍在实施这些措施的国家废除这些措施。

articles.title: Mekies reveals widespread interest in Red Bull engine amid Aston Martin rumours

paras.en: Laurent Mekies reveals 'attention from F1 teams' in Red Bull-Ford Powertrains power unit amid Aston Martin rumours
paras.zh: 劳伦特·梅基斯 (Laurent Mekies) 透露，在阿斯顿·马丁 (Aston Martin) 传言中，红牛-福特动力总成动力装置受到“F1 车队的关注”

paras.en: The Red Bull-Ford Powertrains power unit has been very competitive in 2026, so could they supply more teams in the future, including Aston Martin? Watch every session of the Mexico City GP from this Friday, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 红牛-福特动力总成动力装置在2026年已经非常有竞争力，那么他们未来是否可以为包括阿斯顿·马丁在内的更多车队提供动力？从本周五开始，天空体育 F1 直播墨西哥城大奖赛的每一场比赛

paras.en: Red Bull boss Laurent Mekies has admitted there has been attention from "a lot of teams" about his outfit's power unit performance.
paras.zh: 红牛主帅洛朗·梅基斯承认，“很多车队”都在关注他的车队的动力装置性能。

paras.en: Earlier this year, the FIA deemed Red Bull to have the strongest engine, a contentious decision given Mercedes were granted an upgrade as they were more than two per cent behind Red Bull's internal combustion engine performance.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，国际汽联认为红牛拥有最强的发动机，这一决定颇具争议，因为梅赛德斯获得了升级，因为他们的内燃机性能落后红牛超过百分之二。

paras.en: This year is the first season Red Bull, in collaboration with Ford, have built their own power unit which very few people expected to be competitive in 2026.
paras.zh: 今年是红牛与福特合作打造自己动力装置的第一个赛季，很少有人预计它能在 2026 年具有竞争力。

paras.en: - How Antonelli can win world title at Mexico City GP on Sunday

paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: It is a contrast to the lack of performance in Aston Martin's Honda power unit which has left Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll mostly fighting towards the rear of the grid.
paras.zh: 这与阿斯顿·马丁本田动力装置表现不佳形成鲜明对比，后者导致费尔南多·阿隆索和兰斯·斯特罗尔大多在发车区的后方奋战。

paras.en: There have been rumours that Aston Martin were looking into their future with Honda and even the possibility of taking a Red Bull-Ford power unit.
paras.zh: 有传言称阿斯顿·马丁正在考虑与本田的未来，甚至考虑采用红牛-福特动力装置的可能性。

paras.en: "We got a lot of unwanted positive publicity about the performance of our engine, and that came with certainly attentions from a lot of teams," said Mekies.
paras.zh: “我们的引擎性能得到了很多不必要的积极宣传，这当然也引起了很多团队的关注，”梅基斯说。

paras.en: "Are we having any serious conversations with anyone to supply another team? No, we don't think we are ready for that. Is it set in stone for the next five years? No, because I don't know what's going to happen in the next five years.
paras.zh: “我们是否正在与任何人进行认真的对话以提供另一支球队？不，我们认为我们还没有为此做好准备。未来五年的计划是否已经确定？不，因为我不知道未来五年会发生什么。

paras.en: "We still have plenty of work to do to improve the power unit, refine its integration into the car and reach the level of the top competitors. Only then can we consider supplying another team alongside Racing Bulls. Nothing will change over the next year or so."
paras.zh: “我们还有大量工作要做，以改进动力装置，完善其与赛车的集成，并达到顶级竞争对手的水平。只有这样，我们才能考虑为公牛队提供另一支车队。在未来一年左右的时间里，一切都不会改变。”

paras.en: Mekies says the Red Bull-Ford Powertrains programme have done a "phenomenal job" after launching from "zero" in 2021 to build a competitive power unit in their first F1 season.
paras.zh: 梅基斯表示，红牛-福特动力总成项目自 2021 年从“零”开始启动以来，已经取得了“非凡的工作”，为他们的第一个 F1 赛季打造了一个具有竞争力的动力装置。

paras.en: "People realise it's a very good engine. However, we have our feet on the ground. We think it's better to concentrate on Red Bull and Racing Bulls," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “人们意识到这是一款非常好的发动机。然而，我们脚踏实地。我们认为最好专注于红牛和赛牛队，”他告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "We are, at the moment, you may see the cars on track running smoothly but the reality is it's days and nights, very hard work for everyone back at Milton Keynes to keep the teams in a reasonable condition to run.
paras.zh: “目前，你可能会看到赛道上的赛车平稳运行，但现实是米尔顿凯恩斯的每个人都日以继夜地努力工作，以保持车队处于合理的运行状态。

paras.en: "It's still the first year with all these challenges, so in the near future we will concentrate on these two teams."
paras.zh: “这仍然是面临所有这些挑战的第一年，所以在不久的将来我们将专注于这两支球队。”

paras.en: Newey: A lot of promise in new Honda projects
paras.zh: 纽维：本田新项目充满希望

paras.en: Aston Martin have scored just seven points this season and are 10th in the Constructors' Championship, although Fernando Alonso says the team were on course for their best race yet on Sunday in Austin, if not for contact with Williams' Alex Albon.
paras.zh: 阿斯顿·马丁本赛季仅获得 7 分，在车队锦标赛中排名第 10，尽管费尔南多·阿隆索表示，如果不是与威廉姆斯车队的亚历克斯·阿尔本接触，车队有望在周日奥斯汀的比赛中迎来迄今为止最好的比赛。

paras.en: Team principal Adrian Newey says Honda's deficit is "fairly clear" but is encouraged by new developments by the Japanese engine manufacturer.
paras.zh: 车队领队阿德里安·纽维 (Adrian Newey) 表示，本田的赤字“相当明显”，但日本发动机制造商的新发展令人鼓舞。

paras.en: "Honda - there's a lot of energy and projects on the way now that perhaps are in their early stages of development, but we see a lot of promise from those," he said.
paras.zh: “本田 - 现在有很多精力和项目正在进行中，可能正处于开发的早期阶段，但我们看到了很多希望，”他说。

paras.en: "Too early to comment on exactly where the PU will be at the start of the season and whether then, assuming it's allowed under the PUAC [Power Unit Advisory Committee], there will be further development for what will be race eight at the end of the first period."
paras.zh: “现在评论 PU 在赛季开始时的具体位置以及假设 PUAC（动力单元咨询委员会）允许的话，第一阶段结束时的第八场比赛是否会有进一步的进展，目前还无法发表评论。”

paras.en: Honda's struggles are reminiscent of their turbo-hybrid partnership with McLaren between 2015 and 2017 - a period where they never had a competitive engine.
paras.zh: 本田的困境让人想起他们在 2015 年至 2017 年间与迈凯伦的涡轮混合动力合作伙伴关系——在这段时期，他们从未拥有过具有竞争力的发动机。

paras.en: McLaren and Honda parted ways at the end of 2017, with Honda supplying Toro Rosso, now called Racing Bulls, from 2018 and Red Bull from 2019.
paras.zh: 迈凯伦和本田于 2017 年底分道扬镳，本田从 2018 年开始向红牛二队（现在称为 Racing Bulls）供应，从 2019 年开始向红牛供应。

paras.en: In their first season with Red Bull, Honda scored a podium in the season-opener and Max Verstappen won three races.
paras.zh: 在红牛的第一个赛季，本田在赛季揭幕战中登上领奖台，马克斯·维斯塔潘赢得了三场比赛。

paras.en: Newey said: "At the moment, in all truth, Honda are a little bit behind where Red Bull, as the works team, Red Bull, picked up Honda in 2019. But that obviously was four seasons after they first came back in 2015. So, this is the first year back in.
paras.zh: 纽维说：“事实上，目前本田有点落后于红牛，作为车队，红牛，在 2019 年接手了本田。但这显然是他们在 2015 年首次回归之后的四个赛季。所以，这是回归的第一年。”

paras.en: "They are a great company. I have every confidence that they will accelerate quickly and understand the problems of these particular PU regulations."
paras.zh: “他们是一家伟大的公司。我完全相信他们会迅速加速并理解这些特殊 PU 法规的问题。”

articles.title: Big foot, Bane & Bo's Broncos - Inside Denver's 5,280ft sporting empire

paras.en: Bo Nix's Broncos, Bane and Big Foot - Inside the Denver sporting empire luring fans 5,280ft in the clouds
paras.zh: 博尼克斯的野马队、贝恩队和大脚队 - 深入丹佛体育帝国，在 5,280 英尺的云端吸引球迷

paras.en: Visit Denver hosted Sky Sports in Colorado to see what fans can expect from one of the biggest and most famous sporting hubs in the United States; watch the Denver Broncos host the Kansas City Chiefs, live on Sky Sports NFL from 9.25pm on Sunday

paras.en: They call it the Rocky Mountain Thunder. The stadium-shuddering racket reverberated by Denver Broncos fans stomping their feet on the metal decks of their old Mile High Stadium.
paras.zh: 他们称之为落基山雷霆。丹佛野马队球迷在旧英里高体育场的金属甲板上跺脚，回响着令人颤抖的球拍声。

paras.en: It would become a storied intimidation tactic that has since translated across to their current home Empower Field, but perhaps too an unwritten cheat code to thousands 'getting their steps in', given all I would come to learn of this fitness-enthused Mountain West metropolis.
paras.zh: 这将成为一种传奇的恐吓策略，后来被应用到了他们现在的家乡 Empower Field，但考虑到我对这座热衷于健身的西部山区大都市的了解，也许对成千上万的人来说，这也是一种不成文的作弊代码。

paras.en: Here was your proverbial protein shake of Colorado goodness, unbridled escapism and blood-pumping self-care flexing in the clouds some 5,280ft above sea level, as if detached from the rest of the nation. They breathe a little differently here, operate a little differently, attack sport a little differently.
paras.zh: 这是众所周知的科罗拉多州的蛋白质奶昔，无拘无束的逃避现实和令人血脉喷张的自我保健，在海拔约 5,280 英尺的云层中弯曲，仿佛与这个国家的其他地方分离。他们在这里的呼吸方式略有不同，运作方式也略有不同，进攻运动也略有不同。

paras.en: The city is serene and soothing in accordance with its neighbouring nature, and yet its sporting disciples deafening. From its mountainous backdrop to its rich variety of wildlife, Denver is a laptop screensaver picture of tranquillity. From its sunrise joggers to its rock-scaling climbers, it is a breeding ground for adrenaline and activity. And between its seven major league sports teams, it is a cauldron of intense, ever-expanding fandom.
paras.zh: 这座城市与周围的自然环境相得益彰，宁静而舒缓，但其运动爱好者却震耳欲聋。从多山的背景到丰富多样的野生动物，丹佛就像笔记本电脑屏幕上一幅宁静的画卷。从日出慢跑者到攀岩攀岩者，这里是肾上腺素和活动的滋生地。在其七支大联盟运动队之间，它是一个充满激烈且不断扩大的球迷群体的大熔炉。

paras.en: Welcome to Mile High, where an early awakening at the Limelight hotel (fuelled by some jet-lag) would kickstart my stay with a stunning sunrise view over Union Station, around which bustled coffee-grabbers, job-goers and worm-catching early birds.
paras.zh: 欢迎来到 Mile High，在 Limelight 酒店（由于时差的影响）我早早起床，欣赏联合车站令人惊叹的日出景色，周围是熙熙攘攘的喝咖啡的人、上班族和早起的鸟儿。
